comments: I stayed in the apartment for two weeks with my wife and daughter. The apartment was as described in the listing and as shown in the photos, comfortable and uncluttered. The neighborhood is densely populated but quiet. Simona was responsive and informative throughout the entire transaction period, with a clear and pleasant communication style.

Don't pass this one by. If you're visiting Zurich and would like a perfectly comfortable and central accommodation this is the place. Simona is very friendly and easy to communicate with. The apartment is perfectly clean as seen in the pictures and is a great example of a large and cozy Swiss apartment. If it's still available, book now.

Lucas is a great host! He makes one feel very welcome,its like arriving home. the apartment is perfectly situated in a great new trendy area and is well connected to any place one could wish to go. The stunning view from the rooftop terrace is the perfect place to end a great day with a glass of wine and just relax. I can only recommend this place to stay and am looking forward to rent it again when I am back in Zurich.

Everything was as advertised and it was a great stay. The outdoor space is very nice and there is even an extra kitchen up there. Quick access to the trains which were very convenient. We were there on the tail end of a heatwave and since very few have AC it was nice that there were at least lots of windows and shutters to keep it cool, and fans were provided. Would definitely recommend.

Despite the Fact that the Location is Superb , close to all you need to see and Do in Zurich, the apartment needs some reconditioning. Floor is really noisy, bed is declining on one side, bathroom has Mold. If these matters get fixed for sure i would recommend someone to stay 100%.

This place is even more charming in person! We really loved the location. It was easy to walk or take the tram everywhere we wanted. Lots of places for coffee and food nearby, but the kitchen also has everything you need. Beds were comfortable, shower worked great, everything was clean. We would definitely stay here again.

we liked everything space, location , cleanliness and facility.very near to Zurich HB and just below the house you get public transportation no 31 bus to reach HB in 5 min. Very neat and clean , spacious rooms I Will recommend everyone to go for this if available :). Just a tip..Texi is way costly in this town. Opt if no option left.always check for public transportation which is very very nice and highly available around the city. Thanks Manmohan

The HIT apartment was quite nice and conveniently located, with easy access, and it comfortably accomodated our family of four. However during our stay we hade high summer temperatures and there was no AC in the apartment. For that reason we hade to run noisy floor fans during the evening and night, and keep windows open during the evening. Unfortunately there was a fair amount of traffic outside and the noise was too high to keep windows open after bedtime.

The apartment is located in the centre of Zurich and it is very near to restaurants, shops and historical centre. The apartment is clean and contains moderately equipped kitchen, bathroom and living room. However, in the night it is little noisy at night from the busy street and the parking house is nearby, but expensive.

The studio was very clean and had everything we needed. Stephanie was very helpful and her instructions were clear. The location is amazing. The only downside was the smell of fried chicken from the restaurant underneath. However, it wasn’t a deal breaker and we would stay there again. Would recommend.

A very clean appartment despite the mild up slope when nearing the window area. Nothing to fault at. We are lucky our appartment having the washer and that's very important for us. Appreciate if the appartment having more mirror or long mirror for us to dress up. The only mirror is in the bathroom and it cant view fully because it is blocked by the door. Location perfect. Nearby to supermarkets, main train station, bahnhofstrasse shopping area.. and lot more. Thumbs up!

The apt is located across-above a pub and the noise doesn’t die down until 4-5am. This is only a problem in the summer because you have to keep the window open for ventilation. The apt bldg is located close to all the popular attractions and would definitely recommend it to folks who are looking for convenience of getting around on foot.

Great host very responsive and great house. Please note: The beds are mattresses on the floor (apart from bunk beds) There isn’t any proper plates for food...a couple of small ones and plenty of kids plates. There isn’t a sofa/couch to relax on in the ‘living area’ But the apartment is stunning and in a great location. The above are just minor issues and nothing to deter you from staying here. Very clean, and overall very happy with our stay and our host Anil. Thank you.

This was a great place to stay in Zurich. It is a little out-of-the-way from the core of the city, but the street-car access is a half-block away. It was very convenient. The unit was spacious, comfortable and clean. The hosts provided lots of local information. And while it is on the 3rd floor, there is an elevator! Definitely a good place to stay.
It’s really nice place to stay with family… but the thing is… you need to clean the house by yourself at checkout time. Moreover, it has good facilities and good furniture. I recommend for stay ✌️.

Had the most amazing holiday - Apartment is spacious, clean, modern, brand new and near to everything. A home from home - we will be back. We had a great time. My 3 children enjoyed the playground downstairs and the turkish restaurant below. Anil was always available for any assistance if we needed it. Co-Op and Migros (the local supermarkets) are walking distance, as is the big shopping mall Letzipark. We got to Tobagon down Mount Pilatus - River at Silhwald and swim in the Lake at Mithenquai. Lots to do as the apartment is in the centre of everything. Children loved the bunk bed - there was more than enough space for all of us. Thank you again and we will be back soon!

We had a great time... The apartament was situated in a great location and there was supermarket, main station, restaurants and stores around. The negative point are the stairs to get to the 4th floor where is the apartament. The stairs are tight and its not a short way, so If you have heavy bags, you better be prepared. The bedroom upstairs don´t have a door, just the stairs to separete and the ceiling is very low. I´m sure woth it because of the good location and nice apartment.

The apartment was as pictured in a very convenient part of town, within walking distance to the train station and many of the city's major sights. You could also see the river from the attic bedroom. But note that the apartment is four flights up a very narrow staircase with a low ceiling. The floor is also noticeably not flat, and the attic ceiling is quite low, meaning you have to be stooped almost constantly if you're walking around upstairs. One side has a glass floor/ceiling looking down to the kitchen/living room which means people downstairs can see into the top. However, the location was definitely great.

The apartment is in an excellent location, central and close to central Zurich. Lots of restaurants, bars, and shopping nearby. The apartment itself is unique and charming. The place was clean and secure. We were able to eat in a few nights during our stay. We didn't meet Kim but did meet his wife, Anette, who was very welcoming and gracious. During our stay it was unusually warm in Zurich so the apartment was a bit stuffy but manageable. This is not the norm so it's not a big deal. There is only one issue, the apartment is located in a popular nightlife area so it can be loud at night with the people from the bars. Once the windows are closed, it is no problem. Unfortunately it just wasn't possible with the warm weather during our stay.

Kim’s place is very stylish with lots of character and perfectly located for the Opera House and Old Town. Kim and family were very hospitable and the communication was excellent. Perfect for our winter family get together in Zurich.

Claudios place is simply amazing. The kitchen is not simply well equipped - it’s super equipped and with a style (even grabbed some ideas for the home). The patio is great for spending time, the apartment is super clean! Communication is better than anything I experienced before, Claudio himself is super pleasant person and host who shows you everything at your arrival. Highly recommend if you stay in Zurich!

The location was great. All the local and regional trains were within a 5 minute or less walk and there were restaurants right outside our door. The apartment was clean and had great storage for three peoples luggage (2 adults and one child). If you are a light sleeper or go to bed early this might not be the spot for you, but then any spot in old town would likely have this problem. Noise from the street was pedestrian and died down after dinner hours and extremely quiet in the morning. We are heavy sleepers so it didn't bother us. Train and traffic noise was not a problem. Kitchen was great to cook up finds from the markets and two grocery stores were close by. We loved our stay and had a great time!

The apartment was in a great location. Easy to get to from the airport and close to the shops and restaurants. However, due to its proximity to the nightlife we found it to be quite loud at night. Karina was a great host. Thanks!

Spacious, charming home with a beautiful view of the church esp with the patio balcony. For the most part everything was walking distance to the trams and easy to get to the groceries. We loved that it was very accessible getting in with clear instructions with the lock box. Highly recommend staying here if you plan on visiting Zurich. It was handy having Netflix available and a electric tea kettle to make you feel right at home. The only thing I would mention that it’s on the top floor with no elevator, the top bathroom floor was cute and slanted but if your tall you might hit your head on the beam. The church bell would ring often, but we didn’t mind it. Thank you Leandra for hosting my family’s yearly vacation. We throughly enjoyed our stayed and would definitely come back again. :)

Everything was good during our stay. We arrived a bit earlier than expected, but the apartment was already cleaned. The location is nice, with a supermarket 2 at blocks and some restaurants. We stayed with our cat and we loved the apartment. The location is quiet and safe. The only minor drawbacks: - The church that's in front of the apartment rings the bells every time, even at night, but it seems to be normal in Zürich. - Given the apartment is pet friendly, we were expecting to have a broom and shovel, but it didn't have any of those items.

The apartment was exactly as pictured! It was perfect for a quick solo visit to Zurich. I unfortunately came during a rare heat wave, but luckily there was large fan which was wonderful! I would definitely recommend this spot if you are looking for a convenient location in the heart of the city, there is a lot around that is walkable if you so choose. And I loved that the SBB trains are literally an 8 minute walk from the apartment. I also appreciated knowing from another review that the staircase was narrow and had archways so be sure you can carry whatever you pack and be able to duck down if you are tall 😉.

The place is lovely; I was so grateful to have a fan in the room, considering the outside heat. The apartment perfectly matched the pictures and was tidy. However, I did not receive precise instructions on how to get into the building prior to my arrival. Apart from that, everything was excellent!

Very nice and cosy 1-room apartment. It is located in Niederdorf, only 7 minutes walking distance away from the main station in one direction and 10 minutes from the lake in the other direction. The room is quite modern, the shower is great (although it is located in the entrance area of the room) and the contact was very friendly. Bed linen and bath towels were provided. Thanks very much.

Great little apartment, close to all amenities, supermarkets, bakery and the bus stop to Zurich is only 1 minute away and only takes 10 minutes. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed for our stay. Andrea was a great host and always contactable. We would definitely stay here again.

This flat is perfectly located by Wipkingen station, bus stops and 2 supermarkets as well as a bakery and cash point! The Nordbrucke bar is cosy and welcoming and you have access to the basement washing machine. The Limmat is just a short walk away and just over the footbridge are the design shops in the railway arches of Viadukt and the Migros modern art gallery. It is 2 stops from the airport and so easy to get downtown. There is loads to do nearby as well. We swam in an indoor pool with amazing views and then went for a forest walk on Käferberg on Boxing Day! Andrea is a really helpful host.

Excellent location right in the middle of city centre. The space is small but sufficient for 1 person. The big downside however is the Wi-Fi connection, which was weak and very slow and not good enough to watch a simple YouTube clip or do Skype call - this became quite inconvenient. Room faces southwest so can be quite hot in the summer.

Although there was a last minute change and I did not stay in the apartment in the pictures, overall I would stay there if I’m again by myself in ZH. As the reviews mention the place is very small, even for 1 person, but the location is unbeatable and it has everything you need for a quick trip. Check in and check out extremely easy. Only downside is that I never found the containers to leave the trash and I ended up having to carry a trash bag while rolling my suitcase through downtown Zürich. Perhaps they should think of a dedicated space within the premises to leave it at.

A stunning apartment in a brilliant location. We booked to stay as my husband and a friend were competing in Ironman Zurich and we needed accommodation for 6 people. Violetta and Alvaro could not have been more helpful and friendly and the communication was excellent, nothing was too much trouble. The apartment is gorgeous in a lovely area which is nice and quiet and has a brilliant community atmosphere, the neighbours were very friendly. Getting around the city is easy with the excellent transport system. The apartment was very comfortable and homely and we had everything we needed. I would absolutely book to stay here again, Violetta, Alvaro and their family were on holiday when we stayed so unfortunately we did not get to meet them.

Violetta & Alvaro were very helpful host in general, although we didn't met them in personal however we manage to be in direct contact most of the time; the flat is spacious, clean, well equipped, accessible and comfortable, however we couldn’t find a storage place for our stuff and had to keep them on one of the beds. Neighborhood, I would say that it wasn't what I was expecting, building located within a midlevel residential area, not too much to see around There are restaurants nearby, but not with the level you may enjoy as a tourist. In general it was a good experience, thanks for hospitality of Violrtta & Alvaro

Very nice, small apartment in convenient location. Felix, from the Nordbrucke team met us at the station, and was very helpful showing us in and answering questions. The apartment is newly remodeled as in the pictures, the beds are comfortable, everything is very clean. The kitchen has a stovetop and refridgerator and everything you need to prepare simple meals. Grocery stores are just at the corner and you are right at the Wipkingen station, so can get to/from the hauptbahnhof or the airport very easily. We had a great stay, the only downside was that the apartment still smells of paint. There is some noise from the trains, as they are just below your window, but we did not mind it. It might be harder to live with in the summer if you are used to a quiet environment.

We stayed in Anna's beautiful apartment over the weekend and it was absolutely perfect - it is very central and a 15 min walk or 5 min ride on the tram to the city. It is also very easy to get to from the airport and very well serviced by public transport. The apartment itself is very spacious and spotlessly clean! We would certainly recommend it!

Anna's place is really spacious, well located and great value. The upstairs loft bedroom is amazing :-) It feels very homely, has a lovely atmosphere and has everything you need. I can totally recommend it and will be staying there again on my next visit to Zürich.

I spent more than a month here. The house is located in a residential area, peaceful, green, however Migros/Denner, etc are still close. The house is quite big, really well equipped and a cleaned twice a month or so. Rossana is nice and very helpful. The Parking space is a nice extra - rare to be found in Zurich. I'd recommend the place for anyone planning shorter or longer trips to Zurich

Very nice small apartment! Loved the location: very cool neighborhood, close to public transportation (wipkingen train station and bus station) and grocery stores. They clean te apartment every two weeks, which is really nice. Andrea was very responsive and accommodating with check in and check out times. The only downside was that you could hear the trains from the apartment. It wasn’t a big deal for us, but I could see it being an issue for light sleepers.

The house is super clean and organized. Rossana was really nice and communication was a breeze. The location is a little outside the city center but the area is lovely and public transport is very convenient.

We had a nice apartment, 2 sleeping rooms and one sleeping couch in the living room. It was very clean and with everything you need, meaning kitchen, bathroom, towels... We have booked for 3 nights and the last day decided to stay one more night. I could just recommend this host as well as apartment. It is very well connected with the whole city via public transport and it is not far out at all, you can walk. With two small kids and 2 adults extra, this apartment did fit us perfectly in every way. Contact person was available and very helpful. Thanks for that! Just perfect, that's all! :)

Thank you Jacqueline, we had a very nice stay at you place as the name says paradise on earth. For as it was --> a lot and lot of snow. Which created a magic world like some were fare away, however it was so closed to one of the best city in the world. Despite the heavy snow and cold temperatures your house was beautiful warm and cosy. Thanks for the toboggan my boy will be for ever great full. Markus and Family

The apartment is conveniently located in a great neighborhood with easy access to stores, sites and Everything else. It is spacious, clean and well equipped. The management team is pleasant and very responsive. It was very hot when we stayed due to a heat wave, however, the place was equipped with two fans that worked well. I would recommend this property.

A great place to stay if you want to explore Zurich. It is in a great neighborhood with lots of restaurants and bars, but also well connected to public transportation. However, take care the apartment is a very comfortable place to relax and with two terraces you may chose to explore Zurich from the comfort of home. Gian made coordinating access to the apartment very easy and helpful with questions about Zurich. I would definitely stay there again.

This is a very comfortable, spacious and well located apartment. Lizanne was very responsive to solving any problem she could once we arrived. Cable TV wasn't working so she upped WiFi to unlimited within 30 minutes, so we could stream TV. My only complaint was the noise of cranes, bulldozers etc on massive construction site opposite, building workers said the job will go for a year or two. This may have been noisiest stage, but not sure. And unfortunately Lizanne did not suggest that we might want to get other accommodation until we'd been there for one night, rather than before we arrived, although she did tell us a week before about scaffolding on her building, and the demolition opposite had obviously been going on for a week at least, if not longer.

It was a very nice and cozy house. We stayed very relaxed. The only problem was that it was difficult to connect to Wi-Fi. But Wi-Fi wasn't a problem for a three-day stay. Carrying our luggage by car at the time of departure was very helpful. Thank you very much

Lizanne's place was very close to the lake which was very helpful in the heat. There is no AC or fans. The nights were cool with the windows open. There is an elevator which was helpful to get to Lizanne's place. The bushes are much taller than the pictures show. The number on the building is hidden because of the bushes, but it's very nice. The place is definitely a personal residence that is rented out. There are personal photographs and effects. There was no place to hang my work clothes, but that was the only con. I'd stay here again but not for work.

Very comfy, perfect for what I was looking for, which was a place to stay quiet after a day out. The only thing to mention is that it was a ground floor by the side of a pub, and there is a table by the window that can become noisy on the weekends (until midnight). The place was clean, comfortable, with a place to leave the luggage. The heating is via radiating floors, which makes the winter stay very pleasant. If I am going back to Zurich, I would try to book the same place.

We had a great stay. The balconies were great for morning coffee, The bed was very comfortable, the air conditioning was a huge bonus for sleeping at night, and the neighborhood was very peaceful. We will be back.

Joy is a welcoming and responsive host Arrival and departure are very easy Apartment is very well located, fully equipped and very comfortable Building is pretty, practical and with lift. The private car park at the back of the building is very useful Two balconies with greenery and sunny Living there gives us the impression of perfect Zurich immersion This was our second stay in this apartment and we will come back with pleasure Thank you Joy

This was my first time with airbnb and I am more than satisfied. Nathalie and her daughters were delightful. The central location was excellently connected with public transport (which is unbelievably organized in Zuerich). The room was quiet and well equipped. I shared a bathroom but always found it free when needed. Nathalie was helpful with all the necessary information and left a large selection of informative brochures on the desk, plus (touch of class) a nice bottle of water. The unit was also very sunny and had a wonderful terrace that I unfortunately never could use due to the fact that I was working. Thank you, Nathalie!

Joy is a great host. Her apartment is very cozy and clean. The location is very convenient and close to the city centre, to which you can go just by foot. It's also very comfortable to stay there with a family with kids. Just one thing - there're not many grocery shops nearby. There is a greengrocery on the street, but the rest you can by in the shops which are 10-15 min away. Anyway we enjoyed our vocation there and would like to stay there again one day.

While we never met Joy in person, she was super responsive to questions and made check-in & -out very easy. We did, however, meet Ori, who helped out with getting the postal mail and replaced some bulbs for us; super friendly! The apartment is quite stylish, and the double balcony is a luxury. The quiet corner bar downstairs adds atmosphere, but also a little cigarette smoke if you're keeping the windows open mid-summer. The nearest grocery is open a little later than usual (9pm), and the tram quickly connects you to the rest of the city. If you have little kids, Park Artergut is 5m walk. The adjacent tram line ensures a quick connection to the rest of the city. Our family enjoyed our stay very much.

Allow Joy to welcome you home in Zürich. She offers a spacious two bedroom, two bathroom flat nestled minutes away from the lakefront and the city center. 3rd floor with views across the valley. Lots of mirrors make the space feel even larger. Fully stocked kitchen, bedrooms, and baths. Location offers great options for food shopping and public transport. You’ll come home to a modern European style home that won’t disappoint.

The neighborhood was quiet, so that was nice. The property was conveniently located by a public transport line. The property however needs some maintenance. The light above the bathroom sink did not work, and when we contacted Joy about it she said that the electric outlet did not work. We also asked for kitchen towels which were not provided. We suggest that coffee and filters be provided as a manual drip coffee maker was available. Additionally we suggest to provide guests with city information/maps. The tv did not work.

Nathalie is a wonderful host who gave me many suggestions for what to do in Zurich (and beyond). She and her daughter were very knowledgeable about travel and even asked me to join for dinner. I felt right at home the place was very clean and the view from the room was nice!

Cozy room with bathroom, storage and balcony in a quit neighborhood. Ysabel, Stefan & Moritz (and Blitz) made us feel welcome during our 4 days stay in Zürich. The view from the room is excellent and makes waking up very easy. The breakfast (some days together with the family)) was good and included bread, swiss cheese, jams, butter, Nutella and coffee/milk, juice. A child bed for our little son (1,5 years old) was provided with a good matress. (unfortunately no high chair). All in all a good experience.

Joy's place was great, very convenient, easy to find and very clean! The apartment was perfect for me and my family, plenty of room and the entire experience with Joy was very easy. Joy was very responsive to all of our emails and was a pleasure to work with. If we are ever in Zurich again we will definitely contact Joy! Thanks Joy for making our first trip to Switzerland so memorable. The Brown's

Took 3 nights are to reset after a long few weeks of travel. Was a great place to touch grass and relax. the Views from the room were fantastic. I don't usually do shared accomodations but the hosts were very nice and gave us privacy, but also available when we had questions or were in the mood to chat. would definitely stay again! thank you
Amazing Apt in the middle of Zürich, Happy we choose Joys Apt, as it has everything and she is a very lovely host. highly recommended
Pietro was an excellent host, very welcoming and kind. The place was outstanding in terms of cleanliness and comfort. The room has its own bathroom and balcony. You cant ask for more!

I rented the flat for my parents, and they had a very nice time there. Great location, clean, easy access to transportation and easy communication with Joy. The flat has everything needed for a comfortable stay!! Small thing: if you are lucky enough to have great summer weather in Zurich, you should expect a warm flat! An air conditioner is available, but the flat has large windows on the ceiling, without curtains. It can become really hot! I would strongly recommend this flat!

We had an excellent stay in Joy's roof top apartment with a beautiful view of the city. The air conditioning was efficient and most welcome in the warmer temperatures. The building and apartment was clean and the building street level cafe/bar was convenient and friendly. The close proximity to downtown Zurich was ideal. We are looking forward to a return visit.

I booked Joy's apartment for a group of employees visiting Zurich from our overseas offices. They all commented on how spacious and central the apartment was. Joy was impressively fast at replying to all my messages and was very flexibile and willing to help me with cleaning and key exchange etc. Our company will certainly use the apartment again in the future should the need arise!

The apartment is absolutely fantastic! The room is quiet large and there is every facility you want. Pietro warmly hosts us and is really thoughtful--even prepares transfer plugs for us! Thanks a lot. And don't forget adorable cats in the house. They are sooo lovely and friendly! I definitely recommend this apartment to all visitors. 房间很棒，两个人住绰绰有余，软硬设备都很齐全，不用担心缺什么。房间采光其实非常棒，还有一个小阳台。离市中心稍远，不过这也不是问题，毕竟性价比很高了！推荐给不着急走、慢慢在苏黎世游玩的人！

Very nice apartment in Zurich. The space is clean, safe, quiet, and very close to a tram stop. Includes 1 air conditioning unit and a washer & dryer. Nice kitchen with dishes for cooking. Our only complaint is that the listing indicates 4 beds but there were only 3.

Very cosy and great communication. The neigbourhood is super quiet so you’re garanteed a good sleep ! For travellers with a car, parking can be a bit tricky in the neighbourhood if you’re with a car but in the end managed every night and the commute into the center was easy. Of course public transport in zurich is one of the best in the world so you don’t actually need a car.

Rossana's studio is close to Luzern HB, main station. It only takes 2 bus station from the place. There's hair dryer, Iron and board, tea kettle and dishes. I think it's good place to stay if you want cooking for meal. However , I had to catch an insect on the table next to the bed. Spider was making net on the ceiling and I found another insect was hanging on the window in bathroom. I think the studio needs to be put net on the windows because the place is half basement and there's thicket. The studio was too much humid due to basement. I had to wear wettish clothes. The heating radiator was not working.
The flat has a nice high ceiling, with three rooms, close to the lake and Chinagarten . It is ideal for a stay in Zurich!

The apartment provided enough space for our family of 5 during our short 2-night stay in Zurich. The kids thought the home was cool with its high ceilings, funky tile, and other unique architectural details. Ubers were easy to get at this location, the tram station was a few blocks away, and you could walk to the city center in 20-30 minutes (mostly flat and sidewalks the whole way). Most basic consumables were there, however there was no shampoo, sugar for coffee, or an umbrella to borrow, so do bring those if you plan to stay here. The washer (and dryer!!) was a really nice touch as we used it a lot with 3 kids. The few times I contacted Joy she was friendly and helpful. Overall a nice stay in a safe neighborhood. Great for families.

Unfortunately we did not have the pleasure of meeting Wolfgang, however, we felt very comfortable and just like home while staying in his apartment. Wolfgang left clear and explicit instructions to find his home which helped our confidence in navigating the trains!! On arrival, his home was very clean, we loved the 2 covers on the very comfy bed and settled in immediately! As we spent Christmas Day in Zurich, being able to cook at home will provide memories for us for years to come! We would highly recommend you stay in Zurich at Wolfgang's apartment as it won't disappoint! Vanessa and Maddy

Joys place was perfect! A gorgeous apartment full of character and everything we needed. We didn't see Joy at all, but the housekeeper Ori, was readily available. Great location, would definitely stay here again.

Fantastic apartment, great location. Outside and inside were attractive and our family was very comfortable there. Just a few steps outside to a tram station from which you can get downtown in minutes, but the apartment was surprisingly quiet and peaceful. Short walk down to the lake as well.
It was a very pleasant experience, the apartment is very comfortable, is always conditioned, and very comfortable, is super ...

The apartment is great. Very well located: sufficiently far from the center to be calm and sufficiently well connected to go anywhere you need to fairly quickly. Mars is very responsive and keen to help. The only downside to me was that the apartment gets quite warm in summer which prevents me from sleeping well. This might be in part because I am used to cooler climates though. And the apartment is close to a main road. This makes sleeping with windows open to cool the place during the night unfeasible as the car horns would wake me up early.

I loved my stay. The room was better than described. It was big, spacious, clean, tastefully decorated and comfortable. Wolf and Rosi were the best host. I was ill and they made me extremely comfortable. We even shared a meal together. Very special people. Really good energy. The location was great. I ate at one of the best restaurants located one block from their apartment. A little pricey but definitely worth it. There is a grocery store on the same block. Everything you need seem to be pretty close. The tram is also close. Two stops and you are at the main station. So getting around would be no problem. But the biggest draw for me was the personal connection to Wolf and Rosi. I thank you from the bottom of my heart.

Rosanna was welcoming and helpful answering questions and providing information promptly. She was quick to provide answers and items we requested. The neighborhood is a mix of residential and commercial properties. The businesses are closed at night so sleeping was not disturbed. Rosanna even included a fan which we were happy to use for air movement at night with the windows closed. The location is not in the Zurich center but access via tram is convenient and easy. There is a full service grocery 1 block away. Overall the apartment was very comfortable; better than a hotel room.

Rossana was incredibly understanding and allowed me to check in earlier since I was only there for one day. The place is located in a convenient part of the city. The walk to the bus stop is just a few minutes. The closest store is Migros, but there’s also a Coop (my personal preference) just on the corner of where the bus stop is.

Before and during our stay, Jurgita proactively provided with us directions and suggestion about Zurich. The apartment was beautiful and spotless. It was situated in a convenient area that has easy to trams, buses and trains. We had a wonderful time there.

It was wonderful stay ! The host was very helpful and we had no trouble at all. The house is in a very convenient location, but the sound of the tram can be heard inside the house, so people with sensitivities like me might find it disturbing when they sleep. As an overall impression, it is a wonderful BnB in Zurich!!

Good apartment and host very helpful. The veranda is large and well furnished. Whilst we were there however there was major building work in the main road which was noisy and prevented vehicle access. Also, and this may seem minor but for ladies ,major, the hairdryer did not have a plug that worked, so no hairdryer. Finally it is not close to shops so shopping was hard work especially in the hot weather. Also only a 15 minute walk from lake but very steep hill.

I had a very pleasant stay at Ben's place. The apartment is very big and elegantly sober. The room is really nice and the bed is just perfect. Ben is always attentive if you need something and very nice person to talk to. If you are looking for the AirBnB in Zürich, don't look further :-)

Ben is the best host ever! His place is gigantic, it is way bigger and prettier than it seems in the pictures!Very spacious, stylish and super clean! I think anyone can feel home as soon as they step in. I definitely did! Thank you Ben for your awesome hospitality!

I had a very nice stay with Michael and Vlad. It can be awkward to share an apartment but they were both very welcoming and friendly so this was not an issue (also due to the availability of a separate bathroom). The apartment is spotless and the terrace perfect on sunny days. Thanks for a great stay!

Very cozy, nice room in the middle of Zurich’s trendy neighborhood Wiedikon. The flat is really beautiful with a nice rooftop terrace. Communication was very easy and had nice talks with my hosts. Felt like home! :) will come back for sure.

the experience was great from booking to end. the host very accomodating, key handover on time, the studio was lovely, clean, lacks nothing and is located perfectly to enjoy and explore Zurich. I will book it again.

Nice studio apartment 30 min walk from the train station. I did not like Zurich very much but the apartment was pretty good. The wifi was great the place was already alright. It was very hot in Zurich and place had no AC. Overall nothing special just a place to stay.
Yvonne and Alan are very nice hosts. The apartment fairly close to the universities and close to several tramway stations. Sharing bathroom, toilet and kitchen was no problem. Recommended.

The apartment was clean and in a very convenient location right in front of a tram stop. It was also pleasant enough, and the host gave us a better apartment than that advertised. That said there were a lot of basics missing - for example, we ran out of toilet paper, there was no soap, or any of the usual pleasantries of an Airbnb property - soap, tissues, salt and pepper in the kitchen. The major issue however was that the host did not warn us of the works ongoing in the building. We intended to work from the apartment during one of the days, but this was impossible due to the extremely loud drilling just next door. I'm not sure I would revisit.

We arrived early in the morning and unlike described the host managed to offer us the apartment at 10am instead of 3pm. We got a brief introduction of the transportation and shopping facilities nearby and were offered support if needed. The tram is right in front of the building and brings you in approx. 10-15min to the city center. There is a smaller supermarket that offers all necessities in walking distance (2min). This is a perfect place for a short and long stay Many thanks to the city star team
Very big, nice and clean apartment with a great adress right by the lake. The City Stay staff is very helpful. We are a family with two small children and it worked great.

We knew we were going to arrive after hours so we pre-arranged how to get into the apartment. The keys were exactly where they were supposed to be and the instructions on how to access the apartment were excellent. The apartment in mostly great. The only downside is the shower which is very small and no matter which way you turn you're always sticking to the shower curtain. Once you have your shower temperature set, the water temperature fluctuates from very hot to cold, so you have to step into and out of the water periodically. Otherwise this place is great.

It is a wonderful stay, especially with the musicians in the small but comfortable bar at 1st floor, perfect location to the lake and city center. however, driving to there may not be a good idea since the parking slot is quite tight

The listing was right in the middle of the city. Very convenient and small if you're looking for value and not space. The person who greeted me was less than welcoming. Katie didn't respond to many of my messages resulting in confusion over the meeting place and time. The room also can get very warm- so be prepared. The bar downstairs, however, was entertaining and cute.

Yvonne and Allan were great hosts~~~It was my wife and my first time in Europe and first time staying at an airbnb and they made our stay very memorable~ There were lots of great aspects at this place. 1.It was very quiet as we were the only ones sharing with the hosts. 2.The room was very spacious and lots of sun~ 3.All the rooms were extremely clean~ My wife is a little germaphobic but she was at ease the moment she walked in the room. 4.The hosts spoke English!! We did not realize being able to communite was a big deal until we came to Italy...haha 5.The neibourhood is phenomenal. Eveywhere we pointed our lens were beautiful. WE HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PLACE!~♡

I was pleasantly surprised of how beautiful the apartment is and having my own little bathroom was awesome. The room is exactly like it looks on the photos, small but pretty, and the location is great. Nearby are great places to eat and drink. A few minutes to public transportation and with them a few minutes to the city center. Besides all that, Ivo is a very friendly host and puts a lot of love into details. Towel, tiny shampoo and shower gel bottles, and small chocolate pieces on the pillow really made me feel like staying in a 4 star hotel. I hope to be able to stay here again.
Ivo is a great host! He provide water and some chocolates for my stay. The apartment is centrally located and close to everything. I highly recommend this place!

Our stay was fantastic and the concierge service was really helpful with anything we might have needed. We had a little hiccup with the brand new stove that was installed and they were able to resolve it within a couple hours while we were out and about site-seeing. Thanks for a beautiful apartment!

When we arrived the host was away, however her nanny let us in and showed us the room. Because her nanny does not speak English, it would be a good idea to ask the host any questions before arrival in cases when she's away. The room has a separate entrance and is as shown in the picture . It only has a sink and to use the bathroom guests have to use host's property bathroom (shown in the picture). The pull-out sofa has an air mattress. Guests receive keys to the main property and can use the living room, host's bathroom with shower, kitchen and outside yard, which looks very nice (even nicer than on the picture!) We enjoyed having our breakfast outside on the patio. Duygu was very friendly and helped us with any questions and requests we had.

The apartment was in a very good location for getting into town or the lake. There is a nice garden to sit in as well. We made our reservation at the last minute and Duygu was very accommodating. However, the en suite in our room was used by the other guests staying there which was a bit inconvenient but we didn't mind too much. The apartment was clean and bright and Duygu was very pleasant. Overall I would recommend this place.

I highly recommend Silvia's place for long stays. I stayed a month and it was the perfect setup. Silvia maintains a very fluid communication and the place is always clean and tidy, which I appreciate. Very well connected via public transport as well. 100% recommend!
Very quiet. I was the only guest for 5 nights. The kitchen has everything you can possibly need and more. The room was arranged nicely. Bathroom and toilet super clean. Nothing was lacking.

First of all thanks to Simon for making our stay very enjoyable and hussle-free. The apartment is very spacious, clean, and had everything we needed. It was located on a big avenue but there was no noise from the streets interrupting our sleep. The location was also convenient, we were approx 15' tram ride from central station, city center, etc. The key hand-over process was also very smooth. Simon was very flexible to adapt to our needs. Thanks again for everything!

Simon was a wonderful and accommodating host. We were greeted by him upon arrival with a bottle of champagne, cheese, and and openness to chat about the area, the city and it's culture. The apartment is just as it looks in the photos, clean, bright and spacious. Location is quite good - we were able to navigate ourselves to the city centre, and other attractions easily and in good time. Our stay was only for 2 days, but would happily stay here again if ever in Zurich.

A nice place in a hip neighborhood with lots of night life. Of course, nightlife means noise at night. As Stefan describes it is "lively" at night. Apartment is minimalist in decor with some unusual touches. Clearly a creative couple live here. Kitchen is well stocked though we did not use anything but the refrigerator and a few dishes. No wifi! We took the opportunity to unplug for the weekend. Stefan was very easy to communicate with and even checked our first day to make sure we had made it in ok. Easy key exchange. A bit expensive for the location but overall an easy and enjoyable stay!

Rakesh was the perfect host! He was incredibly welcoming and even took the time to give us a tour around the neighborhood. The location couldn’t be better – a cute and convenient street in the heart of the old town. The apartment was very clean and quiet, and we really felt at home with Rakesh’s great tea collection, free wifi, laundry, and tv to watch the world cup games. Rakesh was flexible about our arrival and departure times, allowing us to check in far earlier in the day than a hotel would have. Rakesh also gave us great restaurant recs. We felt like we were able to get a much more personalized Zurich experience thanks to Rakesh’s hospitality!

I absolutely loved my stay at this aprtment! Rakesh was super responsive, and he also went above and beyond to make me feel welcome. He allowed me to check in late and leave my bags so I could explore the city for a few hours before checking out. He also had great recommendations for activities and dining in the area. The apartment itself is a gem. It matches the description and photos perfectly - clean and cozy. The location couldn't be better, as it's within walking distance from the main train station. I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Zurich!

Stefan was a great host, he contacted me 24/7 and helped me find a place just hours before my arrival. He was very nice and friendly. The house was spacious and comfortable, the only issue was the neighborhood was a bit loud, but when the windows are closed the sounds doesnt effect you much.

Highly recommended! The place is close to tram stop, near to city. The house has everything you need and is perfect for 4 persons. Spacious apartment and nice to chill in the house/rooftop balcony ( if you want to escape the city hustle bustle)

My husband and two kids and I felt so at home in Sandra's flat...because it *is* a home, not a charmless rental property. Our favorite thing was all the color, all the art, all the whimsy on the walls. But there are also big windows, splendid views, and the ideal location. It was perfect for us!

Absolutely fantastic host! The room/apartment area exceeded my expectations! It was very clean and comfortable. In a quite area of Zürich close to transit, or a half hour walk to the Altstadt. I would definitely stay here again!

We had a great time staying with Choryon and her husband Stephan. They are lovely hosts. They are very kind and helpful. The apartment is very clean and nice. It is 5 minutes rides by train to the main train station and the sightseeing attractions. The tramway #2 is near the apartment. You can take it to go to the lake. I highly recommend this private room in Zurich.

Stephan and Churyon are such good hosts. They constantly check on the weather forecast to help us better plan our itinerary and offered suggestions on where to go. We enjoyed the numerous conversations that we had with them and felt really comfortable throughout our stay. They even invited us to join them for a BBQ. And of course, I was really happy to be welcomed with yummy Lindt chocolate in the room :) Great location, great hosts, comfy place!

Gisela's apartment is perfect. Large living room, bathroom, bedroom and kitchen. Everything was well decorated and clean. The place itself was quiet (I could hardly hear any sounds) and got lots of light. The checkin process was seamless as well as Harald was very accommodating. Would definitely stay there again next time!

Gisela's place is amazing, she and Oliver have been great hosts. They greeted us at arrival, helped with our luggage and showed us around. The apartment is beautiful, clean and was well stocked with everything we needed for our stay. We would definitely stay there again.

Roland is a great story teller and a store house of knowledge. He has useful tips to visit places including short cuts to the station, restaurants and places to see in Switzerland. The rooms were warm and the breakfast was outstanding. The tram stations are nearby for visiting places. He was kind enough to make coffee at 5.30 am in the morning on the day we were leaving and packed us some breakfast.
I stayed for a few nights in one of the EMA apartments. Everything was very clean and modern, and the location is only a few stops from the Zurich central station.

This is a service apartment, generally reserved for longer stay business people in Zurich. To have it listed as an AirBnB at those prices were stunning. It is like having an amazing 1 bedroom apartment. The kitchen is stocked with any type of ingredients, but it has all of the basic kitchen utencils. It is about a 12-15 minute walk from the train station, or very accessible by the tram 1/2 block away. I loved every part of this stay, and hope to get to stay there again. (I might bring my own pillow. The Swiss pillow, which are flat and very large are very different from hotel pillows. Just saying).

A passionate host in all senses Roland is a passionate host in all senses and likes to share his passions with his guests. Architecture, music, Swiss painters and sculptors, photography, cooking, spices, traveling, even love are some of his passions Roland likes to talk about. His first concern however is the well being of his guests : explaining the worth seeing sites in Zürich (don't miss the University library by Calatrava and the purposeless machine by Jean Tinguely) which tram to take to go to the city (we did everything on foot), where to eat at a reasonable price and last but not least the breakfast he prepared and served each morning. Thanks you Roland for a unique stay in Zürich!
The location is very good and near to the central and tourist spots. It is really convenient. And, the toilet and bathroom is clear. But the wifi is difficult to assess. The network is not good.

It's a great place in terms of location - about 15 minutes to get to Zurich main station (walk and bus) and even faster with a train. It may not seem that much, but the tiny terrace is a great mood booster on a sunny day. Moreover, Nasma and Giovanni are great hosts and very eager to help.

Check in process was easy. Never got to meet subas his parents was hosting us. They didn’t speak English well so communicate was harder at times. It is located in a great area. The back court is amazing. But there was miscommunication between subas and his parents about amenities we had to buy our own toilet paper. If you have allergies this place is not really a good place to stay it’s a dust pit. If you don’t have a key to the apartment complex you have to ring someone’s door and when they ring the parents room our room got buzzed too. It got buzzed so many times really early in the morning waking us up. Constantly. This place is good to stay for a short time not for a long period of time. We stayed for 3 months and wouldn’t stay again. The room also had ants everywhere.

Katie was great and welcoming. The property is like depicted in the pictures and description. It is very cozy and clean, and the music did not bother me too much as I was out till shortly before the bar closed. The room was fairly hot and I was skeptical to open the windows due to the ant problem I read about in previous reviews, but I gave in and opened them for a little while without any issue. The wifi was very slow however. The location is amazing and is right by all the bars and restaurants.

Hi, your apartament was perfect for us! We shared many moments and have great memories! It is in excelent palace and we had very home feeling in your apartament and we wish we will find time some day to return back. And thank you for understanding about late coming, it was very kind from your side - no stress! Thank you and wish you the best! Elina&Nico

Lovely flat very nicely located in the heart of Zurich. Very good communication with Malin who seems to be a lovely person (unfortunately I had no chance to meet her in person). She prepared everything for my stay which was very pleasant. I recommend her place that is charming and very good value for money. I will book the flat in the future if available. Thank you Malin!

let me start by saying that Malin was an amazing host. I had a great time in her place. She helped me settle down even made the trip to help me use the laundry facility in the building. she was a very nice person and her place was clean and very comfortable bachelor apartment. She was beyond easy to deal with when I had an emergency to deal with and I had to change my booking she understood my problem and accommodated me. In short I think the area was perfect, very nice and quiet easy to get to Zurich HB and close to many stations with all sort of supermarkets around. The apt was perfect for people who look for a short stay in zurich or anyone who is not looking for a large place. The elevator in the apt which is not very common in Zurich buildings also saved me time and time.

Great apartment. Nearly brand new. Everything works. Good neighbourhood. Good transportation. Mo is a very solid human being first, and helpful above and beyond the call of duty. Highly recommended. Zero issues.

We stayed in this apartment for almost 3 months. Everything is just as you see in the pictures. The location is excellent and the facilities are well-equipped and quite nice. The only problem is the floor heating system that the room is a little bit cold during winter time. Mo is a nice guy, if you have any problem he will reply to you quickly. Overall, I recommend this apartment for you.

Yosh, is a very friendly and supportive host. His room is spacious (provided plenty of room for the three of us visiting) and has everything one needs. Yosh gladly provides advice on where to go and what to see in Zurich. He is a very open minded person and fun to talk to. Unfortunately, we had a very short stay and a packed program.
Yosh Noro is a very friendly guy. But his house looks untidy and messy especially the kitchen. However, he kept his toilet very hygienic and clean. The room was just ok to have a sleep.

Christine is a flexible, accommodating and excellent host. The rooms are perfectly fine and the place is clean. She is very helpful, has lots of information about the city and gives good suggestions. The location is great for getting to the centre and for access to supermarkets and such. It's a good place to stay for a short trip to Zurich or as a temporary place whilst you look for something more permanent (my situation).

Christina was the best possible host to have. Nice, helpful and friendly. The room was in good condition, clean and comfortable as well as the whole apartment. Christina also provided with fruits, milk and bread for free which was surprisingly pleasant. To sum up, I recommend Christina for everyone looking for good price to value ratio.

We've liked Katie's place a lot. Very central location, nice furniture, great kitchen. Even though the house is 700 years old, it has been recently renovated and the new hard wood floor doesn't squeeze at all. Can't say that about the floor above us, but the apparently upstairs was occupied for only couple of nights so it wasn't a big issue. Katie's generously provided us with two child beds for our kids, and even though Appartement didn't have an espresso machine, we were offered one when we've arrived. Extra thanks to Maria for the great check-in and allowing us to leave our stroller downstairs and to Ingrid for bringing the espresso machine. Would love to stay there again.

This place was very centrally located to everything that we wanted to see in Zurich and also very close to public transportation. The only thing that caught us off guard was that the 2nd bed is actually a fold-out couch, so the only common area to share is the kitchen table area when that “bed” and living area is being used.

Christine was very welcoming and helpful. The location was great, with easy, quick access to the tram downtown. The furniture was dated, but was functional. It was very quiet for its central location, and the room was a decent size. This little gem in the heart of Zurich is a great deal and well worth considering as it won't be available for ever. Quiet, 15 mins from downtown and big enough to feel comfortable for a few days. A good first airbnb experience for me.
The room and common areas such as the kitchen and toilets were well-maintained and very clean. The host was super friendly. It takes less than 30 minutes to walk to the center of Zurich.

Christine’s place was the perfect place to stay for a start in Zurich. She was extremely helpful with registration and any questions I had. She let me drop off my bags before my stay and keep them there for a couple days after. Very flexible with extending the stay. Forest and nice views 5 min walk and lake for swimming in 20 mins.

It was such a pleasure to stay here! Christine received me personally and gave me a quick tour of the house and suggestions for things to do in the city! The house could not be any closer to the train stop which made so easy to get around. Overall it’s the best place you can get for a lesser cost than the rest of the city! Definitely recommend and will stay again.

Yosh is a good host; kind, friendly, and generous in giving information about Zurich. The apartement was in a great location, close to city center, supermarket, and mountain. The room that we stayed in was bright, perfect size for 2 people, clean and warm. We hardly heard the noise from the train. Overall, we had a plesant stay in Yosh's place. It is highly recommended. Thank u Yosh!

I enjoyed staying at Josch. Everything you need to know about the appartment is accurately written. I can add Josch is a very nice person, that helps you to hang around in the city. Comfortable accommodation and good sleep. Thank you Josch!
We had a great time at Patricia's place. It's quiet, but located close to two tram stations and a grocery store. Also very easy to get downtown. The apartment was clean and as advertised.

Beautiful and charming apartment in a residential area, only 10 minutes away from the downtown. Nearest tram station is literally 3-4 min away. We were travelling with our 2.5yrs old son, and Patricia made sure we were provided all the essentials upon our arrivial. She is super kind and communication with her was more than excellent. Our stay in Zurich was definitely superb thanks to Patricia and her lovely apartment. Thank you!
Rented this for my parents, who were very happy with their short stay. The appartement basically has everything they needed, and they really liked the location so close to the train station.
Reuben was a wonderful host who worked with me and my travel companion when my flight to Zurich was delayed. The place was conveniently located, clean and nice. Would definitely recommend.

This is a great one bedroom apartment in a completely central location. Absolutely spotless and the kitchen facilities are good. The furnishings are a bit spartan but there's everything you need - it was a perfect base for my three week stay. Some previous reviews mentioned a bit of noise but the windows are very sound proof and it's really nothing more than what would expect in a city centre location -- and certainly no issues at all during the week. Highly recommended.

Alberto is a great host, responsive and helpful. The place was exactly like on the photos, cute, nicely furnished and has everything needed (a very small kitchen and bathroom, but everything is in perfect order). It is right in the city center, which is extremely convenient. The only important notice is (and this is a trade-off for living in the center), the place is not suitable for noise sensitive people - especially in the summer, when people tend to stay outside/under your windows longer, plus the church bells.

The location of Tania's place was amazing!! It was really a huge perk!! Everything within walking distance- made for very good use of our days with a baby. Tania's home is well equipped with everything you could need. The place was extremely clean and the washer and dryer were a huge plus!!! The parking is the only downside as you have to find a parking garage and they are not cheap. We got very lucky though and the apartment is above Hotel NIMO and the very kind staff there allowed us pay to use one of their parking places!!! This was huge as we were traveling with an 8 month old baby and hauling our stuff back and forth from a parking garage would have been a nightmare. Thank you for the wonderful stay and the quick responses! This was a great first start to our stay in Switzerland!!

The place was very spacious, clean, and accessible. We loved the proximity to the opera house and the Bellevue Christmas Market during our stay in December. Tania’s communication was also excellent and we had no problem checking in or checking out. Thank you Tania for a wonderful stay!

Silvia is a warm and generous hostess who welcomed us into her lovely home. The accommodation is comfortable and we enjoyed a great night's sleep in a spacious room. The vicinity is quiet and residential with very good public transport access. The breakfast was excellent with fresh fruits, and home made jam. A generous feast along with the best coffee.

Neils is a great host! It is a pity we didn't stay in Zurich for longer, he is very nice and available to contact if you have any problems at all. The apartment is beautiful, clean and spacious. The toilet was no problem for us at all. Just remember to lock your door when you close it! it doesn't lock itself (but the suburb is very peaceful and safe anyway) Would definitely reccomend this apartment especially with such a great host.

We had a great stay in Niels' apartment. He was quite accommodating as we were quite late for checking in. The bathroom set-up was not an issue at all. The apartment is very clean and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. We would recommend this apartment!

Sylvia was a great host and we enjoyed staying at her place. The room was clean, the location was convenient and she was very responsive to questions. We would definitely stay there again next time we're in Zurich!

Location is ideal. Walkable to the city. Neighbourhood is quiet. Functional and well maintained space but the main building feels old. Would have preferred if laundry facilities was within the apartment instead of the basement.

The Good: Great place, ended up extending my stay by an additional two weeks for a total of one and a half months. Would definitely recommend. Cleaning staff comes in and does a great job of keeping everything in good shape. Needs Improvement: The instructions for the washer/dryer were inadequate and the management team finally agreed that there were electrical problems. First laundry I was forced to do elsewhere (there's a laundromat about 15 min walk away). The next times I was able to do laundry onsite after considerable back and forth. I'm no stranger to doing laundry in a foreign place so this was an outlier. The dishwasher was also not obvious but the response from the management was quick. It would be ideal to have accurate instructions handy for both.

Studio apartment located very close to many food options and shopping. On a quite street with a park right across the way. Very clean and comfortable with quite neighbors. I would stay here again when visiting Zurich!
The studio is a dream and my stay there was extremely enjoyable. I will always remember the sunrises and the bright and positive energy of this room. It has everything one needs and more.

This is an excellent apartment, with plenty of space and a great location for anyone looking to explore Zurich and wider afield. It is only a few tram stops to the Hauptbahnhof and the lakeside and a short walk to shops and supermarkets. The flat was very well presented and we received good instructions and guidance about access, appliances, local points of interests etc. We felt very much at home during our week's stay and cannot fault our first experience of an Airbnb apartment.

Tilke is a great host..... she makes you feel at home and is reachable anytime to answer all your queries.. A huge apartment close to (only one station away) fm the main Zurich station.... was a pleasure to see Switzerland from her central place. Strongly recommended!!
A great studio, clean and roomy. Phantastic Location with Tramstop right out of the door, only 7 stops from Main Train station!
Great and easy to access and use apartment, very well kept! The Italian restaurant across the street is superb, and quick commute to Bellevue. Calm area.

The location was really good but the place was so hot. It needs an air conditioning badly. Christian was nice with us and tried his bestand provided us with a small fan but unfortunately it was not enough.

Clean place with great location and view. Do know, however, that (apparently) nobody ever lives here and that this is a business - Bianca is an assistant for Chris, according to him - so if you like to meet your AirBNB hosts, this is not the place. The bathroom has half-empty shampoo bottles from the previous guest(s), and the wireless is unreliable. The windows facing out have no curtains or blinds, so those across the channel can see in, which gives less of a feeling of privacy than desired. That said, I really only needed a bed to sleep in and wanted a place in the old town at a decent price, and this was entirely satisfactory according to those criteria.

I've never seen Blanca and Chris. The room was very warm so even though it's cold winter, we stayed very well. The location of the flat was very nice. we could take the tram to get the flat, but it took just two stops. However, they were abroad, so it was very hard to get their answer.

A warm welcome and a clean attic-sudio. Very central location within a walking distance of everything interesting. Great view of the River Limmat and the Lindenhof. Only drawback: the attic is very thin-walled and it was more than apparent that the first night the room next to mine had been let to a young couple with a small child. The second night that room was empty and I slept like a log.

Absolutely superb location and apartment! The room (apartment 12) was bigger than we had expected and it was very clean, quiet and had a very cozy feeling and "feng shui". The only (very small) downside was that when we arrived in the evening, we only had towels for one person but Tania responded to us in the morning and arranged the cleaning lady to bring us another set of towels plus toilet paper which we were also in need of. All and all a very good experience and hope to stay in the very same apartment on our next visit to Zurich as well.

It is a good choice for short stay. It is clean, simple and tidy. Like the environment, local residential area with very good choice of restaurant. Just ensure you don't have last minute question to Tania, we messaged Tania in the night time and normally received feedback next morning.

We had a great stay at Cathy's! She wasn't home while we were there, but her roommate Beni was very welcoming, even though he was quite busy. The apartment is very clean. The kitchen had everything we needed and was comfortable to cook and eat in. Thanks for everything!
Very cozy room in a beautiful area of Zurich, not too far from the city center and quite close to the nature. Cathy was a perfect host.

Everything is good and nice. The location is great, very near to the tram and a train station. It’s located in the middle city of Zurich. The only problem we have, there is no elevator which is quite difficult if U have many luggage or difficulty in walking. But everything else is perfect. The place is clean n huge, also a balcony to sit and chill with the cold weather.

Dimi is a great host. Thanks to detailed instructions check-in went easy. The apartment looked like on the picture, was very clean and comfortable. It had all the kitchen appliances we needed. Unfortunately, there was no car access to the building and no parking belonging to the building. We had to walk about 400 m to the place. But Dimi advised us a few covered parking spaces, do we parked our car there. Otherwise, the neighborhood is very nice with plenty of restaurants, cafes and shops. Definitely would stay again.
Salvia is a very kind person and my guest liked her room and the very quiet place very much. It‘s a bit outside of Zurich however, with Tram or Train well reachable.

Excellent value for money. We had an excellent stay in Fuwa's lovely and very clean appartment. The location is in a appartment zone with many playgrounds, trees, .... There were construction works going on (new appartment buildings), but the noise disturbance was limited. There are shops, a pharmacy, and restaurants nearby. The location is not in the city centre, but we preferred this.

A wonderful place to stay at when in Zurich! The apartment is centrally located and has 2 tram line stations available nearby. The airport is 10-20 mins away. The apartment itself is very pretty, spacious, and clean. Fuwa is such a wonderful host. She's easy to talk to and always available. I will stay here again if I ever come back to Switzerland!

The room was OK as described in the photo. We have four people so two of us sleep on the couch bed and the other 2 sleep on an air mattress. In general, the room was crowded for four of us and there was no enough hot water. Some of us had to take cold water shower in the early morning. The host was welcoming and the house was clean. He sent out detailed descriptions of the direction and the city before we arrived and stayed very accessible. However, there was not many living stuff provided in the room. We did not receive towels and bath utilities ( we asked for towels and hosts provided their personal ones).

Salvia is a very kind and helpful person. She took me from the train station and gave all the instructions about the way and the house . Unfortunately we didn’t have any other time to spend with because she was away for the weekend but she prepared everything for my stay and she answered all my questions quickly during my stay. Thanks for everything Salvia.

jen's place was exactly the same as the picture. really clean, but i've found a bug(?) once on the sofa bed. not a big deal. and looks like jens was a bit hurry to prepare our room bcs the bedcover is a bit untidy. however, it was good to stay at there. eventhough we didn't have a chance to met jens, but he was very communicative and very helpfull :) thankyou jens!

Location was incredible! Stocked kitchen and washer/dryer. All the stars for that. However, the flat was not exactly as expected with a lamp without a lampshade, stapled on shades acting as a divider between the bedroom and rest of the space, stained couch covered up with blankets. Key exchange was hard to coordinate even with booking 3 weeks out. Though Alberto reimbursed us for the Uber we had to fetch the key, it was inconvenient after 10 hours of travel. Overall it was a good stay but it could have been so much easier and delightful if other details were taken into consideration.

Thanks for a great stay! The location is incredible. It’s an old apartment, but it’s kept up quite well. The host was quite helpful and communication was great. I stayed for a month and felt quite at home, this place has everything you need.

Fantastic location, big comfy bed, clean, lovely view, everything you want in a place. Under 10 min walk from the central station and from all the sites in the altstadt. Even though the flat is super central, it's still quiet at night and I slept very well on the big, comfortable bed. There's a really cool showerhead that changes colors too. Highly recommended!

Jana has well welcomed us in her apartment. She gave us all information we needed. Her flat is located 20mn from the city center by direct tram in a quiet and green area. The flat is clean and very well equiped.
We strongly recommend this cosy and stylish apartment in the fabulous location. The host was extremely helpful and caring too.

Tania's place is great for short or long stays in Zurich. It's close to the airport and walking distance to the train station and all the sites, including Old Town and the river. The apartment was spacious, very clean, and had everything I needed. Definitely enough room for up to 4 people with the sofa bed, though I was on my own. Great place!

Good location with easy access by train from the airport and also most attractions were walkable. Clean and tidy flat. Check in was easy. Unfortunately this wasn’t the flat we booked, originally booked a 2 bed apartment but this still had adequate space. It was only after I contacted Tania close to the time off my original booking that I was told there was damage and property was unavailable. This alternative was arranged promptly.

Great apartment located conveniently next to the bus station. Easy access to the train station and tourist attractions. We liked the contemporary style kitchen and furniture. All the amenities were available for our use. Recommend it to anyone. Would definitely stay here again.

Perfect place for a home base in Zurich! We were situated walking distance between two major train stations, allowing us to easily go anywhere around the area. Area a street over is very lively, but the apartment itself is very quiet and private. Small, stocked kitchen was perfect for cooking some meals to save cash.
Clean and cozy apartment near the old town. I haven't seen Tania, but the informations about the key and door codes were accurate. Backyard is a plus!

A great spot with some perks. VERY easy to get to from the main train station. Maybe due to Michal being out of town but the kitchen in particular was not very clean and I overheard another booking had issues with ants. The pocket wifi was a huge benefit for me and would book again for it and the convenient neighborhood.
Great location, very clean and comfortable. The pocket wifi was very handy around the city. Slept like a baby in the comfy bed and duvet. Would definitely stay here again!

Checkin and check out process was smooth and Niles and Luis have even sent us some instructions beforehand, which was really helpful. The apartment had everything needed for our stay and was nice and clean. The only downside for us was the temperature in the apartment - like others pointed out, the heater does not provide enough warmth.

The apartment was lovely. Travellers with heavy luggages should be mentally prepared as the climb to the apartment was very tiring. However, when we reached the top, we felt that the climb was worth it. Place was exactly as shown in the pictures. The height is perfect for people who are below or around 1.65m. Anything higher than 1.7m, head can reach the ceiling in the bathroom. Other than that, we love the apartment. The check in and check out was really easy and simple. We had a good stay in zürich!

Great location within a short walk of all the attractions. Loved that it was so close to everything but on a quiet street where you could easily relax. The place was simple, clean and Dimi was very responsive. The only thing lacking was just the little things that make a difference like some coffee to use in the machine or a working bathroom fan or shampoo. Otherwise a good value.

It was great. Location excellent and Dimi responsive. Neighborhood cute and apartment top notch. The only thing missing was shampoo as it has a huge value for us travelers who come in just for the weekend. We do not carry bottles of shampoo due to several reasons. Otherwise everything 5 stars
Fantastic location surrounded by bars, restaurants, shops, and street-life of the Old Town section of central Zurich.

The place is great, as simple as that - easy check in / check out - 100% as advertised - clean - very cosy and stylish interior design with a lot of love decorated - great location - parking is very close The church is right next to it but you don’t really hear the bells. When we were there everything was closed due to covid, so we had no noise at night which I think could be a problem once things go back to normal. Nevertheless we would come back if we return to Zurich. Strong recommendation

The apartment is big and very well located. Communication was always perfect and checkin/checkout was smooth. 2 points to consider: - The smell of cigaret on the apartment was terrible (not sure it it was from neighbors or from previous guest) - The noise on the floor (as the floors in the rooms are pretty old) from the rooms and the stairs outside are pretty annoying, waking up everybody in the apartment. So if you have a light sleep consider this point in staying there. Apart from these 2 points, everything was great! Tatiana

Apartment is really big one, you have enough private space in three bedrooms and in a living room. It is well located like 10 minutes walking to the lake and 20 minutes to the Old Town. Apartment is not very "fresh" in terms of renovation, but all the beds are with good mattresses and you will sleep well. Bathrooms are also in a very good, almost new condition. Kitchen is with everything possible needed for cooking and dining. Wi-fi worked perfectly. The only minus was rather strong smoking smell from the sofas in the living room, so we didn't spend any time on them. Really good option for big families or group of friends.

The host had a coworker meet us at the apartment when we arrived. She was so sweet and helpful. The apartment was magnificent. It was so much better than we could have ever imagined! Very clean, very spacious, and very safe! The kitchen was well equipped and I was able to cook every night. I would say the only recommendation I would have for future renters would be to bring a sound machine because the train is nearby and the area outside was a little too loud on Saturday night...with a sound machine, it would be fine! The laundry is so convenient and new. If I had any issue, Tania would respond very quickly. We can't thank you enough for such a delightful stay. I would highly recommend for anyone to stay here!

Wonderful, relaxing space right by the park and transportation. Spent a week here while in Zurich for work and it was a recharging, calm space. I had a fairly long (by distance) commute to work but the proximity to transportation made the commute the highlight of my day.

Anak is an amazing host. She is inviting and generous. Her house is located in a beautiful neighborhood in Zurich, just a few minutes walking distance from ETH which was the purpose of my trip. This is a great and quite neighborhood. Anka gave accurate instructions on how to reach her home. In the morning she organized a very nice breakfast before leaving for work. I spent a few more hours in her home preparing for my meeting. The amazing light in the house provided a perfect working environment. It was a great experience. Anka also provided accurate instructions on how to get to my next destination. I stayed with Anka for only one night, but the experience was so great, I hope to stay there again during my next trip to beautiful Zurich. Thank you, Anaka and Fedor.
