Anka sent us detailed instructions about finding her home, just a short tram ride from the train station/centre of the city. (It is possible to walk to the centre in 10 minutes but the return trip is all uphill and not recommended with suitcases.) She and her son Fedor were there to greet us warmly and immediately made us feel at home in their lovely, bright apartment in a quiet and safe part of town. In addition to the two comfortable rooms and private bathroom set aside for guests, we were also invited to use the kitchen and the outdoor terrace.

Cheap for zurich prizes. Host was very friendly and provided a written paper with lots of advice. The bed was in a bad state and the bathroom unclean with garbage still in the bin but otherwise clean. Dmitry apologized amd said he'll fix it. The best part of the house is the great library they have put together. Lots of interesting books. The area is quiet and a bit off the centre but there are tram stops nearby.

One of the best AirBnBs we’ve stayed at! The apartment was clean, well stocked with coffee, tea, and snacks. The hosts had thought of everything from toothbrushes to extra pillows to a sewing kit. They even had toys set up for our baby. I really can’t say enough about their warm, helpful welcome and great space. Wish we had more than one night to stay!

The apartment is beautiful, well furnished and well located (close to public transportation). The host is friendly, providing all the information needed to reach the apartment easily. Everything was absolutely perfect.

Super cozy and confortable apartment in a quite and residential aerea 10-15 mins via tram/taxi to the city center/main train station. I didn’t personally meet the hosts, but the apartment was exactly as described and the inscructions how to get in were easily understandable. I enjoyed my holiday week there and I totally recommend Dmitry’s Apartment!

Peter & Engin are so nice! Great hosts! They were very responsive and provided everything I needed during my 3 month stay. The location is perfect. Great comute to all parts of Zurich. The tram stop is close by, which is very convenient, but it also means the room can get noisy sometimes. There is a grocery store and post office right next to the house. During the fall, you'll have beautiful views of the trees changing color slowly - and after the leaves fall down, you even get to see the lake :) The room has a large desk and a wardrobe, it's easy to find a place to store all your belongings. There's also a fridge and a coffee machine (coffee is provided - amazing!). Comfortable bed. Overall, my stay here was great and definitely worth the price! Thanks.

Nice location close to a tram stop and with a great view over the city. The room was small but equipped with all necessities and even a small coffee machine. There are common bathrooms and a kitchen, which is unfortunately a little small and you have to eat in your room, which can be a bit of a nuisance for longer stays.

Lovely apartment and super central to explore Zurich. Very close to the lake which is a fantastic amenity during the summer. Arrival and departure all very seamless with everything as promised. Whilst there is plenty of parking watch out for stay limits of between one and two hours, but in any event the tram is literally just outside the door. Would definitely recommend staying here.

My stay in Cécile's flat was lovely and fitting for a two-week business trip to Zurich. The flat is roomier than the pictures let on and had a very well-equipped kitchen, which I used daily. Cécile was very hands-off but made herself available for questions / concerns. This is the perfect place if you're looking for a low-touch, homey lodging arrangement. The location is highly convenient, too. The tram is just around the corner and is very closely to Old Town / city center. Thanks for the great stay!

I’d had great days in Zurich, but there wasn’t a time as beautiful as those days at Cécile’s place. Everything was literally perfect: aesthetically pleasurable and practical! Cecile was so warm and caring. We didn’t meet but our communication was like we were friends for years. Her place is located in my favorite area in Zurich; it’s upscale and quiet, but very convenient. The building has its accent, and so is the flat; I’d say more French than German. Living there is like living in the Vogue magazine or in a movie set of modern Europe. I just re-read all the other reviews; they are spot on every single detail. I feel so fortunate to get this booking!!

Great apartment right in downtown Zurich: 15 min walk from the HB, and an easy pleasant walk to all the highlights in downtown. The street is very quiet but is super close to major shopping and restaurants, restaurant at Hotel Bourbon is highly recommended. Great contemporary food! The apartment has an alcove with the best and a bedroom. Both beds are queen size. The sofa bed in the living room can sleep another 2 people. Terrace has an amazing view of the city. Dimi was very responsive and easy to deal with. Getting to the airport (family of 4) coat us 40 CHF. Surprisingly cheap.

Our stay was short, but the apartment had everything we needed and was conveniently close to restaurants, grocery stores, other shopping and the tram which led you into the inner city in a matter of minutes. I would definitely stay here again.

Dimi’s place is great! Big enough for the four of us, me husband and two kids with complete amenities. Just bring your toiletries and food plus condiments to cook if you’ll use the kitchen. I was able to wash clothes as well for the kids. The place is within the old town area but in a more private part. There was a bike tournament when we went there so roads are closed. We had to walk around to look for the place and it was a bit of an uphill walk. So it was a challenge since we had 3 big luggages and it was raining. Overall, the place is just a few mins walk around town and around 10-15mins to Zurich Central Station. Dimi was responsive and a great host too. 😉
Very nice and stylish apartment in the heart of ZH. The terrace is amazing! Very close to the city center, old town and Bhf-Strasse.

Perfect location! This apartment is great for a stay around the center of Zurich. Karina was a super host. She offered us a new apartment after we discovered some issues with the previous apartments address. Clean apartment except for the bathroom ceiling were there is currently a good bit of mould due to the steam and moist air. The foldable couch is very comfortable too. It can be a bit noisy if you have loud guests around you, as the walls aren't very sound proof, but the area is very quiet and lovely so we had no troubles sleeping! Overall would recommend this place :)

We had a really good experience, very clean apartment, very close the central station and convenient to drink, dinner or walk around. Branca is very nice, she explained the place warmly and recommended some places. The room was a bit hot because of the super sunny weather in Zurich, unfortunately didn’t have a chance to drink on the roof, but all good in general.

Anni's place was a great homebase for me. It was a quick walk to the multiple tram lines that took me into Zurich's city center or main train station. There are many supermarkets and cafes nearby as well. It felt very quiet and safe. Anni was super responsive and helpful whenever I had questions, which I greatly appreciated. The only things that would've made the stay even better was if there was Wifi (which to be fair, Anni had disclosed in the listing Wifi was not included) and some cooking utensils haha. What was nice also was during a heat wave, because Anni's place is garden level, it was always cool to come back to! I would be happy to stay at Anni's again during my next visit to Zurich. Thank you for everything!

As the other reviewers said, Sigrid and her family are very welcoming! She is very motherly and is a fun host. I enjoyed going on trips with her, cooking with her, and exchanging stories. Sigrid's English is also very good, so you will definitely have a good time here. I stayed here for one month as a visiting student @ ETH, and it is roughly a 15-20 minute walk to the university. The location isn't completely central, you won't walk out to be surrounded by bars and restaurants, but with public transportation it is quite easy to get around. The rooms and apartment are clean and comfortable, and all the facilities are clean. Thanks for your hospitality, Sigrid and Pauli!

Nice place, it's spacious compared to other places in Zurich. The location is 6 stops away from the city center and tram stops are very near to the house. The area is quite and we liked the overall experience. However this is a HiTrental service apartment so you will miss the host, you can connect with her anytime with message

Sigrid's place is really amazing, it has a lovely kitchen/living room where she likes to spend time with her international guests. Sigrid will make you feel at home from the very first moment. She is really helpful and willing to make your stay as comfortable as possible. If you visit Zurich, it's definitely the place to stay at, since it is also very close and well connected to the city centre. The neighborhood is residential and very calm. Definitely recommended!

Right next to the station, Jun’s place was easy to find and spotless. The room looked like the photos, we could have used a fan as the room was very warm and it didn’t feel safe to leave the exterior door open at night but the weather was warm. Bathroom was great, very clean and good shower.
Jun was very nice and it was clean, but the house was full of huge spiders, both the bedroom and the bathroom. I have a phobia so sleeping was near impossible

The apartment was big, clean, and in a great location. There are blinds on the windows which were great for both noise and light reduction (a couple of nights during our stay, there were street partied nearby, but with the blinds, they didn't bother us at all). The shower was about 15cm too small in every dimension, but there was a nice big bath, and it was all very will appointed. The one real complaint I have is that the WiFi was almost completely unusable. I was mostly able to connect to the router, but the transfer rate was actually slower than cell phone data.

Great place, clean and bright. The host was extremely responsive. The park across the street seems to be a meet up for people to drink/smoke so it might not be the most family friendly park. The place was great and easy to get to.

Great location, great apartment. The immaculate tram system just around the corner takes you anywhere basically, many spots including the city center are within walking distance. The apt is bright, clean and spacious. Communication with Ferrat was straight forward and quick, even though we had to deal with some travel changes everything worked out perfectly fine. Highly recommend.

The apartment is perfect for exploring the city, it’s close to various public transport centers and some amazing restaurants and bars around! A short run/ walk from the Uetliberg hiking route, which is a must!

Jun was an amazing host. She accommodated every request, even if I had to change the check in time last minute because my plane was late. Communication was very quick, and the place was very comfortable and tidy. Would really recommend if you need a place to visit Zurich!

Check in process was extremely smooth, walkable to old town and had a great view of the park across the street where the balcony overlooked. Shower was very small, but the vanity with double sinks was nice for a group of people.

This is not discrimination. There are many "blacks" in the neighbourhood and we even witnessed fight in the park just in front of the apartment on the 1st day when we arrived . We booked 3 nights stay but we felt unsafed and eventually we checked out on the 2nd day morning and moved to a hotel instead.

We enjoyed our stay at Juns place! It's just like 2 minutes from the train station which is the next stop from Zurich main station. Trains are comming every couple of minutes. Jun was communicating well and also gave us some hints for our stay in Zurich. The room was nice and clean and definitely enough space for 2 people. In the bathroom there were many useful supplies provided. The only thing we think could be improved was the fact that the weekend was really hot and there was no aircon or fan for us to cool down during the night.

The apartment was very nice. The whole place was arranged very well, modern and with everything required. The location is also excellent. There are numerous public transit options easily accessible. Downtown Zuerich is only a short tram ride away and there is a small grocery store 1 block away. The WIFI worked flawlessly and the building has an elevator. Access to the laundry facilities was good to have too.

Mo & Angelika were very responsive throughout the process: from answering questions leading up to making our reservation, to meeting us at the door and taking us through the features of the apartment, to making the checkout process super easy. The apartment itself was very well appointed and is conveniently located near the #2 tram making getting around the city a breeze. We were very happy with our stay and would gladly stay here again should our travels bring us to Zurich again someday!

the house was very good and clean, and Rossana is very kind, and I need to apologize to Rossana because I put an umbrella in my bag and forgot to put it back. I'm so sorry. it made me feel very comfortable to stay there, have breakfast in the little garden with fresh air. maybe one day I will back there, and I bring the stolen umbrella

A comfortable and stylish room in a very nice house. Very well organised so guests in different rooms don’t get in each other’s way, but there is also a nice dining area if you are staying with a few people and want to socialise. Rossana was extremely responsive when I asked for anything. The house is located near the end of a few tram/bus routes but you can get into the centre of town in about 30 mins. There are also several supermarkets and many other shops nearby.

Tania’s first floor studio apartment was perfect for the two of us. Small but well designed to have everything you need neatly built-in or tucked away. It’s well appointed with convient appliances and kitchenware but no staples. Large windows look out onto a beautiful lush garden. The neighborhood feels secluded and quiet. So you feel safe and protected in a lovely, vibrant area of Zurich, rich with history. The apartment is close to public transit, restaurants and boutiques- very walkable!

Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay while in Zurich. Had so many great options for restaurants and shops at a couple of minutes walking, a lot of beautiful sightseeing locations nearby, and felt private at the same time. I recommend it to anyone staying a couple of days in this beautiful city.

Coco is a such a sweet person and her apartment is proof of her kind personality. We enjoyed to spend time in Zürich and the stay made it better. Coco even got some time to talk with us and shared dinner, which she cooked herself. We recommend to stay at Coco’s and walk around this beautiful city.

Coco is super nice and considerate host. She gave extraordinary suggestions to local food, sights and everyday life, and is willing to chat on details of Zurich native culture. I recommend this great stay and would love to visit again if I have the chance.
Rossana is a very friendly Host, plus the Room was super fresh and clean.

Peter was very communicative and both check in and check out went smoothly. The room was very nice and all amenities were provided. However, we were sharing the bathrooms with many others and we often had to wait a long time to use them.

287/5000 Beautiful place, quiet part of town, cozy house, beautiful room. A small room, but enough space. Overall clean environment, the possibility of washing and drying clothes. The other rooms are occupied by other tenants. Approximately 20 minutes to the center, excellent transport links. I would definitely come back again.

It is simple, you have to share the bathroom, that’s uncomfortable, but the room is big enough for one person, it is good to move around the city, the kitchen is small and simple so you should take into account before buying things that need an oven.
The apartment is lovely and located in a nice building with a beautiful garden. The hosts are really nice and helpful. We will definitely come back to their place when in Zurich!

I stayed for one month in Peter's place. The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures. The best thing of the whole place is the host. Peter was an excellent and very friendly host, and always willing to provide all any help that one may need. During my stay, he even brought new fresh towels, even though I didn't need more, since the apartment is equipped with a washing machine, and I was washing them. I must say, however, that the apartment had clearly not been cleaned up when I entered. There was visible dust in many corners, under the bed and on top of some furniture. There were even several spider webs in the corners of the ceiling. Except from this, the rest of the apartment (kitchen utilities, restroom and bed) was in an excellent state of cleanliness.
Nice place, clean and near to the center.

I stayed at Peter's place for a week with my dog. The apartment is ideally located, directly by the Tram Station 5/6 and the Buss 33 that bring you to the middle of the city and the lake in only a few stops. The apartment was clean and has a good feel, perfect for 1-2 people. Peter and Engin are very friendly, helpful and offer a service that is hotel-like with all the little details. The best part about the apartment was the garden space which is very nice and makes for a nice summer evening experience. I would definitely go back there. Loved it! Thank you so much for your great hospitality!
Very friendly hosts. Don't expect something fancy, but the place is good value if you, like me, move to Zurich and need a home base for few weeks.

It is a great place to be. Very nice and cozy room to stay also for a longer period. Near to all important places in Zurich. Great neighbourhood. The host is very kind, answers fast and will help you in a fantastic manner. I really recommend this host and place. Also for a longer stay. Thank you.

Peter was perfect in giving us the directions, and helped us to check-in when we had the possibility. The house was perfectly clean and we found everything we needed. The position of the house is perfect, the city center is easily reachable using public transportation.

Peter & Engin are great hosts. They are very helpful and responsive. The place itself is cozy and has a rustic charm. I had a great stay. Small quibble: The dishwasher was not working. I did not cook much so this was fine for me. But if you plan to do so, check with the hosts before booking. Overall it’s a great place with very accommodating hosts.
Farrat was out of town but his friend opened up for me and showed me round his great place. He was away for the whole time but the place was fantastic and super clean.

Ferrat is very hospitable and thoughtful, I truly felt as if I was at my own home. He went out of his way to make sure that I had the best Airbnb experience. Everything about my stay was excellent. He arranged his plans so he could offer me his help weather it was for my check out or even giving me tips about my travels. The apartment is very nice and in a perfect location.

My stay at Olga's was wonderful. The location is excellent for quietly working and getting a good break with easy walking to the water and a very short tram to the OLD Town. Olga is very quick to respond to any questions or concerns. She is full of generosity and hospitality! One of the best places I have stayed!

I thoroughly enjoyed staying at Olga's apartment. The place was neat, tidy and spacious and had a very nice homely character. Great kitchen area and everything you need to cook. The location is perfect, public transport was very easy and frequent and there were local supermarkets close by. I would highly recommend Olga's apartment to anyone wishing to enjoy Zurich.

A friend an I only stayed for one night at Sylvia's and was unable to meet her until checking out. She gave very clear instructions and even described the best way to get to the apartment. Upon arrival, everything was set up and there weren't any problems at all. The neighborhood was a short train or bus ride away from the center and very quiet. The room was sufficient for a short stay and nicely decorated. Sylvia was also very easy to communicate with and checked in with us as often as she could.

Very nice apartment in a pleasant neighbourhood. Not super close tot the city centre, but still walkable and enough options. Sylvia responded, was very friendly and clear and contacted me proactively. For Zürich, nice price quality balance.

The apartment was wonderful. It was tidy and very comfortable. It looked just like the photos. We had very smooth communication with our host. Instructions and directions were clear. When I got a little lost, I was able to make a phonecall to get some directions. Our host also checked in on us a couple of times to make sure everything was ok. Check-in and check-out was very smooth. Overall, it was a good experience and I'll look them up if I do go to Zurich. =) Thanks Zaynar and Sarah.

Zanyar is an excellent host and he was quick in response. The place is located in a scenic hill region. The apartment has a nice terrace with excellent view. The connection to the city centre is very good. Shopping places are nearby and the apartment is well equipped. I recommend Zanyar's place for short stay.

The room is very nice it quite big and bright. The apartment is located in the beautiful area on the hill so if you stay on the second floor you literally can enjoy the lake view from your room. Peter and Engin they both very nice host friendly and flexible. However, it quite hard to reach them by phone it faster contacts via email. They also have the good laundry service not expensive clean and smell good. Thumb up!!

Peter and Engin were really kind to us. Their house is located in one of the best neighborhoods of Zurich, which is well connected to the city center with tram 6. It is an ideal place for one working at ETH, as it is only within walking distance. There are three markets just next to the apartment (Denner, Spar, and Migros). It is very convenient for shopping. The house has everything you need! We had a big room with authentic furniture and a balcony. Engin and Peter were always there when we needed sth, they replied very fast and always solved if a problem occurred. They are amicable and honest people! We definitely recommend it, especially for people just settling in Switzerland.

the flat is very well located—so close to grossmünster and right next to great small bars, cafes, and restaurants! the apartment was nice and well-kept :). the only downside was that the apartment is kept by a service instead of a human, so the provided snacks / drinks with surcharge felt like a hotel minibar. regardless the stay was lovely, and i would certainly consider staying again next time i'm in town!

You can’t beat the location and value for Old Town! The studio was clean and bright and we loved having the kitchen to cook one night for dinner. It’s located across from a park, but the street is very quiet at night. We did the Old Town walking tour from Viator and learned so many fun facts about the area. Thanks Tania :)

This apartment was perfect for our first trip to Zurich. The location was awesome, the apartment very functional. The only challenges were that Zurich was unseasonably warm while we were there and the AC units had limited capacity, and the bedroom ceiling took a bit of getting used to :) bob
Unfortunately our stay was cut short due the US Travel Ban but the accommodation was I'm the city center and very clean. I would recommend staying with Tania

This is a lovely place, Peter and Engin are fantastic hosts, caring and helpful. The room was spacious and the bed felt very comfortable and we had a view of the lake.Not only is there a fridge, but a coffee machine in the room and we had our own dishes. The location is perfect in an upscale area of Zurich. Since there is a shared bathroom and shower to be shared with several people it might be a bit inconvenient. But then the price is right for this beautiful accomodation!

My partner and I stayed in Room 9 for ~4 months and we were instantly made to feel right at home. Engin and Peter are very responsive, and went absolutely out of their way to ensure we were comfortable, and settled into our temporary home. We managed to cook essentially all of our meals in the space, and the room itself is lovely. Thank you both again!

We rented a room at Peter & Engin's place for our start in Zürich. They were very helpful and forthcoming to our needs. The house and shared areas were cleaned daily. Our room was big enough for a couple. The kitchen is a bit small but it has everything you need for cooking your own meals. They even bought a new microwave during our stay. Regarding the location, stores are just a few steps away next to a tram stop. The tram connection takes you to the main train station. You can also walk to nearby hill / forest for a great view of the city. Very good stay!
Peter and Engine are the best, always so helpful. The place is beautiful, and incredibly well located 10/10.

Joy's apartment is spacious and centrally located, with trams going to the HB and also to scenic spots like the Opera House and the lake. We arrived early in Zürich and asked to check-in early, and Joy graciously agreed. She also responded promptly to messages and provided a hair dryer for us upon request. The apartment has a kitchen well-equipped for a homemade meal. The beds are soft and comfortable with clean sheets and thick duvets. There is only one toilet but the three of us managed just fine. Would be nice if some breakfast foods or snacks could be provided, but we managed to go grocery shopping and had a nice stay overall.

My husband and I enjoyed spending a week and a half at this well-appointed, airy and convenient condo. The deep bath tub was especially delightful after full days of sightseeing. The air conditioning unit in the main bedroom worked fine, but we usually kept windows open for the cool air and breezes. The only drawback to this is that the cigarette smoke from the bar downstairs wafts up. Otherwise, the flat is in a pretty and quiet neighborhood with a nice bakery, restaurant (Rosengarten, very good) organic grocery store and pharmacy just a few blocks away, and it's just a few minutes' walk from two different tram stops. I can definitely recommend Joy's place.

Lovely room, very clean and spacious. Looked very similar to the pictures and was very easy to access as it was central to Zürich city centre. However, as the walls were very thin we could often hear people in and around the building throughout the night inc. a man who continued to tell loudly for hours. Despite this, the overall stay was lovely and would definitely recommend :)

Dimis place is in the city centre ! It is just 50meters from the tram station and the supermarket and other need stores are in the vicinity of 50meters . The house was spacious , kitchen had all the required arrangements . Washing machine is not there in the house , that is the only point we felt mentioning . We had a wonderful stay at Zurich

This apartment is perfectly located, 5 minutes from the lake (good for a morning swim!) with 2 supermarkets nearby. There are also many restaurants, cafes and bakeries close by. It was an easy 30 minute walk to the old town but there were trams if you prefer. The apartment was very clean and the kitchen well-equipped. The beds were comfortable. We had a great stay, I would definitely return!
Good apartments in the center of Zurich city and very pleasant host! Thanks you

The host was very welcoming and gave us a good rundown of the neighborhood. The room itself is not that big in size, but is decently cozy and very clean. Pretty good location as well. The only downside was the side 'bed', which wasn't very comfortable. Overall we had a great stay!

This is a lovely building situated in the financial district with easy access to streetcars and the train station. The apartment is small but had everything we needed. The bed was comfortable, the bathroom was a good size, the shower was great, there was a kitchenette with a refrigerator and stovetop. We loved being able to keep the windows open. The floor fan was very much appreciated.
Tania is amazing and she is the perfect host. I highly recommend her!

Tania's flat is the better place to be in Zurich. Very well located, spacious, net , nice and modern decoration, with all the usefull and home appliances you need . Plenty of natural light , only one block distance to the lake. I strongly recommend Tania's place!! Virginia Lee
This room is quite bright, clean and neat in an apartment located in quiet area. It takes few minutes to walk to bus station and conveniently get to the downtown. There is also supermarket nearby.
Really lovely place in Zurich. Very central. I had a small room and my own shower, but the toilet was next door shared with 3 rooms. No big deal. I would definitely stay here again for convenience.

I stayed at Jens's place only for one night and unfortunately you didn't meet each other. However I only have good things to say about my stay. Jens organize every thing perfectly and I didn't have any problem. I was very easy to me to find the apartment thank to his indications. Everything was clean, the bed is confortable, the neighborhood is very nice and quiet. And is very well comunicate. I deeply recomend it.
Good hotel for affordable price. Great experience but the only downside was that the mattress was a bit hard and uncomfortable
Thanks Jens! Very good at communication and fast response. Gave me a lot of info on the email. The room was as described, the only issue was that there was a spider web right next to my bed.

This apartment was the best to date I've stayed at. The openness and airiness made me almost want to spend more time in my apartment then out exploring Zurich. The location near the train station was ideal. Most of the restaurants I had researched and wanted to visit ahead of time were within walking distance. Old Town is within walking distance along with almost all the other sites of Zurich. Cannot say enough good things about this apartment. Also, the host service was extremely helpful and responsive. Would give it 5 stars plus!
It’s amazing there enough space really local and so much fun. The apartment is a dream i couldn’t be more satisfied. James is a super host. I would definitely re-book it.

Nice apartment but unfortunately it didn’t match the photographs - completely different flooring and furniture - and Dimi didn’t seem particularly concerned about the difference. Said that it had just been renovated but it really didn’t feel like the same apartment. Would have preferred a more honest response to our concerns.

I stayed with my family (my spouse and 2 children) at Dimiter's apartment for 4 nights this December. It was a wonderful stay in every way - great apartment, great location and a great host. The apartment is spacious and well fitted for family needs. The location is perfect - pleasant neighborhood with eating and shopping places, proximity to the city center and connectivity by trams really close to the apartment. And Dimiter makes for a great host - very communicative, proactive and prompt in providing support. I will come back to his apartment any time I am in the city again.

We enjoyed our visit enormously and enjoyed the convenience of the apartment to Zurich and the local area. The apartment was clean, well furnished met our full expectations. However, our apartment was on the ground floor on the side of a busy street that meant it was noisy at night. There is nothing that could be done about this but it was our only negative. 4/ 5

Very spacious place with two bathrooms and large kitchen in very quiet location that is near to downtown, transportation and many amenities. The only important thing to remember is that nearby supermarkets are closed on Sunday, you’d have to travel to the station where supermarkets are open.
Good stay , but the host provide a little more essentials like hand wash soap and cooking oil It was mentioned in description but not present

Great place! I have been traveling through Switzerland for over a week and this was the best place that I got!! Great location, spotless clean, great communication and paid parking as well! Stephanie was always reachable and responsive! Worth each penny!

The apartment was fabulous, very clean and new, well located in the center of Zúrich and walking distance to public transport. After a long day enjoying the city it was great to get back to the apartment as it felt like your house. And Tania was a great host!! I totally recomend it for a short stay with your couple or friend in the city!!

I stayed with my family at Tania's place. This looked exactly like what was shown in the photograph. Very clean and tidy. Also this place is near to most of the places like Zurich lake, Lindenhof Hill, St. Peter Kirche, main station etc. We truly enjoyed our stay and want to come back.

Beautifully appointed flat in an unbeatable location—right in the historic first district, steps from the Grossmünster and Bahnhofstrasse. The space was spotless, stylish, and well-equipped. Communication with the host was excellent. The only drawback was that the Wi-Fi wasn’t working during our stay; the host was very apologetic and tried to fix it. A great place to experience Zurich from the heart of the city.

The apartment is in a fantastic location, close to restaurants, coffee shops and shopping. Dimi is very responsive and friendly. Things to note: the apartment needs maintenance. The bathroom has black mold, tiles are cracked and stained. As well, only one small bar soap was provided for our family of 4. Dimi sent extra cleaning but unfortunately it did not help. The bedrooms and living area were clean.
The apartment was spacious and comfortable and close to the downtown which is easily accessible by walking or tram

Great little place to stay! Very clean and nice. Large room with lots of space for all your things. The only downside is that it is about a 25/30 minute walk to the city center. But I enjoyed the walk and seeing the city. Great little kitchen and bathroom.
Flat is in a good location and quite spacious, but the place was not clean. We contacted host and she resolved it. However the WIFI was not working the whole time we were there.

Michal is a really kind, laid back but very knowledgeable and patient uber host. I really enjoyed our brief conversation; he has a warm spirit to him that, for me, is crucial to solid hospitality. The room is exactly as pictured (immaculately clean, nice comfortable bed, very functional desk with reliable WIFI, in a perfectly located sector of Zurich. 100% recommend and will stay there again next time I'm in the city.

Everything went fine. The apartment was in order, very bright and easy to reach with the car. Public transports are also very close and there is a good supermarket near by. Unfortunately I haven't had the pleasure to meet Filippo but he provided to us all sort of information via email before our arrival and anyway we received a warm welcome from his friends giving us the apartment keys. It has been a perfect stay for me, my wife and our two kids.

Very good host; was very responsive and addressed a couple of issues quickly, including giving us some tips on where to pickup a few things on a Sunday. Excellent Location - a short walk to the tram station, and to the lake. Being summer, and not having AC (apparently a Zurich/Switzerland thing), we had to crack open the windows to get the air moving and to cool down the place - which also let mosquitoes and bugs into the apartment, something to keep in mind. More importantly, the open windows also let in the sounds of the trains - light sleepers will definitely be affected.

Our host was great and very accommodating. Location is in a quiet part of town and get to live like you’re a native. We didn’t learn about the public tram system until the last couple of days but very useful. The stop is only 1 minute walk from the apartment and the only tram that goes there is number 7, which goes directly into the middle of Zurich and Zurich main train station. Felt like a safe neighborhood and clean apartment.

Sofia was a great host. To my surprise, I was not able to communicate with her upon my arrival because of issues with my phone, but she was very accommodating and friendly. The room was very nice, safe and in a great location.

Super location and reasonable price! No elevator, be aware if you have a big suitcase, you must climb up. However, on the check-out date Sofia’s partner helped me to bring it down, very nice and thanks a lot!
Rebekka has a very nice apartment with amazing view on the river. Flat is very clean and really well organized. I will definitely recommend it for anybody who want's to spend a week in Zurich.

Rebekka place was amazing , extremely clean , tidy and cozy .Great location just right on the river with stunning views . Felt like home. Communication was quick simple and she was very friendly. Would come back any time. All stars for this place.
Place has good connectivity but the host is too slow to respond and some time also not responsive

Tania’s place was absolutely wonderful! The tram is just around the corner of the building, the place was sparkling clean, spacious, and comfortable. As mentioned in the description, there is no coffee, tea, snacks or shampoo/conditioner but there is a grocery store around 5 mins by foot. Would definitely recommend this place :)

I had a great time in Zurich. Ruth is very helpful and kind,she is very careful and quick with the answers, always willing to help! The apartment is really clean and well located, very convenient to go from Zurich main station and other train stations, and a short walk away to bus and tram stations also. She allowed me to use her refrigerator and kitchen, just like in my own home. Check in was super easy,same as the check out.

We had a lovely weekend in this beautifully furnished flat directly in the hub of Zurich life with gorgeous views of the lake from the apartment windows. The property was spotlessly clean with everything we needed and the check-in process could not have been easier with our own access via a password without the need to meet a host. The only two issues we encountered were the noise from outside the windows as it is located on a very busy street full of bars, on a Friday and Saturday the volume continued until around 2-3am, and it was also extremely hot in the apartment, often to points of discomfort.
I would recommend staying here. Plenty of space for 6 adults. Right in town and parking nearby. Communication was quick and easy. The place was clean and quiet.

The place is nice just near the center of the city you can get there in tram. The host was kind and let us do the check out an 1 hour later. The only issue we had were the spiders, there were spiderwebs everywhere I understand that special when it’s cold spiders are everywhere but I would recommend clean the webs.

We absolutely loved our 2 night stay with Fabienne in her lovely apartment! Not only is the apartment in a great location, spotless and welcoming, but Fabienne is a fantastic host, offering endless advice and suggestions and full of fantastic travel stories. We would highly recommend her place for anyone visiting Zurich and wanting greta local hints :-)

Fabienne was a fabulous host - easily one of the friendliest I've stayed with! Her place is nice and in a great area close to the centre of Zurich. The only downside is the bed...if you're anything over 5"5 (I'm 5"9) you'll struggle with a small, single bed. But otherwise a comfortable home and a great stay!

My family and I loved staying at Asa's place. Despite requesting to book last minute, Asa went above and beyond to make sure that we could check in smoothly. Her place was central but quiet, and it's exactly as pictured. What was special was her continuous check in to ensure that we could enjoy her home to the fullest. Seeing the New Years fireworks from her balcony was a highlight of our trip. Thanks so much!

Beautiful home- it was bigger than we anticipated. Sadly we didn’t get to utilize the pool due to the rainy weather all week. The short walk to the tram was very convenient. With a baby, the only slight negative was the creaky floor and stairs in the main hallway, but the house overall is pretty kid friendly. We loved our stay!

The location of this place is great, close to public transport and close to the city. However, there are too many house rules and the house is not very clean (it did not get cleaned a single time in the 6 weeks I was staying there, except for the room which got cleaned once at the start of my stay). Most importantly though, the bed is not good. It is a double bedframe but only has a single and very thin mattress and the duvet doesn't fit the cover. If you open the window it is quite noisy because of the traffic, but with the window closed it is quiet. I would not recommend this for a long stay, as I found it hard to get proper sleep with the bed.

I booked Fabio’s Apartment for a whole week to look for an apartment in Zürich. The location is perfect, close to the centre and everything you need is close by. Fabio was very flexible concerning the check-in, and also the check-out. I found a place after only a few days and he was kind enough to agree to a refund since I left early. Concerning the rooms, there are actually two, both are quite spacious; however one of them is facing a busy road and you have noise throught the night if the windows are open. The bathroom was super clean as was the living room, not too tidy, since nobody lives in the apartment permanently. All in all it was a good experience and I can recommend the room for a weekend trip to Zürich!

It has been a nice stay in Zurich and a positive experience living in Sofia's apartment. It is tiny, true, but a comfortable base right in the city centre, a few minutes away from the main station. The apartment is in a very quiet and characteristic part of the city, just in front of the Lindenhof gardens. Two rooms, one en-suite, guarantee privacy and comfort. Every shop you need is just few steps away as well as the main university departments. The apartment is old as the building and the furniture may look a little oudated. However, being tidy and dry, is absolutely funtional and I heve never felt the need of something more updated. Just a note : some guests can be untidy and should be reminded to pay respect to the host who is offering the service.
My one-month stay at Sofia's apartment was a fantastic experience. She is very responsive and always ready to help. The location is also perfect.

What a marvelous location! The accommodations are exquisite and the rooftop can only be described as an experience. The only thing better than the place itself is the host. Asa clearly knows Zurich well and is a fantastic human being. The location is central to literally every and anything you may want to do in Zurich. I super highly recommend!

The place was absolutely stunning and was located in such a beautiful district--extremely clean and walking distance to convenient tram stops and numerous nearby restaurants. The neighborhood is quiet and peaceful if you are looking to relax...and the bars/clubs are just minutes away if you are searching for nightlife. Unfortunately, we were not able to meet Tania in person, but she definitely made sure all of our needs were taken care of. This will not be my only visit to Zurich for sure...and hopefully, this apartment will be available the next time we travel there. Thanks Tania!!

Tania's flat was great! Great location, laundry unit was a huge plus. Only one flight up and near the tram stop. Walking distance from nice parks and good morning runs. Spacious apartment. Tania was also great at communicating and getting into the flat was easy.

I stayed a month with Karen and she gave me a lot of tipps and information about Zurich. She and her son ensured that I did not feel alone in this new City. The room and house are like in the picture and it is in a very quiet area near the City Centre. The bus and tram stations are within walking distance and it was easy to find the house. It was an awesome experience:)

Karen was responsive, hospitable, and wonderful company. I ate at some restaurants in Zürich for most my meals, however, the 2 best meals I had were the ones Karen prepared. I would also like to thank Karen for the great recommendations, and lively conversations. Lastly, the value was extraordinary. Karen needs to charge more.

Nice location, close to train station and light rail. The room was not ready at 3pm check-in, however they did allow us to drop off our bags. Greatful for the A/C, wish it had a washing machine. Overall good experience.

Bettina was a wonderful host, very polite and courteous! The arrival was flexible, it was no problem to find a parking spot and the room was nice and cozy. As we only stayed for one night, we did not get to spend a lot of time with Bettina, but the talks we had about Switzerland and Zurich were very interesting! It was not recognizable that she just started to do AirBnB ;) The thai restaurant is 10 minutes by foot and the food is heavenly ;) Also, for breakfast, if Bettina offers her selfmade 'Zopf' , you should try it ;) The cats are of course lovely ;)
Host is really nice and helpful and easy to communicate. We were a little late to arrive but the host waited us. My friend said that she had a nice sleep there.

The apartment was very clean. The bed was very comfortable (soft). The location was perfect! The AC was nice to have. It was cooler than expected when we visited, but the AC kept it nice and cold inside. Check-in and check-out was easy. They even let us drop off our bags early! Overall a great stay.

Very good host couple! Friendly and meet us at bus station, only 10 mins walk, the department is really nice, warm and cozy, lovely place, the best Airbnb I've ever had, clean and convenient, you won't regret living in here, the only problem for us is the cozy room sort of let us stay in house more.

I'm not sure that it's possible to find a better place to stay in the heart of Zurich. Maria's place is spacious by Zurich standards, in a comfortable neighborhood with plenty of cafes and restaurants and parks within a few blocks. Two bedrooms, a huge kitchen, a cute little patio, and lots of nice Chilean and Swiss touches throughout. Considering how pricey Zurich is, Maria's place was mind-blowingly inexpensive. There's a tram right outside the door that can take you wherever, but we barely used it -- Zurich is compact, and you can walk anywhere. The 10-minute walk from the train station is uphill, so if you have a lot of luggage, you might prefer a cab, but it's a great stroll without baggage. :) I can't recommend this place enough! Just do it.

The apartment was clean, modern, and in a central location. We had trouble with the laundry machine (the breaker was off, so it didn't turn on), but they were quick to come fix it. We stayed with a 1 yr old and they had a pack and play for us. There is a grocery store just right around the corner and other shops and restaurants within walking distance. Apartment has portable AC unit, so it's not the best but we only had one day in Sep that was hot (low 80's). I'd stay there again in a heart beat!

This is a beautiful spacious apartment in the center of Zurich's shopping district. It was only a 15-minute walk to see New Year's Eve fireworks on the lake. James answered my emails very quickly and even anticipated some.

The place is located in an ideal area. Close to the universities and the center. There are three supermarkets within a 5 minute walk! For laundry there is a service provided by the hosts, but there is also a laundry place about 1.5 km away. All in all, strongly recommend a stay!
Nice place to spent few days in Zurich! It is like an hostel with shared toilet, bathroom and a very tiny kitchen. It is ok for few days. It would benefit a renovation but the price reflect that.

Fabulous apartment, very clean with all amenities you need to cook a meal, is you want to but there are heaps of bars/cafes very close by. Great location within 5 minute walk from central train station. We travelled as a group of 3 which made it a little awkward as the accommodation is one room which includes kitchen, bed and sofa bed. In saying this highly recommended for couple.
Had a very nice stay in Zurich. The apt was just as advertised and the view and central location were wonderful. Clean apt, and good communication from host as well. Overall a great stay!

The apartment itself is s fab... clean, huge, contemporary and with sleek design furniture. It's managed by an agency who are friendly and professional. We had no issue collecting the key from the office which is just around the corner. The apartment is actually apartment 2.1 but the agents call it apartment 7 which stumped us for a while until we read the names above the apartment numbers and found 7! It's such a shame that there is a very noisy construction site immediately over the road. Work starts at about 6am and goes all day. When I raised it with Tania she was great and professional and resolved it for us with no fuss at all... The location is amazing. .. so close to the lake. A great place... just a shame about the noise.
Great place in the heart of zurich close by the lake. Tania is very responsive and always helpful 24/7 great hospitality. Will come back anytime...thanks a lot

Easy and quick to communicate with Tania. The place was not difficult to find. However there is no air-conditioning in the very hot days of over 30 degree. We could hardly sleep with just two small fans while all the windows have to be closed because of lots of flied in bugs.
Tania is very responsive and accommodating. The location is in the center but in a very quiet neighborhood so it is very nice!

The apartment is fine. Very good location, overall clean, good amenities. However, the host is unresponsive on AirBNB messaging, and it was a bit of a challenge getting in. If you just need a place to stay in Zurich, I would recommend it, but it won't blow you away.

Stephanie is a n awesome host. She responded to all my questions promptly. The description of the apartment is accurately but take note that this apartment is at the top floor. Although, there is an elevator but there is a part of staircase to the apartment. If you have many luggage, might need to re-consider. Suitable for family and friends.

Check-in and out are very easy, as it is all done by yourself. My main complaint would be the noise at night. The street noise is rather loud, and I often heard neighbors while trying to sleep. Location is very close to transportation, but about 20-25 minutes to the Old Town Zürich. Overall, nice place to stay for a cheaper option close to town :-)

The place was equipped with amenities beyond our expectations and was par excellent in terms of cleanliness. The location of the house is apt with respect to the distance to train, bus stop and supermarkets for daily needs. The host was prompt in addressing our queries. Would recommend this place highly for anyone looking to stay in Zurich.
Great location and apartment. The flat is huge and comfortable.

Tania is very kind landlord. She gave me an early check-in when she knew that I arrived early in the morning. The house is clean and tidy. It is very close to the tram station. It takes only 15 minutes to Zurich main station. Highly recommend this house.

The flat is a wonderful and well-maintained two bedroom place. All the amenities you need. Decent kitchen if you choose to eat in a bit to save money. Very quiet area with quiet well lit during the day and dark shades at night. Hyesook was very nice and easy to get in touch with. We had a great time and recommend it to everybody coming to Zurich.

The apartment looked great on the web site and we were guided by all the positive reviews. However, when we got there, the apartment exceeded our expectations. It was spacious, bright, warm, and each room was well equipped. We felt very welcome and comfortable. The apartment building is also beautiful. The location is fantastic – just a few minutes’ walk from the main train station. Communication with Hyesook and her family was amazingly efficient and they were eager to be of further assistance (what to do) once we arrived. As you settle in, you notice little touches that have been added to make you feel at home – we’ll let you discover those for yourself. We highly recommend this apartment.

Me and my girlfriend stayed here for ~1 month when we first relocated to Zurich. The apartment was lovely. The location is fantastic. Plus Tania always responded within a few mins to any requests or inquiries. The only thing I would warn future guests about is if you are moving to Switzerland to stay, the local kreisburos(government registration offices) can be a bit odd about registering you with an air bnb booking. I observed this not only myself, but with a lot of other people who started in my new batch in work. This is more something for airbnb to resolve with the Swiss authorities than anything specific to this property. Thanks a lot for having me Tania and I would certainly stay again or put up my family if they come to visit.

I spent 2 nights in Tania's apartment and loved it. Close to the water and easy walking distance to the centre of Zurich. The apartment itself is very welcoming - spacious, light, well equipped and quiet, and Tania is easily contactable and very helpful. I would recommend this to anyone travelling to Zurich for a short stop over or a longer stay. Fabulous. Thank you so much Tania.
Had a great time booking with Dimi, very responsive and helpful. The apartment was exactly as advertised and I would recommend it to anyone.
Spacious, clean, quiet apartment 5 minutes walk to the lake. Excellent tram service and a good supermarket nearby. Demi was excellent at communicating.

Great location, clean, and nicely equipped (really appreciated the N espresso machine). The two bedrooms go to the back, so very quiet notwithstanding the proximity to public transport. Check-in was easy, the host Tania was very responsive. Would definitely chose this place again.

Great location, close to railway station, groceries, lakes. The living room by the street side is bit noisy, especially the place directly below the window open till after midnight. Those people talk loud. However, the two bedrooms (2+1) on the other side is quiet and comfortable. The place is clean and organized well.

Perfect accommodation for a Zurich stay. It is cozy and close to the tram and other connections all over the city. The place has its charm and the host is proactive and communicative. Very clean and well-equipped. Also has a hairdryer. Quiet neighborhood. Not good for disabled people.

Perfect apartment just steps away from public transportation, great restaurants and shopping! Bus/tram stop is less than 2min walking distance making traveling and getting around so easy. Tania was an excellent host. Check in/check out was a breeze and she was so kind and responsive. The apartment was spotless and had everything we needed for a comfortable 10 day stay. This was the perfect place to stay in while in Zurich and the only place I would stay in Switzerland!

This place could not be in a better location. It's right next to the bus and the train station, so it's perfect for those jumping on tours and stuff like that. The space is very spacious and comfortable. Hyesook was super nice and helpful if we had any questions. The only negatives we could think of would be the bedroom closest to the train station can hear the trains running all night, but the other bedroom was completely quiet. Not a huge deal at all, but it's more for awareness of people aren't used to that noise. Additionally, it's on the 4th floor, and you need to climb spiraling steps. Again, not a big deal for us, just more for awareness if you want to stay here. Overall, the place was wonderful, and we'd recommend others to stay as well!

We had a great stay at Hyesook’s place. Even though we arrived very late we were met by her daughter and check-in and check-out were both very easy. There are lots of great amenities including a Nespresso machine. The bedrooms are comfortable and quiet. The main space is really nicely decorated and fun to hang out in. Hyesook was also very accommodating when due to some unforeseen circumstances we needed to extend our stay by two nights at short notice. All in all highly recommend!

Clean and tidy, excellent location, supermarket nearby, close to the trams and city center, hot water available, nice to stay here for my Zurich Visit. There is no washing machine, and unfortunately ant problem has to be fixed. But the neighborhood is quiet and peaceful, and just few tram stations away from the City center. Its still great place to stay. Dimi has been responsive and helpful. Great host.

Definitely one of the best Airbnb experiences. Ruth's house is located in central Zurich and everything is within the reach via either walking or tram (tram station is about 3 min walking). Her house was spacious yet cozy. The experience felt like real Swiss experience which we enjoyed. Ruth had been a great host as she is very responsive of our needs and did the she could do to provide the best experience for us. Highly recommended for sure!

What a lovely place. I had a wonderful time in the house and the garden, with the river Limmat a stone's throw away and the city center close enough as well. Ruth made sure that everything was perfectly prepared for my stay.

This place was lovely! Beatrice's roommate took care of us and made sure we had everything we needed. Location is great--quiet but still close to lots of fun stuff. Bed is on the floor but very comfy. Just what we needed for one night after a long trip :) Thanks!

Beatrice is an amazing host and her place is absolutely beautiful. Check-in and communication was perfect and easy. And her loft apartment is just stunning! We fell in love with it right away. Its very spacious, charming with a lot of light and it's very clean. The location is wonderful as you are surrounded by cafes, little insider restaurants, shops, little galleries, local markets and parks. The flat is very quiet as well and we could leave the windows open during the hot nights and we couldn't hear a single noise. This place is just beautiful and I hope I can come back soon again :)
Raffaele was very welcoming and accommodating. He was also helpful with figuring out transport to the airport. The room was very clean and quiet, and it had everything I needed.
Raffaele and Stella are very nice hosts,I am glad that their hospitability was great,the room was clean,apartment also,so I am glad that I stayed there!Wish you all the best! Stelian
We had a pleasant stay at Lukasz's place. It is convenient from the apartment to reach any attraction in the city of Zurich. Quiet and safe neighbourhood.

It was far better than I expected. The room was big, well-designed, comfortable, and fully-equipped. The host was fast responding for everything and considerately prepared more than we could have thought of. There is a train station and a bunch of supermarkets nearby, with one that opens until late night. It was a bit far from city center — checking the train timetable before leaving the apartment should save a lot of waiting time.

Very nice stay near the Affoltern region of Zurich. Fairly quiet and very clean place, contained everything that was needed for the stay. The hosts were very responsive and solved any issues immediately. Would recommend the stay for anyone looking for a nice place with good connections to the main city

The apartment is very spacious, clean and tidy. The infrastructure is very well-organized, very convenient for cooking and very cozy for relaxing. Great location for a short holiday in Zurich, train station 5 mins walk, supermarket 1 min, and a lot of green lands in the neighborhood. We were very much positively surprised at the rooms and very helpful contact of Simone. Great thanks to her flexibility and assistance! Should we have another chance to visit Zurich, this place would definitely be the choice.

Perfect location; Close links to the hub at Oerlikon and Bahnhofstrasse. Handy local supermarkets. Exceptionally clean and comfortable home. Well worth the booking and definitely the place to stay again next time we’re in Zurich.
Lukasz was a great host, responsive, careful and kind. His artwork is great! The apartment is located well and with local transportation everything is quickly accessible.

Julian is a friendly host. The communication is good with privately prepared house guide and travel guide. They are useful. The house is tastefully designed. The bed is comfortable. The transportation to main station is good. Will recommend to other guests.

Trudi is a truly amazing host. She genuinely cares that every person who stays in her place has a wonderful experience of the city and the house. The breakfast is so healthy and delicious. The rooms are adorable - really living in a historical house, but without lacking anything. The only thing I regret is that I had to leave so soon! Thank you Trudi!

I had a really great time by Trudi. The location is almost perfect as in the old town but the residential one, which a quite; and this was enjoyable! Trudi is a warm and welcoming person and her house is well decored and charming. I had the opportunity to do Massage and i would also recommend it... really appreciate. To conclude, i will go back there for sure!!
Great location for our conference around the corner at the Sheraton. Nice Bakery right outside and some food bars. Grocery store “Co-Op” very close by
Fantastic apartment, full of everything you need, the only downside was it was quite noisy at night being by so many bars and restaurants

Excellent location. Nice and close to central Zürich. Good public transport. Limmat is nearby for a swim. Quiet at night. Beware that you do have to like cats to stay here as the cats are very curious and do love the visitors place. So it does take some chasing around to keep your room cat free. It's not great value for money, sharing the bathroom and kitchen with the host, however nor is any hotel in central Zürich. And for our short holiday trip it was excellent.

Everything was perfect except no AC(there was some kind of fan, but I find it very noisy and not useful) , so I had to open the window during night, which was quite noisy (bars in the street). In all other aspects - it was perfect(flat itself, location, check in) and of course city ❤️

Cute, cosy room within 10 min walk from the main train station. You can hear the church's bells inside the apartment. There seems to be quite a few flatmates living in the apartment. Unfortunately, the host wasn't present to receive us and one of the flatmates did. Communication was limited.

The place was like the description and for the price it was a deal in Switzerland. The only negative note is that there were big noticeable stains on the mattress of the sofa-bed. The location is a bit far from the city center but well connected with the public transport. Overall was a nice stay for the price.

I only stayed in this flat for one night unfortunately although I would have preferred to stay for longer. The flat is well connected by public transport, it is in a quiet and relaxed area, all the rooms were clean and equipped with all the necessary supplies, from the oven to the dishwasher. Excellent, I would stay there again with pleasure! Thanks, bye.

The house is big, nice furniture, the neighbourhood is full of restaurants, supermarket. The tram stop and bus is in few minutes. David was very nice and quick answering. The house is silence and the street too. But the house was full of things, clothes, books, food… if you are staying for a long time. Think twice to stay there, because there is not much space for your own stuff. Also the neighbours are in my opinion too much strict with the not noise policy. If you arrive late due work or whatever reason… think twice before renting the place. Apart of this all was great, highly recommended.
It's still my favorite place to stay in Zürich. It's always a pleasure to come back to Karen and Jakob. It was my 4th stay at Karens Apartment and not the last one for sure.
You will got as described. The place is in a good neighbourhood environment, clean and warm with a free wifi. Jung Soo is a good host, highly recommended..

Karen and her son were lovely hosts. The room was spacious and the apartment was located and very quiet and nice area. However, we weren’t informed that we would be staying with an additional guest in the apartment.
Sabine's place was very nice! The bedding was super comfortable and exactly as described. I also liked how it was relatively close to the airport!

The flat is clean, spacious, luminous, well-kept, has a nice view and is located in a quiet area. We were welcomed in the flat by Sabine's flatmate, who showed us around and offered us a tea. Sabine is kind, gave us easy-to-follow instructions, and communicated well with us.

Lorenzo's place is small yet quaint, and perfect for our 3 day visit in Zurich. It was clean, and had most things that you would need. The bed was comfy, the wifi worked great and it was an easy 5 min walk to the bus. It was a 15 bus ride into the centre and very easy to navigate. We did not meet Lorenzo but the communication was great, check-in was easy and he responded quick to questions during our stay. I would recommend Lorenzo's place, it is perfect for a couple.

I've stayed for a week in this calm apartment, it's cool and cozy. The kitchenette has most of the equipment you may need, the Wi-Fi is portable and you can take it to wherever you go and avoid paying for your cellphone's roaming! and the apartment is rather in a good location if you go to the city center by public transportation, however by walk it's a bit far. The only problem was about the neighbor who had a child and was crying in the mornings, and they use to watch TV loudly! All in all, I highly recommend it...

Giselle's background in hospitality shines through in the way she treats your stay. Her breakfasts are amazing, and she is very generous and organised. From her place it is very easy to get into the main part of Zurich.

Lily's place is a great bolthole for exploring Zurich in walking distance (albeit a longish walk) to the old city, the lake and the bars on Langstrasse. There is a handy Lidl round the corner for cheap supplies and transport links are good (though Zurich public transport is expensive). The place itself is well-decorated and you are given a large room with a very large bed and lots of space. You can cook in the kitchen and use the espresso machine. Lily is a very kind host - as long as you don't take her directness in the wrong way and are respectful of the space, you will get on very well! Thanks Lily for your hospitality!
I had a great stay at Lea's - she and her flat mate are super nice, communication was easy and the place is very central in Zurich. Would definitely stay there again!

I stayed in one of the rooms for 15 nights, it was really pleasant! The two other rooms were also occupied but the guests were really silent and friendly. Kitchen has every equipment that you would need to make some meals or breakfast. The internet connection was really great and fast, so if you want to work from here it is really great! Lea was really nice and friendly! Thanks for everything!

Beautiful apartment in an amazing location - really couldn't have been better for access to the city (we used the tram one day, walked it the next), local shops and the lake. It has everything you could wish for and all really good quality and spotlessly clean. We loved Zurich and honestly can't wait to come back. Would recommend 100% without hesitation. Thank you!

Great stay, the location is in good distance to Oerlikon train station where you get easily and quickly to all spots in Zurich. The place is quiet. The host has been super friendly, reliable and reacting fast to my requests. Thanks Jung Soo!
Thanks to William for a last minute request from us. The apartment is very spacey and only few steps from the central. We enjoyed a lot in Zürich :))

Dominique's place is superb. There is a lake with pretty view just 2 minutes walk, so does the tram stops. The place is clean with complete cooking utensils. The neighborhood is interesting with a lot of options for food, coffee, and bakery. The only catch is the check-in procedure is a bit confusing since we do not know at first which floor/unit is Dominique's. Once settled, everything is absolutely splendid! Definitely will go back to Dominique's if I had the opportunity to travel to Zurich again.

Highly recommended! William's place is awesome: conveniently located with a great view and comfortable atmosphere. A similarly priced room at the Marriott across the street would be upwards of $300 so it is an amazing deal! Though we didn't get to spend much time with him, we could tell that William is a really great and sincere guy. Stay here and you will not regret it!
Balbir was really nice and caring. He gave me good tips on how to spend time in Zurich, so I enjoyed his support. The apartment is as described, really nice and perfect for a few days stay.

The flat I had originally booked wasn’t available, but Balbir went out of his way to find me an alternative which was bigger, better and in an even nicer part of town, all for the same price. Fantastic service as a host.

We loved our one month stay at Anna & Karina's place. It was clean, comfortable and quiet. The location is perfect - close to several tram lines, the airport, grocery stores and very good restaurants. Highly recommended.
Anna & Karina's place was clean and in a great spot in the city. It has everything you need for a long or short stay. Highly recommended!

Roland's place was well-equipped and easily accessible to the tram station. His house was also spacious and fit 2 people well. You will find that Roland's kitchen was well-equipped with everything that you might want to find, from cup noodles to ready-made food, it has everything. Roland's house was also equipped with a handy washing machine and dryer which we found to be particularly useful as we are travelling around for a long period of time. Roland ensured that we got to the apartment fine and ensured that we had everything that we needed. Definitely would recommend!

This is a house with rental apartments/studios conveniently located close to Oerlikon train station. There is an abundance of grocery and other shopping opportunities and food (excellent Vietnamese right across the street) options. The Studio itself is nice, laundry can be done in the basement (buy your own detergent), has a Nespresso machine and dishwasher. The only thing I was missing for a fully equipped kitchen was a water boiler. -- The main downside of the location is that it is quite loud, also during the night, due to street noise etc. Overall, definitely recommend to stay there if you want to be close to Oerlikon station and don't mind a bit of noise.

Convenient location to access downtown with the train and nice neighborhood for walking. Lots of parks and playgrounds in walking distance. Inside the house is also comfortable and quiet. The host is very kind that they went out their way to find a bulb on a public holiday so that one of the bedside reading lamps weren't out of order. As stated in the description, suitable for individuals and couples. Stairs and extension cords might be a little bit challenging if you are with younger kids.

We loved Marco's place and would stay again. Marco was a great communicator and stayed in touch throughout our stay to make sure we were ok and comfortable. Everything was as described in the listing. We were very happy.

Stephanie was very responsive and made the check in/out process very easy and flexible. Easy to find place with lots of space. Within walking distance of bus/tram stops. Covered parking garage located about 800 meters away.

The location is very good. You're just off of a metro line and Zurich HB is 10 minutes by train. The space itself is also beautiful with a super comfy bed. Cristian is super responsive and will help with anything you need!

We really enjoyed our stay at Beata's flat! It was comfortable, clean and had everything we needed for a long weekend in Zurich. The flat is within easy walking distance of the centre of town, and also very close to loads of public transport, supermarkets and great restaurants/bars. Beata's mum was lovely and helpful when we checked in. We would definitely stay again :) Thanks!

Great home for visiting Zurich. Cristian communicated very well and his apartment felt very homely. There was even a bottle of wine ready for us! That's a first for me on Airbnb! Top marks for that. The apartment has a kitchen with a lot of equipment like Moka pot with coffee, tea supplies, condiments, even a fryer, and in the bathroom were most supplies you would need, even new toothbrushes if you forget yours! Location is great, really close to the University Hospital and a fairly short walk from the centre of the city. It was not a problem for us but some people might find the walk back up to the apartment a little steep. The only other small negatives were the sofa bed wasn't very comfortable to sleep on, and there was a slight smell of smoke in the apartment.

Hi Alex, I would give 6 out of 5 stars if it would be possible. It was really nice staying at your place. Thanks for the nice amenities and nice talks. Also thanks for the food. It was yummy. Best Airbnb so far. Cheers Damir

I stayed here a week for work, and Alexandra is the perfect host. She is very responsive and incredibly accommodating despite herself being very busy. The room is great, with a comfy bed and lots of storage space. You get your own fridge/freezer in the kitchen, too. What I like most is that it's a lived-in house, so it feels homely and not some sterile show-room type place. You can get a bus/tram to HB in about 25 minutes, so it's convenient and in a really nice area. Wholeheartedly recommended!

The apartment is located in a nice area of Zürich: it had a lot of great terraces and restaurants. We walked a lot, and the citycenter was about a 30 minute walk. You could also go there by public transport. The apartment itself is bigger than it looks on the photos. However, it's a bit outdated: for example the couch has a lot of stains on it, and it's covered with a blanket. Furthermore, the apartment smells like cigarettes smoke. As none smokers, we didn't appreciate that. An upside of the apartment is that it offers a free parking space! Great for people who travel by car. All in all, we would recommend this place, but don't set your hopes to high, price/quality wise it's ok!

Lis place is very cute, sparkling clean and has all the amenities even for a long stay like mine! The neighbourhood is quiet and pretty but at the same time close to the center. Lis is also a very helpful host. I can only recommend it.

Lis is a very caring host and the place is already equipped with everything you would probably need. It is perfectly located. Very close to downtown and ~5 min away from public transportation and ~10 min away from my working place, ETH, on foot. It would be good to know that it is up on the hill, which could be a decent exercise, but not a big deal without heavy luggages. I'm going to stay longer than my original plan as I was satisfied.

We felt very well during our more than two weeks stay in Thomas his apartment. It has a very modern feel, very clean, every room is correspondingly fully equipped. Good wifi, comfortable bed, fantastic sofa… Thomas is a great host, welcomed us at the apartment, showed and explained us everything. A wine, cheese and some cold cuts offer by Thomas made a great welcome arrival after a long journey. We would definitely like to stay here again .

A roomy, elegant, and modern apartment close to public transportation (tram, train). It offers a view of a beautiful mountain and a railway station. The only drawback (which we knew in advance) is the noise from the passing trains. Thomas is a very efficient and kind host.

Staying with Jung Soo is exactly what I was looking for! As it was the first time I travelled alone, I wanted to stay somewhere I felt safe and comfortable. Jung Soo gave clear instructions of where to go, was very responsive when I had questions and made me feel at home. I would definitely recommend to someone wanting to stay with a friendly, helpful and safe host. The only advice I would give to someone staying here is bring a good pair of ear plugs to ensure a good nights sleep. The walls in the flat are quite thin so you hear others living in the other flats around.
Good place to stay. Clean and spacious. Just as shown in the photos. Stephanie is a great & communicative host.

Overall, everything was pretty good. I only stayed here to sleep and to be close to the train station since I had an early flight the next day. The apartment looks quite appealing, but there's one big problem: the old, very noisy locks on the doors. Every time my neighbors went in or out of their room, I heard it, even through sleep. The same goes for the bathroom door. If you're a light sleeper, you'll definitely need earplugs. I wasn't prepared for this, and unfortunately, it prevented me from getting a good night's sleep before my early departure. I also think the price for the accommodation is quite overpriced.

Perfect place for your stay in Zurich. After almost 3 weeks there, all I can say is fully recommended. Great location, with close bus and tram connections, and also Oerlikon station. The apartment (and the room) is spacious, fully equipped and clean. Daniel and the other flatmates were very nice, and they try to make their guests feel at home. Upon my arrival, they even gave me a tour to know the neighborhood.

I was in this accommodation for 6 weeks and had a great stay. The room was really comfortable, clean, light, had everything that you could need. The guys in the flat were super friendly and helpful, yet totally respected personal space. I was welcome to use the kitchen and the common areas, and found sharing a bathroom to be no problem at all. The apartment is in Oerlikon, so may not exactly be close to the centre of the city, however with the bus stop right outside the house and the transport connections being very frequent, you can actually be at Zh HB in just 15-20 mins. Would stay here again if I come back to Zurich :D

Walter's house really exceeded my expectations! (I can say it was twice as spacious and beautiful as the pictures.
