The pictures are great, but the rooms are even better in person.) ) The views of the mountains from the patio were especially nice, and the kitchen is very well equipped. I also really enjoyed walking in the hills behind the house, Walter was very friendly and made my stay enjoyable. Definitely recommend!

Apartment itself is quite nice, located under 15 min walking from the train station. Place is clean, spacious, located on the first floor. Fast reliable WiFi. The windows are facing the street with 4 bars basically under the windows. Bar customers create a lot of noise even on week days and at night. The noise is quite disturbing even with closed windows. The place itself was very nice, but it is REALLY noisy and the noise did not stop until 04.00 in the early morning!! It is very difficult to sleep. Please know that the apartment is located in the red-light district of Zurich. We did not know this until we arrived. The place is well equipped and Jacqueline is a lovely person.
Great apartment in very convenient location which was accessible to both the train station and central Zurich

Sarah's loft flat was literally right in the heart of the old town, with its cobbled streets and traditional architecture. The loft was small and cosy, and had absolutely everything necessary for a comfortable stay. Although I didn't get to meet Sarah, we kept in touch through messaging and she was very responsive. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone wishing to stay in Zurich!

Thank you so much Tania for the wonderful hospitality. The property was very cozy, perfectly equiped and in a very quite area. The problem we had with our modem was repaired very fast. Again thank you for everything. We will definately visit you again.

Pricy appartement - more expensive than most hotels, but quite close to the city center and the interior is cosy and nice. Communication and check-in/out is very easy. Convenient spot to stay in whilst in Zurich.

My mistake was not to read previous reviews properly. This air bnb would be great for anyone coming to Zürich for fun and spending time out enjoying all the central attractions. Location is fab. Communication with hosts very good and they kindly let us check in early. But for us it wasn’t great. We needed a good nights sleep but the room (and it is a room with an ensuite rather than an apartment) was boiling hot , even with a fan as it’s at the top of the building in the eaves. Open the windows and half of Zürich seemed to be outside in the square partying. My teenage son would have loved it probably. So overall not a bad place but just didn’t suit us. Maybe better in the winter when cooler.
Nice business flat near to the lake and center! Good friendly host/Service Thanx
Beautiful place, convenient to explore the city, and detailed instructions for ease of staying

Flat was really great, though it was not in the center but the area was well connected and easy to reach everywhere, and the surroundings also had everything, supermarket, restaurants… etc Place was clean and we enjoyed our stay

Very clean and spacious apartment. Very comfortable for my family of 4 kids. All appliances are brand new. Easy commute to Zurich town. Even though near to town but the area were very quite and private. The check in process very easy. The owner can be contacted easily. Will recommend to others definitely.

Great appartment with nice central location. Quick and efficient reactions from Tania. Quiet surrounding. Nice terrace on the roof, while it was cold enough to enjoy it)) I would love to stay here again in the future

2 min. from Bellevue = very central, but completely quiet. You won't think you are in the middle of Zurich. If you have a lot of luggage, be aware that there are 2 stairs to take to the flat. Very big bathtub (only the whirl is missing) and big shower, very big sleeping room (e.g. no problem to do yoga with 2 people) and a lot of space for placing your stuff in a lot of closets. In winter you will be happy to have a floor-heating system - you are in Switzerland = winters can be cold...

Deborah was an excellent host to us. I visited Zurich with 3 other friends and we all had an excellent experience. Starting with her written out directions from the airport to her apartment via train. She was also very thoughtful to welcome us with some fruits and chocolate. Apartment was very clean especially the bathroom and kitchen. We had 2 beds and they were comfortable. Neighborhood was quiet at night. I'd definitely stay at her place again if I should visit Zurich in the future. Thank you Deborah

The apartment is spacious, well-furnished and very clean. Location-wise, it's about 15 mins away by tram from Zurich HB (central train station). The neighbourhood is peaceful and there's a large grocery store nearby. Our host - Deborah - is thoughtful and caring which made our stay very relaxing and stress-free.

The place is perfect for business or tourist/family stay. Tram/bus station 12mins from city center is right next to the flat and the location itself is suitable for walks and beautiful view over the city and it's surroundings. We had beautiful evenings on the terrace with the view over the city. The only little disadvantage for those who likes the full silence during the night is the near tram line. The owner is kind and responsive in communication. The flat is fully equipped and is in very good condition.

We had a great stay at Petra's home. It is in a quiet street but very near public transport, supermarket and everything else we needed. While check-in went with a key in a lockbox, Petra also met us personally on the day of arrival and departure -- something which not many hosts do and gave the stay a more personal touch :) The apartment itself had all the amenities we needed, including a cosy living room and enough toys for our daughter to play with. Recommended!

Petra was a very kind and attentive host. She allowed us to check in early and always responded clearly and quickly. The house is very nice, comfortable, cozy, and spacious. Using Zurich's excellent public transportation, it is very easy and quick to reach the location. There are markets nearby as well. My parents and I really enjoyed the experience and we thank Petra for welcoming us so warmly!

Rakhal is an excellent host—always available and highly responsive. The flat offers a fantastic view, which you can enjoy from the terrace. Situated in a residential area, it is very quiet, yet well-connected by public transportation with direct trams and buses to the city center. Additionally, grocery stores are within walking distance. I would definitely book it again!

Lara's apartment is a peaceful retreat with easy access to the city centre and the airport. There are 2 tram stops and 2 grocery stores within 2 minutes of the front door. We loved the roof top views, the sunshine on the balcony, the cool fireplace, the comfy bed and high quality bedding, and listening to all the church bells. If you are up for a walk with a fantastic view of Zurich, we recommend taking the funicular (also around the corner from the apartment) to the top.
Excellent and very friendly, the owner and all the staff. Thank you for everything

Ales place is great and only 5 minutes from Wipkingen station and supermarkets and well connected with local buses. House cool and spacious bedroom. It is only a single bed as seen on the photo so as expected. Would stay again.

Alessandra was very helpful giving me information to get to her place from Zurich airport (very close and easy connection). The room is big, with a chair and desk which was great for me to do work in the evenings. The room is on a busy street but the windows etc help block out the noise. Thanks Alessandra!

Lara's Loft is indeed a cozy place for a longer stay nearby downtown Zurich. The Tram stations are within a stone's throw away, which is very useful for ppl traveling without a car. The apartment is clean, bright and very tastefully furnished. Book it, you won't regret!

Thierry's house was absolutely gorgeous! My husband and I were traveling with my parents, and my sibling, and one of her friends so 6 of us in total. The one bed doesn't have as much privacy, but works absolutely perfectly for families/groups of friends/etc. The master bedroom is absolutely gorgeous, and the house overall could not have been cleaner or more tidy!

Actually, I quiet surprise that it is not a three bed rooms apartment, it only have one bedroom, one bed in the common area and one bed near the stairs. Besides, the cleanliness of the kitchen and dining room can be improved a little bit. However, the bath room is perfect, clean and large. The location is also convenient and the host is really nice.

Michael's place was perfect. His place is easy to find. Laura, his associate, welcomed us when we arrived. She was very accommodating and even let us borrow her converters when we realized the ones we had didn't work. Good walking distance to old town. Overall a very pleasant stay. One thing I will say, is there are a lot of steps to get everything up so keep that in mind if you have heavy luggage. Otherwise, I recommend this place to anyone who wants a relaxing visit to Zurich.

Great place for couples or two friends. Small space but it gets the job done. Only a few minute walk to the train, plenty of bars, restaurants and entertainment. Shopping is close by as well. Very clean.

Lovely apartment with everything we needed for our stay located in a beautiful and convenient area very close to the lake and city centre. Tania was a great host, friendly, cooperative and responded to our enquiries quickly.

After a bit of a rough start with my first Airbnb booking (first booking request never responded back and first apartment I booked was unavailable due to damage), this ended up being a very pleasant stay in a very nice and centrally located part of Zurich. I had been traveling around for awhile so the best part of this flat was the washing machine in the bathroom. (Bring your own detergent.) Tania was a great host. Check-in was a breeze. Lack of elevator was the only minus.
Wonderful place. Close walk to everything, very comfortable and Patrick was so kind the whole way.

We spent 1 week at Campell’s Mansion. The studio was beautiful, very modern and the view from the windows is stunning. The stairs to get to the 3rd floor can be a bit challenging if you have suitcases but once you are at the top of the house it is very satisfying! Even if you are in the owner’s house, it still feels private. It is very quiet and the neighborhood is quite lovely. We loved the breakfast: champagne, homemade tart, and local cheese...

I have stayed at Duri’s place three times now for work trips. The location for me is ideal, walking distance from the main train station, the old city and the University. The check in is always seamless. The apartment is perfect for a single business traveler. I will certainly be staying at Duri’s the next time I’m in Zürich.

Lovely stay! Very convenient for a family, especially if you're looking to have a relaxing home base with plenty of space for the kids to run around, and the ability to cook instead of going out for every meal.
Great apartment convenient to many activities and public transport. Laundry facilities were available when we needed them. Very clean apartment, the neighbors were all very quiet. Great experience!

We had a very nice stay at Tania's place. This home is clean and spacious and very close to public transit (or you can walk ~20 mins to the city center/near the train). The kitchen is fully stocked with cooking supplies like pots and pans, but there is no oil or seasoning so if you plan to cook you need to buy those things for yourself. Overall, a great stay!

The Villa is beautiful, quite and intermediate decoration (which is enough). Very close to public transportation (20mins). 10 mins driving to city center. Two up-floors plus one under-floor. When we checked out, there was a misunderstanding that the staircase was broken. And the manager thought it was us. However, we took some pics when we check in, since it's really gorgeous. And the pics showed that it was already broken (first floor to second floor). Luckily, everything is fine, and we do cherish our time in Zurich.

The property manager was extremely reasonable with us and our many requests. House was better than the pictures in many ways. However it was a bit empty and there wasn’t much in the home entertainment wise. The check in process was a bit more cumbersome than expected but in the end it’s the only place I’d stay should I return to Zürich in the future.

Nice cozy apartment in very good location. Tram and Train station at 1 min walk. Bahnhofstrass and Lake Zurich are walking distance. Apartment is well furnished with well equipped kitchen. One thing to note is that parking is difficult in this area. There r not parking on same street. You may have to go around and park in back streets. Good thing is that for overnight parking you can park in white spots (8pm to 9am). But the challenge is getting the parking. Parking garages are a bit far. You don't need a car for moving around within Zurich. I was driving from Geneva so had the car for the night.

Gecy is honestly the sweetest lady and I’m so happy I booked a room with her. She does not speak English, however when we were communicating she used a translator and it worked out great. She left us very sweet notes on the door and was overall a great host! I would recommend staying here.

Gecy’s apartment was spotless and amazing! Even though she didn’t speak English we were able to translate everything and she was very kind! The room itself is spacious and comfortable! Would recommend to anyone :)

Spacious and clean, even the dishes were sparkling. Location for value was great. There is noise from upstairs (mostly kids, so it’s acceptable) but they quiet down after 10pm. The tiny elevator was much appreciated after long days of walking. Would gladly stay again.

Arno's and Danielle's place was exactly as described by pictures. A very nice, clean, spacious apartament perfect for 4 people. We had a very good time. The only negative are the thin walls but I think this is a general problem in Zürich. I would recommend Arno's place.

Excellent option. Very clean, space very well used, everything works well. The location is quiet, with a handful variety of restaurants, grocery shops and a few steps from the tram and bus stops that can take. The host is very responsive, friendly and helpful. The price is quite good for what you get.

A small, but clean and well furnished place, perfect for a week or two of business travels in Zurich. Kitchen has everything you need. The only downside was a bit of a smell from the drain, due to the older plumbing, which brought it down to 4 stars. It wasn't a problem for me because I could open the window, but in the winter might be tougher.
Good place and very near the station! It’s not as noisy as what other reviews say!

Ernie's apartment is very modern and comfortable, which was perfect for our stay in Zurich. It is in easy reach of the city centre, with very local transport services. The apartment block is quiet and attractive. The apartment is also equipped with everything that we needed to have an amazing time away. Ernie was also really helpful, providing useful information to find the apartment and was very responsive to WhatsApp messages. My two sons loved the PlayStation 4 and selection of games and access to Netflix and music/Sonos. I would definitely recommend Ernie's apartment to anyone planning a trip to Zurich and we will be back in the future.

Wonderful flat, one of the best AirBnB flats in terms of style, equipment, and space. Wonderful kitchen, great living room with a huge TV viewing spot using a projector. All is new, modern and super well maintained. Zen like feeling due to lot’s of space and cleanliness of design. Unfortunately no really nice view but compensated by all of above. Good connection to city and a new hip area, a short walk from Frau Gerolds Garden. Easy self check in and a trustful host. Even a balcony with a barbecue. Everything first class. Thank you for this great experience!

I stayed at Ernie's apartment for two weeks when I moved to Zurich and I really enjoyed my stay there. The apartment is modern and stylish and has everything I wanted, a nice balcony, fully equipped kitchen, private bathroom, a cellar for storage and a comfortable bed. The location is great and there are many good bars and restaurants within walking distance. I was never short of options, even at late hours or on Sundays when most of the places in Zurich are closed. Ernie is a great host and is very thoughtful of the things his guests could need. It was fun to talk to him and get to know more about Zurich. The best part of the stay though was Bert, Ernie's dog, who is way too cute and fun to play with!

Wonderful flat in Zürich West ! I stayed at Ernie's house for 6 weeks and every thing was superb. The accomodation is super clean, garnished with modern furniture and Ernie is both welcoming and funny. He let you feel at home, but is always available if needed. Last but no least : Bert is probably the cuttest dog you’ll see in your entire life !
Really cute place, could’ve used some extra pillows, but otherwise great. The location is perfect, however if you keep the windows open it is a bit loud and bright!

The apartment is very clean and comfortable. It is located in a super quiet residential neighbourhood, very close to public transport (tram and suburban railways). Internet connection works flawlessly. For those who forget or just don't realise that AC sockets in Switzerland are not compatible with most of the usual plugs, an AC adapter is provided. Check-in is fully automatic, so I didn't have the chance to meet the landlady, Ms. Gabi, in person. However I spoke to her on the phone and has always been extremely kind and helpful. It was a great pleasure to stay in Gabi's apartment.

Would really recommend Norell’s flat to anyone looking for somewhere to stay in Zürich. The flat is absolutely beautiful, and very well equipped with everything you would need, including a coffee machine ! It’s also conveniently located - it takes about 30 minutes to get to the airport, and it’s also walkable to the city centre (about a 20 minute walk). Norell was also a very helpful and communicative host. We had a really lovely stay here.
Great place, spacious and light - and it really is in the coolest area of Zurich, with cafés, bars and restaurants in all directions. Would book it again for sure!

Patrick’s place was great for my dad and I. Transit was super easy because the house was right next to the tram stop. Best part of the house is the super comfy couch! Great value for the price, we’d stay here again.

Great place to stay in Zürich for a tourist or business trip - very clean and well located apartment, super responsive Patrick and overall “feel like home” vibe made my short trip very comfortable and pleasant. The only thing that has nothing to do with the apartment is neighbors that were sometimes a bit louder than I expected (I barely was at home so it didn’t bother me much!).
Gabi’s place is great. Very clean. Nice quiet neighborhood. Close to train station and only 1 stop from the airport. Gabi is a great host. Very responsive

Solid and good quality apartment in a wonderful area of Zurich. Quiet neighborhood. Close to the lake (5-10min walking distance). Spacious apartment. Well equipped and simply decorated. Apartment is directly above a simple Swiss restaurant; this is an advantage if you do not want to cook yourself. However, can be a disadvantage if you are sensitive to noisy restaurant guests.

Great flat to stay, clean and tidy, quick response, I especially love the balcony, sit there and hear and see the waterfall. It is really close to the botanic park. However we didn’t have time to go there. I hope next time I can stay here again and visit the park.

Lovely flat in a beautiful and interresting area. Quiet neighborhood, but the old floors in the room are squeaky. Good accommodation to recommend and nice hosts who give you freedom and trust. I also appreciated that I could make coffee and leave my luggage until the afternoon. I am convinced they will welcome You well and you will enjoy your stay.

Good value airbnb near a lot of nice places near the edge of Zurich. City centre is extremely accessible through tram or car. Somewhat small but useful if only plan to sleep. No problem with WiFi, towels and other amenities. Room was not ready at time of check-in unfortunately. Had to check-in 2 hours later and the lady that came out to speak to us did not speak much English. Other than that, completely fine.

You can't beat the location of this apartment! Awesome park across the street and central to kreis 4. Friendly hosts that were present and helpful. Unfortunately we did not have hot water during one day of our stay due to maintenance which we were not notified of before we arrived. I would recommend bringing a fan if you are staying during hot weather and sleeping in two rooms as the apartment got pretty warm even with all the windows open and only had one fan.

Close to Zurich main station, reachable by tram or 20 mins by walking. There's no AC but there are fans however it didn't bother us because the weather during our stay on September was a bit cooler. Overall we had a great stay and would recommend. It can accommodate 4 guests.
Clean apartment with excellent amenities within walking distance of the main train station and many city attractions.

The apartment and its facilities and furnishing were clean and well maintained. Not so great in terms of location as one had to still take a bus/tram from the Zurich main railway station with heavy luggage. There is a park/playground directly opposite the apartment and there were many eateries and a supermarket nearby.

5min driver from ZURICH HB. 10min walk from Zurich HB. beautiful apartment facing the park. Spacious apartment. easy check in- check out. lots of restaurants and convenience stores are just around the corner. we were on 3rd floor. it had lift too and easy access. very functional; nothing fancy but the apartment had homely vibe and we loved it.

The place was great — clean, great communication, and spacious. We didn’t feel super safe as women with a young family walking around past dark. Strip clubs, men approaching women for favors, and late night parties in the park. The space was clean, well-equipped, and felt like a safe haven.
Perfect little studio apartment for 1 person, maybe 2. Very central to old town Zürich, shopping and dining. The bed is comfortable and the view is fantastic.

This B&B has the perfect location in the middle of the old town. The appartement is tiny but fits very well for 2 persons. The only pain point was the curtains didn't block out the light as they were orange and made the room very bright and the view from the window was beautiful and straight down to the river, which could bring too many lights in the morning. Otherwise, the appartement was perfect!

Our stay was very nice. The place was very pleasant and comfortable. The location was very convenient to restaurants and shopping. The only complaint I have was the mattress on the bed was a bit too soft for us. We arrived a bit late and the host was flexible with our check in and the process was super easy. Last year we stayed in Zürich was a nightmare! This time was very pleasant 😊

This was a great place to stay in Zurich! Very clean and quiet area! Tina and Sasha were extremely nice and helpful. Need to use public transportation into the main part of Zurich but the bus stop is close to the airbnb.
The room is really nice! Everything is clean and you can find a lot of green areas near the apartment with many benches where you can relax..

Chris’s place location is perfect, heart of Zurich, near many good restaurants and markets, 10 mim walk to the Hauptbahnhof (central station) and right in front of the Limmat River (beautiful view). Inside it has everything you need but no kitchen sink, the only sink is in the bathroom.
Thank you Stéphane for a lovely stay at your great place. I loved everything about it, location first of all, but the amenities and equipment no less. Will be happy to come back!
The apartment was clean and comfortable. The location was convenient. Our hosts were accommodating and helpful. We very much enjoyed our stay.
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and the host was very friendly and helpful.

While the apartment was very lovely, the photos on the listing are not of this apartment. It is one large room - no separate bedroom. The photos on the listing are of a different apartment. We requested extra towels and pillows and were ignored, however we were allowed to check out a little late, which was great. Overall it was a pleasant experience. The location was perfect.

The location and space of the apartment is extremely good - 15 min walk to the main station and within 5 minutes you're on the main street with access to tons of bars and restaurants. Apartment is very big for sleeping 2 people. Our stay was great but we were there during Sechseläuten which meant the bells at the church next door went off quite early for a long time. If you don't like early (8am) wake ups or are a light sleeper it can be noisy as you're on a street near to bars and by a nice public area. Being on the top floor did mean the noise was less obtrusive, but still audible. Overall a great stay and would heavily recommend if you don't mind the bells.

To be honest, not our favorite Airbnb we’ve stayed at. There was no paper with WiFi information and the password on the back of the router was incorrect. There was no shampoo, conditioner, or shower gel either. I didn’t like it that the apartment also has insect traps all over it. However the location was great.

The flat is really nice and it matches the description and the pictures. The only negative aspect was the mattress which is a bit too soft and shows signs of overuse (it is bent and sinks in the middle). Appart from that, everything is excellent and Marco is a great host!

Fantastic location, really great view, loved the place. Located very near the tram / bus station. and 10-12 min walk from the train station. Perfect for families. Above all a very good host Julian, response time was very quick, everything was ready and setup when we arrived, was kind enough to wait for more than 45 mins for us to check in - as we were late, greeted us really well..OVERALL HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

Tania's apartment was in the perfect location! Very walkable through charming old town Zurich. The style was clean and minimalistic. Obtaining access was easy and seamless. The only area to improve would be providing simple amenities such as soap for guests. Thank you for our stay!

I couldn't have been more pleased with this apartment! It was clean, modern and well appointed. My favorite things were the big windows, the slide-down screen on the front-right window, and the roll-down sunshade on the back windows. These items helped keep the apartment at a pleasant temperature even on hot days. Location: It was in a quiet little neighborhood that happened, as if by magic, to be close to everything. Things I'll remember: the park across the street! It was wonderful! Kids and parents would appear there throughout the day and workmates would arrive to have lunch and a game of table tennis. Nothing loud, but with the window open, you couldn't help but smile.

Great older apartment. Plenty of space. Comfy beds. All amenities. Very handy to shopping and transport. Directions to the apartment for public transport could be clearer though as there were traffic diversions in place when we visited and for those unfamiliar with Zurich buses/trams and language - it was a challenge to find the place initially. However, once finally there, gaining access to the apartment was simple. While I didn’t meet Daniella she was easy to communicate with, and the apartment manager, Prince was very obliging and helpful. Be aware though that there are 4 floors and no elevator. I would definitely stay again when in Zurich with family.
Fabulous place that is a cosy and welcoming space, very close to transport The supermarket is just across the road. Thanks Daniella for a lovely place to stay.

Simply one of the best apartments i stayed in. Its vintage but the appeal is in the classic design and space. I enjoyed exploring zurich from the apartment. It is very close walking distance to the stations and ammenities!

Vanessa's place simply made you want to enjoy Zurich by not going anywhere! It's fully facilitated, very clean and super cozy. It's also really close to the city centre, only around 10-15 mins to the Zurich main station. Although we did not have the opportunity to meet her, but she's really responsive. Totally recommended if you want to spend some time in Zurich!
Very pleasant stay at Lizzie's place with the curious and nice dog ;) Also she made our stay more comfortable becauae we could leave our stuff after check-out. Very appreciable

This is a very comfortable and large apartment on the city fringe. It is a bit of a hike to get to the center of Zurich (10 minute walk to the nearest tram, then about 25 minutes on the tram to the main station). However, the walks in the nearby forest were very nice for us as a family. We were a bit put out that there was no washing machine available (despite it clearly saying so on the ad on Airbnb). The nearest public laundrette was again a good 40 minutes on public transport, so if you need to wash clothes during your stay, you would probably be better off staying elsewhere...

Apartment highly recommended. The house is simple, but has everything you need. The cleanliness is impeccable. Be careful only to the parking that must comply with the rules of the area, but the host is very kind and will inform you about this too.

I was staying at this property for 9 days from 25/2-6/3 and sadly this flat didn’t meet my standards or expectations . It’s completely unmodernized with creaky floors , very bad soundproofing, a lot of appliances didn’t work , especially essentials like oven. Very dirty communal washing machine and the dryer . Very dated kitchen and the bathroom . Over all very disappointing stay , the flat isn’t worth what I paid for. The only good thing is location.

This apartment is a true find, comfortable, bright, with kindly touches of every sort -- a nice coffee maker with plenty of coffee; a package of pasta and sauce just in case you arrive too late to get to the store, some fresh fruit. The beds are VERY comfortable, blankets too. Really you could not do better. Oerlikon is not where everyone needs to be while in Zürich, but the apartment is convenient to the train and within walking distance of everything local, including a surprisingly nice park with a 14k running/walking loop. Peter was also very kind and helpful. Highly recommended.

Our stay at Peter and Ursula’s apartment was like a home away from home. The apartment was cosy, spacious for our family of four, very clean, and extremely well appointed. Everything we could of needed was available to us and one of the best parts was the amazing Lavazza coffee maker. The only slight drawback is that you must take a 7-minute train ride to the city center but the quietness of the apartment was a nice reprieve from the hustle and bustle of downtown Zurich. I highly recommend this place and Peter’s designation of Super host is well deserved! Thank you Peter and Ursula!!

Five people stayed here for two nights. I recommend it for larger groups, like perhaps 3 couples. It's a good location, slightly out of the centre of the city but extremely close to the lake and to trams and shops and restaurants. The neighbourhood is stylish... but then again, everything in Zurich is pretty up-market. We felt very comfortable here - one nice feature is the large dining table where we could all eat and discuss things. The kitchen is wonderful, too. The bedrooms are huge and comfortable. There's a lift and the access and communication with host was good.

Sandra’s place was adorable and perfect for a stay in Zurich. She left clear directions and notes to explain how the AirBnb works and was there to answer any question! The room was cozy and the WiFi / Ethernet adapter worked very quickly! The only slightly negative point is that there is no lock on the bedroom door and you can’t keep the main door key with you. As a solo woman traveler this made me a bit nervous, but the area was safe so it was acceptable. Overall I would recommend Sandra’s place as a cozy and clean stay in Zurich! :)

This place is fantastic and we loved it! It is very connected to city center and available via tram to travel everywhere. Coop is nearby and convenient. Host Tania is a great host. We enjoyed our stay here and would like to come again!! The only thing which we mention to host as well was that the website of airbnb display two baths but in apartment we got one bath and one toilet which is incovenient for 8 people. we managed by adjusting wake up time, some got up very early and some got up once they were done. The house is pleasant and clean. The office staff is friendly and helpful. Highly recommended! Thanks again for everything.

I enjoyed drinking coffee in the garden and reading in the room. I hiked to the highest point in Zürich and walked to Coop for meals every day. It is a beautiful home and perfect location. The train and tram are so close you can get anywhere! I was in Zürich finishing some work from studying abroad in Italy, and this was the best place to get everything done. The Ethernet works extremely well and the room and desk were perfect. Despite how hot the weather was, the room stayed comfortably cool. I can’t describe how wonderful Sandra’s place is!! And, she is very smart, helpful, communicative, and warm. I only briefly met her son Baldus but he is very sweet. I felt at home. A cozy, beautiful, and tidy place! Also, Sandra’s instructions are charming and clear. Thank you :)

My 17 years old daughter and I, visited Zurich in August 2019 for a couple of days and stayed at Marina's place. The apartment was even better than the pictures posted here! Marina was so welcoming and on time on our arrival. She even helped with carrying our luggage with us while she didn't have to. I do highly recommend for couples or small family.
The apartment was perfectly clean and conveniently located near the tram stop.

We enjoyed our stay at Magalie’s. She was very fast to respond and let us check in in the morning straight from our early flight, allowing us to leave our suitcase in the flat to go explore the city (although it’s good to know there are lockers in every station in Zurich). The area is very quiet, with a supermarket close by, as well as public transports to easily access the city center by tram (15-20 min to the central station). The flat is nice and quite spacious. The bathroom very nice and clean. The bedroom also nice although the bed was quite hard (maybe the only down side) but we still slept ok. There is a lovely terrasse very nice for a summer day. Magalie is very friendly and hospitable. A nice place to stay at!
The house is big and surrounded by a nice garden; the whole neighborhood is very quite and relaxing. Magalie has been welcoming and was always available. We really had a great stay!
Simple apartment. The bunkbeds are actual children bunkbeds and not entirely for older people. Everything was neat and organized but the building itself looked strange.
I have been staying in at the apartment for five years. The experience is always enjoyable, restful and very convenient.
There were some minor issues with the check-in process, but the host quickly resolved everything and provided alternative accommodation. Great service!

Very nice room , clean. The area is quite . Close to messe center. And in few min with bus in city center. Very welcome feeling by irina. And with very good price for Zurich. Looking forward to stay at her home again.

Irene was the best host we could hope for. We arrived earlier than her check-in and she arranged to work at home in order to receive us on-time and trouble-free. We booked her place in order to look for apartments over there and her place served as our bunker. We cooked there lots of meals, she lent us everything, we where like in our house. Towels and bed essentials are really great. The bed is comfortable. Irene also helped us with everything in our burocratic journey and giving us local tips for touring. She also let us store one spare luggage after our check-out so we could travel lighter in a holidays eve trip to Berlin. It is really a home away from home and we felt like we were staying at a friend’s place. Would stay again there without hesitation. Thank you for everything Irene!!

Strahinja is a great host. The apartment is as it is in the pictures. Very clean and comfortable. Toiletries, towels and all a amenities were there. Kitchen is excellent with well stocked utensils and basic groceries. Close to Coop so easy to cook and eat. Thoughtful of the host to keep snacks and drinks. Would strongly recommend to families.
Great hosts, quiet and large guest room. The only “challenge” for some would be the hike up 5 flights to the apartment/flat.
Andrea was a great and helpful host. The space was clean and very stylish. The only downside was the 100 steps up to the apartment, but we knew this was the case and are much fitter for it!
Great place, great hosts!!!! Everything was even better than expected with all the details, goodies and information that we received. Definitely would recommend this place to anyone.
My priority was to have a great sleep. And this place is ideal, with absolute silence during the night. Near downtown, walking distance.!

A very lovely place to stay, the apartment is at a perfect location, very easy to get around with public transportation and in close proximity to the centre. The place is great, very clean and has a lot of amenities you need. The accommodation of pets is also a plus. Rudolf and his wife were very helpful since the beginning, available whenever I had any questions and direct with their answers, which was very much appreciated. Totally recommend to visitors or people who are moving to Zurich and need a place to stay for a short term whilst finding their feet.

I have stayed in 5 star hotel all over the world but the luxury of this apartment is estonishing ! From the jacuzzi to the huge patio ! The great amenties and the amazing TV and speakers ! The check in is also quite easy ! James is a fast responding and professional host ! He tried to help us as much as he could but in the end there was a little misunderstanding as we had to leave the apartment because there was a different guest that double booked us ! That was sad but overall i would definitely stay here again perhaps in winter would also be nice ! 10/10

Beautiful apartment in the center of the city, good and efficient communication with the host. Unfortunately the Jacuzzi was not working, which was a disappointment. There's also noise sensors in the apartment, which we found a bit intrusive.

10 min walk to a closest train station. Some restaurants within a walkable area. Clean room and shower. Although the host wasn’t home when we stayed, the room is next to the host’s room, so it is something to note if you’d like some privacy. Also there’s some noise from the trams because the apartment is along a street. But, It was overall an amazing stay!
★★★★★There is everything you need. I can't believe it that I stayed such a nice place at really good price. You can easily go to the main station and coop.

Andreas’s place is exactly as described and centrally located (1min from the main station). I would definitely stay there again if I could and recommend the place to anyone looking for great place to stay in Zurich. Andreas is a wonderful host, super responsive and accommodating.

Vanessa's place was a great stay for our 1 night in Zurich. Though we never got to meet Vanessa, Luis was great communicating with us and helping us get settled in. We had a car and even though there was not a spot provided, Luis was kind enough to help us park it on the premises with some help from the neighbors. The location is great, and even though it has been mentioned before it is on a busy street - however for us personally it was not a bother. Bathroom, room, and kitchen were all clean and great. The only downfall I would say is that the quilt on the bed seems to be for a single bed which can be a tug of war in the middle of the night if there are two of you.
Tania runs the best Airbnb’s in Zurich. They are always clean, well appointed, and in get locations. I highly recommend.
Overall the place is great, very central and upscale neighborhood. The elevator was unfortunately broken during our stay
Christian was a very nice and kind host. The apartment it’s a little small and old but it’s correct. The location is in a quiet neighborhood near everything. It’s a good place to stay.

This apartment is in a great location, close to Tiefenbrunnen station, which has a direct train from the airport (S16) and trains that go along lake Zurich. It was very useful to have the basic kitchen. The host was responsive and helpful. However, the apartment was not particularly clean, with dirt on the blanket on the sofa, visibly dirty bath mat and bits and hair on the bedding. One of the pillows had extensive rust coloured staining and another had what looked like staining from mould on the pillow case. There is no temperature control in the apartment and I found it unbearably hot, particularly at night. I couldn't have the balcony doors open as mosquitos came in almost immediately (in November!). Overall, I probably wouldn't stay here again.
Easy to find, spacious and clean with all the amenities as well as snacks. Very good experience and great communication

The location is great and the neighborhood as well. Hosts are really really nice but the price we paid was not worth the quality of our stay. The room was very dirty and the building was old. We selected this place because price was high and we thought it is indeed a studio apartment. But to our disappointment it is not.
The place was very nice it was very centrally located and easy to manage the public transport... I would definitely stay here again

Patrick's flat is very comfortable and well furnished. It has a wonderful terrace where you can relax while having breakfast or at sunset, the views of the mountains were beautiful. Well connected to the city centre and the Central train station with trams 2 and 3 stopping nearby. The communication with Patrick was great and his friend Agnes, who showed us the flat, was lovely. We had a fantastic time in Zurich and will not hesitate to come back to Patrick's flat when we return.

Patrick is a great host and greeted us warmly at arrival. We had a homelike stay with all amenities available. The place is perfect for a couple. House was clean and well maintained. We loved the large balcony and open outdoor area.

This place is in a fantastic location close to the river.And also close to a beautiful shopping street with nice restaurants. The host is very easy to communicate with flexible and a pleasure to work with. This part of the city is a wonderful place to visit.

Location is perfect in a beautiful neighborhood right by the lake. Lots of restaurants and coffee shops within a couple of blocks. Master bedroom bed wad very comfortable and Bernhard was flexible and easy to communicate with in english. Highly recommend this place.

The apartment was in a great spot close to Zurich HB and tons of restaurants. The balcony also had an amazing view. However, there were stains on sheets left out for us, food leftover in the fridge and dirty carpets/bathroom rugs. Besides needing a better cleaning between guests, it was overall an ok place to stay if you’re willing to overlook a few things for the convenience of the location.

Mario was very attentive and replied within seconds. I felt very welcome and he also made sure I had everything I needed. Zurich can get quite hot during the summer and I had a little fan, however it broke. Mario went immediately to buy a new one and bring it by. Theres a big balcony where you can sit and enjoy some fresh air. The location is fantastic and it has everything you need within walking distance! Definitely recommend.

Great apartment in a perfect location, 3 minutes walk from Oerlikon Station (1 stop from the airport and 1 stop from the city centre) and surrounding shops, bars and restaurants. Mar was a great host sending all the relevant information and the place was exceptionally clean. Had a great stay here and would thoroughly recommend.
Great location. Upstairs felt a bit dusty. There is one queen bed. The other beds can are short and can only fit a child comfortably

An eclectic top floor apartment great for a Zurich visit and only a short walk from the main train station. It is an easy walk to all the activities the city has to offer. Our favorite family fun was jumping off the bridge and swimming in the river to cool down during the Zurich heat wave!

Old style building, plenty of space. Clean, warm and cosy. Only thing to note is the toilet is on the landing outside the apartment door. however you are the only apartment on the landing so it is no problem at all. 😁

This apartment is extremely spacious. There were only three of us, but the apartment easily could accommodate five or six. The location is excellent. There is a grocery store nearby (about a 2-minute walk), and it's only about a 10-minute walk to the train station. I definitely recommend this apartment.

Good property. Centrally located. Short walk from the main train station. Layout is a bit disjointed but mattresses were good and it handled our party of four adults easily. Large master bedroom has sloped ceiling so you need to be careful. All in all a good place. I would rent again.

Janet, What could I possibly say other than what a fantastic place to stay! Through my many travels internationally I've never had such a terrific host. The place was very clean and comfortable. The bed was great and the convenience of being near Uetliberg and the city were all added bonuses. Janet always made you feel like you were home. Her place had plenty of kitchen space and supplies and my bed was one of the most comfortable beds I've ever stayed on. She also has a great washer and dryer and a nice bathroom with excellent water pressure. She is very nice and caring. I highly recommend staying at Janet's if you find yourself in Zurich. A truly 5 star experience! Thanks, Brian
Janet was hospitality and helpful in anything. Feel so comfortable with her. And the location is so convenient.

What fabulous hosts!! House had a piano and lots of other wonderful musical instruments for the children to play. We were across from cows grazing on pasture, there was a farm stand across the street, we could walk to town easily and stroll to the beautiful fun lake.

This is a great place to stay with family. We were a family of 7 people spanning 3 generations. As soon you enter the house you feel this is a true home away from home, lovely decorated, a real warm feeling. The location is great with a nice view and only about 10 min. away from the lake shore. Grocery shopping and public transportation is also close by. A great place!

Dorothea was very nice. and she responded quickly to our emails, and the apartment was already warm when we arrived, that was a nice gesture from her. The apartment was perfect for our trip, 10 minute walk to downtown. We also used the tram a lot and the polybahn all that was 2 minutes away from the apartment.

I had a Fantastic stay with Mr. Rodríguez, he is a super nice and friendly person, as well as everyone in the house, I truly felt like in home, and really enjoyed my stay. The neighbourhood is very pretty, calm, and sorrounded by nature. Thank you very much for everything Mr. Rodriguez! I loved the experience to stay at your home. Thank you very much for having me.
Rodriguez was a great host! Very detailed, professional and the place was very nice. He is a very kind person; I wouldn’t hesitate to rebook with him next time I’m in Zurich!

We booked this place on 26th July 2025 for a family trip to Zurich from 4th Aug to 9th Aug. Unfortunately had to cancel it due to my son's unexpected health concern. He is a autistic young person. Our son’s health & wellbeing needed more attention at that point of time. Hence we informed the Host Dimi immediately on 29th July 2025 that we will not be able to make it for this trip and requested her help in terms of a giving us a refund. She declined our request despite we explaining her our situation multiple times. We found that humanatrian/empathetic approach was missing from the host side. With a heavy heart we are writing this review.
I think for the its price the place was okay and location is great. But the host does not even provide hand soap and washing machine capsules. Floor was quite dirty. Doors make cringy noise.

Sebastian’s place is cozy for two. He is responsive and very accommodating to our every requests. However, room is quite cold during winter as there is no heater except for a dehumidifier. The walk up a steep hill to the apartment is challenging with luggages but can be resolve using other pathways. What you see is what you get.
No steps at all, perfect location between airport and downtown on tram 10 which run constantly. However, a very steep hill from the tram. Super quiet and gorgeous neighborhood.
Had 3 nights in Zurich and we really enjoyed it. The apartment was very nice and was close to centrum. There is a quite steep hill you have to force if you come from train station/downtown
The apartment is in a good location and everything was very clean. The available space was used very well and the Host replied quickly to questions.
Cozy apartment with the tram running just next to the building. Staying there was very nice and convenient.

I loved my stay at Larissa’s Place. It was beautiful and clean. Larissa was so kind and offered me coffee and a yoghurt or sandwich breakfast. The kitchen was great to use and the bathroom very spacious. I loved the attic style apartment within a building with a rich history.
The location was good and it was clean, but the air was hot and repressive and the tub didn’t drain. Just not quite as good as the other Airbnb properties we have stayed in

The place was very hot - the AC h its weren’t strong enough and when we came they were blowing heat with all the sunlights in the house warming it up without blinds. There weren’t as many bedrooms as advertised and people had to sleep in common space including a nook under the stairs (no real space to keep things and no privacy). It is actually 2 apartments and each apartment got one different piece of paper with instructions/rules but there wasn’t much helpful and two differing instructions was confusing. The place is very nice and modern but not the sleeping situation we expected. When it was overheated the host wasn’t helpful and forthcoming in solutions. I wish there was more than one set of keys per apartment given how many guests it holds.

Great place, very clean and stylish. Close to public transports and grocery shopping facilities just around the corner. The traffic on the “Wehntalerstrasse” in front of the apartment however is pretty loud.

It was just great, everything from the linens, kitchen and appliances were super! Even great soap products, and a little bag of cooking treats for the first day. Lots of towels. Hot water, great water pressure, three balconies (one for each floor). Close to transportation (train and bus), grocery stores and some restaurants.

Alexander's apartment is lovely and spacious! He was super kind and generous as a host and I felt like I was truly in a home. The apartment is light and airy and the beautiful kitchen made cooking easy. Thank you for a wonderful stay!!!

It was okay, nothing special though. The room was clean and had everything we needed. The rest of the flat is shared with other flatmates and thus was not clean. Furthermore it was repeatedly noisy in the evening - however they were quiet after we complained about it. It is a cheap place for Zurich, so if you just need a bed for the night and are not a light sleeper, it's ok.

Excellent place! Very clean, very private. Far from the city center but there is a bus station right outside that is very convenient and Zurich public transportation is very good. Definitely recommend!

Alex's apartment is at a great location, right in the heart of Zurich. He is excellent in communicating and accommodating requests. He has great taste in art and decor and has set up the apartment really well. We enjoyed staying at his home and definitely recommend it.
Amazing stay! Very large apartment close to local transit and close to the city center. Tania is very responsive and kind. Highly recommend!

We really enjoyed the stay even the weather wasn’t so good. The location was very convenient for visits and supermarkets! The environment was also very calm and quiet but there are plenty of public transportation around! The rooms are large and warm enough to feel at home. We will definitely stay again when we visit Zurich next time !!

Large, quiet home in a very charming neighborhood. Extremely close to a large shopping center (grocery stores, etc...) and the train line to the center of the city. Had a very positive experience here.

Chris’s apartment was located right across the River in old town area. Great for a short stay! Only issue was the lift wasn’t working for the first day and had to go up to the 4th floor with my luggage 🥵 haha. Obviously, it was not his fault and it was fixed the next day, so not to worry about it for the next person to book here. The only other thing is that no air conditioner during this heat wave in June made it a bit uncomfortable while sleeping at night. The fan and open windows helped a bit, but from what I hear, it’s difficult to get a permit for A/C in Switzerland for apartments. I’d definitely stay here again due to proximity to main station as well as the lake/river.

Location 20/10 Cleaniness & accuracy 1/10. You literally can’t do better for location and view. Truly. It’s amazing. But that’s where it stops. The place was very dirty. Holes in bedding, food stuck on all dishes, bird poop on inside windows, stains on curtains and walls. I have pictures. I literally cleaned every kitchen item before using. The description is inaccurate. Nothing luxurious about it. Very small for two people, missing TV, only had one coffee cup so we shared, you do dishes in the bathroom which is unsanitary. There’s just a lot. The host said he upgraded me to this location but when comparing listings I noticed it was much smaller and cheaper then the one I originally booked. He become a little combative when I brought it up. Still waiting for my refund….

The place is very stylish and a bit out of town but near a very convenient bus stop which goes in town in about 15 minutes. I did have to kill roaches but the apartment seems like a shed extension of the house so perhaps that's expected. It's in a very quiet and residential neighborhood and Kaithrin was excellent at communication. Full amenities and nice little touches such as tea, olive oil, spices, etc already included.
Kathrin is a fabulous host. The place is lovely and we were extremely happy. They are super helpful in fixing any issues that crop up

Highly recommend staying here!! It was very clean and peaceful, and the views were gorgeous. I found it to be very walkable to the center and there was public transportation right outside the building to get you to the center. I will definitely be coming back!

The place is beautiful and the view even better. The only thing that was too much for us was the malfunction of the cooktop. We couldn’t get it to work and couldn’t cook there, which was our intention from the get-go. The kitchen appliances could also be better. Key pickup is a bit hard to get especially with the hills. It’s a hike especially with heavy luggage. You need to climb a steep hill. Tips: take the Tram, much faster to climb.

Very well thought out and executed space. I had everything I needed and felt very comfortable during my stay while my husband was in hospital. Extending the stay for a night was no trouble for Rossana to organize. No stress for me. Thank you.

We felt very fortunate to stay at this Airbnb. the location was excellent, right near Tram stops that could connect you to anywhere you want to go. The neighborhood was very quiet and we got great sleep every night. the host was responsive and we had no trouble for our week in Zurich. Thank you very much!

We spent 5 days in the apartment and the location was perfect. The space is very spacious and it was easy to enjoy the city with a lot of shops, restaurants and transportation available. Unfortunately the apartment was not very clean and there was a very strong smell of food or cigarette in the kitchen. The kitchen was especially dirty with traces of oil, the balcony had cigarettes on the floor and we found dirty tissues below the bed… the washing machine and dryer were dirty with black spots. Very basic hygiene products were provided (mini soap, dishwashing product and tablets but that’s about it). Overall I would recommend this apartment because of the central location and spaciousness bit for the price I would expect a clean apartment.
Nice place close to the public transportation that made it very easy to get around. Space was comfortable and clean

Really clean, nice place. Perfect for a night before leaving on a trip at Zurich Airport. Many public transportation options to get to the airport at <1 minute from the apartment. The only default is that there is no elevator and the apartment is on the third floor. Be mindful of that if you are bringing strollers and heavy suitcases. However, Vincenzo is very kind and offered to help carry up my things. :)
This is a perfect place for business and pleasure. I loved the location, the amenities, the ambiance, the staff and the host. I can’t imagine staying anywhere else in Zurich.

Great apartment. Nice appointments. Great bathroom. Great location. Only downside is it is quite noisy front the street. The AC’s run through the windows so it will be quite noisy. Other than that the place is excellent. James communicates really well and was extremely accommodating to an early bag drop.

The room was rather spacious for one person. There is no common "chill-area" which is why there is not much interaction with the host. However, Vincenzo welcomed me nicely and was flexible regarding the time of my arrival. A good place for people who will be out most of the time. The apartment is right next to a busy street, so sleeping with an open window was not an option for me (but I guess that also depends on your tolerance, I am rather sensitive). The public transport is great though, so it is easy to get around town.

Hello, Had a bad experience with the radiators as they were not working for a day and the temperature outside was -2°C and infant were freezing inside the house, one of the bathroom shower was having cold water until the day i checked out, One of the clothes rack (Heated) was not working until i checked out, On the second 2day of my stay the lift/elevator stopped working which was sorted in about 3-5hrs time frame where in half of my day was wasted. By paying 650/Euro per night i was not rewarded any compensation. Additional heater provided after 24hrs. House is nicely done and right in the city center 1min walking to bahnhofstrasse. Thanks

James is an outstanding host - he’s very responsive and flexible. The apartment is super clean and modern. The location is great and walkable to the train station, trams, restaurants and coffee shops.
the place is nice but the lights in the bathroom is too dim and not enough water pressure otherwise we had a nice stay there.
I tried already another apartment in this building. Love it every time and loved this one even more...great location...amazing set up in the apartment and loved both the sauna and the bathroom
James is consistently great with all his listings. This one in particular has such a convenient location especially if you plan on using the train. Very clean and modern.

The James-Team is absolutely kind and caring. I was really looking forward to this great apartment. Unfortunately, I had a to cancel due to a serious family issue. Thanks to the James-Team, who took immediately care of this I got a complete refund. Awesome Service!

This apartment is in a nice location super close to multiple tram stations making it easy to get around the city! The host was super helpful and always responded quickly to our needs and questions. As listed there is no AC and it was very hot during our visit. Fans were provided and appreciated but the heat was very uncomfortable.
Beautiful modern apartment with all comfort and well linked with trams and busses to go anywhere in the city

The apartment itself is outstanding - very modern, beautifully designed, and thoughtfully detailed. The space makes a strong impression, and I’m happy to give it the highest rating. The team was responsive and addressed any questions that arose, which I truly appreciated. At the same time, the only discomfort for me was related to technical issues that were already present upon arrival and had not been taken care of in advance. I would gladly return if all technical aspects were fully taken care of before arrival and did not require the guest’s involvement during the stay.

It was my best buy in AirBnB for my business trip so far. Josie is charming and kind, friendly and good at cooking as well, The room kept very clean and organized perfectly, The location is just next to Oerlikon station where many train lines stop. It This new redevelopment town from industrial area has everything such as nice restraint and decent glossary market but unfortunately there is no historical feeling of Zurich

The place is very clean and conveniently located directly next to a major train station. Oerlikon itself is mostly built in the late 1980 or later so you won't find any of the historic attractions nearby. City center however is easy to reach with public transport. Host has long term experience in renting out that home. She is very welcoming in the beginning. I even got a cake when she and her partner were staying at the flat. For a business trip this room is a good fit.

Our family of 5 stayed for 3 nights at Daniel’s apartment. It was clean, large and the kitchen was excellent. Daniel always responded quickly to our communication. This apartment is not in the old town, but there are two trams that go past and the public transport is so easy and fast to get into town I would say it is a very good choice to stay. We would recommend this to friends.
Top place to visite the city and the communication with the owner is very good!

Overall value for money. Sonja was responsive, very helpful in assisting the check-in process. The place also offers washing machine and dryer, which is really a good perk. Unfortunately the house is a bit dusty.

Perfect accommodation for short, mid and long stays. The whole house is for the quests of the 4 rental rooms. Common part is well maintained and the individual areas are kept with respect to privacy. It is nice to meet other people and have a chat. Rossana is open and ready to help or explain local live. She helped me with a place, where I could park a car (parking in Zurich is a bit complicated). A place definitely worth recommending!

A fantastic and good value place to stay. The room is just like a hotel room with only the small downside of not having any light blocking curtains. There were privacy curtains so it wasn't too much of an issue. Rossana is an excellent and very quick at responding to any questions you may have. The house was lovely and was in an ideal location for my travels. I would highly recommend a visit 😁

Judy was not there when we checked in and out. But everything was so good organised that we could not feel to ask anything. The apartment was neat and clean and very centrally located. It was great pleasure to be able to reside in her apartment and I would definitely recommend her place to stay in Zürich.
Judy gave perfect instructions so that everything from arrival to check-out was very easy! She was also very flexible and kind and gave us lots of important information about the city!

The apartment is wonderful! It felt like abhome away from home. The sofa bed is enough for 2 people, the room and bathroom are clean, the kitchen has utensils, WIFI works, the owner is friendly and kind, the rooftop was a plus! It has a nice view of the city 😍. The apartment is near the lake, so bring swimwear because if the weather is good, you’d definitely want to swim! 21 minutes walk from Bus Station, 20+ minutes walk to the city, but there is a tram station nearby if you don’t want to walk. Would definitely stay here again if I would visit Zurich again. 😊
Henri was extremely helpful, he made sure check in was as easy as possible. This stay is in the perfect location, very clean and with great views! Highly recommend :)

Paula's place is the best location that one can imagine for business or leisure travel. The apartment is located in a green area, very close to the city center, the bus stop is in front of the building just 1 min away, supermarkets are just 10 min walk. Everything you need is available in the apartment, the room is very bright with wood floor and balcony, bed is comfortable and the atmosphere is very relaxed. Paula and her dog are the best hosts one can have, kind and warm, she is taking care of everything. It was a great pleasure to stay at Paula's place and I am very happy I made a new friend:)

Outstanding experience at Paula’s place!! Great location, clean and cozy flat, bright room, relaxed atmosphere: absolutely enjoyable! But the best part is for sure Paula’s hospitality! She makes you feel welcome from the beginning on; she is a wonderful, warm-hearted person who shares the true traveller’s spirit:) Her dog Toshi is also very sweet! Wholeheartedly recommended!!

The place is well connected to the city center, the area is quiet. The hosts were really responsive and always available for any questions. The only thing that could be slightly improved, in my opinion, is the general cleanliness of the floors both in the room and the common areas (which also depends on the people staying in the other rooms).

This apartment was perfect for what I needed. I was in Zurich for a weeks work assignment and I had everything I required including cooking facilities. The bed linen and towel smelled fresh and there were toiletries incase I needed them. It was warm and cosy.

The apartment is located within walking distance of Zurich Main Station and Langstrasse, and also has a bus stop, convenience store and restaurants nearby. Communication with Bandula was easy and he even came to explain how to use the washing machine and dryer. The apartment was smaller than in the photos, but there was enough space to store all of my luggage and rest comfortably.

Jelena was a lovely host, very warm and friendly. The place is very clean, quiet and has some characterful touches. The bed was very comfortable :-) I was expecting the place to be further from the centre, but I could walk there in about twenty minute or so. There are also trams nearby.

Comfy stay. Easily accessible by transport. Jelena is courteous and polite, she was nice to help me with my luggage and offered coffee in the morning. I slept like a baby after a long flight however it can get a bit warm in summer and there’s no AC or fan. I would stay again with Jelena.

Such a great place to stay on a budget! It was a beautiful area, the bedroom was clean and the bed was very comfortable, and it was nice and quiet at night— slept great! Would definitely stay here again when in Zurich!

Great place in a quiet neighborhood, but walking distance to Kinkelstrasse tram stop where you can catch several different trams (direct to Zurich Train Station and Airport). Flat is very modern with good wifi and seems to be recently updated with very nice fixtures. Entrance and exit is through a keypad code which you get to choose, which means you don't have to worry about carrying around a key. There is not a cooktop but there is a machine called a Thermomix, which I had never seen before. Its like a big metal cooking blender and it was easy to make pasta in. There is a microwave as well and the washer dryer does both the washing and drying in one go. Really nice place.

Was a really comfortable and private place to stay, not so far out from the main hub in Zürich. There was some noise from construction, but of course that’s out of the hosts control. Other than that this place was perfect!

Very comfortable studio within 15 minutes by tram of the city center, close enough to access but far enough for peace and quiet. It’s very clean and spacious with a beautiful, minimalistic design sensibility. The bed is large and very comfortable and the views out the window of the surrounding neighborhood were pleasant to wake up to. A 5 minute walk from the apartment up the hillside is Zürichberg woods. Go get lost in them for a few hours at sunrise, and when you get back don’t deny yourself the breakfast that is offered - it’s superb. Thank you, Duri and Luzia, see you next time.

It's a beautiful space, very stylish and well thought out. It has every little thing you could need, has a great location near public transport (direct tram line to the airport), wonderful view, comfortable bed, and super friendly hosts. I really look forward to coming back.

A very nice apartment. The room and the bathroom are very comfortable. The neighborhood is very quiet and not far from the Alte Stadt to walk. The shops aren’t so far, as so for the public transport. We recommend you

The big attic apartment is very nice and clean. It is on the top floor of a nice building and although it was a bit warm during our stay, the open windows allowed for a nice cross breeze and we were very comfortable. The kitchen and bathroom were well stocked, including any toiletries that you may have forgotten. The lift was broken and Strahinja came over during checkout to help us get our bags down the stairs. He was very friendly and helpful. The only thing I would caution against is staying there with young children as the loft bedroom has a very steep ladder to reach it. This was fine for our teenagers but would be a worry with young kids. We enjoyed our stay and will definitely book again if we are in Zurich!

Great location, really pleasant and clean rooms, but the thing that makes this such a good place to stay are locality. Everything is nearby and you will enjoy the near by places as well. It was one of the nicest places we stayed in the two weeks were in Europe.

We really enjoyed the stay. Simon was friendly and helpful, and the rooms well appointed and spacious. The location was very convenient for us, especially being close to some wonderful swimming spots and to public transport.

My stay in Christians place was very pleasant. Great location, clean place and cozy whilst having pretty much all amenities you need. Good communication with the host. I would stay again and for sure recommend.

Great place to stay, walking distance from most of Zurich’s touristic places. My only consideration is that it’s more of a room with a private bathroom, there’s a little small cooking area with limited space and appliances. The price is Ok considering that Zürich is extremely overpriced, however I still believe it’s expensive. All that regarded, cozy place with a beautiful view.

We had a great stay with Trudi. The Airbnb is in a beautiful historical building and the gardens are spectacular. Trudi is the perfect host! She is welcoming and kind. We looked forward to breakfast with her each morning. Check-in and communication was really smooth. The location in Zurich's old town is on a charming, quiet street and you are still close to the main sights and the lake. It's a great 'home base' while visiting Zurich. We will be staying here again and are already looking forward to it! Highly recommend!
Thank you for allowing us to book so last minute! Our family of 7 was displaced after a missed flight and we needed a place in Zurich just for the night. It was great!

Trudi was nothing less than a superb hostess. We felt so welcomed by both she and the house, really feeling like we found our home-away-from-home. Trudi provided us with delicious breakfasts, wonderful conversation, and fantastic advice on wandering throughout Zurich. The house itself is magnificent, and the location is perfect. We hope to return again one day! Thank you for everything, Trudi. Take care :)

Anouar is very warm-hearted. We had dinner together, talked about jobs, culture, and he even helped me find an apartment for longer rent. The place is cool, with all necessary stuff for a short stay. Staying there is definitely recommended.

I had a great stay at Anouar's. There's a tram stop right nearby, so it's super easy to get into the downtown areas; or, head up the hill and get to parks! Had a great time chatting with Anouar, and he was super flexible. I had to work remotely while there and the wifi was great.

This apartment is in the perfect central location in Zurich, walking distance to scenic locations, trendy bars and restaurants, main train station and public transport. Even though it is so central it located on a quiet, safe and cute street. The apartment is very cosy, clean, stylish and very spacious. We did not get to meet Natalia personally but communication was very quick and easy and she made sure we had everything we need, including an extensive list of personal tipps for the city! Would highly recommend and hope to stay here again. Thanks Natalia!

Stylish and very clean apartment in a cool neighborhood. Very close to public transport, grocery stores, trendy shops and great restaurants & cafes. The place was equipped with all we needed and plenty of space for a family of 4. Natalia was a wonderful host and very responsive. Check in was easy. We’d definitely stay here again next time we are in Zuerich.

Great location. It was quiet and very near public transit. The #8 was literally on the corner a 3 minute walk away, close to the grocery store and a good cafe. Very convenient. I was on my own so the studio was good for me. Mia was helpful and I had everything I needed.

Nice flat, small but comfortable. The situation is great, very close to the language school were my daughter stayed. Mia was not here at arrival and departure but gave us clear instructions to find everything.

Our staying was great, I have never experienced such a warm welcoming such as we did. Ceco, his mom and his family were outstanding, gave us many tips about the places around and what to do in Zurich. It was such a pleasure to stay there and I highly recommend the place 100% no doubts.

I used this Airbnb during my last Interrail stop in Zürich and was able to rest very well as I was already quite a bit exhausted because of all the prior trips Unfortunately I didn’t get to meet Nana herself as she wasn’t home during my stay, but she sent me all the right information to check in myself The apartment itself was very clean spacious and cosy with a well stocked kitchen with all kinds of spices and African foodstuffs. I recognised some of them 😊 This Airbnb isn’t that far from Oerlikon station but I would recommend taking bus 80 for the last part. I did the walking two times but it was at least 20 min each time Highly recommend this place for a trip to Zürich

Nana's home is very homely. The checkin instructions were easy, and she was very friendly and accomodating.. The place is very well connected. Just 3 min from a bus stop which connects to a train station in 5 min and from there it's 10 min to Zurich central station. The apartment is on 5th floor, but there is lift available. there are just a 4-5 steps that you might need to carry your luggage to get to the apartment. The home was very homely, clean, and very homely. Washroom was very clean and pristine.
We really enjoy the time that we stay in this house. It's really nice and has the good location.

This is an amazing place to stay in Zurich. The rooms are spacious, well kept, and will meet the needs of large or small groups. It is just outside the city center, but the tram stop is only a few meters away, and you are at the train station and city center in 15 minutes. I especially liked the view from the rooms, and that the neighborhood is quiet and very safe. And the obvious added bonus of a great breakfast.

The host, Judy, is fun and kept us informed of anything needed for check-in and check out timely and the villa is decorated with very good taste as if it came straight from Instagram. The garden and lake view are contributing to the charm of this villa. We had conduicive teambuilding discussions in the dining area, with enough space at a large oval artistic table :)

The apartment is very nice and the host is very helpful. Everything was very good. I was just surprised that the apartment was full of guests - there are 3 AirBnB small rooms in the apartment so there is quite a lot of opportunity to meet other people ;)

The terraces are amazing! It’s such a pleasure to spend the morning out on the terrace before heading off for the day. The location is super convenient, just two minutes to the tram and a 15-minute walk to Lake Zurich at a relaxed pace. The only downside was that the apartment wasn’t very clean… but that’s something easily fixed with a bit of tidying up :) Overall, I definitely recommend it to everyone!
Great, central location close to the train station, with modern and spacious rooms. Very friendly and helpful staff.
The hotel location is near to public transport and close to the shops. The room was clean. You can find everything you need to feel very well in this hotel.

The neighbourhood was quiet and the tram station was walkable. Sabrina’s apartment had a huge balcony where I often drank my morning coffee and did some yoga. My sister says Sabrina has an excellent tea collection. We did cook dinner every night, we carried some Indian spices but the bonus was her kitchen too had some. Me and my sisters had a good stay. There was also an elevator, of course we are not the light travellers. Great stay over all !!

My children and I were very comfortable in the apartment and we loved it. The apartment was couple of minutes away from public transportation which was great and there was a small shopping mall couple of minutes away also. The only only minus I would say was the continues church bell ringing and disturbing our sleeps☹️ The apartment is very close to the church so you can here it very well. The church bell would ring every hour from 7:00- 22:00.
I loved this place. Close to the lake and old town. I walked everywhere. The flat is very spacious and light and I loved the design touches. Ana was very helpful with everything.

My stay at Chris place was simply perfect! Perfect space, location, communication,amenities.
