This is the place to be when in Zurich, 2 blocks from the lake, 10 minutes walk from Bellevue, supermarkets, restaurants, pharmacy in less than 1 minute and trams number 2 and 4 at your doorstep. Do you think this is all? No! The best is that although super central, the isolation is so good that you don’t hear anything, so your good night of sleep is guaranteed. I can’t recommend this place enough and would for sure stay here again! Thanks Chris!!!

Great comfortable quiet spotless studio in Seefeldstrasse. Unit has amazing new soundproof windows and apartment is right by tram stop and great markets. Close to the beautiful lake and wonderful green uphill hiking. Navigation to all Zürich destinations is easy and efficient. Enjoyed coffee on my tiny terrace.

Cher was a wonderful host, always reachable and giving us useful tips. The apartment was super clean. From fast wifi to bathroom amenities, it has everything you need. We can highly recommend this place and would always come back!!
Very convenient to get to and from. Only a few bus stops from the main part of Zürich!

This was a perfect stay for our trip to Zurich! It was right near the local tram, and a doable walk to the main station. They also left thoughtful snacks and had great communication! Would recommend :)

Location was great. Walking distance to nearest team was less than 5 min. The communication was excellent. We'r did share 1 shower for 7 people, but never ran out of hot water. Washer and dryer was a plus. It was perfect for our big group. However not really a place to all hang out as one of the bedrooms is also the TV room with the couch. Very comfortable.

The house is very clean, and is very close to a lot of tram stations (Englishviestrasse, Klusplatz, Romerhof, Kreuzplatz- the one we use when we go to Zurich HB). 2mins walk to the English-speaking Catholic church. Restaurants and grocery stores close to Kreuzplatz. Jens also provided coffee, tea, toilet essentials. The sofa bed in the living room is very large and very comfy. Probably can sleep 3 people. However the airconditioner that is mentioned is NOT for the whole house. It is only a portable one for the living room. The other rooms are cooled by electric fans. Not a big deal when it is not that hot as you can also open the windows. Just a note also that you have to climb up some steps to get to the ground floor apartment. In all, this is a good place for staying in Zurich.

This is a very nice and clean apartment with a beautiful veranda and access to a small courtyard. The house itself is located near the old town - 5-7 minutes by tram (the stop is right next to the house) or 15-20 minutes on foot. Jens is very welcoming, he quickly answers all questions.

Nice, convenient place not far from the city center. I never met Rachelle in person as she was in Hawaii. But check-in and communication with her was easy. When I had a minor complaint after check-in, she immediately addressed and solved the issue from the distance, which was great. It's easy to get to the center by tram. And I really liked the nearby Irchel Park. What I found a bit confusing was that the hard wood floor trembles a little bit when neighbors walk around. However, the place was nice and quiet most of the time. Definitely recommend it.

I had stayed at Rachelle’s place earlier and I remembered it as a cosy apartment for a single person. So, I stayed here again for a month this time and it was quite comfortable. Transportation and shops are nearby and the building is quiet. The apartment is quite well stocked with essentials, so even though I was there for a month, I didn’t find anything lacking and used the washing machine/dryer in the basement too. Rachelle was friendly, helpful and responsive. Would love to stay here again.

The apartment is at perfect location,very easy to get around with public transportation and walking distance to awesome bars and restaurants. The pace is great, very clean and has everything you need .Totally recommend it.

Strahinja was an amazing host, offering us extra items for our little ones to make our stay more enjoyable. The washer and dryer are clearly marked with clear instructions on how to use them. I also appreciated extra toiletries that were provided!

The location easy to get to via tram. Just a bit walk once you get off. The only thing, if I were to nitpick, would be I wish the place had a fan. The open window bring cool air in but a fan would help circulate it better. The check in was easy. The hose sent detailed directions with pictures for location and process to get the key. She was responsive and the place was very clean.

Convenient location, a few tram stations away from Zurich HB. However, I’ve trouble opening the main entrance, it’s difficult to figure how it works. It was noisy at night, and the lights were a bit dim, but others are all very nice. The bathing room was clean, and the kitchen had all we need.
It was a wonderful stay and the flat is even nicer and larger than the pictures capture.

One of the best locations in Oerlikon. We had the most pleasant stay and Micaela is very responsive and accomodating. The apartment is clean and spacious with multiple balconies. Easy access to public transportations, groceries, cafes and restaurants. Will stay here again in our next visit. Thanks so much for hosting us Micaela!

Bandula is a great host and responded very quickly by whatsapp when I had a question or problem. The place is tiny but clean and very well located just off Limmatplatz. I especially appreciated that he put a Nespresso machine in the kitchenette for me because I am a „coffeeholic“. I have not met Bandula in person, but I would definitely book this place again.

Clean, cozy, and trendy spot. Everything you could want and more. Very easily accessible from the train station and airport as well as near a very cool bar that Sebastián recommended. He was the best host!
Well located between the airport and downtown, very clean, the space is comfortable and nicely decorated, the communication was efficient, all in all a flawless stay.
Pascal has an absolutely immaculate apartment just 20 minutes into town with the team. Close to public transport and beautiful park. Thank you!

Great location and window view, you can easily walk everywhere and the main train station is just a 5 minute walk away. Clean, well-stocked apartment with kitchen utensils to cook a meal. Easy check in. The wifi worked well. Great hosts, very helpful. Would recommend.

The location and view from this unit is unbeatable. The host was quick to respond and very accommodating. However, we came over a warm weekend and found the place to be unbearably warm, we stayed out of the unit until late enough to go straight to bed. The shower has been mentioned already but it is quite small and gets water everywhere each time someone uses it so fair warning!

This is a good option for a solo traveler. The building is somewhat secure as the front door may or may not be locked. The apartment is cozy, and suitable for one person only. There were no amenities as properly noted in the listing. I stayed on the 4th floor. Since there are restaurants and bars on the street level, the noise travels up. If both the bedroom and bathroom windows are closed, then the noise is minimal. The unsettling part of my stay was the amount of bug stains on the walls where people have squished insects. I found a couple bed bugs on my pillow and sleeping pad. Also, there was a distinct odor in the pillow, blanket, and sleeping pad provided. Despite 36 hours passing and two showers, I still faintly sense the smell in my hair and skin.

The host was very accommodating and responsive. The place was clean and well kept, with plenty of appropriate cookware. The area, Altstetten is beautiful and close enough to walk to the Limmat River, old town Zurich, and Uetliberg. Public transportation is also a few steps away and very convenient however, we preferred to walk most places.

Great place to stay. Exactly as advertised - great location, close to public transport, very clean. Note that the space is small and on the 5th floor - but it is all clear in the advertisement. The host was great: he communicated clearly, check-in was painless and he helped me with luggage storage after check-out. Wifi is also very fast. Highly recommended.

Great place close to the main station. Lots of great local bars and restaurants to help get a local feel. Grocery store just s couple blocks away. A little bit of a hike up the stairs but there was a fan which helped tremendously during the heat wave.

The apartments is very nice, clean and it has everything and more. I wasn't expecting an apartment as nice as this one. From the pictures all the apartments look nice but this one really is. It was indeed a perfect stay. The best ever I could say.

The host is very reachable and helpful. The apartment is well located and if you're willing to walk 20-25min you don't even need to worry about public transportation to get to most touristic spots. Would stay there again if needed.

This is a perfect place to stay for one person for a few days. I found the location to be great, it’s right in the middle of the Sri-Lanka community and the area is quite alive day and night. About 25 minutes walk from the old town but the walk is quite nice. The space is tiny but private and clean. Overall it was perfect value. I had a nice stay.
The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. It located about 15 minutes away from the central, but the tram station is in front of the door.

Great stay. Location was really convenient for the tram into town. We had really clear instructions for self check in and for leaving and everything worked really smoothly. Apartment was clean and had everything we expected. Would definitely look to stay again next time in Zurich

The house is big and spacious but unfortunately when we opened the door it did have a strong smell like it had been left closed for a long time and no fresh air circulated in there. The sofas in the living room were dirty full of durst. The table and chairs in the backyard were not cleaned at all...we had to clean them ourselves despite the fact that we had paid € 150,00 for cleaning services WIFI did not work Cleaning material was left in the kitchen Well what surprised us the most is that the owner did not even feel sorry about all this he insisted that he had checked the house the day before and it was ok. We thought it was a 5 star apartment but it turned out to be a 2 star. Will never go back there.

Vishvala was an amazing and gracious host and went the extra mile to make us feel welcome and at home. The apartment was beautiful and was a two minute walk from the nearest train stop. The bathrooms were leaking, but it wasn’t a huge deal. There were a couple bugs in the apartment but the host gave us some spray for it. This was the most welcome our family felt from a host. Overall a great experience, and would definitely stay again if in Zurich!

The room is one of some AirBNB rooms located in a very old and beautiful house (hostel - like) in a great location (Züriberg) in Zürich. It´s easy to get to the airport and center by Bus/Tram. We lived in Room 1b which has a picturesque and sunny balcony. According to the house´ age and its thin walls and the Tram passing by it might be noisy, if you´re sensitive for it. But the place in all is quite calm, for us the noise was no problem. Peter and Engin are friendly and helpful people.

I stayed here for a month and really enjoyed my stay. Peter and Engin were very helpful and friendly and the room was beautiful. The only thing I didn't like was that the kitchen was quite small and dark, but otherwise the place is perfect.

Marie is a wonderful host. She was welcoming and easy to communicate with. I only spent one night at her place before catching a flight, but the apartment was a perfect place for a solo traveler. Everything was clean and well organized. The location was perfect for getting to the airport.

Very responsive and friendly host. Bed is just a sofa, but for that very comfortable. Windows are facing the street and tram station with a little noise. There is a fully equipped kitchen, soap and towels, which is a nice extra!
Easy host and a small cosy place at a walking distance to the train station.

There were not basic amenities present - not even a bar of soap to wash our hands. I stayed there with a friend and we specifically booked because it was advertised and pictured as having a pull-out couch, but upon arrival that “couch” was only a chair. The drapes were falling off the windows. There was a noticeable odor in the kitchen. No extra towels were provided. There was no air conditioning and the weather was extremely hot, however a fan was provided. Overall the experience was fairly average, and I wouldn’t recommend staying here. The two good things were that Dimi was very responsive and it was a good location.

We had a wonderful stay at Dimi’s apartment in Zurich! The location was perfect—peaceful, easy to find, and well-connected to everything we needed. From the moment we booked, the host was incredibly responsive and helpful, making the whole process smooth and stress-free. The apartment itself was comfortable, clean, and well-equipped, making it a great place to relax after exploring the city. One small thing to note is that the washer and dryer are shared with other apartments, so availability can sometimes be a bit tricky. However, this did not take away from our overall experience. We truly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Zurich!

The flat was just perfect, featuring a nice small balcony for 2 people to relax, a big living room and a bed with an actually comfy mattress to sleep on. Also the kitchen had everything you need to cook (which comes in handy since Zürich isn't the cheapest city) The communication with Mirjam was always swift and accurately. The location is close to the city center, you can even take public transportation or walk to the city center. An added bonus was the flexibility Mirjam offered when it came to checkin/checkout. When visiting Zürich, I definitely recommend staying at Mirjams place.

It's a lovely apartment. Pretty, cosy and comfortable. Mirjam is a lovely host. It's a place where she stays and the place has her personality. Will stay again if i come to Zurich if the place is available

The apartment is nicely located, close to transit. Within walking distance to some good restaurants and several grocery options. The apartment was very clean and warm in the cooler November weather. Thank you

Really nice and adventurous place to stay, for a very good price. Jakub is really nice and communicates well. The place has everything you might need - except shower which can be arranged from my understanding. You can also make yourself a tea and coffee. We went in March and it was a bit cold weather but the van has heater and it wasn’t that cold. Extra blankets were also provided. Great experience for a van!
Jakub was such a pleasure to be hosted by. He is a very clear and honest guy dedicated to providing a good experience. Truly the cheapest bed in Zurich and worth the price!
nice appartment in the middle of Seefeld. Didn't meet Christiana & Chris but they message promptly and friendly. recommended.
Olivier's place is great: a spacious clean room and your own bathroom. The apartment building is very modern, a very nice vibe with very nice people. Strongly recommended!

The Villa is absolutely beautiful, the rooms large, bright and very comfortable. There’s a well equipped kitchen, a lovely garden and Judy answers any questions very fast. She gives updates on who is coming or leaving and let me park my car in front of her garage, which was extremely kind. I lived in the villa for 10 days and was happy there. The only negative point is that because it’s an old house, the floors creak and you can hear your next door neighbour talking, moving around, etc. This can wake you up on weekends. Apart from that, the Villa is a fantastic place to stay in Zurich and I can fully recommend it.

We enjoyed our stay at Judy’s place, it’s such a beautiful home. I love that it’s so close to the tram so we had access to public transportation right up the street. I worried a little about the shared bathroom situation but it was just fine and we only shared it with one other person, not a problem at all. So don’t let that part hold you back from booking. I think the only thing that surprised me was that it did not include much of a breakfast, just you can make a toast and tea or coffee so you may want to bring your own if you need more. She has a fridge you can put things in overnight. Everything went well and Judy is very social and happy to answer any questions you may have. We had a great day touring Zurich!

This is our second time staying in these apartments. This time with 2 units for ourselves and our parents while traveling to Zurich. We may be biased as we lived nearby for years in the neighborhood in the past, however the location of the apartments and proximity to the lake, tram lines and city are just so wonderful. The apartments and hosts are fantastic for a longer stay in the city/country as we use them for and have everything you need. We'll be back! Thank you.
The room is very spacious, clean and looks exactly like the pictures. The hosts are great people! Loved to stay at their place.

Great apartment. Maher was fantastic! I booked his place last minute, he was quick in responding and I was checked in within 30 mins of booking!! The location is great, about a 10 min walk to Zürich Enge train station. (Faster if you take the tram) There is an adorable cat that lives there, that was a bonus for me😻

"I arrived in the afternoon and went out to look around. However, when I returned to the room at night, it was too hot. I looked for the A/C but couldn't find it. When I contacted Mr. Maher about the air conditioning, he told me there isn't any. I had to sleep in a hot room first night with the window open, which meant dealing with all the noise coming from outside. The next day, he brought me a fan. The second issue is the outside window, which doesn't have a curtain. Imagine having sunlight flood your room at 6:00 AM when you planned to sleep until 9:00 AM."

Amazing place! It's was a short stay for us but the apartment is fully equipped and it's had everything we needed it, very clean and neat with lovely modern stylish touch. It is about 15min away by tram to the centre of the city and on walking distance to supermarket/shopping centre We highly recommended this lovely place and thank to Franz, he is great host! Thank you Mimi&Ves

Franz was extremely kind and communicated very well and responded quickly. It was a pleasure having him host me and my girlfriend during our time in Switzerland. Franz gave great recommendations for activities and hikes in Switzerland and I highly recommend his beautiful home if you’re staying in Zurich it’s only a 5-7 minute walk to several of the Tram stations it made it very easy for us to plan quick trips with everything close by there are also several supermarkets close within 7-10 min walks if you need anything it’s very well located and I’m very glad that we chose to have Franz host us.

The place is very well located. You can reach Zurich center easily by bus+train. I stayed 3 days and it was great. Samir was very kind for leaving everything arranged for my late arrival. Yvonne is very kind and gave me good advice on the transport and a pleasant conversation. I highgly recommend this place. Thank you for everything.

Judy is an amazing host , nice conversation with her, always looking for the best for me , she even gave me a ride! The breakfast is very good and the rooms are very clean, cosy and with amazing view!

Jana's apartment's is spotlessly clean and it is very light and bright. The apartment is very close to Zurich HBF and only a few minutes walk into town. While it is close to this part of the city, it is very quiet at night. There is also two close by supermarkets and eating places. Of course the shopping in the HBF is also close by. We loved staying in Jana's apartment!
The place really good and clean, missing on the complete address to be easier to arrive at the door but the rest fine.

Not a bad location as it’s walking distance to many places and quiet at night. However, you really only get a small room with a bed and a small shared bathroom. And the heat was stifling! There is a fan that somewhat helps but I’d frequently wake up in a sweat. There was also a peculiar smell in the apartment that requires me to wash my clothing in another stay (the drying unit here didn’t seem to be working for others). Not a bad spot, but I’d probably do a hostel next time around.
Judy lives up to the 5-star reviews she receives. Beautiful home, great location, and a helpful host.
I can't say anything about the apartment because we needed to move to another apartment due to a covid-19 person but the communication with Tania was good and easy.
Súper friendly, informative and responsive host. Location is 5 mins walk from the waterfront, fabulous sunset. Cafe, restaurants all you need is in the surrounding. Enjoyable stay.
The host is nice and friendly, but the room is too expensive for its size. The location is great tho if you just want a place to sleep.

Lena is so warm and nice, her excellent preparation and explanation help me survive from many affairs after arriving at Zurich! The room locates in the best area of Witikon, quiet, clean and cosy. just a few minutes walk you can enjoy the wonderful scenery of the whole area!
Excellent Apartment. Very nice and clean, close to the restaurants and pubs. Few minutes walk to Enge train station. Highly recommended and when I come back; surely stay there.

We had a marvellous stay. Chris was extremely helpful in giving local tips and the place was wonderful. Clean and well located. The central town Altstadt is about 15-20 minutes walk but the location has all facilities available. A supermarket, cafe, and tram stop just in front of the building.
Dimi is a great host. Very responsive and friendly. The flat was exactly as described and my partner and I felt right at home. Will definitely return next time we’re in Zurich.

As others have said, Maher's place is a perfect location for anyone visiting Zurich, on a direct route from the airport and in a calm, green part of the city close to the lake and to the shops. There's a great Italian cafe/restaurant directly opposite if you arrive hungry! Maher is a welcoming host but then gives his guests space to do their own thing. The flat has sunny balconies, stylist furniture, comfortable bed, clean towels and is generally a nice place to be.
The place is located in a lovely part of town, close to the lake. Great for morning swims (if you're into it). The apartment is easy to reach by public transport, clean, organized and quite spacy.

Emre’s place is beautiful. Apartment had everything we could want for an amazing holiday. Location is great only 15 min walk to main train station and less to walk to lovely restaurants. Close to the river for swimming too. Very comfortable place to spend time. We had a gig at Hallenstadion and walked home afterwards. Quick taxi to airport too. Great communication from the host. Perfect, thanks again Emre :)

Maher was really great with communication and his apartment has plenty of space! There are other rooms being rented as well so there can be several people coming and going at any time but everyone was nice and you can lock your bedroom door for privacy. There are also two bathrooms for convenience and your able to use all the kitchen facilities. Great place in a great location!

Expect to be close to public transit and grocery stores and the store at the front of the building. You are also about a 45 min drive from Lake Lucerne and excellent hiking through the mountains. I loved walking by Lake Zurich 2 or 3 times a day. I bought a Zurich card downtown at the main train station and used it for public transit to go downtown to browse the scenery and window shop. Also took the short lake cruise twice. Inside the bnb, I found the bed comfortable and the bathroom excellent. I like to cook most of my meals. The kitchen is not set up for cooking every meal. The fridge is great. For cooking, there is 1 burner, microwave and a kettle. However, I did eat most meals at the bnb. If you are not a serious cook, I recommend Alex’s bnb. Have fun.

I've stayed at Sigrid's place before, I've returned as it is the best experience. I've rented apartments and being in hotels, I still prefer staying at her place for she gives a lot of useful information, makes you feel very welcome, the apartment is spacious and very well located. The apartment have a fully equipped kitchen, laundry and is very comfortable.
The room, the shower room, and the kitchen are clean and tidy. Sigrid is very kind, helped me a lot during the stay. Quiet and peaceful neighborhood.

Fine apartment in the tram line. Very near are grocery stores, restaurants and bakeries. The bathroom has a great shower and the main bed in comfortable. Keep in mind it is on a busy road and therefore very loud. The kitchen has a few things for preparing basic meals.

Great location and fair price. But the place was not thoroughly cleaned (there was confetti and popped balloons on the floor from the Zürich Street Parade the previous weekend) and the host had the checkin time wrong even though we discussed it prior; we showed up and he asked us to come back in one hour.
Convient location to the train station, bedroom was a bit small, but overall, we enjoyed our stay and the quiet atmosphere of the hotel.

Great hotel, staff, and location! I really enjoyed my stay—the staff were friendly and helpful, and the location was perfect for exploring the area. The only downside was that the room was a bit too warm, and opening the windows let in quite a bit of noise from outside. Otherwise, everything was excellent!

Tania's place is great--super stylish and comfortable and a good location. Kitchen is stocked w/ all the utensils you need to cook, although be aware that the it might be completely empty in terms of non-perishables like cooking oil (although there was s & p), but the super market a block away makes it super easy. Right by the water, it's about 10-12 min walk to the Opera House. Great cafes close by

I almost didn’t want to give the apartment a good review, just to keep it to myself! Unfortunately I don’t have an excuse to be in Zurich that often. Really a fantastic apartment, with a great host. Beautiful secure building in one of Zurich’s more upscale neighborhoods. Apartment is a couple hundred yards from the nearest tram stop. Great selection of cafes, restaurants, and stores within easy walking distance.

A great, well maintained place. Very close to Lake Zurich and a short walk from Old Town / Zurich HB. Tania responded promptly and accurately. A note for future guest, remember to carry your body wash and detergents. This Air BnB doesn't have these as supplies and unfortunately it is not mnetioned in the listing. We carried our own but when our stocks ran out we were left stranded on Sunday evening as all convenience stores were closed. Overall a great experience

Location is great: 1 min walk to train station and supermarkets. A few blocks down and you will be at the lake for a stroll. Washing machine in basement but it is a communal sharing so plan to do laundry during off peak hours. Clean with elevator. Apartment was warm in the middle of winter.

What can i say ? Worth IT! I Love the place big n clean .. near to the lake and shop… i feel like home .. wish i could stay longer… will come back again when im back in Zurich … the host is very responsive.. thanks again👍😀 recomended 5*
Dimi was a wonderful host - responsive and helpful from the moment we booked. The apartment is in a great location, had everything we needed, and was very clean. Highly recommend.
A great place to stay over a weekend to see the city! Very central and near everything

As comfortable as it is for a 3-star hotel stay. Room and bathroom were clean and comfortable for use. Located near the train station (5-10min walk) and close to restaurants and the river. Honestly a little too pricey, 3-5min walk further in the area are accommodations half the price.

Love the style and the breakfast was good but at an additional cost. If you have to stay in the city and you're in a pinch, this place works. If you can stay outside of the city a bit you can save some money, have breakfast included, and get a more authentic experience.

This space is just as advertised. The location is a quick tram ride taking the S11 from Bahnhofstrasse HB followed by a short two minute walk. We arrived early in the morning and were allowed to drop our luggage several hours prior to the scheduled check in time. The space was easy to access, taking the small elevator to the third level. Inside was perfectly clean and tidy, although there were no minor amenities such as a few coffee pods, sugar packets or cooking oil, which seem to be standard in most of the Airbnb’s we’ve stayed in. The space is comfortable and well organized, but there is a bit of traffic noise from the busy street below. The host arranged for a fan so we were able to close the windows and still have some air movement during the warm evenings.

This is a great flat to explore Zurich from. Good transport links to the centre, walkable to the river, and more spacious than many of the other flats you will find. It's also close to a grocery store and good local coffee and restaurants. Has all the basic amenities, access to washing machine facilities, and lovely and tidy. There were reviews suggesting it was noisy and/or hot but we found with the blinds kept down in the hottest part of the day and windows open we were fine. You wouldn't want the bedroom window open at night due to street noise but the others were totally fine. I would certainly stay here again when back in Zurich!

The place is very convenient and just a 2 minutes walk from the station. Natalie was also very helpful and respond quickly to any enquiries. Her place is very comfortable and 100% true to the photos provided. Supermarkets and shopping malls are also very close by and easily accessible. Would definitely stay here again!

A really lovely place with really welcoming host. Natalie is so awesome and give us with helpful advices for everything. Equipments and things are so well prepared and the loft is so sweet and lovely. With train station and supermarkets nearby. Really recommended.

Checking in and out was super easy. I loved the location because it's both quiet and very central. I also loved how restaraunts, markets, and the train stop are a very short distance away. The price is what you'd expect for Zurich. The only thing I'd request is weekly cleaning if booking for more than a week.

For a two-night stay the hotel was conveniently located, a 20-minute walk from the train station and very close to the excellent Kunst museum, easy to spend six hours there. Lovely Morocco-themed cafe and bar. The hotel room was spotless and warm.

3rd time staying in Christian's apartment (or maybe the 4th?:), great location with easy access to lake, public transportation, restaurants. Very clean apartment, comfortable bed, and well equipped kitchen. (If the windows are open, you'll hear the tram and some restaurant noise, but the windows are well insulated and when closed, you easily get a good night's sleep). Chris and Christiana are great communicators, and attentive to needs. Absolutely recommend staying there.
It was an exceptional experience, I would recommend it to everybody. The villa itself is huge and beautiful and a rooftop room is very cozy. Judy is really caring host and everything is provided.

Such a beautiful stay at the Villa! Judy is one of the most proactive hosts I’ve come across, exceptionally friendly and helpful. She provided awesome recommendations and even took the time to meet with me personally for a little catch up which I really appreciated. Everything was spotlessly clean, from the room to the bathroom and common areas. The home is stunning, decorated with thought and has real character, including the slightly squeaky floors that come with a historic home! Eating breakfast in the garden was the highlight of my stay - so incredibly peaceful! Location is fantastic, very easy to get around and the room itself was comfortable and bright. Would definitely recommend a stay here!
Very responsive and helpful. Enjoyed the stay - thanks.

Lazhar has been very helpful and extremely responsive. The apartment is nice and in a quiet area. The room was spacious and facing the garden including a nice balcony. We booked the room for my son who was in Zurich for an internship and everything worked very smooth. Can only highly recommend !
Nice apartment with all the amenities you need. The tram stop is 2 minutes walking and you can go to the centre in about 20 minutes.

The location is great and close to the train and bus station. The view is great. However, the fact that he lives there and his personal stuff are everywhere was so weird and made us feel uncomfortable. Also the flat isn’t professionally cleaned which is not ideal. He is responsive but sometimes he is aggressive with his responses and attitude

This AirBnB is superb. The hosts are very social, friendly, and interesting people. The room is private, large, has a fantastic balcony and nice and functional furniture. The location of the apartment is very central. Although it is in a busy street, the room is surprisingly quiet. For us, it could not have been better!

My stay at Andreas's was just perfect. The apartment is ideally located, very well equipped and particularly clean. Andreas was very friendly, he was always responsive in our communications and attentive to my possible needs. I highly recommend!
It is a cozy apartment, clean and comfortable. Its location is very good, close to the Opera (Opernhous) and easily accessible by tram.

Christian's place had everything I needed. It was clean. Easy to find. Right next to public transportation and a short walk from the lake. It's a little ways from the center, but the tram stop is right in front of the door. The street noise is extremely loud so the sound proof windows are a great help. I recommend, especially if you don't need a/c in the summer.

Had a wonderful stay, loved the location, apartment was good, host was helpful, it was a little hot without aircon and the tram stop was outside our door which made getting around super easy however a little noisy at night. Overall it was just what we wanted and would recommend.

We found our “home away from home” when we go visit our son, daughter in law and grandson. The location was perfect with the tram right outside the building and the market right across the street. Two blocks from Lake Zurich, it was a dream. They were well equipped and the place was a perfect size, bigger than a hotel room and much more space. We did have a problem with internet service, but they worked diligently to help us find a solution that worked. Communication was excellent. We definitely will use them for our next visit to Zurich. Definitely recommend.
Lea was so nice and the apartament very comfy

Lea was an excellent host, with superb communication throughout my stay. The apartment's location was perfect, offering easy access to trams, restaurants, and supermarkets. The cleanliness and safety of the place were top-notch. I would definitely choose to stay here again in the future.
A great stay at great location. Close to both train station and Zürich attractions. The room was comfortable, clean and tidy - perfect for a few nights in the city.

It’s a good residential place , bed was comfy , kitchen well equipped, bathroom good. I can’t comment on the local area as we did not go out there. Great that the busstop was right in front of the door and in no time you are at Zurich or the airport . Osaro has been a good host, always being responsive. I liked that check in was flexible, so perfect for that late arrival . The only downside for me was the street noise at night. So if you sleep with the window open that could be an issue. All in all we felt very much at home there and would not hesitate to recommend Osaros place.

This was hands down one of the best airbnbs I've ever had the pleasure to stay at. And I've stayed at A LOT! Its beautiful, the location is perfect, we felt like a local, and they made us feel at home. Thank you ♥️

Rakhals place was great, just a 20 min or less tram ride from the main station in Zurich and you’ll be at the door step! The only down side is we were there in very hot weather and no AC, so a fan for each room would hav been nice. Otherwise it was the perfect getaway!

We had a really great time at Rakhal's apartment. It is perfect when you stay in Zurich with many people (we were 12) and also the location is great. Also Rakhal responded really fast when we had any questions. The only thing we were a bit unhappy about was the kitchen equipment. The pots and pans were in a bad shape, some things were a bit broken (although still working) and there was barely enough cutlery and glasses/ cups for everyone. But we were also really the maximum amount of people and it still worked out somehow. We will definitely come back next time we come to Zurich in a group. :)
Wonderful host, truly made the trip less stressful. And the apartment is right next to a bus stop

The description of the flat and the photographs do unfortunately not match reality: they are misleading. There was not one touch of luxury. The flat is modern but basic; it feels airless and stuffy on warm days as one cannot leave the window open because of the street noise. The best thing is the location: good access to the lake, the city and to public transport.

Great location and price, super-clean, and stylish. It's very small, but that's just what I needed, as I didn't plan to spend hours in the room while awake. Bandula lives off-site but is nice, helpful, and forthcoming with messages. I had a short but pleasant chat with him as I departed.
Good central place in Zurich, very small though, but OK for solo traveler Didn't meet the host but check-in was easy and communication was good

The building is nothing to look at from the outside, but the 4th floor apartment is more spacious that I thought it would be from the photos. The bed was very comfortable, the kitchenette had everything we needed. Bruno even left some coffee for us which was much appreciated. The storage was great and the location is fabulous. Half a block to the river and right in the middle of old town Niederdorf. We would stay here again in an instant and would not hesitate to recommend Bruno's place and Bruno, who was very accommodating and helpful and easy to communicate with. I think staying here helped us love Zurich even more than we would have.

The apartment was great! Super clean and had everything we needed for a four day trip. Location is perfect and in the middle of great bars/restaurants. Unfortunately, it’s a little loud at night because of the bars, but it was what we expected, so it didn’t bother us. Parking is about a 5 minute walk up the hill in a Blue Zone and we never had issues for the entire weekend. Tobias is a great host and I’d definitely stay here again!

Great place in Zurich! Good location, within walking distance to tram and bus stations. Very nice and updated. The only complaint is that it is very hot in the apartment because it’s on the 5th floor with no air conditioning. Honestly this is a first world problem, but definitely couldn’t spend much time in the apartment without sweating. Overall, great stay for the price!

A well-located and clean apartment in the heart of the city. Chris provided clear check-in instructions and communicated necessary information ahead of time. Certainly a warm apartment, but the fan provided definitely helped.

Very charming old villa furnished with taste and modern style. Fantastic marble bathroom, very spacious room, very comfy bed. Judy's villa is really to be recommended and a much better place to be in Zurich than in one of the boring standard hotels.

The B&B is beautiful with stunning views and great architecture. It is far enough out of the main city for relaxation but close enough for any needs. Public transportation is right up the road. It was a perfect getaway and we would loved to revisit given the chance!

Josefine responds quickly and check-in and check-out are quite relaxed and straightforward. It's a small room, but there's more space to use. From Josefine's place you arrive at a nature reserve within 15min of walking and are in the city centre in about 20min by public transport.

I stayed at Josefine’s for a week while doing a course in Uni. The neighborhood was nice, clean and quiet, with good transport connections. The stay at Josefine’s place was really comfortable, clean and she provided everything you might need, but the best part was her hospitality. I enjoyed chatting with her over a cup of coffee at the end of the day!
Manuel was so kind and friendly the apartment was in the center of zurich it was so easy to walk around the city i recommend it
Manuel and his son were fantastic hosts! Always willing to help and really nice people. The place is also great. The room was clean and comfortable and the location unbeatable!

Barbara is a very pleasant and interesting person. The room and the apartment are just wonderful. The area is fantastic, very close to the Train Station and the city center but in a quiet and green area with a beautiful forrest in fron of the door. Great for a city trip and recreation. Highly recommended!

Barbara was fantastic. Her place is a gem! The bed is a little small and firm but everything else was excellent. Location was 10 min tram from most things, area is quiet with a cute forest near by. The bathroom was private and the space is modern and bright. Communication was great and her English is fantastic so it was really easy to communicate. She even helped me figure out an early morning train route that I couldn’t find which saved me a taxi ride. She is friendly and sweet. Would stay again for sure if I come back.
Great one week stay at Katarina’s! The appartement is super clean and conveniently located and Katarina is a perfect host. I will stay again !

I had a very comfortable stay at Katarína’s place. It is located in the most beautiful part of the city. Tram stop, train station, shops and restaurants are all nearby. It was really convenient for me as my office is just 5 mins walk away. The place was kept very clean. This was my first visit to Zurich and Katarína gave me great tips to explore the city. She was also very patient while helping me with some german skills. I had a great time and would visit again!

I loved absolutley everything about this Airbnb Rental. Fast communication, easy flexible Check-In and the view is just amazing! Probably the nicest neighborhood I have ever stayed in, in Zurich, with LOTS of sunshine on their large Balcony and a view to the lake and Ütliberg. A clean, full equipped kitchen, makes your stay even more enjoyable, if you like to prepare home cooked meals instead of eating out all the time. But there are also a lot of good restaurantes just walk distance from the apartment. Also lots of forest close by for some nice walks in nature! Everything was just perfect! Thank you!!!

A cosy studio directly across the street from a train station in a nice part of Zurich near the lake. We visited during pandemic restrictions that kept restaurants and bars closed, which took some of the shine off the Seefeld neighborhood. The kitchen was sparsely equipped but the shower was nice. Chris is a friendly and helpful host.

I stayed in the apartment for 3 months. The location is great, the park and lake close by, amazing, no need to comment. Of course you can hear trains as it is right next to a train station, but nothing too much disruptive. The apartment shows its age but has all basics you need for humble living including a laundry room in the basement. The balcony is really an added benefit for the price, you can chill there and enjoy a partial view of the lake. Chris is a good host, willing to help you with anything. Only sometimes I had to ask multiple times and some things stayed unresolved because I gave up trying. The important is though that overall I was happy with my stay and would choose this place again.

The stay at Martina's place was excellent. Martina is a very nice woman who made sure that I as a guest had everything I needed. For example, I had forgotten my power socket adapter, Martina saved me with hers. She gave me tips about activities in the neighborhood, not only by indication like 'this and that' but by looking all the activities up and sending me the info to my phone. The neighborhood is very close to the lake, 4min walk. The tram/bus stop is just next door, the tram will take you to the center in about 20min. The apartment is very nice, there's enough space, good wifi for the internet, very nice kitchen with everything you need. The place was very clean also. Finally, Martina is a very nice person to talk to, she did everything in her power to make my stay very pleasant.

Martina is such a nice person that she answer all my question patiently. I feel like at home when I stay at Martina's house. The location is very convenient that tram station are just 1 minute walk away. The place is clean and comfortable.

Fantastic apartment in Zurich. Perfect in every way and would have loved to stay longer. Convenient to all amenities, brilliant hosts who provided excellent communication throughout. Highly recommended as one of the best apartments in Zurich.

Cristian's place is ideal for a quick stay in Zurich, ideally located to visit the city. It's clean and functional. The kitchen isn't much to work with, but there are some nice shops and cafes in the area for eating.

Thanks for hosting us Cristian. Clear instructions were provided concerning check-in and apartment instructions. The apartment was as described. As described basic kitchen but plenty of eating options close by. Bakery and grocery market literally downstairs. Washing machine and dryer facilities available in the building basement. Located on the second floor, but there is a small elevator. Opposite Tram 3 and easy walk to old town. Lovely neighbourhood. Thanks again.
Great apartment near tram transportation from train and plane. Super location well suited for single or couple. Enjoy all the area restaurants.

The flat is in a good and quiet location, nicely decorated and comfortable. Lots of nice small details that were totally unexpected, and communication with the host is perfect. I would definitely recommend for your stay in Zurich!

All I can say is BOOK IT!! Fabulous place to stay, Juerg and Valeria were super helpful and kind especially patient with our kids and let us use the delicious herbs from their garden. We were a family of five relocating to Switzerland and I can’t think of a better landing pad. The garden was glorious and the apartment is perfectly located and equipped. There is a park at one end of the street and super market the other end and it is super easy bus into town. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend.

Valeria had a lot of recommendations for us, I landed with no plan and she helped chart our daily activities around Zurich. Juerg was super fun to talk to and the house is a beauty. Awesome views from the bedrooms and very clean. Bathroom is spacious and well appointed. Loved the stay, especially the walk down to Elephant River. On down days, we walked over into the dense forest area which was fun

This cosy apartment was in a perfect location in the old town which made it so easy to explore Zurich. The hosts were very helpful and friendly and were quick to answer messages. The apartment was very clean and well set up for a comfortable and convenient short stay. There were basic cooking facilities, and food items provided for breakfast etc, which I appreciated. I enjoyed watching a bit of Netflix too! The curtains do let light in but the host thoughtfully provided an eye mask and ear plugs. I would be happy to stay here again! Thanks Karina and Dominic!
We found everything we needed in Karina's apartment: the location is great, close to train station and right in the city center. Karina showed us the place and answered all of our questions.

We were so happy staying at this little apartment in Seefeld! The place was neat, clean, and well laid out. We were blessed with good weather and spent some time having coffee or drinks on the balcony. We liked the neighborhood a lot--tram right outside, grocery stores across the street, nice people, and Lake Zurich just a few minutes away. The only thing we would have liked to have is a microwave. Otherwise, this place is perfect!

Everything was as described, and overall, the stay was very good. Just a heads-up: the apartment got very hot during warm weather, and there’s no air conditioning or fan available for cooling. The only real downside was the dishwasher, which didn’t seem to work properly—dishes often came out dirtier than they went in. I did experience some initial issues with the WiFi, but the technical support team was responsive and helped resolve the problem quickly.

The small flat is nicely appointed. It gets lots of natural light and was sparkling clean. The hosts are easy to communicate with and very responsive.... I recommend a stay here.... the bed is quite comfortable and the small balcony is nice since the space is small. The only thing I would say is that the pictures of the space on the AirBnb website/ app are not of the actual apartment. So, I recommend wholly, but the actual space is different than what is pictured.... at least it was when I stayed... mid - late August 2020. I wish you a pleasant stay in Zurich.

Tania and others were quickly responsive to our needs and showed great care for our well being and comfort. The apt was very clean, lots of storage space. Kitchen functional for easy dinners. The location is not far from train station however it is straight down many stair and then back up again although there is a bus stop very close by. Grocery store several blocks away but is closed on Sunday so plan accordingly.

This is one of the best airbnb apartments we've stayed in. Really stylish, very clean, and in a super location. It does get a little hot in the summer because it has lots of very big windows (you can't see this in the pictures very well) which catch the morning and early afternoon sun. But there are sunscreens that you can roll down. And in the afternoon the sun is gone and you can open up the windows and doors. Also, the big windows do make the flat very nice and bright. :) There is also a wonderful little outdoor area where you can sit and have a drink or eat. Despite the fact that it's in a very busy area, the flat is very quiet. The neighbourhood is also very cool - take tram 2 or 3 to tramstop 'lochergut' and walk to ida platz for a drink or a bit to eat, very nice!

Nice place, comfortable and very well equipped! Great for longer term stays! Well connected to public transport and easy to get to by walking as well! It feels like they really put attention to details. I visited it in summer and it was a little too hot on the inside, but they did provide a ventilator and in Switzerland AC is hard to find out of hotels! All in all a great stay and would definitively come back!

Overall the apartment was okay but there was no pan for the oven or extra trash bags and things like that. I had an extended stay for 20 nights and thought they should have provided a few extras of things like trash bags, dishwasher soap, and toilet paper.
Really enjoyed our stay. Apartment was clean and spacious. Had a few issues with the wifi, but Harm responded immediately and we were able to fix it with no issues.

Convenient location while spending a couple of weeks visiting ETH Zurich. Also a short walk to the old town and the main train station. The kitchen was well appointed and the apartment came with spare linen for the duration of my stay. While there were no washing facilities in the apartment itself, the shared facilities in the basement were very clean and well maintained (with complementary detergent!). The only negative was a small bit of mould in the shower, but it was otherwise very clean. If coming from the airport with luggage, I'd recommend catching the #10 tram - it's a little slower, but an easy downhill stroll rather than a very steep uphill walk (with stairs) from the main train station.

We really enjoyed staying here. This apartment was well situation a little away from Old Town, but the train is close by and it is 10 minutes to that area. The apartment was clean and the amenities were great, including beer and coffee! Also, the shower pressure was incredible. Loved staying here.

Jelena was very responsive and helpful. The Air BnB is located behind the park so anyone fancy something more quiet, this is the place. We have to take the train to St. Moritz the next day and it only takes 7 mins by team. Would recommend if anyone wants to explore Zürich city.

Maria's flat is amazing! It is very close to the center and (that is my personal oppinion) very stylish! Our room was spacious, clean, full of light and we even had a separate door to the balcony. Unfortunately, we did not meet Maria but she was very nice in the messages. Her boyfriend was very helpful, kind, made us feel like at home. If we go to Zürich again, I would gladly return to them! :)
Sophie was very responsible and communicative and her place is super adorable and beautiful. I had good sleep as it was very peaceful. I liked the dinosaur decorations, very cute! Totally recommend

We had a lovely stay at Sophie’s place! Her studio is cute and cozy; it has everything you may need in terms of bath and kitchen supplies. The flat is located in a quiet area, however also very close to the town centre, so very walkable. We would definitely recommend this place! :)

This is my new go-to place whenever I come to Zurich. The place is secure, is a very short walk to public transport, and central to a lot of places. Kitchenette is well stocked and there is plenty of closet/shelving space. Dayana was quick to respond to my questions at check-in, and the flat is definitely a safe place for single traveling women. (PS For long-haired folks, the water pressure is also amazing)

Thanks to Maria and Beny for the space and privacy provided to us! Their local recommendations were well received, and Cinnamon and Pepsi ensured that we were never bored when resting back in our rooms. Will miss this place!
Great place to stay in Zurich It’s close to multiple tram lines that are a short ride into the city center. The space is clean and located in a beautiful neighborhood.

Dayana is a good host who's communication was excellent and who provided great area information. The home is in a lovely neighborhood with reasonably priced street parking and easy access to buses/trams. The unit fit my family of 4 well and had a nicely stocked kitchen. The noise of the bells from the large church a block away was the only problem. The bells ring hourly (and some daytime hours every 15 mins.) from 3 am to 11 pm. Some hours are just a few rings and sometime 150+ rings (like 7 am & 11 pm weekdays). We learned some Swiss churches do this all-day bell schedule and many people adjust to it. Unfortunately, we have some lighter sleepers in my family and, even with ear plugs, the bells woke us up.

It is a really rustic and unique place. We stayed at the bottom 2 bedroom apartment that is past the stairs. There is one bathroom with 2 showers that you have to use stairs to get to. Rooms are pretty spacious but the kitchen is a little tight. The backyard is private.

Cher’s place is an incredible oasis in Zurich. She has thought of everything to make her air bnb feel like home. The outdoor patio is fantastic and the location of the apartment is outstanding. Literally everything you need is right at your fingertips. Cher was super responsive to any questions we had and is very organized and wonderful in her communication. Our family of four would definitely stay here again.

Cher's apartment was perfect for our family! Everything was easy, the location is just the best you can immagine, railways are close and buses as well, everything is walk distance and the neighbourhood is very nice. The kitchen is well equipped and supermarket is so close. Cher is always very prompt to answer any question you may have and is very well organized!!
Unfortunately I never got the chance to stay at Claudios place as I got sick, but the communication with Claudio was super and I'll stay at his place the next time I'm in Zürich.

A great Airbnb find! A part of the house right under Uetliberg— amazing location and great value. The house has everything you need, a well-stocked kitchen and bathroom. A somewhat old-school feeling which I really loved—it really feels like a place with a soul.

Luca’s place was very great to rest after a good day. Not only was the flat clean and tidy but the whole building ! We felt safe being there. We had to buy some stuffs by ourselves but it didn’t matter much because everything else was perfect. The flat was sparkling clean and it was quiet outside as the flat is situated near a park/forest. Luca was always there answering very quickly if we had any request (Thank you for your kindness once again.) I would definitely recommend booking Luca’s place and will surely book his flat again if I happen to come back to Zürich. Thank you again for everything. Best regards Camille

This place is exactly as it says. Great view on a clear day. It was very clean when we arrived on the 73 bus. It takes you right up to the front of the building. Super convenient. It is a little out of the city center but only about 3-4 miles. You can take the 73 bus to the train station. I would recommend and even stay here again if I were in Zurich. Luca was a great host. Checkin was easy if you follow the directions given. Luca was very accommodating and answered any questions promptly.

Katrin's room is super cozy & clean. The whole apartment has a great vibe and very nice roommates. The place is in a great location, close enough to the train station and very close to some great bars.

The ONLY place to LIVE BEAUTIFULLY in Zürich. Le bijou is just that - a BIJOU! I have traveled a lot and this is by far the best Airbnb I have ever stayed in. Without a doubt 5 star quality accommodations across the board. There are no words but perfection to describe this apartment in every area.

Katrin and Janine were hands down the coolest and kindest hosts I’ve ever had. I really enjoyed getting to know them and Zürich through their stories. The apartment itself is bright, spacious, extremely well curated, and next to multiple tram stops. But the people made the trip unforgettable. Thank you for the experience Katrin and Janine — hope to see you soon!

We stayed for one week last year and loved it so much that we returned this year for two weeks, even though the price had doubled. The apartment is spacious and the location is truly unbeatable. At US$1,600 per night, expectations are naturally high, and while we noticed a few small details, they didn’t detract from the overall experience. The only real downside was having to leave!
The apartment was perfect and the location could not be better!
This was our second stay with James. We truly enjoyed the space, location, comfort and the features of this apartment. Everything is new, clean and exactly what we were looking for.

The apartment was clean and very well equipped. Eluard was easy to communicate with and has provided all the necessaries in the place. The location is a bit far from the center but there is a visitor parking next to the apartment, and 2 min walk to go by metro. We have enjoyed our visit and definitely recommend Eluard’s place.

One of the easiest AirBnB rentals I’ve ever experienced. Key and WiFi instructions were clear on check-in. Apartment had everything we needed for 8 night stay (including toilet paper, paper towels) My son slept on the fold out couch, which was comfortable. The only interaction I had with Eluard was where to put the key at the end. Really easy

The location in Seefeld area is excellent, there are two supermarkets directly across the street, a nice playground and several restaurants and bakeries. Chris’s place is good, the apartment is a good size for a couple with a small child. Chris provided us a crib. The beds are comfortable and the kitchen has the basics we needed. Chris had prepared some nespresso capsules when we arrived. The only issue we had is that it was very hot in the summer with no it conditioning. The attic apartment gets super hot and it was hard to sleep even with the fan in the room. Thanks for a nice stay!

It’s a very clean place, with very good host, but there is a one and huge problem, which declined all previous pluses: there is a bar located under this flat, so, I can’t fall asleep till 3 am, I’ve closed window, but I felt I’m on this party, but not in the bed. So, if you are partying person and come back at 3, it’s perfect place to stay, but if you are tired and prefer to stay at room and get some rest, it’s not place which I can recommend you

Tor was an extremely kind and hospitable host. I stayed for one month and I felt really at home. The apartment is well located, with the train station just minutes away. The room is bright and well furnished. The stay was great. Thank you for everything!

The flat is located in a hip neighbourhood of Zurich, in walking distance to many good restaurants and cafes. It is also in easy walking distance to the central station and town centre. The balcony is a real bonus on hot summer days.

I loved my stay at Artel’s apartment. The place was spacious enough, super clean, modern, the kitchen equipment is amazing and I loved the location. Lots to do around and many nice restaurants. The host was very helpful and responsive. Solved an issue I had in no time! The only negative experience was related to the noise coming from the reconstruction next to the building. It started at 7:30am on weekdays, which was really annoying.
Tania's place was nice and clean. Great location near the train station and within walking distance to the lake and old town. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Tania’s place is amazing! Very spacious and accommodating. It’s about a 30 minute walk to old town which is easy and doable. All basic necessities such as towels, soap, etc were provided. The space was clean and Tania was very helpful for us!

Everything was perfect and fitted the description and the pictures shown on the site. The only negative part is that it is noisy because the flat is located in front of two very busy tram lines. It was particularly warm during our stay with vey high temperatures and it was impossible to sleep with the windows closed. Thus, we have to choose between high temperatures or noise from the street starting very early in the morning... I am sure that in winter time would be perfect and I would probably rate the stay as "great" instead of "good". Nevertheless, the place is highly recommendable!

Make sure you take the opportunity to meet your charming host! She is warm and generous and so helpful. I had only one day in Zürich and she gave me excellent advice about how to see the lake, city, and mountains without breaking my budget! The trails nearby are great for stretching your legs, not exactly pristine nature; there was some active logging going on, but the views are nice, if you make it to the lake-side of the hill. The studio was perfect for one or two people, neat and clean with a nice garden area to sit in the sun for morning coffee.

Had an awesome stay in David‘s apartment! Loved the location: very quiet and close to the tram. The apartment was well equipped and the bed was very comfy! Everything worked well. Communication was excellent as well. Definitely highly recommend it to future Airbnb guests!

We enjoyed our two nights at Grazyna's house in Zurich. It was clean and tidy, and the location is good. You can get public transport easily to the city, and a cab to the airport is not very far and not expensive. We had a warm, quiet, comfortable sleep, and Grazyna is upstairs if you have any questions. And her little dog Amelie is adorable too! Thanks Grazyna

David was an incredible host, the apartment is exactly like the photographs and he was so responsive when it came to my inquiries. He was amazingly polite and kind. A perfect apartment for a couple, me and my girlfriend enjoyed our time immensely. Hot water was as described, would be a bit frustrating at times however, did not take long to get used to. Thank you for a beautiful stay!

Erich was very proactive and helpful ahead of check-in, and when our trains were very delayed he kindly waited for us & showed us around. The kids were delighted with all the gadgetry and the flat was clean, quiet and very comfortable. Transport into Zurich centre was very easy. All round a great place to stay! Thank you!

Erich is a great host - very friendly and accommodating. He even FaceTimed us to show us how to best get into the garage. And during our stay he always replied within a very short time when we had a question. The place is great, the pool and the bus stop are within easy walking distance and it doesn’t take long to get into Zurich. Good place for a trip to Zurich!

The apartment is conveniently accessible from Zürich's Main Train Station, surrounded by plenty of dining options. The building doesn't look attractive, but the apartment is very clean, well-equipped and comfortable. Overall, very good value for money. The best part, Steffi and her boyfriend were extremely communicative and flexible at all times.

This is a great place just a short distance from the train station. We only stayed a night but would definitely come back for a longer visit. Large, clean, comfortable room. Best bed of our whole trip around Europe. The bathroom was also the only one that had a tub and not just a shower. Overall a great stay.

Firstly, the place is in a really accessible spot in the city, and that’s what is exactly needed in Zurich, be it a public transport or a private car parking 🅿️ (in a place like Zurich, getting an easy access close to the room is NOT easy). The place is extremely clean with well organized shelves, comfortable and rooms and guaranteed you’ll feel right at home, especially after having a busy day. Saving the best for the last: Piotr is one of the most amazing host. He made sure to take care of all the things and was extremely accommodating to my requests. He even went above and beyond to help me out. I’m not done with Swiss or Zurich yet, and so does my stay with Piotr. Wishing him all the best!

Irina is a great host, really nice and very good reachable. Check-in is the best! The flat just fantastic, really just like the pictures just bigger. Very modern and a lot of space. Had a really good stay & time. The location is also good so I can only recommend staying ah hers. No regrets for sure! I‘ll definetly stay again.

Piotr's place was great for my one night stay in Zurich! The room is huge with a very comfy bed. Only 10 min tram from the zurich main station and 30 min train to the airport makes it a super convenient location. Piotr was super nice and friendly, even gave me a few recommendations for my short stay. Highly recommend!
Loved my stay! Host is very friendly and easy talk to. Excellent value for the location and amenities provided!

This place is such a good deal for how expensive Zurich is, and Blandine was happy to give tips on local places to check out or how to navigate the train system. Everything was clean and as shown in the pictures - the apartment is in a nice quiet area of the city but you can get on the train and be in the city center within 20 minutes of walking out the door. If I were to come back to Zurich I would absolutely stay here again!

Bernadette's flat was amazing! It's stunningly beautiful, and well very designed and spacious. The patio and BBQ were fantastic, and we had a chance to grill and eat outside one night as the bells were ringing and sun was setting. Her apartment really helped us fall in love with Zurich. The location is fantastic. She's right between two tram stops, and the trams go everywhere in Zurich. If you're coming from the train station, it's well worth the $4 to take the tram rather than walk uphill, ha! It was one of my wife and I's favorite Airbnbs. Strongly recommended!

Wow—we can’t say enough good things about Nadine and Marcel’s place! It was perfect in every respect. Really clean, open, bright, and airy with a beautiful balcony and lots of houseplants. It was quiet and peaceful but easy to take the tram to the city center. But the kitchen made the place. It had everything we needed and more. Nadine and Marcel were friendly hosts and offered us plenty of tips on places to go, even though we barely wanted to leave the apartment! Highly recommend for your trip to Zürich if you’re lucky enough to find it available!

Charlotte and Matthias were exceedingly friendly and generous guests. The apartment was immaculately clean, the bedroom large and the bed super comfortable. They were also really helpful in navigating Zurich and helped me have a great time. I would stay again in a heartbeat.

Very neat and tidy unit in a decent part of Zurich. ‘Excellent’ customer service to any needs we had during our stay. The only recommendation I might have would be a more comfortable mattress on the bed. Other than that, very nice experience!

Really happy with my stay here. Location is central but quiet. Both the building and the flat were spotlessly clean, and well lit. There's lots of storage space. Plenty of natural light. I was there during a cold snap, but the flat was always toasty warm, and with a powerful, hot shower. The bed was comfy and the kitchen was modern and spacious, as described in the listing. I also used the washing machine and tumble dryer a few times, without any issues. WiFi was strong and reliable too.

I had technical difficulties with airbnb, not having discovered the app (and not being fond of apps). But Shelly was very helpful, so that my insecurities disappeared, and I felt very safe and secure, that everything would be okay. I enjoyed my stay, found it very practical to be near Kreuzplatz and not far from Stadelhofen Bahnhof. Easy access to everything!

Room had decent size bed and also a balcony which was amazing, top floor is an added bonus. Shelly is very talkative, approachable and makes the rules very clear. Place is not far from the opera House area and some good bars and restaurants. Will return if I need somewhere to stay in Zurich.
Was a nice stay! Rooms are stylish, clean and comfortable. The bath is really good. And it’s very close to bus station. Worth your time here!

The room was satisfactory, and I recommend the area. However, there is room for improvement in communication, particularly during check-in and check-out, and in the cleanliness of the room. Overall, my experience was positive.

Unfortunately the cleaner had not completed their tasks (bed not made up / wet washing left in machine, in the dryer and on an airer / loaded dish washer etc) appropriately and the apartment appeared as if it was still occupied when we checked in. (This has apparently never happened before though - so very unexpected for the host) The host responded quickly also and refunded the cleaning fee. In our opinion, the pillows need replacing as they were very thin / little, but otherwise very nice secure apartment in great location with great rooftop views.

This Artel apartment was perfect for our two week stay in Zurich. It had everything we needed and more. we especially loved sitting in the balcony to cool off in evenings during the heatwave in Zurich. It was close to restaurants, grocery stores, parks, river, and train station. Our host was easy to communicate with. Would totally stay here again if we could!

The place is located in the city center, next to a tram stop, and just a 5-minute walk from Zurich HB. However, there is no elevator, and the staircase is small, so it may take some time to go up at the first time. At night, there might be some noise and cigarette smoke from the bar on the first floor, especially on Fridays and Saturdays. The laundry facilities are located in the attic and can be booked using the sheet provided in the laundry room. Overall, Roger is very supportive, provides cleaning services every two weeks, and promptly fixes anything that breaks.

Roger is a fantastic host! Very friendly. Very responsive and made both my daughter and I feel very welcome not only to the Air BNB but to the neighborhood as well. The bar below has open mike nights and we enjoyed the bar and the music! Thank you Roger! This apartment is a 5-minute walk to the Zurich main station, grocery shopping as well as restaurants around the corner. It is an excellent location for those wanting to explore Zurich and for train access. The apartment is located on the 4th floor and does require going up and down stairs. The laundry facility is in the attic and was very clean and easy to access at various times. I felt incredibly safe and welcome. I would come back here to stay anytime I am in Zurich.

Really loved the place, it had everything that we needed and the location was perfect. The stairs did get to us some days, especially with the moving but we managed. I would definitely recommend it. It’s gives you that city feeling, and a way to experience Zurich.

This is a perfect place to stay with your families. The loft is clean and spacious, it was nice and warm and located in a great spot. The coffee shop and train station around the corner is an added bonus, I highly recommend this place.

Vinh's place is good value for the money. It's small and simply furnished and equipped, but has practically everything you may need if you're looking for a place that's functional rather than homey. The studio is clean, the bed is comfy, the kitchen is equipped with kitchenware, there are laundry and dryer machines in the basement, and it's located a convenient 3 mins walk from a train station. The only issue I encountered was that there was no hot water in the bathroom sink faucet during the week that I stayed (but there was hot water in the shower and kitchenette sink). Vinh was responsive to messages, and even met me upon arrival and gave me the key.

We loved our stay at this apartment. It is located very conveniently right next to bus (89 and 304) and Tram stops (13) which will get you easily to Altstetten or the city. There is a Coop in the building and a bakery across the street for all your grocery needs. The place was very private and we truly appreciated the fantastic view over the valley especially from the loft at night. The only thing we had some issues with was the mattress which seemed to be very hard but I guess it depends on the individual. We found a solution though and all was well. We would definitely recommend this accommodation and will be back! Thank you Tobi for assisting us with all our questions.

Very organized and tidy apartment in the Wiedikon neighborhood. It was very easy to get inside with excellent instruction, less than 5 min walk from the train station. Apartment was close to every place I wanted to get to in Zurich. The space is well organized with everything I needed. The kitchen seems very practical though I never had any meal there. The host was very responsive and friendly. The only thing that was a bit tricky is the indoor temparture as it got a bit hot at times, howeve there is a fan which was pretty helpful. Recommended place!
Lovely clean place and in a nice quiet area with easy links by tram and bus to the centre.

This is a lovely and elegant apartment on the roof floor of Tina's house, has a great view of Uetliberg. Tina is very helpful and great at communication. Although there is no stoves, but there is many kitchen equipments are sufficient for simple meals.
Beyond great. You’ll be lucky to be able to stay here. Warmth and spirit exudes throughout the home.

we stayed 3 nights un Zurich at Arno''s listing from Zurich Furnished homes. Apart from the Central location the things which great was the apartment is quite big, everything you can ask from an Airbnb is present and there are multiple washers and dryers in the basement. Small points which unfortunately led me to incline more towards 4.5 star overall is that the Sofa is a bit worn out. I didn't sleep quite soundly and maybe it is time to change it. The bedroom and its balcony is badass. Rest assured, it was more than worth the money for Zurich!

We loved to stay in Elena's Ecohouse. The house was nice, impeccable clean, cosy and situated in a green neighborhood in the western part of Zürich. We could park the car nearby and could reach the whole of Zürich easily with public transport. The only thing that visitors should know is that the house has two (double bed) rooms but that they are not completely privat. The rooms are on different levels but are (partly) open spaces and those sleeping in the upper level need to pass through the lower bedroom to go to the bathroom. Anyway, for us that was clear beforehand as it was visible on the photos and on the plan that is given with the description. I would definitely stay in Elena's house again.

Gunda received me and I must say: She is incredible. Do you know that feeling when you look at someone for the first time, and you already know that everything will be perfect? That comfort when listening to someone? That's is Gunda. I really enjoyed the stay.
Junda is the best host I’ve ever had from Airbnb!! The place was perfect and so close to the tram stop.

Mathias was a perfect host, very attentive, helpful and very nice guy to chat with. He gave us some great tips for the city and went above and beyond to help us with various stuff. The apartment is beautiful with lots of (private) space and very well equipped. Everything was neat and clean. All in all we had a great time and would 100% recommend!
Very nice experience there. Amazing location to visit the city you can get most of places on foot easily. Also the host is kind and friendly.

Spacious, though not very high sleeping rooms with comfy beds - no lock on the door, but there are lockers to keep your belongings secure from other guests. Bathrooms were clean, though we'd often had to wait pretty long because other guests used them. Excellent location, right in the middle of the centre and only a 10-minute walk from the station. Note that you can't really invite other people into the room and it's not an ideal room to spend idle days in. A perfect sleeping place for explorers
Very clean and well equipped apartment. Good location. The host offered a storage room for our luggage after check-out.

Outstanding location! You're far enough away from Old Town to be out of the noise and crazy, but two blocks from the lake and one block from a tram stop on a main line through town.
