Right on the edge where biz becomes residential. Nice variety of places to eat nearby, groceries close by - everything you want. Host is great, place was larger than we expected, everything clean, crystal-clear instructions. All good!

I was originally booked into one of Dimi’s other apartments but after finding a huge amount of mould in the bathroom Dimi immediately moved me to one of his other apartments which was bigger and in an even more central location. Everything was dealt with very swiftly and the second apartment (this listing) was perfect. Huge living/dining space, large bedroom which was very comfortable. Check-in was easy with finding the keys. I would definitely stay here again. The price is maybe a little steep but for the location it is worth it. Thank you for another good stay!

Great location and apartment is really nice. Unfortunately we visited Zürich and day temps were close to 90 and the apartment does not have AC. We did have fans and were able to open the windows. Very comfy beds and clean apartment

Great place to stay. Central location with restaurants, public transport close nearby. Easy walk to the center of town. All necessary amenities in the apartment that made the stay comfortable and very pleasant. Very thoughtful the welcome snacks and soft drinks! Perfect check-in and check-out description. Friendly and professional in every aspect. Thank you!

Me and my fam of 4 LOVED this stylish apartment. It was incredibly clean and so well appointed. Plenty of space even with the 4 of us and lots of luggage! The manager on the property helped us with anything we needed, whether that was a spare plug adaptor, an extra fan, and directions to town. The only issue was that we arrived at the end of a heatwave so our first night was pretty warm as there's no aircon. But it was short-lived and once the weather was perfect, the accommodation became moreso :)

Andrea was very responsive and gave clear instructions. They let me drop my bags early. Sofia came to clean the place very frequently. She is very friendly, and always asks whether you need something. "Room Orange" is spacious and has a large desk with two chairs. There is plenty of closet space, hangers, etc.
Andreas was a nice and easygoing host. Bath was not clean too much unfortunately but the location of the house is perfect!

Conveniently located, very bright and clean apartment. Great communication with the host. Also good value. The only problem is that you will not find it easy to cook dinners as some equipment is missing and there is no light in the kitchen - floor lamps are the only lights there is in the flat.
The appartment has a lot of beds and is well located near the center of Oerlikon, but doesn't offer much more. So fine if you just need many beds to sleep and plan to eat outside anyway!

Timo and Kim are world-class hosts. Their kindness and hospitality was evident from way before I even arrived in Zurich, offering suggestions on what to do during my short stay. Communication skills were excellent and their home is very centrally located with the airport and city center being 15 mins away. Very clean and tidy home and the only downside was that my trip wasn't longer. Unfortunately I didn't get to meet Kim however it was very nice to chat with Timo who further recommended three things to check out based on my interests, all of which were fabulous. 10/10!

I have lived with Kim and Timo for two weeks, my first two weeks in Switzerland, and I couldn't have been asking for better hosts! The bedroom and the whole apartment are extremely nice, comfortable and clean. They are extremely friendly and available. Moreover, I was moving for the first time to Zurich, and I had to deal with this new city and complete some administrative tasks: they have been incredibly supportive, and they have helped me with documents and advices making my life much easier. I would repeat this choice without hesitation, thank you again Timo and Kim!

I had a very nice stay at Andrea’s place! It’s in a good location, with public transport very close to the apartment, and conveniently located near two supermarkets. The only downside was that the roommates also staying at the apartment didn’t always clean up after themselves and were sometimes loud at night.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described — clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything I needed. The location was perfect, close to supermarkets, restaurants and transport. The host was very friendly, responsive, and made check-in smooth and easy. We really appreciated the small touches that made the stay feel special. I’d definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the area and would love to stay again!”

The place was just what I needed - clean, good space. Unfortunately, the window in the bedroom wouldn't open, and no one was around to fix it. Also, I was never able to get the wifi to work. The host was responsive, just unable to do anything about it.

The room I started in during the entire lockdown while in Zürich. Perfectly fine for short stays and very adequate for staying longer, with the right company. The local woods and first spaces have spectacular views of the city of Zurich, great for those who like a run, in a quiet part of the city that's a short journey away from the centre via public transport. During the lock down however, this isn't ideal. There are shops an 8 minute walk away. Susanna is also a very friendly, welcoming and attentive host!

Check-in was super easy. The room was really nice an clean. However in the kitchen the sink was often full of dishes from the flatmate, but during the day he was most of the time at work, so you had the flat to yourself. The bathroom was okay, but in the shower there is some mold on the walls. The location is really quiet and the wifi worked well.

I had a short stay before I flew back to my country. It was a clean and cute room. Everything is as expected. Rossana is also a great host! However, it was a bit noisy opening the windows at night. Please also note that there are few steps of stairs you have to take. I had a bit difficulty carrying my luggage up to the room.

You can't beat the location. It's in the coolest area of Zurich. The check-in/out process was smooth and painless and Chris is very responsive. The apartment was perfect for the week I was there. Bed/pillows/blankets were all good and the bathroom was very roomy. I'd stay there again.

This is a very practical and well maintained stay. For my visiting relatives, it offered everything they needed. Rossana (Host) is very attentive and clear. It is Not a luxurious place, though it is very well kept and fitted. The only negative thing to say (completely personal) is that you gotta brush your teeth in the kitchen sink, which is the only one in the room. That said, if you like what you see, book your stay with peace of mind.

The place is very well located and had beautiful green views. Very close to the tram station which is super convenient. It’s was a really hot day but the host managed to provide us a standing fan which was perfect. Also they had a baby chair as well which was really convenient for us.

Gabi's place was nice and the room was quite spacious. The location is 10 mins walk to Oerlikon and many restaurants. The room is in a shared apartment with another person who enforces strict rules about keeping the apartment clean though.

This was a great location with young kids. Not only did they enjoy playing in the spacious garden but there was also a great park/play area and indoor swimming pool 3 mins down the road (we were there in early spring). The apartment was spotless and had everything we needed. The nearest tram station was just a few minutes away and it was a lovely green neigbourhood. There was also a laundry area in the building which we made use of a few times (no booking required).

Peter is a good host.. he kindly agreed for a late checkout and at the check in time came down himself to help.. even helped in getting one luggage down the stairs.. Kitchen was good, well stacked.. Bathroom was ok Rooms were ok, may be one full wardrobe in bedroom will be good, as of now it is half open rack type.. Location is good.. 10 minutes drive from central Zurich.. Did not used train or tram.. Garden is very good.. Could not use swimming pool due to rains.: Overall good experience..

the is a great place for anyone looking for a budget accommodation in Zurich. there area is in a quiet residential neighborhood, not much to see or do but there is a train station 15 minutes away that is 2 stops from the center of Zurich. the room is one flight up. Very clean and quiet. Switzerland is so expensive for foreigners so you will not find a better deal. a few points though. the area has only street parking by permit. if you are driving, discuss this with Serdar before booking. the apartmentis old and if you will be bringing anything that does not use the 2 pin plug used in EU, your adaptor might not fit into the outlet. the outlet only has a narrow opening for small 2 pin adaptors. the bulkier 3 pin adaptor probably will not fit.
He is the best host very friendly and a great human being He provided me everything that I needed.he was continuously in touch with me until I reached his place .

The space was in a relatively good location and very spacious for a couple. Tastefully decorated and fluffy towels. Check-in was easy as well. However, I left with a bad taste in my mouth, though, because when I asked the host to please provide some hand soap (there was none; only several bottles of shampoo), he told me he trusted his crew and that they would have left it and that he was "under the impression" I'm trying to get money from him. It was insulting and rude. Marc was unresponsive and unprofessional, so something to keep in mind.
Enrique was a nice Host and the apartment was super cozy

The apartment was spacious and looked just like on the pictures at first sight. However, later on we discovered large stains on the couch, some of the chairs at the dining table and also the curtains.

Christine is an amazing host! Thoughtful and flexible with times. She responded immediately to any inquiry and recommended a very sweet sightseeing place nearby. I would stay at her place again. The house is very clean. However one thing is inaccurate and was slightly surprising to me: the shower room is separated by only one curtain from the room next to it, which is currently occupied by another tenant. Another small thing, from my room I could hear almost anything the person next door was doing.

Christine was a super nice host! She really went above and beyond to make your stay comfortable. She came every week to make sure the environment is clean. She provided breakfast!! The location of her place was also great. Trams 3 and 8 are within 1 min walk. The only downside, however, was the spiders in the room. If you come in the summer, there might be some spiders around...

I spent 2 nights in the studio and I really enjoyed it. It was well located since I watched a game at Swiss Life Arena, otherwise it's a bit far from the centre but the tram frequents very often :) Enrique and his dad were really nice in our communication. I'd totally stay again in this studio.
Clean and for this price&couple of nights is good. But the toilet is not in the room, need to go to the first floor.

Nice little room in the University district. Had a wonderful surprise when they upgrade my room without telling me, so I ended up having a toilet in my room despite what was advertised. It was a great room for the price and very clean. While it's not exactly down town, you can still walk to everything or hop on the public tram which is just a couple blocks away - super convenient.
Matthias was extremely friendly and welcoming. He gave us many tips and recommendations for navigating the area. Would absolutely book with him again!
matthias's place was well placed and easy to get to from the airport. it is close to the city centre and allowed us to explore in the few hours we had. matthias was very helpful and a great host.

This lovely residence in a brand new complex is nicely located in a very peaceful residential community overlooking Lake Zürich. It is walking distance from Old Town Zürich and all that it has to offer. The residence itself is sparkling clean and has all the amenities a visitor needs. It accommodates two couples very well and, as such is a very good value. Hosts Goldiss and Dominik were very communicative with us in advance of our stay to ensure that we were comfortable and well-prepared for our stay.

We had a wonderful time staying in Dominik's beautiful apartment for the holidays. It's very well located near the Wollishofen train station, and you can either take a quick train or tram, or walk along the lake to the centre. It has a beautiful view of Lake Zurich and Uetliberg mountain, and is very tastefully designed. It was a wonderful home for us for our stay - would recommend for a cozy stay in a quiet suburb still close to the centre of Zurich. Thanks so much!

Chris's apartment is an amazing place to stay in Zurich. The view of the Limmat River below and the old town across the river are amazing throughout the day and night. It is perfectly located for exploring Zurich -- in walking distance to the main train station, shopping areas, amazing restaurants. The apartment itself was clean and comfortable. Chris was fantastic with communication and making check-in easy for me. You'll love staying here -- especially if it's your first time in Zurich.

This place is fantastic! Amazing location, great view, several small cooking appliances if you need, walking distance to the main train station, restaurants, bars, comfy bed, nice pillows, windows that open nicely for some fresh air (it’s on the top floor so the heat rises up there a bit). Neighbors are a little loud and the walls are paper thin so you can hear everything. Check in was a little off but chris accommodated and we would definitely stay here if we came back to the area! He has other properties as well!

This apartment is really nice. It's very well designed, with great use of light and space. The furnishings are new. The kitchen supplies are perfect. Henrik is easy to communicate with. We'll be back soon!

The space was immaculate, modern, serving every need, as well as accurately described from the listing. Henrik’s reliable communication and amiable guidance will help you enjoy Zurich to the fullest. He is worthy of his super host status and high review numbers.

Nadine is definitely a super host. She had lots of tips for hikes around Zurich and places to visit in Zurich. The place is really clean and in walking distance from the old town and the train station. There are some great coffee shops close by too. In case you want to save your energy for hiking the mountains around Zurich, you can easily take the tram to reach the train station. I had a wonderful time at Nadine's place and I highly recommend it.

Nadine and her partner are very welcoming. The check in is after 2pm but they let me check in at 12 pm. The location is near the tram station especially if you use the garage door and the tram duration to the main station is like 6 minutes. The place is clean and feels just like home. Before I forget they put chocolate in the room so yummy ( i’m not someone who like chocolate but these were good). Nadine place will be my first choice when i visit Swiss again.
The area is super cool, the apartment is really good organized and close to everything but super quiet. You can find everything in the apartment I felt like I was at home.
Great location and hassle-free stay . The place is spacious and everything working well. Highly recommended
Alvaro was a great host, he was very responsive and helpful. The apartment is beautiful and the location very good! Thanks Alvaro ☺️

We enjoyed our stay! Peaceful spot and 20 minute walk from Zurich HB. Several grocery stores nearby. One note, laundry is not in-unit. There’s a shared laundry room in the building (one floor up) — not a big deal though, we were always able to do it.
Min is a wonderful host. I definitely love the time I live with Min and would like to come back again.
The location is good and the host is very nice and he even helped us to pick up the luggage! Very good experience except that the toilet is quite complicated, but the host will explain to you!

It's a nice place. The only small drawback is that it's on the edge of the city so takes a little longer to get to/from places. The upside is that it's practically in the green: there's a forest nearby and some hiking trails. Armin is extremely kind and helpful, and responds quickly to messages. He has helped me solve any little problem which arose.

A lovely room located on a hillside with a beautiful view of the town below. There’s a nearby horse riding area, so you might sometimes spot horses eating grass in the fields. Although there’s no air conditioning or fan, the temperature remains quite comfortable. A bus runs down every 15 minutes, though unfortunately, there are no evening services. The room is not very spacious but has all the basic amenities. Arri is very responsible and friendly, always quick to respond to any questions.

Jordi is a friendly and nice host. The room was quite big for two people, there are a sofa, TV and refrigererator in the room. However, the kitchen is quite dirty and the response was slow. Though I’d still recommend this accomodation since the place located in the city centre and the price is still affordable.

room was okay, nice balcony, quite noisy area but okay if you´re not planning to spend a lot of time in the apartment. Communication was a bit hard due to language troubles, but it somehow worked out anyways. I was welcomed by Jordis partner and even though we could not find a language that we both speak he was very hospitable and lovely. All in all: Zürich is pricey, so the place is fine for the price and location is good (very close to railway station, most things reachable by foot, public transport also very close)

Nice apartment. It has everything that you need and it is quiet. The Airbnb price is fair considering that apartment is in a residential area in Zurich but the cleaning fee is another $100 which I think it is a little expensive. Everything was cleaned and organized as described in pictures. Thanks,

Cannot fault the location or the host's communication. Apartment was very clean and had everything we needed for our stay. The weather was very hot during our stay but the hosts had left a tower fan that was very handy.

Hosts were welcoming and gave clear instructions on how to check in. The area was right in between either going to the lake or into the city- it was perfect. There was no air conditioning, but the fan was more than enough with the lovely windows that opened wide. The laundry in the basement was easy to access and operate. I felt very safe my entire stay and would definitely stay again!

The flat is bright, comfortable and efficient. The location is great and close to so many amenities. Supermarket extremely close. Small problems came up and were dealt with very quickly. Communication was excellent. We would rent from Tania again for sure if we were ever in the area.
Great location to hop on the tram and See the city. The place is super nice and the beds are so comfortable.

This host has multiple properties they run through AirBnB it appears as our original apartment had an issue the day before our arrival. They reached out and offered an explanation along with a new apartment to stay in for the night we had booked. I cannot speak directly to either unit as I do not know which unit this review will appear on, but the unit we did stay in was very nice and the host was very friendly and communicative.

Excellent location, great place and very near from the supermarkets such as Migros and Coop, the city center is near and the place is super safe! The hosts reply fast and they offered us things more than we expected!

The apartment was lovely, the building and neighborhood was awesome. The only thing was that the Wi-Fi was never able to operate at full speed. It took awhile for it to connect and when it eventually did it was super slow. Other than that it was a perfect stay.
Super nice brand new room in the most beautiful Jugendstil building with both the lake and centre in walking distance.

all the amenities were right as the description, the place and the building is beautiful, and the view of the appartment I got it was really lovely. It was a heat wave on Switzerland so the fan was a gift to avoid the extreme temperature. Would definetly reccomend and stay again there!!

This clean, modern, and secure efficiency apartment has everything you need for your extended stay in Zürich - including kitchen and bathroom staples. Bathroom is recently renovated; kitchen appliances new. The location is a 7-minute walk to a major train station and less than five minutes to pick up a tram but the city is so wonderfully walkable that you're rarely more than a 15-20 minute walk from wherever you want to go! Several restaurants, two grocery stores, and many shops just steps away from the building but still, the neighborhood is quiet. The host was prompt, clear, and helpful with his communication. You will not be disappointed with this apartment. This is a FABULOUS place to stay!!

Perfect for two. The room has plenty of space. The neighborhood is quiet but there was some road work one day and the windows protected well against the noise. On the downside: there is no micro-wave. Maybe it's me ... but I think that the micro-wave is essential. When I go to an Airbnb, I either eat at a restaurant or heat a dish in the micro-wave. The flat has an oven, but that does not do the trick.

Christian’s flat was a dedicated Airbnb space and did that job very well. Easy to find and access and very clean. There was a very noisy building site nearby, but the double glazed windows were excellent at keeping the early morning Jack hammering noise out. Great location near to the centre of town and the lake. Recommended
enjoyed the stay here. the location is awesome. place was quiet and clean. is definitely worth the price we are paying.

Very suitable for parent-child tour friends, there are children's room, lego toys, a piano, a garden, and a cute cat with human nature. The kitchen is perfect for cooking at home. It's safe and convenient to park your car in your garage. It's only five to ten minutes' drive from downtown Zurich. The landlord is very friendly and will reply to any questions in time. In a word, this room is especially suitable for those who travel by themselves. It is highly recommended!

This is a top-notch apartment perched in a quiet neighborhood about 20 mins walking from the heart of Zurich. Our stay ticked all the boxes. Plenty of natural sunlight in the morning, a great balcony, comfortable bed/couch, high-tech kitchen full of everything you could ask for, and an A+ coffee machine. Michael was incredibly accommodating for us and made the stay a pleasure from start to finish. If I'm ever in Zurich again, I wouldn't hesitate to stay here.

Apartment with a special charm located in the quiet street, however very close to the center of "busy" neighbourhood Oerlikon. It is located close to the both city center and the airport. You'll find everything you need at Enzo's place for short-term stay. Enzo was very friendly and even left small present for the guest. I enjoyed staying at Enzo's place and would definitely recommend anyone to use the opportunity to rent his place and enjoy true airbnb experience.

Central Location. The apartment was stocked with lots of extras like soft drinks, chocolate, and pasta. The construction is very nice but be prepared that the floors are not all level and some doorways are low. This adds to the charm. This is my favorite place to stay in Zurich.

Lilian’s place was impeccably clean and very comfortable. He gave clear instructions for how to get in when he couldn’t be there due to my delayed flight and graciously offered for me to stay until noon the next day after my long travel day. Would stay again!
We enjoyed the stay at Lilian‘s place. It was super clean and quiet near the city center and all advertisements. Highly recommend!

Amazing apartment and wonderful hosts. The place was beautiful, tidy, clean and the room was very comfortable. We slept like logs. Bert and Kamil are wonderful people and really did everything to make us feel right at home. Their dog is the sweetest and added even more amazingness to an already perfect stay. We would really like to recommend this Airbnb and we will definitely be staying here again when returning to Zürich.

Bert and Kamil are amazingly sweet and welcoming hosts! We absolutely loved staying with both of them. We only stayed one night and they made us feel right at home, and the breakfast is such a sweet treat! Their home is beautiful with lovely views of the city and easy to walk everywhere. Can't wait to stay with them again for our next visit!

We originally booked a separate place with Tania and we were offered this listing due to flood damage on the other. Great location and Tania was really helpful with our questions when we arrived. There was some noise from the upstairs apartment (footsteps etc) but these tended to stop before we went to sleep.

The flat is in a great location and is beautifully clean with all the necessary amenities. The local supermarket is conveniently close, the public transport system is easily accessible and the wonderful lake promenade is two mins away. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and love Zurich! We'll be back!

Great pleace to stay, but not for a first time on airbnb. Sandra has very clear that is her own property and only travellers that knows how to behave will felt comfortable here. Public transport connection is very good, the place is nice and fresh in summer (I could sleep every night this days with almost 40 degrees during the day) but there is nothing around. Nearby supermarket is 800 meters away. Is a great place to disconnect if you go for work the whole day. Thanks Sandra for hosting me!
Chris was accomodating and gave us all information needed in a timely manner. The location made it convenient for working at the Zurich Uni. Recommended :)

Karen is an awesome host and is always responsive! The location of the place is also great, with multiple busses within 2 mins of the building. There is also a mall within walking distance, making shopping super easy. Overall, highly recommended and great price compared to nearby hotels.
Amazing place!!! We really appreciate the place. Well located, but a little noisy during the night because you hear trains! I recommend the place and the host is very nice!
Karen was a great host!! The place was cozy and much more comfortable than a hotel. Would recommend to anyone visiting the area!

Great location, great price, close to everything, clean, with an amazing of the river view. Small but good for one person. A little loud at night with people outside but I would stay again. Host were friendly and communicated well. Easy process

I love this place! The location is ideal, the room and common areas are clean and well appointed and everyone who works here is wonderful! It’s really nice having the common areas, especially the wine bar, to meet up with other travelers. I will definitely be back next time I’m in Zurich.

Very good place. Only the bathroom that is super small and there's no light when you take the shower. It's super strange. But the place itself is good and very clean. The reception is good and people are friendly! I recommend this place! :-)

We had a great stay at Krone’s Pop Up Hotel. We actually have stayed a second time, but booked directly on their website. The space is tidy, comfortable and organized. There is a front desk agent at select hours throughout the day (check in and check out). There were Nespresso pods for the morning, which was a nice touch. The bathrooms and showers at this property are communal, but there was always one available when needed and they were very clean - there is a sink and mirror in each room, as well. Overall, this was the perfect space for our stay. The neighborhood was just what we needed, and extremely walkable.

Unfortunately I cancelled so I haven't seen the room itself. But the employees were really kind and understanding towards my situation. The contact was polite and quick and thus they received these 5 stars from me.

Staying at Krone feels like staying more in a dormitory than a hotel - especially if like me your bathroom is shared. I do not mean that as a complaint - the facilities were well-maintained , and the room - while not decadently outfitted - had a simplicity which I quite enjoyed. The room is heated, but comes which a portable heater just in case. Concierge was efficient, and the location is ideal. Admittedly, I did not myself use any of the “hip” (while not fancy) amenities or shared spaces the building had to offer - but they are there! Zürich was wonderful, and I hope to venture a return one day!

We enjoyed Sandra’s beautiful apartment so much! The check in was very easy, she and her partner kindly greeted us and provided wonderful hospitality. There was even a jar of home made kiwi jam (delicious!) The apartment was the same as the photos and very clean. Her garden is pristine and we were able to enjoy breakfast in the cute patio chairs. It was walkable to the station. Couldn’t have asked for a better experience!

It was a nice stay, everything was as described. Nice host. The listing mentioned that we cannot use sofa in living room which is ok but the sofa takes up majority of living room making it unusable, so for a relaxed seating the only place remains is bedroom. It was complete peace and close to tram station.

We enjoyed our stay at Sandra's place. It was in an excellent location and very close to transport links. The flat was warm and welcoming with some lovely touches by Sandra, including a lovely kiwi jam made with fruit from her garden. Thoroughly recommended.
Fantastic, nicely furnished, new apartment at a great and quiet location in Zurich. Great hospitality and communication with José. Also, the bed is very comfortable!
Amazing apartment, nice and clean, very comfy and perfectly located. The host was easy to reach and friendly. I can only recommend.

The apartment is in a convenient location, close to a tram station and easily accessible from airport. The location itself is very beautiful. It is a well kept and maintained apartment with ample kitchen facilities. Micheal was a great host. He was very responsive to all our questions and concerns. He gave very clear replies. Check in was smooth and so was check out. Would definitely recommend this place.

In general, its pretty good. The draining system was not functioning properly but they are working on it. A few drawbacks were:the bathroom and the size. The size was a bit smaller than expected. And the bathroom design makes it easy to make the whole bathroom wet. Considering all aspects, its pretty nice for a short stay

Very secure and quiet place. Easy tram to HB. Thomas is a great host. He is able to bring suggestions for a good sightseeing in the city. I will come back to Thomas' place at any time I return to Zurich.
Thomas is a kind and attentive host. The room is large and functional.

Super nice place to stay. Good location (walking distance to the lake, supermarket, bakery, a good pizza place). Both the kitchen and the bath room are very well equipped and the bed is one of the most comfortable ones I‘ve ever slept in.

As a host, they had left all our requests at home before we arrived (such as a high chair). They even left a water bowl and a welcome snack for our dog. Since we had a baby and the weather was very cold at the time we went, this caused the inside of the house to be colder than it should have been for a baby. However, the hosts responded to our request for a portable heater immediately and provided us with one right away. Due to the location of the house and the extremely good approach of the owners, I definitely recommend this place to anyone who is considering it.
Had an amazing stay! Clean and nice rooms, friendly people and the only minus is the pricy parking for 20 CHF a night but besides that I highly recommend.

Irina is very responsive and knows the area very well so she can offer good places to eat and activities to do. As a bonus, she accommodated my later checkout time which I really appreciated. Would highly recommend!

Irina's place is the closest you can be to the train station, and the tram station can't be nearer. It is literally at the door step. The bed is large enough for 2 adults and a small child. Irina is a great host, very friendly and always available for any queries.

Place was okay, had a situation with the sheets having stains of blood. Communicated it to front desk and said it would be taken cared off however by the third day which is when they clean ( didn’t like that) the sheets were not changed just folded and put back on the bed even though they were put aside.

We enjoyed our stay in THE FLAG Zürich. The check in and check out went smoothly and they were very helpful and responsive. The apartment was very clean and nice, we enjoyed drinking coffee and tea that the provide. Downstairs there’s free coffee for guests 👍🏻 thank you

Miserable experience!! There is no curtains on the windows and shared rooftop with other rooms. Someone was looking in at me at 1:30 am on the rooftop trying to open the locked sliding glass door. I didn't feel safe in the safest country in the world and left to stay at the Marriott at 2:00 am. When I left this place the security was at the bottom of the floor with the women guard walking around and I left in a uber. Very frustrating stay and not very clean.

Cozy small apartment. It was clean and the host was nice and she left little treats for breakfast as well. Pretty accessible by public transit. The only con for me was that it was on the third floor and I had a huge heavy luggage that I struggled with getting up and down the stairs as a petite woman, but that was specific to my situation and not something bad about the place. Just to keep in mind if you’re travelling with a lot of luggage.

We had a great stay at Alessia’s flat. It’s beautiful, clean, and has all the necessary amenities. The check-in and check-out were fast and easy. Communication with Alessia was great - she responded quickly and provided us with local recommendations. I highly recommend staying here!
Great place to stay in the quiet part of Zurich, easy to check in, host is very responsive and always helps, highly recommended!

The place was clean and nice. It felt like home. There are various public transport options from the place and you can get to the train stations pretty easily. The neighborhood is lively but not loud. Rene communicated very well.

Rene's place was perfect for my needs. Additionally, Rene's hospitality and communication was second to none. Very flexible at any level. Location is perfect 10 mins from the airport and really close to public transport to get anywhere as public transport in Zurich is unbelievable reliable and takes you anywhere.

Ramona's apartment was beautiful! It was very spacious, clean, had a full kitchen (if needed) and she had awesome plants growing on the balcony and in the apartment. We had a great stay and Ramona was responsive and even gave us great tips even though she was out of town! I would highly recommend this listing.
This cozy and extremely luminous apartment is in the best area of the city! At 2 steps from banhof str. , limat and in the real heart of zurich! We’ll surely return! arik was an excellent host!!!

Location was really great, central to many things. Transportation was easy. Good sized and comfortable bed. Up two floors but there is an elevator. Relatively quiet despite the shopping around, at night very quiet, no disturbances at all.

We had a very nice stay at Daniel’s flat. The description and pictures accurately represented the flat. It was clean and had everything we needed. The flat is located in a quiet and safe neighborhood, yet is only around 10-15 from the city centre by train and/or tram. Daniel was very friendly and responsive. Thank you Daniel for our nice stay in Zurich

Comfortable little apartment in a very cute neighborhood (very residential) with a great grocery store. When we arrived, there was only enough bedding/pillows/towels for one person. We did eventually find more in the closet. Daniel was flexible with check in and the apartment is convenient to public transit and the city center (a 15 min train away).
Great place! Keep in mind that it's up multiple flights of stairs (no lift) and above a bar which is great for an end of night beer, but a bit loud with the windows open.

Absolutely lovely central location in the Old Town. With a couple of extra touches like coffee pods that fit the machine and sugar etc it could be outstanding. Marie did accept a late booking from us so maybe that could explain this , but the accommodation was running very low on toilet paper (we ran out) and had no garbage bags.

The flat was lovely and perfect for our trip. It's located close to two tram stops and easy to get to from the city. It was nicely decorated and very clean, the bed was comfy, and the bathroom nice. We didn't cook at all but the kitchen was also well equipped. Selina the host was excellent at communicating with us about the trip, entry into the appartment etc... and even left a Zürich book on the table to help us find fun things to do for the weekend.

Great location, close to the action and restaurants. AC was not working but they did bring us an extra fan for the evening and fortunately it cooled down a bit more at night and we opened the windows. The room was a bit too small for 2 people, for 2 nights but we made it work! That’s the only reason why I wouldn’t give it 5 stars. Location and everything else was great!

Highly recommend Hotel Alexander! The staff was great and their flexibility to check in was amazing! We arrived at 9am and they still allowed us to check in free of charge which was a life savor! The location is great very close to bars and restaurants. However the outside can be loud but with the windows closed it’s not bad at all!
The place is small and clean. Overall is a good and is near the station.

We had a lovely stay at Selina’s apartment. The bed was comfy, the place was clean and it had everything we needed. Sleina was a welcoming and kind hostess and her dog was super cute. It is close to Limmat where we took a swim and close to public transport. Would highly recommend this apartment.

A little confusing since the check in location and actual Airbnb are separate but the staff were helpful. Great location, super walkable to everything yet the room was quiet. The only thing was the room smelled like it had been painted recently and it was a little overpowering.

This hotel offers an ideal location for a trip to Zurich, as it’s conveniently situated within walking of everything. There was a minor issue with the air conditioning, which wasn’t strong enough on the highest setting due to the heat. The front desk informed us that this problem affected a few rooms, but unfortunately, there were no fans available. Since we only stayed for a single night, the A/C didn’t pose a significant problem, and the temperature eventually cooled down. Overall, I recommend this Airbnb!

Decent place, good location. Small rooms, complimentary mini bar drinks which was nice. WIFI was weak, which was the main reason I went. Clean rooms, ok shower, hospitality varies, some super nice and take the time to help, others just Swiss nice. All in all an ok experience, not great but definitely not bad
Gian was a great host. Communicative, informative, and straight-forward! The stay overall was very pleasant, and exactly matching his description.

Gian is an excellent host. He is highly communicative and made sure that I had a comfortable stay. I felt his hospitality even before arriving at his place. Smooth self check-in, apartment is clean and has everything that is required to feel at home. Location is just PERFECT, extremely central. I enjoyed watching the happeningS on the road from the window. I'm definitely going back.

This was a great stay, 5 minute walk to the tram that is very accessible. Stephanie was very nice and very responsive when we had concerns! This apartment is an Attic style, so it is not very tall friendly however it was very spacious and comfortable.

All the staff were so very friendly and helpful. Breakfast was excellent. Really enjoyed staying and being in the Old Town of Zurich is a great location with lots of atmosphere. I definitely would come back again.

Good location and easy check in. Free coffee in the lobby was very nice. However the unit smelled VERY strongly of something like men’s cologne, like they were masking a smoking smell or something. There were also hairs on one of the beds. 3 stars for cleanliness.

Greats place to stay for few days . Great location , secure and private ! The young guy at the Front Desk “ sorry forgot his name “ is the best . Kind , helpful and super friendly make a difference to our experience . Thank You 🙏
Very good stay at this appartment: modern, clean and well situated, I recommand. However pay attention that the quality of the wifi is really low, do not rely on it.

The apartment is exactly how described in the add. The only things to have in mind are that there are stairs to get to the building (if you are travelling with small kids you have to carry the buggy). Other than that everything was great. The are with the views of Zurich is very nice but yet you reach the city center in 15 minutes with public transportation. The laundry facilities were very good and always available, which is important if you stay for a longer time. Would recommend this apartment. Thank you Stephanie
Good location, hotel which has everything you need, staff super kind. However i do not recommend for light sleepers, the walls are thing and noises are easily spread
Awesome place … great location .. walking distance from all the attractions and market.
It was a perfect option for a sleepover in Zurich before going for a hike in the Alps! The flat is super nice and clean. Communication was also perfect.
we just stayed for one night, but the stay was really good. Michael has a very pretty house and the check-in was very smooth.

We had a great time at Michael’s place. Very clear instructions about how to check-in, usefull tips and Michael was very responsive. The Airbnb is a bit out of the city centre, but there’s a tram stop right in front of the apartment. Would recommend!

Reto's apartment was in a fantastic location, a short distance to trams and in walking distance of central Zurich. The apartment was very clean, accessible, had all the amenities I needed. Reto made some fantastic restaurant recommendations. I felt absolutely at home and had a great trip to Zurich. Thanks Reto.

This was my second stay at Reto’s place. Beyond the excellent location, walkable to everything, I particularly enjoy the cheerful decor and beautiful art. It was a pleasure to return to this home after long, gray, and rainy days. Reto is charming, proactive, and attentive host who makes you feel at home right away. One detail to be aware of: smoking is permitted in this home, so it may not be suitable to nonsmokers sensitive to cigarette smell. For everyone else, this home is a treasure!

This is my third stay at Lisa's place. This speaks for itself: The apartment is bright, spacious, well equipped, clean and near bus/tram, supermarkets, pharmacies etc. The bed is comfy and Lisa is super-helpful and responsive. Thanks, Lisa, would love to come back. Ruth
Really happy about the place!! it is really close to the city center and the place looks incredible! the hosts are always available for anything at any time.

Very nice apartment. Clean and the hosts were very helpful. Parking was expensive at the building but the location was great and very close to public transportation, so it made our time in Zurich very easy. The area it is locates is in a walking mall type area with a grocery store and a gym so it made our lives very easy while we were there. I would recommend staying there for anyone traveling to Zurich

We had a great stay—the room was spacious with a lovely balcony, a comfortable bed, large cupboard, house shoes, and an iron. The kitchen was spotless and fully equipped, and the bathroom was clean too. The host kindly allowed us to store a small suitcase before check-in and for some time after check-out, which made exploring the city much easier. The only downside was the uphill walk to the property—it felt like a 15–20 minute hike, which could be tough with heavy luggage. However, it’s well-connected, with a bus/tram stop just 2–3 minutes away.

This was a great and cozy air bnb for two travelers. They were very considerate about little things such as having an international adapter for charging devices. The only problem was sharing 1 bathroom but everyone was very considerate and there were no issues. We loved the location and also enjoyed the balcony. Overall it was a great stay!

Judith’s apartment is set in the perfect location if you want to explore Zürich and it’s surrounding areas. It is extremely easy and convenient to reach the Zürich HB. It is our family’s second stay here and we wish we could stay longer, but unfortunately the apartment was fully booked during the remainder of our holiday in Switzerland. Any family visiting Switzerland would love staying at Judith’s! Highly recommended. We’ll certainly be back.
We loved our stay in Judith’s home and hope to come and visit again. The only recommendation is fixing the wifi which cut out a number of times during our stay.

This Airbnb is in a perfect location and has great amenities. It is supper easy to access old Zurich with the railcar. House keeping comes three times a week to keep the place clean, but the time of day varies between 09:00 and 17:00. Unfortunately, I was disappointed when I arrived, because I expected a different room layout. The photos represent two separate Airbnbs. In addition to the layout, I did not expect to sign a liability waiver, and was expected to arrive at a designated time by the owner.

Very responsive, helpful hosts. Cleaning services provided every 2-3 days. The listing photos are of two different rooms. The location is very convenient for public transportation and groceries, and the surrounding area fairly calm and quiet.
The host is the best, super nice, responsive and very hospitable. The place is very central, super clean and very handy, everything you is available.

A very modern apartment with an interesting layout in a good location. Also easy check-in / check-out. However, there were a few shortcomings: - the apartment is listed as three bedrooms, but one of the bedrooms has no bathroom or other access except through one of the other two. It is really a converted additional livingroom / study - There are 2-3 cm gaps above and below each door and some of the walls, so that there is no internal sound insulation between any of the rooms - A detergent with a strong fragrance was used, which created a strong smell throughout the house and especially in the beds - Additional paperwork to deal with before arrival, which I have not encountered with other hosts

We enjoyed our stay! The house is great for 4 people, especially having 2 duvets in each bed was really nice. The area is really close to restaurants and cool cafes, we walked pretty much everywhere. The only thing is we couldn’t find the adaptor for the coffee machine but we sorted out ourselves later (our friend had one). In general are very happy with our stay.

The apartment is very nice, just like it is displayed in the pictures. The bathrooms are new, the beds are very comfy. Note that the third bedroom is an open Maiaonette one, this I did not see when checking the pictures . However, with six adults, the living and kitchen area are too small, with four adults and two little kids it is totally fine. Only downside in the kitchen is, that we only had 6 glasses, knives, forks etc. it would’ve been nice to have more. Apart from that, no complaints, I would stay there again!

We had a wonderful stay here with my spouse, mom and two teenage kids. The apartment was spacious, was close by transportation to Zurich center, quiet, comfortable beds and the A/C on the top floor was a plus that cooled down the kitchen/living area (although not the bedrooms). The building also has an elevator. The WiFi is a little spotty, but we weren’t here for business so this was fine. EMA was always quick to respond to our queries and we had a great two plus weeks here.

I had a wonderful stay in EMA’s studio apartment. It’s in a fantastic location - great and safe neighbourhood, within walking distance of Old Town, cafes, restaurants, supermarkets and shops are close by and public transport is within 3 mins walk too. The apartment is clean, fully equipped and the Wi-Fi was excellent. You are also only 4 mins walk to the lake promenade which is absolutely beautiful, especially during sunset. EMA were great with communication and were very responsive if you had any questions or problems. The added bonus was that the apartment was cleaned and towels were changed every second day. If I’m ever back in Zurich again, I would definitely stay with them again. Thank you for your fantastic hospitality EMA!! 🙏🏼

Rafael was such a warm and welcoming host! The place was exactly like the description in the Zurich area. The only downside was the street noise at night, since we had to have our windows open due to no air conditioning. Otherwise everything was great!

Lovely little apartment. Keep clean and had everything I needed. Walkable to the old town or a quick tram ride. The only downside was no AC on some very hot days and the flat kept its heat so I had to sleep with the fan on. But otherwise I’d definitely recommend the apartment.
This place is amazing. The views outside is wonderful and the private balcony is next level.

My stay at EMA House was incredible from start to finish! The team is extremely communicative from the moment you book. Instructions were very clear. The space was beautiful and clean. Housekeeping was extremely helpful. It was a five star experience! The location is very walkable to the HB station -even in cold weather it wasn’t bad. At the station you can find everything you need from groceries at the co-op grocery store to a pharmacy and since I went in December, the beautiful Christmas market. Everything was open on Sundays, which is also unusual. The views from my room were stunning. I will definitely be back!
Host is great and helpful. The house is clean and comfortable, especially the kitchen is well equipped. The location is convenient, just a few mins walk to the Tram station.

Very clean and modern family sized apartment. Kitchen is fully equipped. Nice and big terrace. Quick response from the team on airbnb chat. Washing machine and dryer available in the apartment. No Air conditioning but there is fans. Bedroom doors has no keys for locking them.

Very clean apartment with a beautiful terrace. We checked in with the front desk, who were very helpful and walked us around the apartment. It was well-equipped, including washer/ dryer, bathroom amenities, and a well stocked kitchen. The view from the terrace is amazing (river on one side and hills on the other) and the tram into old town stops right in front of the building. The only thing I would say is that this is not a warm cozy apartment (I was cold for most of the stay) but it is pretty in a minimalist way.

great location in Zurich. walking distance to main train station and everything else. staff were friendly and the place was clean and as advertised. balcony offered great views. would definitely stay again

The apartment exactly as described in the listing and photos are accurate. Peter and Engin are incredibly responsive and helpful. 1 minute walk to grocery store (COOP and local store, which is open on Sunday) and about 2 minutes to the tram lines. Would definitely stay at again. The building has a small elevator, but note you will have to go up about 8 steps from the entrance to the elevator landing. Note the apartment is not air conditioned, but several fans are provided. It was uncomfortably warm on days that were 30C+, but not mu

The apartment was excellent and looked even better than in the photos. The room was more spacious than expected and in a great location, only about 100 meters from the tram station and just 7–8 stops from Zürich HB. Both bedrooms offered good privacy. The host decorated the place with great style, and it truly felt like staying in a real Swiss home. We were pleasantly surprised to find a CD player with a large collection of CDs. The bathroom was fully equipped, almost like a 5-star hotel. The host was very attentive and offered quick, personal assistance whenever needed. We would definitely stay here again if traveling as a group of 2–3 people.

EMA House was an absolute gem to find on my trip to Switzerland. The apartment was very clean and spacious. Me and family felt right at home. The only point of note is that there isn’t any air conditioning. It can get hot, especially for used to using an AC. However, we were able to open the windows and have a nice breeze flow in. Overall, it was a fantastic stay and I look forward to staying at EMA house again in the future.

Great large space that was clean and comfortable. We were there during the heat wave with no a/c (very few places have it), which was a little rough but they had a good fan. Great communication and cleaning every other day if you want it.

This is a great property. We stayed a week and found it exactly as advertised. I guess the only downside is the elevator which is a bit small and doesn’t go to the first floor, we struggled to get our baby stroller inside. That said, this was minor; and we would absolutely stay here again.

EMA apartment was very spacious and comfortable. Easy walk to the waters edge and a 15-20 minute walk to Main Train station or just get the tram 2 minutes away. Unfortunately the lift was not working when we were there and we were on the 4th floor so getting heavy suitcases up the stairs was a bit of a pain. Otherwise, I would highly recommend EMA House if visiting Zürich.

We stayed for 3 days in Roland’s place. We chose the area because we had friends who live in Oerlikon. The small apartment was exactly as shown in the photos and extremely clean. Roland was SUPER responsive - within minutes - and addressed a small issue that arose with highest professionalism. We would highly recommend his studio apartment (we are Canadian and that is what we would call his space).
Roland is helpful . the place is just as like the photo and more . it is clean and close to the supermarket. Highly recommended

I was in Zürich for a professional training and the tiny house was a great place to stay at the start of my new adventure. Jürg was friendly, helpful, and always responsive. I enjoyed the garden and the leafy neighborhood that allowed me to have pleasant walks by the river to the city center. The location, place, and host are great for anyone looking for a comfortable start in a new city.

We loved our stay at Sara's apartment. We had a lot of space and the apartment was very modern. Sara was an extremely friendly and helpful host. Sara was super helpful with helping us locate the parking and checking in. Could not recommend this place more. Thanks Sara!
We wish we could’ve stayed longer. Very comfortable and easy to get to the Landiweise park. Comfortable bed and cool shower w/good water pressure.

Elegant and stylish studio which had everything I needed, dishwasher, fridge and freezer, hair dryer, iron and board, equipped kitchenette. It has everything to offer peace of mind during your stay. Unfortunately I couldn't stay longer due to logistical reasons, but I would love to go back again if the circumstances change. The self-check-in process was also very smooth, José and Dijana were both very nice and responsive during our communication. Thanks again for having me over.

The location is great! It’s about a 20min walk along the lake into the city. The apartment is super clean. The room is big and there was no problems with sharing kitchen and bathroom with the host. The only thing is that there are a lot of dog hair on the bed linen and towels which didn’t bother us (because her dog is super cute) but might be an issue for other people. Marissa is nice and we really enjoyed our stay.

Great location - so close to lake and easy to reach the city. Very good value in expensive city! Unfortunately there are currently roadworks on the road outside that start very loudly before 7am! Would recommend this place for those who are comfortable sharing a flat with a dog.
Amazing flat, close to the sea! Dimi is very helpful and always contactable!
The apartment was clean and as described in the listing. lot of restaurants and cafes in the are. supermarket is 5mins walk. Overall our stay was pleasant.

We had an excellent stay on our visit to Zurich. The staff were very flexible for check-in while we figured out trains on our way into the city and the unit was great. The location was very useful for getting out to explore the city. We have moved on to our next city on a tour of Europe and we already miss EMA House!
A lovely little place located right at the heart of Zurich. The room is modern and furnished well and was also very well-stocked. I would highly recommend for anyone travelling in a group of 1-2!
José-Luis was reactive, the appartment was clean, well located and really well equiped. The only inconvenience was the noise outside during the night.

We had a great stay at EMA House, everything was as expected and better in our views. We are a family with a 5 months old, we were afraid of travelling with our daughter but the apartment was great that we didn't have any issues. The location is amazing, walkable distance to Zurich attractions, close to groceries and restaurants in the surroundings. The apartment was very clean and looked brand new. We would definitely consider EMA House again in the future if we are visiting Zurich again.

A nice, clean, conveniently located apartment near downtown, old Zurich. The kitchen was nice, as were the washer/dryer (located in one of the two bathrooms), and it was nice to be on the top floor, with a large balcony. The only things we would have preferred are that the second bedroom/sleeping space had its own door versus having to pull doors out of the walls, and that the second bedroom's two twin beds were equal heights. Otherwise, a well equipped spot. We would stay here again, given the opportunity.
The condo was clean, comfortable and conveniently located. We loved the decks!

Great Airbnb, practically a hotel! Cleaning every other day if you wish. Communication was great - was able to ask things throughout my stay and they responded quickly. In a more residential area so it was nice and quite but also a quick 15 mins slow walk to the train station. Only issue we had was with the shower drainage when using the ceiling shower however we did not inform EMA house of our issues during our short stay. I'm sure they would have remedied the issue quickly if we had. Would definitely stay again and recommend!

Great location, very clean space, awesome transit options, great hosts. I can imagine living in Zurich in this space. I arrived on Christmas, and the hosts were available to let me check in early, super responsive upon my arrival. However, it being Christmas, they were short on labor and asked whether it would be ok to opt out of service for a couple of days (service is normally only every other day). That was fine for us--the only thing we later realized we missed was that the room only had 2 sets of towels for 3 people. We made do -- never did get the third set of towels. Still, we enjoyed our stay and would definitely return.

This small studio is very well located for exploring downtown Zürich. The apartment was very clean and has microwave, fridge, coffee maker, tea kettle, and a very nice shower. It’s small but comfortable for a short stay. For more than one person it might get tight for a longer stay. Check-in was a bit confusing for those not familiar with the Nuki process. We were only here on a Friday night and it was quite noisy as there were groups of people gathering to party just under the apartment on the street level alcove. But the windows help a bit with muffling noise and we had a comfortable enough sleep for an early flight next morning.

We had an excellent stay. Our unit was two blocks from the service desk, and they were a great help. The unit is in a great location and walkable, and the tram stop is two blocks - very convenient, especially when you have to go uphill. Highly recommended.
Sonia’s listing was very clean and in a prime location. The only thing I’ll mention is that it can get a little noisy given its proximity to the bars. Communication was perfect!
Overall our stay in Zurich at the EMA house was very comfortable enjoyable and up to our expectations..

Jose's team is very responsive, I don't have to wait for more than 5 mins for a response. The apartment feels brand new, quality branded (Miele) kitchen equipment, washing machine, dryer, vacuum cleaner etc. Tastefully decorating and extremely pleasing. Very quiet area, easily located and very convenient as the tram stop is nearby. Only 9 mins to Zurich HB and the tram is very frequent. Full set of kitchen ware for cooking. Overall, this apartment is much better than hotel rooms, and even my own residence! Only consideration for the host, is about the lack of instructions to access English TV channels or movies. We tried and gave up watching TV even we got back to the apartment. There are no air conditioning in the apartment, but fans are provided when we requested them.

Great place. Sunny, quiet, stylish, well equipped and with a nice balcony. I had a blast. It’s close to the big park by the lake which is very beautiful and has nice restaurants. It takes about 20-30 minutes walking to get to the city center though, but for me it was not a big deal.
Great apartment , super host with accurate and fast responses to questions. Thanks so much for the place ! Made our stay in Zürich super.

Wonderful apartment; Convenient location, 1-minute walk to the tram heading to the city center. Clean and comfortable room, fully equipped kitchen and bathroom. Wi is a friendly and welcoming person; we had a great time. Staying here is a great choice if you want to truly understand life in Zurich. Highly recommended.

This place is a great little hideaway for Zürich. The location is awesome and easily walkable. The walk from the train was no more than 10 minutes and Christian was great with giving clear check in instructions. The apartment is smaller than the photos show, but great if you are just looking for a place to sleep after a day of adventuring. The only reason I give it a 4/5 is because the bed was pretty broken in and difficult for my husband and I to share for that reason.

Overall, I liked the place, it was really worth the money. The location is nice - close to train station and tram stop. It is also close to the walking path along Limmat river. The room itself was pretty clean, maybe a bit small. But there was everything you needed. Maybe some hangers for the clothes would be nice. Wi is a great host, always there to help you.

Really enjoyed our stay at Christian Robert’s flat. Christian was an extremely good host, answering questions quickly and accurately - a massive thank you to Christian who also let us check in early!! This flat is in the perfect location and is at the heart of the Old Town. The flat is a walkable distance to all local tourist spots including lake Zurich and the Lindenhoff view point. The only reason we gave 4/5 stars is due to the cleanliness of the flat. The flat was very dusty & could do with a good scrub - however this is the most reasonable priced flat in the area. There is cooking equipment available, working fridge & iron. Overall, happy with our stay and would come again.

Great flat in perfect location. I spent a long weekend in Zurich and had a great time walking to restaurants and bars in the area. The flat is well appointed, but as noted in the post doesn't have a ton of items for home cooking. So make sure to wander out and try some of the cafes nearby!

Overall a great place to stay. Very easy to walk from and super close to the train. It’s def a basic studio, not mich to it, but a good value. Host was responsive. Ideally like to have more bath towels provided.
Very pleased with the place and will definitely be using again when we return for future projects.

The place was very nice and it had a homely feel. Carlos was very responsive and friendly. The only downside was that the wifi didn't work as there was problem with the provider, however Carlos made up it.

Carlos was the best host I've ever stayed with! Super responsive at all hours, friendly and proactive. His place felt like a home away from home - the whole experience is the way airbnb used to be and should always be. Considering that I came during The Eras Tour, pricing was sensible. Thank you Carlos, hope to come stay again!!

This is an excellent, large, one bedroom flat to spend some time in Zurich. The location is very good--it allows you to walk everywhere and there is a small gym next door that was also wonderful and kept my busy during this stay in the Winter. The quality of the flat including the bed, kitchen, and everything else is excellent. Host and his housekeeper kind, generous, and friendly to interact with. I will be coming back.

Konstantin was an amazing host! Location and the actual apartment itself was just incredible. It had everything necessary for the most enjoyable 9 day stay, ever. Check-in and check-out times were flexible and Konstantin was extremely responsive and helpful around everything needed. 10/10 - I’m looking forward to my next stay in Zürich!

Rakhal’s place was amazing. It was outside of the downtown area of Zurich, but the location was perfect because it was steps away from a bus stop. Public transportation was so easy in the city! The apartment was huge and was perfect for our family. The pictures do not do this place justice. It was the best landing spot for our family in Zurich.

Everything was perfect - great communication and tips before arriving, everything went smoothly organisation-wise! The apartment itself is great - spacious, lots of light, includes everything you could need. The roof balcony is incredible, gets the sun all day long and plenty of space up there to enjoy the views! I stayed for a month and worked from the apartment, it was the perfect second home for my time in Zurich. Great location with parks, bars, restaurants and nice squares nearby, as well as the river and train station!

Rossana's apartments at Badenerstrasse 414 are ideal for a short to medium term work stay in Zurich. The location is convenient (close enough to walk to the city centre in 30 minutes, or a short tram or cycle ride) but also close to Uetliberg for a hike. the flat is kept clean, the laundry facilities are very useful (remember to take CHF coins...) but the main stand out selling point of this apartment is Rossana herself who is very communicative, endlessly helpful and very friendly. I would definitely recommend to either holidaymakers or business travellers.

Had a comfortable stay. Wifi worked well for remote work and video calls. Despite the hot weather, having the windows open and the fan helped. Just a few minutes walk to grocery stores and trams/buses. The only small downside is the shower temperature fluctuates between warm and cold. Otherwise, recommended!

I stayed for nearly 4 weeks, and this beautiful apartment was an excellent place to use as a home base while arranging my permanent relocation to Zurich. Augustin was so responsive, answering any messages within a few minutes and arranging solutions very quickly if any issues arose. The apartment is very central, and so easy to get to anywhere by public transport. I had no issues with the noise as the sound isolation in the apartment is excellent, but there were a number of people hanging around outside the building, often Uber Eats drivers, which as a single woman at night I found a little uncomfortable.

Great location, close to the main station and well commuted with public transport (bus or tram stations 2 min away), lots of shops and restaurants in less than 2min walk. The host is very responsive and considerate, apartment is clean and spacious with 2 balconies. Perfect stay for the city life experience with night life adventures;) Definitely recommend and looking forward to stay at Au’s flat again
The view from the balcony is wonderful, and the location is excellent, close to train and tram stations. However, the house is quite small and old. Some repairs and updates would make it much better.

My 2 teenager children and I spend a wonderful time in the appartment. It is spaceous and very elegantly decorated. The kitchen is well equiped. The location is ideal as close to public transport (bus and train) and very close to the lake. We could park the car in the courtyard which was very comfortable. Joseph and his father were wunderful hosts and fast in responding. There is a nice terrace, but without view on the lake. The only downside is that due to its location along the main road, the traffic noice starts early in the morning.

Great location with a great view. I travelled for work and this spot was perfect for that. Close to where I needed to be, there was a kitchen and a small desk. Train station with trams to the old town were in front of the house. Check-in and communication were okay. In the building and the room it was very warm. The underfloor heating was set at 23 degrees celcius, which could not be changed. I could, of course, open the doors to the balcony but there is quite some noise outside which makes it inconvenient if you want to sleep or work. If you don’t mind the heat and bring some earplugs you will be fine ;) but overall it was good for my travel alone.

Lovely apartment finished to a very high specification. Location is easy to get into the centre of Zurich and easy with a bus stop directly outside. You are sandwiched between the train line and the main road, but the soundproofing is to a very high standard. No complaints.

Ina is great! Unfortunately, we didn't have the opportunity to meet but she answered all my messages quickly and kindly. The apartment is in a very calm and quiet neighborhood. There is a bus stop nearby that takes you anywhere in the city quickly. The room is great and spacious! I recommend it to everyone!

This is the place to stay if you like quiet and still want to be close to a train station! Ina is very kind, responsive, and even left out pastries for me. Room as advertised-- I appreciate that it had a desk!

A nice flat, in a very quiet green area slightly outside the city centre with a direct and fast connection to the city centre by tram. Very clean and well maintained, with the added advantage of a private car park directly in front of the house. Kamil handed us the keys in person and we appreciated his interest and several details, for example the coffee already ground or the body hygiene products. The mattress could be a bit more comfortable, but the absolute quietness made it possible for us to sleep very well. Absolutely recommendable, especially for those who want to retreat to a quiet place after a day of traveling/sightseeing.

The apartment was located in a quiet, beautiful neighbour and it was very close to public transportation, which was well connected to the city centre. The apartment was beautiful and clean. Besides, the bedroom has blackout curtains as well as shutters, so if you don’t like getting sunlight in the early morning, it is a plus that we really alpreciated! Kamil was very attentive and responsive, provided local recommendations and even left some delicious cookies on the kitchen counter as a welcome gift. The only negative thing are the bed pillows, which we didn’t find specially comfortable, but apart from that, it was a very pleasant stay. Kamil is a great host! An overall great experience :)
We felt almost like at home at Leos place. Beautiful appartment and very spacious. The communication with Léowas easy, he is a great host! We can definitely recommend staying here.

Léo's apartment was beautiful. It was a quick trip from Zurich's metro station. I only used the bedroom but the rest of the apartment looked unique and comfortable. The only detail was that the bed was not made when I arrived. Other than that, my stay was great.

We stayed at Karolina's place for 3 nights and really enjoyed it! The house is spacious and you have everything you need. It was pretty hot in Zürich (about 30-35 gedrees) but the house was cool. We swam every day at Savera Areal. It's also very convinient to reach city centre with the tram. Karolina gave us a lot of information about the city and facilities.

Wow!!! Beautifully located in the heart of Zurich, expect to wake up 1 min away from the pristine lake Zurich and welcomed by the soothing yet dreamy sound of the bells of the major Zurich münsters! The apartment has everything you need for a short stay - from kitchen appliances, utensils, to linens and bathroom paraphernalia. I’m still in awe with the location, and how it enabled us to discover the city with tremendous ease. Indulge in walks around town and good restaurants nearby. And, of course, enjoy the fact of having a beautiful lake 1 min away. The communication and check in procedures went smoothly. Finding the house is also not an issue as it is pretty easily identifiable with any maps app. Will come back :)

Hosts were very responsive and the location was really good - close to a bus stop. The place itself could use more TLC given the cleaning fee and looked much cleaner in the photos. However still was a decent option for those wanting to stay in Zürich and the building had a lift for those who have large luggage.

This is in such a great location! On the map, I couldn't tell if it was really close to the city or not, but it's incredibly close to the lake (just a couple of blocks), and then I would walk along the lake the entire way into town!! I just walked everywhere from Maurice's place, but there's also a bus stop very, very close and the buses/trains/public transport are incredible and clean too. This apartment was great: comfortable, clean, close to town, and Maurice was easy to communicate with and get ahold of with any questions.

Great appartment, exactly as advertised. The location in Seefeld is hard to beat - very close to tram stops, the lake, shops, and restaurants. The appartment offers all you need: a nice bathroom, cozy bed, small sitting area and a well-equipped kitchen (plus there is an elevator to reach the 3rd floor where the flat is located). Maurice is an excellent host who is very responsive, flexible and just really nice. 10/10 would recommend.
The check-in was smooth. The place was comfy and location was great. We did enjoy our stay very much. I recommend a stay at Tania's. 🙂

Great location, close to public transport, restaurants and super clean! The size of the flat is good and beds very comfortable. We went during a very cold weekend and unfortunately the heating system is maybe not enough powerful or should be checked because it was a little bit cold in the flat. Apart from this, we had a lovely stay and would come again.

The apartment has a great view ! And We enjoyed seeing the skating rink across the way. yet the building was quiet and in a courtyard. The apartment is spacious and very well laid out. It was nice to have the two bathrooms with a family. The kitchen is great and had everything we needed. The hosts were always available and very responsive. Thank you! We will visit again.

The place was clean with all that u needed but my comment is that it’s written it has air conditioning but we found a very small one in one bedroom hardly working and rest of the house doesn’t have which was not as described we chose this place especially for the air conditioner,a little bit far from city center 35:40 minutes by transportation. It was spacious and clean and the kitchen has all the utilities needed only a microwave.
The apartment is in a great location! 10 minutes walking to the main train station and most local attractions.

We had a great time at Gerard's place in Zurich. Gerard is quick to respond to all the queries and was very helpful in getting us settled. The place is in prime location surrounded by fantastic restaurants. We even had a great time watching the parade on Sunday which was less than a minute walk from the place. Highly recommended and we will surely stay here if we visit again. Thanks for hosting us.

Definitely worth what I paid for. There was no soap and shampoo, and he immediately went and purchased it and brought it over. The area is rough, graffiti everywhere and a cannabis store below the building. He was a great host, and did all he can to accommodate.

This listing was attractive and the stay as a whole was pleasant. We (my family) liked the location and accessibility. The apartment was well kept and neatly maintained. I would love to come back and stay here again. The only drawback was, there were additional hidden charges which of course was optional. The listing said it can accommodate 4 pax and a price was quoted. After booking there was a recommendation made to pay additional for sofa bed, for "comfortable" stay for the same 4 pax. I raised it with AirBnB, they confirmed that since it is optional, it is my wish to choose to pay. So what happens to the "comfortable" aspect for 4 pax ? If I hadn't paid would I have had an "uncomfortable" stay?

Perfect quiet location with an incredible view. Very well connected to Zurich by tram stop just a 3min walk away. Grocery store nearby to stock up on essential food items. Juerg and Valeria were excellent hosts. Very helpful and responsive. The apartment was perfect for our family of 5. We felt so relaxed.

It’s a very spacious and quiet apartment with an awesome view and a huge bathroom. The kitchen has everything you need and even more. The instructions are perfectly arranged via a website. We received a freshly baked bread twice during our stay which was very nice. Public transport to the center is very close and goes very often. The forest at the end of the street is a great place for children (and also adults). The only thing we sometimes faced was that when there was a smell in the hallway of the building because of the neighbors cooking, we could smell it in the bathroom. It wasn’t always the most pleasant fragrance.
Catherine's apartment is very clean and she's a super friendly host. I had a great stay and particularly enjoyed the closeness to the lake.
I had a really pleasant stay in Zurich. Easy to find location close to the train station and the lake. Very pleasant neighbourhood.
