Great location. Modern apartment and good set-up with lots of small touches. Communication and check in excellent. Manoel is super friendly and offering help and advice. Very clean and bathroom is new. There is however humidity and smell of damp in the apartment and despite the dehumidifier and dyson air fan there! Anyone with allergies or conscious about smell you would need to consider this well!
This was without a doubt the best Airbnb I've stayed in. It was clean, very comfortable, quiet, and had so many thoughtful touches. If you're reading this review just go ahead and book now!

We enjoyed our stay. The hosts were very accommodating especially with having a young child. However, Friday night it was very loud, and there was a lot of smoke coming in from the bar. This should be made known if you have young kids especially if you are traveling abroad. We did enjoy the location, it was very walkable and train-able.
House is exactly as described. Our 2 kids loved the garden to play in, we enjoyed the fresh herbs, the spacious and bright rooms and the convenient location just on the outskirts of Zurich center.

Our time at Josephine’s - and in Zurich - was too short and we’ll definitely be coming back. We didn’t realize how busy the neighborhood was, so the complimentary ear plugs came in handy, but the space was clean and felt super safe. Definitely recommend!

We enjoyed our stay here a lot. It was very clean and comfortable. The entire place was clean and organized including the common areas. Reception is not 24x7, however, there is a contact number provided that will respond immediately and is also very accomodating. Location is also a plus and near Zurich HB station.

Amazing cozy room right in the middle of Altstadt Zurich. The location could not be better. The room is small but it has everything you need. The bathroom is great and modern, the kitchen is also just enough. Last but not least, Peter is an amazing person, he cares about his guests and he is very interested to talk to. Definetly recommend 👌 👏

I had a lovely stay at Peter’s place with my seven year old son .. the highlights : it was cozy, felt extremely safe, quiet and peaceful - the shower is A+ amazing and Peter was a very sweet and responsive host. The only drawback for us was the bed which is exactly as pictured (so there was no surprise there) but it is definitely too small for two people !! Even two small people. That said, we still had a great time. The neighborhood is the perfect place be in Zurich for a few days. Thanks Peter !!

Great place to stay, cute and small studio perfect for one person or a couple and very close to the bus stops. Efficient stay. Note, there is no stove so you won’t be able to cook but there is microwave and blender and fridge.

Great place to stay in an accessible area of the city. You are able to get a bus/tram and get to the city center in about 6/7 minutes. The host was very responsive and helpful, always offering tips of what to do in Switzerland. Would definitely recommend!

The room perfectly fits one person, women only makes me feel safe. Room looks perfect, small but all needed facilities are included. 2 things that can be improved are checkin and cleaning. Host sent the wrong password, but host didn’t respond me for 1 day after I messaged. I waited outside for 1 hour before I figured out the correct password myself. As for cleaning, I hang the tag outside before 11am but the room was not cleaned. Hope this can be improved. Over all it’s a quite good place to stay and close to the center. Recommend!

Very cute and clean small studio, great for 1 person. For 2, its a bit cramped. You have to clamber out of the bed unless you climb over your partner - fine if you're a kid I guess. Great location, very quiet. Our host Nathalie was great, always available in real time.

Stayed at Silvan's place for about 1 week and can highly recommend. The apartment had everything we needed to self cater ourselves and it is located in a pleasant central neighborhood. Perfect to explore Zürich and surroundings. The host, Silvan, was friendly, accomodating and always fast to respond to our questions.

Fantastic place! Highly recommend, close walk to the central train station and the city center. Ended up walking everywhere, however if you would like to take the tram, the closest stop was less than a minute away. Also has a Starbucks nearby which was great. Quiet and safe area, highly recommend for any other solo female travelers!

Adhuirm was very nice and super responsive. Just as described, a small, clean and simple apartment in a friendly residential neighbourhood and very near to the airport and HBF. However, the bed sizes were very small (especially in the living room, and only one adult can sleep) but still highly recommended for maximum 3 people.

the room is very nice and has a small but nice private bathroom. you can enjoy a beautiful view over the city of Zurich. the apartment is clean and tidy. The only disadvantage is the position. the apartment is not close to the center and the last bus to reach it ends at 19:00. so if you don't want to hike up a very steep climb, you will have to opt for a taxi after that time. friendly and helpful staff

We liked that the accommodation was situated away from the centre, yet still accessible. The kitchenette and bathroom were great, they also included an ironing board which was super handy. The floor was unfortunately a bit sticky, so it would have been good to have some cleaning products for those staying a few nights. The whole complex also had a bit of a strange smell. But in general, everyone staying there seemed nice and it was affordable compared to most other places in Zurich. I would recommend it for the more budget conscious traveller.

The studio is as described. Everything was very clean and it was in a very calm neighbourhood. In terms of price/quality, I think the place is great. Be aware that the studio is not that close to the centre, so be ready to walk a lot or pay for public transport.

Martin was an amazing host. He responded quite quickly to all my queries even after checking in. The room was spacious and exactly as shown in the pictures. The check-in and check-out process was smooth as well. I would definitely come back here when in Zurich.
I had a lovely stay at Martins place. He is a very responsive host. The apartment was incredibly clean and made you feel right at home!

The location is good, it's outside the city and one has to take the train (S10) to Schwabstrasse and then take the bus 73 that doesn't appear on google maps suggestions. The walk uphill is wonderful and there are beautiful landscapes when you go for a walk. While the location is great, unfortunately the stay wasn't so much. It was cold and the blanket provided was not big enough for two people, they mentioned that there isn't one more available. If the property is supposed to host two people, there should be enough resources available to host that many. Also, according to me the whole point of Airbnb is that the host interacts with the visitors and help them with the suggestions that a local would know better, in this case, there was absolutely no such interaction.

Simone was extremely helpful and very accommodating throughout our stay. It was me, my wife, our baby, and our dogs, so it was a lot to manage - but Simone made sure that everything was stress free during check-in and out. The apartment itself was super clean and modern. Perfect for our needs. Highly recommended.

The Airbnb was located in a good place closer to the public transport. The big issue for me was it was not worth the price we paid for. The bed was very uncomfortable - it was a sofa bed which has partitions in odd areas and was painful to sleep on, both me and my partner woke up with a back pain - that being the biggest and the only pain point. Would recommend placing a full mattress instead. Besides that Kora was very communicative and the place was squeaky clean.

Great location for us and very nice and clean apartment. It has 2 beds/bedrooms and a couch so we were a little compressed for 5 people. We came from the United States and selected this place because it listed central air conditioning. It did not have that by our definition, no thermostat even, and it was very hot the whole time. Unfortunately there was a heat wave, and we could not cool down the apartment, which made it hard to sleep. Either way, we enjoyed our stay, and Simone was extremely responsive.

Our stay was good overall. The place was clean except for a couple small things I noticed. The wifi was good, but it required both a password and an SMS verification code. We didn't have international cell coverage, so we weren't able to connect on our own, but luckily our host was able to provide a verification code for us to get connected. The airbnb is conveniently located right by a bus stop, but unfortunately the bus that goes there is small and doesn't seem to stop there very often. We walked to dinner one night, and it was a pretty long walk because the area around the airbnb didn't have any restaurants. Plus, the return walk from the restaurant was all uphill, so keep that in mind when thinking about the location.

We liked the location of the accommodation, but it‘s more a hotel than an airbnb, and unfortunately we couldn’t enjoy our staying in Zürich because of the very inflexible checkin hours - we tried to ask the host kindly to offer us an option so we could checkin earlier or later than the given hours, but the answer was unfriendly and unhelpful, in the end. The person who welcomed us at the „hotel“ was very friendly and professional. Another minus is that we didn’t have hot or warm water in the morning, at all, until 11am when we left the place. The place was clean, but then again, it was a hotel room. 😊

The place was beautifully located in a quiet neighborhood. It had a few nearby trails that one can go out on for a walk. The room was clean and tidy with all necessities like cooking utensils that one may need for longer stays. The host was very accommodating and helpful. I would book this place again in a blink of an eye.

Nice apartment and located close to many restaurants and cafes. Be prepared to walk up stairs to get to this location however , but we did alright and in our mid 60's. Didn't realize it was on such a hill, but we did like the location.

Found Tania's place just as described and clean. The place is quiet, neighbors were not to be heard despite the ground floor. The tram station is conveniently close, but the place is sideways from the track and far enough for it hardly to be heard. The washing facilities in the basement are well-kept and clean as well. Found the pillow too thin for my preference, so would bring my own next time. The inner garden in the house is also nice and quiet. Thanks, Tania, for the comfortable stay!

Lazhar was attentive to our stay, proactive to provide information, the house is really next to the Center town but in a peaceful and green neighbourhood, shops and public transportation are just next door, it is really to be recommended when visiting Zurich.

Well located spot close to many transit options, supermarkets, restaurants, and others. The place itself is very nice and clean. You do share a bathroom with others, but in my experience, it was always available. There is a small extra fee for towels and bedsheets. The host is very reachable and always ready to answer any questions.
Lives up to expectations, very clean and convenient, free parking for cars is a big incentive in Zurich. Will surely use the place again. :)

stayed in a flat where someone had smoked inside. I asked to change it due to the smell but the guy from the check-in did not allow me. I found the spoon to clean dishes already used by previous guests and the shampoo open. Unacceptable The rest is fine

A nice location outside central Zürich. The room was clean and well organized, recommended! We had some questions and requests, but nothing that the staff couldn’t fix. The only thing lacking were cooking utensils such as salt, pepper and oil (which was mentioned on the AIRBNB page). Other than that, great place to stay!

The host made everything really easy I had to check in late and they allowed me to, also I needed stuff during my stay and they provided very fast. The only thing to take inti consideration is that it’s up hill walk which sometimes was a pain especially when at night and buses don’t run anymore to up there.

We had a very pleasant stay in Sebastian's apartment: it's very quiet (windows are on a courtyard), spacious and luminous, clean, with a comfortable bed and enough room for two persons. We had the opportunity to cook and use the provided washing machine, and everything worked as expected. Sebastian provided detailed check-in instructions: be sure to check them as the street number indicated on Airbnb is actually for the house on the other side of the street. He was also very responsive and helpful. The only thing that would add comfort is the missing show curtain, in my humble opinion. A final remark: everything is exactly as on the photos. We were just surprised by a large painting on the living room that we weren't expecting and that made us a little uneasy, but nothing dramatic.

I recommend this place if you’re visiting Zürich. I wouldn’t consider the location to be close to the city center, although there is good access to public transport. Bus 73 stops literally in front of the building and has great connections; you’ll be able to get anywhere is Zürich easily. The only thing to keep in mind is that bus 73 does not start running until aprox. 09:00 (am), and does not run at night. Download the app “SBB mobile” and you’ll be able to plan your trips without a problem. The views from the room are beautiful and the check-in/check-out process is quite simple.

Absolutely loved this place. We needed an affordable spot and lucked out with this gem. It's tucked away near the top of the hill with access to amazing hikes that take you to the top of Zürich. The walk up the hill to the place is tough, but if you catch the 73 they drop you off right outside. Just watch your timing as they stop shuttling around 7 pm. The room was very clean, came as advertised and was big enough for us. There's a Coop just down the hill and we cooked dinners, although check the basics before you shop. There's one of those water fountains outside that you can refill your water bottle with too. The city is just a bus ride (32) or train ride (S10) away. You'll enjoy the views too!

This place is in perfect location - short walking distance to trams and train station that take you directly to the airport. Tania shared great trip details with a map, even a great hiking spot near the city where you can get great views overlooking Zürich, lake, and part of the Alps.
perfect! large spaces, clean, close to the center and well connected, everything necessary was there. the price Is High but in line with city'prices

Nice fairly well located apartment with comfy bed. The shutters in the bedroom can be closed so the room gets nicely dark. Clean and generally as described in the ad. Check-in was easy and communication good. The only thing was the apartment smells of cigarette smoke, you get used to it after a bit but it’s not very pleasant when entering the place.

Highly recommend this cosy little apartment. The host is great and location perfect. As other reviewers say unfortunately the walls are thin and you do hear other residents at times, but if you can ignore that it's a great little option.

The location of the apartment, the ease of access, its cleanliness, and the quietness of the street were all excellent — I would rate them a 10. The only downside is that the apartment tends to get quite warm, and there is unfortunately no cooling system available. I believe that at least a fan would be essential for added comfort. Additionally, having an iron in the apartment is a thoughtful touch and much appreciated; however, it might benefit from being updated.

Deutsch unten. — AirBnB the way it was originally intended! The entire family is incredibly charming and hospitable. Location, room and amenities are even better than you‘d guess from the pictures. We felt right at home and might be back some day. — So war AirBnB ursprünglich gedacht! Die ganze Familie ist sehr liebenswürdig und gastfreundlich. Lage, Zimmer und Ausstattung sind noch besser, als die Bilder vermuten lassen. Wir haben uns wie zuhause gefühlt und kommen vielleicht auch wieder.

Sarah and her family were really helpful, friendly and kind. I had a warm welcome and found the place to be very comfortable. The bathroom is luxurious. I drank wonderful coffee and learnt about good places to eat and explore. The lake-side spot nearby is also wonderful.

This is well-located and tastefully furnished apartment. Johannes is an excellent host and his communication is fast and accurate. Zurich is an easy city to navigate and we used trams and busses which were just a few metres from the apartment. We would highly reccommend this property.

Really nice studio apartment in Zurich. We enjoyed the location, which is well-connected to bus and tram networks, and has a lot of bars and restaurants a short walk away. The art museum was also a 10 minute walk away. The studio was very clean and well-suited for travelers doing work, and gets great light. The Wi-Fi was quite good; the external monitor looks great, but we unfortunately did not have the right port (Thunderbolt) on our laptop so we couldn’t use it. Johannes was very responsive and professional. We would come back and stay here again.

Great location, near public transportation, 15 mins walk to Zurich main station. Mi is great and she replied to all my inquiries instantly. The only thing to consider is that the bathroom has no door, so it’s not suitable for people who require privacy.

Great place - not super spacious, but the place has everything needed for a temporary long-stay. Location is great, with good restaurants and grocery store just around the corner. Clean and modern place, with seperate room for storage of bags.

The host is nice, responded to everything patiently and also gave us early check in at 1 p.m. but the place itself is not worth the effort of booking it or the money. It’d be better to book a hotel even if it is a little more expensive. The place is too shockingly small. Impractical for 3 adults or even 2. It was an unpleasant experience for the lack of space and amenities. The location is good as it is close to the main station. Unfortunately it was a non refundable booking, I’d have liked to cancel the booking after seeing how small the place is.

The location is great. Very close to the main station and yet being on a back street, the station noise can’t be heard. Communication with Stephanie is easy and you normally get your answers within an hour. The check in was easy. The apartment is spotless clean, big enough for a week trip and the space has been smartly used. There are enough amenities and with high quality (cutlery, plates, dishwasher, …). Maybe the only downside is the thin walls that you can hear your neighbor and their pet. All in all, great experience!

The host was very responsive and the unit was sufficient for a traveler who needs a place to crash. However during my stay to see was incessant construction that woke me up at 7:00 in the morning and would not stop for hours. I wish the host would have mentioned his in the email as I would have never booked this property. I had to leave early because of this issue
Perfect location with all the amenities, fully equipped kitchen and a beautiful balcony. Seamless check-in and check-out. Highly recommended.

It was a good stay - the apartment is close to train and bus station, walking distance. Even though its a small space, they have everything. Loved the efficient kitchenette. We had a lovely time and we hope to stay longer next time.

It has a great location, not too busy with tourists but still very central. Apartment was clean and nice but it was very very hot inside. There was no A/C, I think there should be one as outside temperature was 35C degrees. There was a ventilator, it was the only thing that saved us, but it would heat up after 3-4 hours of use so we had to turn it off from time to time. But I think maybe in the winter it will be nice and warm. Cleaning lady was nice, check in was at 15:00, but she cleaned the room faster so we could check in at 14:30, which was very helpful after long hours of travelling with no sleep and hot weather.
Great location near the lake and many restaurants. The unit was very clean with comfortable bed linens. However, the street tramway noise was quite noticeable. Overall, a good stay.

Great location near city center and the lake and close to grocery stores and nice restaurants. Just know that it is right near a tram route so you may hear the trams at night. But honestly it was great location and a clean apartment. Would totally stay again on our next trip.
Great location, clean, easy check-in and check-out and quiet. The only negative was the bed, which was cheap and uncomfortable. If you don't mind that - it's a great place to stay.

Very cosy, clean and well equipped little studio with a garden view, close to the Milchbuck tram stop. The only little drawback is that when the window's open you hear the cars passing by, but with earplugs it's no problem. Thanks for the great stay!

Had a really pleasant stay in this comfortable apartment with a v comfortable and spacious bed and great views of trees. Check in and general communication was outstanding. Resolved unexpected issue with plug adapter quickly. Line 10 tram nearby was perfect, especially getting out to the airport. Quiet location aside from some tram noise. Loved integrated transport system in Zurich

Booked at the last minute so we could rest after a long flight. This worked out perfectly! Reasonable distance from the airport, easy to find, and we had no issues getting inside. Loved that there was an elevator for heavy luggage, and felt extremely safe while inside! The local area is full of dining options. The shower was a great bonus- and the little patio area was awesome for “people watching”. Great for a short stay!
Everything was as expected but the pillows were horrible and I got a kink in my neck sleeping on what little there was of it. I got it for the location and it was where I needed it to be.

Very good place for a short stay, the apartment has everything you need and is only a short walk from Zurich HB train station making it super easy to get around. Only downside is the road outside is quite noisy first thing in the morning.

Stephanie’s place is just 5 minutes walk from the train station which is very very convenient. The apartment is very clean and spacious.The only problem that bothered me was the noise from the pub downstairs, from where you can hear people laughing and shouting at 4 am.

Nicolas place was amazing. Great location, walking distance from the main train station, also few minutes walk to the most beautiful spot at the lake. The house is beautiful and cozy. It had everything we needed. Nicolas was very helpful and responsive. We will definitely come back to the same house when in Zurich.

What a cute Airbnb within walking distance to sights and train station. Comfortable and well equipped. We really loved this place! Great local bars and restaurants nearby. We stayed during a hot time of year and there is no AC or fan, it was too loud at night to open windows. Plus it’s a ground floor unit. Majority of the year it wouldn’t matter, but it was unbearably hot without airflow when we stayed. That’s the only downfall for us. Everything else was amazing! We would stay again!

This is a great place for a short stay in Zurich. It is close to the train station and commercial streets, and easy to find. There is even a supermarket nearby! I had a great time, but I did expect more appliances for what I paid (e.g., a microwave). I know Zurich is expensive, but still… The pictures describe the place well. Thanks for everything!
Great stay ; Erika is very responsive and helpfull. The flat is very spacious & well equipped.

The place plus the host both stood out. The host was extremely friendly and helpful. we struggled with the stove for a brief time but she took the pain and came in person to help us. not only that her responses were always on time and polite. now about the place, it is near to the main station and city .. we covered all important places easily.. and when we came back we had the ease of staying at a cozy comfortable place.. Thanks very much Erika for hosting us. you have given us memories to cherish.
It was a perfect stay. Everything is very well organized and the contact is easy. Even if the apartment is shared, the room has enough privacy and I felt safe. Recommended!

I enjoyed Lazhar's place, but I think the guests should know it is a shared townhome very close to public transport. There are four rooms for rent all on different floors (I think). Lazhar is very responsive and was helpful in adding better pillows and a dorm fridge for my six night stay. I was disappointed by the extra fees he charges even for sheets, which I thought was ridiculous. Also, there is no real common area to sit and a lot of post it notes with rules. However, it was restful place to stay and close to Seebach train/bus station and very easy to take the 768 bus to/from airport. Also, there is no free car parking at Lazhar's place, but possibly available for extra fee. Overall, it's a nice clean and quiet place.

This was my first time to Zurich, and I would have to say this place was beyond expectation. Amandine has thought of every detail to make your stay comfortable. Her place is quiet, spotless, comfortable for relaxing, and in a great location for the train and walking in the city. 11/10 rating!!!

Great apartment. The host was very fast for answering and everything was tidy and nice. The area has many restaurants and is close to the old town and the lake. Unluckily, we were very flexible to enter the apartment late (several hours later) but there was no intention to compensate us with a late checkout. That could be improved with almost no effort.

Tania is an amazing host. The house is a lovely, premium, modern, spacious apartment in the first floor of a complex with lift. The sofa bed with comfy mattress in the living room and the other bed in the spacious bedroom can easily accommodate four people. Everything about the house is thoughtfully and tastefully placed to provide all comfort and convenience to the guests. Located in a peaceful neighbourhood, it is just minutes away from the nearest Weidikon tram station that connects you to all other parts of the city. The Zurich HB station is also minutes away from the home by tram. The kitchen is fully equipped with all conveniences. Thanks a lot Tania for being such a wonderful host.

Céleste is a incredible host. She assured that checking in was as easy as possible and made sure everything went smoothly. The room and apartment was as advertised, the place is very clean and has everything you need to live comfortably. Céleste as an individual is very nice, welcoming, easy going and easy to communicate with. During my stay we had amazing conversations and a great time all around. I am so fortunate to have her as my host being new to Zürich. I am sad to leave however, I undoubtedly recommend staying with her if you’re able to.

Overall, the stay was great. The place is quiet and conveniently located near ETH Zurich. The kitchen is very well equipped. The only minor issue is the sound insulation, so noise between neighbors can be a bit of a concern （neighbors would complain if you talk a few word after 10 PM). All in all, it's a very cost-effective accommodation, and I would recommend it!

Céleste's apartment was the perfect location for a course that I took at the ETH. It is only 10 min away from the main building and also close to Oberen Letten and city center. It is relatively clean and has everything you need for a week. I didn't meet Céleste in person but the communication was good. I would stay there again!

One of the worst stays we’ve ever had. The moment we walked in, we were hit by an overwhelming stench of synthetic perfume — we had to boil vinegar just to make the air breathable. The AC was useless against the heat, and the bed was so sunken we slept in a pit. The shower alternated between scalding hot and freezing cold due to faulty plumbing. We paid CHF 265 per night, plus CHF 35/day for parking in a space the host rents monthly for CHF 150 — blatant overcharging. After one unbearable night, we checked out early, but the host refused any refund. Tellingly, when we mentioned we’d left our Airbnb, the hotel across the street immediately guessed the address: “Ah, Badenerstrasse 414?” Clearly, this place has a reputation — and not a good one. Avoid at all costs.
The place is clean and quiet. The hostess is very friendly. All in all a great experience.
Great location, near the lake! Nice safe neighbourhood with parks and cafes. Many thanks Kay

The flat is functional, and 20 mins away by tram from the main station, in a quiet area. Communication-wise, the flat was missing a control wheel for the oven, and the entrance lights were not working, so I contacted the host on the 2nd day. The third day after that I contacted them again asking about the oven missing piece and then I got a very fast reply from Céleste, who came and gave me the missing oven control piece, so I think the first message was somewhat lost during communication. The entrance light was not fixed, however. The host also contacted me right after booking to inform me about the building being old, but that had no impact on my stay whatsoever.
Good location but the apartment was not What I was expecting. The host was super disponible and polite.

Very tidy and lovely AirBnb apartment. Huseyincan will make sure it is equipped with everything you need. A comfortable sofa bed and a small but nice bathroom. There is even a minibar service with delicious Turkish food. Huseyincan is a great host and there when you need him, very nice and keen to share all to know about the area. I had a great stay!
The apartment was very nice and comfortable. The check in notes were the best. The apartment location provided easily access to Zurich. I would recommend staying here.

Such a cozy and spacious apartment in peaceful neighbourhood. A lot of equipments in the kitchen so you can cook :) easy to access public transports! Big shopping mall near by. Blandine is very friendly host and she is always there for you! I highly recommend her place to stay!

My two daughters and I had a wonderful stay in Zürich. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed, we truly felt at home. We especially enjoyed the view over the tennis court, with the mountains in the background and the city on the other side. Daniela was a great host. Communication was smooth and friendly, and she made sure we felt welcome. Thank you so much, Daniela!

Rene’s apartment was all I hoped it would be: easy to get to (10 minutes by train from the airport); easy journey to the centre of the city, (Hauptbahnhof 7 minutes by same train); quiet area, clean and spacious apartment. Rene was always responsive to all my questions, and very helpful with advice about accessing places to eat. It’s worth making the Hauptbahnhof journey, but there’s a pizza place and supermarket a few minutes walk away from Rene’s apartment. Excellent value. Thanks, Rene.

A very nice, clean, large apartment in a quiet neighborhood. The apartment is on the 4th floor of an office building. Did not appear to be other apartments in the building. The space was large and very clean. There is no air conditioning but the large sliding doors on both sides allowed for nice cool nights on very hot June days. Note it is an open floor plan with no door to the bedroom.
Great apartment in an awesome location with everything one needs near by, the hosting and comms were second to none. Looking forward to another stay.
This is the owner's private residence and it was a treat being allowed to stay here.

Delphine’s place was excellent! We enjoyed our stay and wished we could’ve spent more time at Delphine’s apartment. We found the place to be quite lovely and modern even though the apartment is in an old building. The kitchen however was lacking a few basics such as pepper and oil. All of which we managed to get easily from the grocery stores nearby. One thing to note is that the place is located on the second floor with no lifts. If you travel with lots of luggages you must be prepared to carry them up the stairs. Delphine’s place was an amazing find for us and one of the highlights of our trip in Zurich. Highly recommended!

Delphine’s apartment is tastefully decorated, very spacious and comfortable. It was very easy to get here, following the instructions provided. The bed was comfortable and the apartment is quiet. The apartment is on the second floor, so there are 43 steps and there isn’t a lift. There is a great little group of shops just along from the aparmtment - organic groceries and bakery. And the restaurant opposite it great too. You can walk into central Zurich, or catch the tram that stops at the end of the street. We would stay here again, if we were visiting Zurich.

The apartment was very modern and beautiful than the pictures. It was clean and neat for our 11 month old to move around. Roberta gave us clear instructions and was very reachable. Looks like someone is living there full time during non booked days. Hence there were used soaps, linen and stuffs. However it didn’t bother us. Location was great too. I will definitely recommend this place.
Apartment is very well located and just as in the pictures. Flat is large and very clean
Had a fantastic time staying at Roger's last weekend. The place was tidy, spacious, and generally very pleasant to stay in. I don't believe I will be staying anywhere else next time I visit Zurich.

Julia is a very welcoming and kind hostess. She offered every amenities I could hope for, and is also open for talks. The room was cozy and perfectly clean, with plants atop the window sill and a beautiful view towards Zürichberg. The apartment is located in a quiet residential area in the middle of the hill, about 6 minutes walk from tram stops. Thanks Julia, I wish you all the best and hope to see you again next time!

The room was nice and clean, and the host was kind. However, I probably wouldn’t choose this place again because of the location. It’s on a steep hill, which makes it difficult to reach, especially with luggage.

We absolutely loved our stay at godfred's house. It was just opposite the tram station ,in the city centre and very well connected to all the sights in the city. He has a very tasteful decor which made our stay very pleasant. The check in was also easy and we'll definitely love to stay here again.

Godfred's place was a great stay! Incredibly homey and stylish, spacious, and well-equipped. Great location-- a 10 minute walk from the main train station, and easy to walk to old town and everywhere you want to see since Zurich is not too big! The listing does say there is a washer in the unit, but both the washer and dryer are outside of the unit in the basement. However, there was shampoo, conditioner, and body wash provided which was a nice bonus as well. Godfred kindly let us check-in early and the self-check-in was smooth. I would stay here again!

I loved this stay! It was clean, very nicely decorated, and there was a lot of sunlight & a nice kitchen, bathroom and living space. Jung Soo even let me check in a couple hours early because my flight had landed early! The only downside was that I booked it expecting to have the place to myself, but there was another AirBnB renter also occupying it at the time. It wasn’t a problem at all, both host and other tenant were very quiet, and hardly there-never really ran into them! But May be something to ask the host about before booking. Thank you Jung Soo for a nice stay! I appreciate it:)

Jack collected me at the airport and drove me to the apartment! You can't really improve on that for starters!! The apartment is a good size, there are supermarkets and a gym within a short walk and the tram stop is outside (that's the only downside - it's a little noisy but earplugs are great!!). Plenty of space, good amenities inside, big tv, great shower pressure. And you can run downstairs and catch a tram to the centre in 30 seconds!!!

Simple, unfussy and uncluttered, with a superb central location. A short twenty minute walk gets you right into downtown Zürich, or five stops from the tram stop literally outside the front door. Oodles of supermarkets within a few minutes walk makes cooking in the apartment trivial.

Amazing stay here at Jung Soo’s place. I reached Zurich late in the night but the whole place made it look like I was at home. Thanks for the home cooked rice and an amazing resting place before I headed out for another adventure ( thanks for the orange 🍊) . The place is a perfect fit for someone looking to escape the buzz of city and rewind the day later. Thanks! 🙏🏻

Only in Zurich for two nights and one full day Dimi’s apartment met all our requirements. Situated in a peaceful area with a coffee shop opposite, a general store close by and very importantly very accessible to everything Zurich has to offer via the nearby tram stop. We were there during a very hot spell - both the balcony (great for morning coffee) and the two large electric fans were Godsends. A very comfortable nights sleep - an apartment which certainly met our needs both with regards to the space and also the location. Thank you Dimi.

My best friend and I absolutely loved Dimi’s place. We spent so much time on the balconies when we weren’t out exploring. It has a lovely view of a park. There is a bus stop right outside that will take you directly to the Zürich HB, but the walk there is also very nice. It’s a lovely walk into town and very private and quiet. The place was super clean, very comfy and had everything we needed. I couldn’t recommend this place more. Please stay here if you get the chance!

We enjoyed our stay in Dimiter's place. The neighborhood is nice and very well connected. There are plenty of places to grab a coffee. It's also a 20 minute walk from both the old town and from the train station. Dimi's instructions were spot on and we didn't need to ask almost anything. The apartment itself was very sunny, with large windows and a nice outside terrace. We would recommend his place for a family trip to Zurich.
Hello all, The location was as he described. The flat was clean and specious. Backyard garden from the kitchen balcony feels peaceful. We enjoyed staying there. Recomended Thank you
Had a great stay at Saschja's. Great location for getting into the city and at an affordable price for Zürich
Perfect for our group. Well worth the money and conveniently located. Would recommend

Beautiful studio that has wonderful natural lighting and was clean and well maintained. Dimi was a wonderful host and communicated well. However, the listing said 10-15 minute walk to city center, but to actually get to the Banhopfstrasse and Zurich HB was closer to a 40 minute walk, so the location was a little inconvenient. Other than that though, lovely apartment and wonderful hosts - would recommend staying!

My stay was amazing! I really recommend for a trip of two. It was super comfortable bed. The dining area with the beautiful view was great. The host gives super clear instructions and helps if you don’t understand something. If walking distance from almost everything. Great!

Yvette is such a warm and welcoming host. Her place is the cleanest space I have ever stayed in. Very clean very quiet and such a perfect location. I highly recommend if you are visiting Zurich. And, it is walking distance to the wonderful lakeside. As well as shops, markets, and bars.

It was such a pleasure staying at Yves place. We enjoyed a nice conversation of an amazing herbal tea as she told me all the hotspots in town. It was too short a stay in Zurich and will definitely be looking to come back and stay at Yves.

Janna is the best host one can wish for :-) Her place is beautiful and we felt at home right away. She was super accommodating and helpful checking us in and giving us recommendations. Thank you again for hosting us and we hope we can return the favor one day!

First at all, thank you for giving us the opportunity to stay in your apartment. We were hopping to find the apartment in a place not so high up and far from the center, but the neighborhood was fine. Regarding the kitchen, we found it as someone left things just like that. There was full recycling garbage in the kitchen and the trash in the sink, also a glass dirty with some flies around it. Finally the bed hasn't bedding , we found it not 100 % as one we expected airbnb place in zurich.

Ideal if you happen to travel alone to Zürich. Everything went smoothly, Luiz is very helpful and cooperative. The Bus station is nearby. You might meet the lovely cat which welcomes and enjoys any petting.

Dimi very accurately described the check in process so it was very easy! Place was very clean and spacious, and it was nice to have the little terrace for sometime outside. Place is also very close to tram station which made it very easy to get around. Highly recommend staying with Dimi!

What a host .. Raf is a really nice guy - relaxed and professional, but at the same time responsive, attentive and kind. It was hot in Zurich, but it was fine in the apartment - large windows, and very adjustable shutter system. We had slight difficulty with our British adapters but there is a USB socket in the extension which was very handy! It's definitely a cosy place and Raf makes you feel most welcome. 🤗

Fabulous location and environment. Dimi is very responsive during the stay to answer all kinds of questions we have. However, the parking space and washing machine is not as cited on the airbnb page. There is actually no parking space, but a public parking lot by the road, which costs around 2 CHF per night. While the washing machine is not in the house, but at the top floor and requires a deposit card, which is not being notified during the check in.

Rafa was such a sweet and communicative host!Super responsive and genuinely kind. His place was cute, cozy, and perfect for our stay in Zürich. I really appreciated how easy and welcoming he made everything. Would 100% stay here again and definitely recommend his place to anyone looking for a chill and comfortable spot in the city. Thanks again, Rafa!

A very nice and clean apartment. Nice view and good location, however the connection to the city is not 24 hours a day. The apartment is very nice and ample, and has all you need. Only the cleaning service channeled through Blueground was not reliable - they cancelled twice and when they finally came, they did not do a great job. But all in all it was a great place to live and Blueground was a great owner.
Very well located, this is a very nice and clean apartment. The place is well furnished, and Guillaume is attentive and able to answer very quickly. Perfect to discover the city of Zürich!

Our stay was amazing! The place was spotless and very beautifully decorated. Unfortunately the AC was not running when we went, but they provided a fan for us in the room. Anna was really helpful in answering all of our questions and accommodating an early check in which was much appreciated. Definitely recommend. :)

Great and quiet location. Spacious and very bright, as seen in the pictures. Internet is fast and reliable. Kitchen floor was a bit sticky, but the rest of the house was clean. Check in and check out was very smooth and communication was great. We appreciated that the host went above and beyond to get a second blanket for us. The place was a bit more cluttered with the host belongings than the pictures show, but other than that, great place.

I stayed at this hotel twice, and both experiences were pretty consistent. The staff is incredibly friendly and proactive, always willing to help. Early check-in might be possible — which is super convenient after a long trip. The hotel itself is very central, and all the main attractions in Zurich can be reached on foot. However, for travelers with luggage using public transportation (like us), it’s good to know that no bus, tram or train stop is right next to the hotel. The nearest tram stop is about a 5-minute walk on mostly flat ground, and the closest train station is around a 10-minute walk with slightly uneven terrain. Overall, for the price–quality ratio, this place is simply unbeatable!

The apartment is very clean and cute, it’s all new and it has a full functional kitchen. It’s near the tram stop so it’s comfortable to move. Sonia is very kind and nice, and they reply the messages very quickly!

I recommend staying at Pablo and Sonia studio apartment. Pablo was very responsive and detailed for check in and other info about the area. The studio had everything we needed. Small kitchen, washer and close to old Zurich. I recommend this place. Only thing I do wish was available was air conditioning. However most of Switzerland does have air conditioning.
Great place to stay, 20 min by tram to the city center and 10 min to the airport. Nice well equipped apartment with exceptional garden on the balcony.
Waheed’s place was easy to find and in a nice quiet area with easy access to get into the main area of Zurich! everything was super clean and he was quick to reply if we had any questions
Super responsive and flexible host, very recommended if you’re visiting Zurich with your family or friends. The apartment has everything you need!

The villa is amazing! Featuring a huge garden with lots of flowers, herbs, strawberries, vegetables and big trees. Best location in walking distance to the lake and city center, but quiet and surrounded by nature. Pearl is an amazing host. She welcomed me with food & drinks. Breakfast and dinner were served every day and included in the rent. Pearl's great hospitality exceeded my expectations by far. Enjoyed playing with the dogs. I would love to stay there again if the internet connection was better.

Pearl is an amazing host. She welcomed me into her home and showed me around the house and the gardens. She explained that the villa is part of trusted houses and it is 200 years old. Unfortunately, the listing is not accurate and the building is not so clean.

Grazyna had a lovely home. Even though my flight was delayed, I was able get in with easy directions and she still greeted me. The room is clean and comfortable and perfect for solo travelers. I only stayed one night, but wish I could have stayed more. Thank you, Grazyna.

Easily accessible from the airport (~30 mins). The host was very welcoming; very kind for making me tea and toast. I enjoyed talking to you, Agnes. The place had everything I needed - a bed, a table, and bathroom. I would stay again. Please note that this is a room/bathroom in her house.
Rafael’s place is perfect for a nice stay in Zürich! The apartment is lovely, and Rafael is always available if a question comes up. Highly recommended!
Great apartment in a great location. It was clean and looked exactly like the photos. The only thing to be aware of is that it’s located on the 5th floor with no elevator, but it wasn’t a big issue.

Very clean and very comfortable. We’ll decorated. With everything you need even laundry detergent (appreciate the thoughtful details). Very easy access to airport and all of Zurich from Banhof Wiedikon stop. Would happily stay here again!

Great location one tram stop away from the Opera House. Lots of restaurants and stores nearby, within short distance to the lake. The apartment has all the essentials you might want to spend a few nights, do some cooking, and relax after a day of sightseeing.

The location is excellent and perfectly situated to visit the city with public transportation within minutes. The apartment is nice and spacious. It lacked a bit of amenities but the host was responsive to our requests. Overall, nice place.
The place was super clean, minimalistic, spacious and recently renovated! It’s a short walk from the train station and downtown

Ernst’s place was perfect for my short stay in Zürich. Easy access to trams and buses, yet on a very quiet side street. The room was clean and comfortable, with a fridge and kettle provided. It was hot during my stay, but there is a fan that helped to cool the room down in the evening. Ernst is helpful and friendly and I can wholeheartedly recommend his place.

Staying with Ernst was a great experience - he gave such helpful and clear instructions on how to navigate the local public transit towards the flat, and was very communicative. The apartment was very comfortable and it was an amazing experience overall.

The room has enough space for a single person. Carry-on luggage and backpacks fit easily in the room. Entry with key card. A small fan, table, stool, lamp and wash basin are available in the room. Shower/toilet on each floor. The room was on the third floor but the property has a lift which is a plus for anyone with mobility issues. But the best thing about the stay was the location! All major Zurich attractions were nearby. You can walk to most of them. Zurich's main train station, Zurich HB was 7 minutes by walk. And the tram stops right in front of the hotel. Coop/Migroline and many restaurants were just a walking distance away. Overall, a great place for solo travellers.
The appartment is clean and cozy, unfortunately for me it was too noisy with bells each hour ever in the night :( I recommed just for people not fragile for noises

Fantastic location, very hot room when hot outside, and noisy throughout the night. But you are paying for location and it was as described. Great communication and staff. Thank-you. The one common room with Aircon, fridge and amenities was a blessing.

Jennifer is an amazing host and will make you feel right at home. The room was super spacious and comfortable and is perfectly located. You can get to anywhere you need to go with the train station being a ten walk away and the nearest tram station only a 2 minute walk. I would highly recommend her place to anyone visiting Zurich!

The apartment was very clean and had all necessary amenities! Unfortunately the Wi-Fi hardly worked for me, which was an issue as I was intending to work. If you do not need consistent Wi-Fi, I think it is a great place to stay.

The stay was really wonderful. Excellent communication, easy check-in /out. Great location; lots of shops, places to eat, and great coffee, all within walking distance. The room is great for a solo traveller with access to the kitchen, bathroom and washing machine. Jennifer was a great and accommodating host :)

Nice, cozy and quiet apartment in a very well connected area, with a variety of places and close to many forms of transport. It has practically everything you need to live comfortably without any worries. The only thing I would say as a drawback is that going with an animal is a bit expensive financially, even though it is someone else in the family.

Quaint little place but great price. The shower was so great after a long day. We didn’t use the kitchen area and were out most of the days we stayed, so we just needed a place to rest. It was perfect for these reasons!! Also great communication overall! Very helpful.

Very nice apartment, I stayed with my family for more then 1 month and the apartment had everything we needed. It's very well located, close to supermarkets and train station. In 10 minutes you can easily reach the city center. Besides being an airbnb the apartment was very cosy and friendly. The plus side was that Blueground was super easy to communicate and to reach with the help line always running.

Teresa's apartment is perfectly equipped and with what you'll need for a stay, very close to both Aldi and Coop as well. All amenities were in good condition and the apartment was also clean and organised. Walking distance from anything you need or anything you want to see, and it is a great price considering how close it is to Zurich centre. Apart from all positives, maybe I was just unlucky hence why I still give it 5 stars, on the weekend some of the neighbours can be noisy, and the apartment is on the ground floor next to the outside communal area so you can always hear people coming in and out of the building. However, Teresa is great and fast at communicating to solve any issues and will be in quick contact with the building manager on your behalf, so problems were solved. thanks!

Staying at Francesca's was wonderful. I felt right at home and it was perfect for a two week stay in Zurich. For those who do not know the area, it can be loud and active but the windows of the apartment were so good I barely noticed. The kitchen was stocked well with everything I needed for cooking. Bedrooms spacious and comfortable. I can't recommend her place any more. :)

Had an excellent stay. Super accessible with bus and tram. Migros and Denner a stone throw. The apartment in itself had all the amenities, very spacious and clean. Ample linen and laundry facility. Felt at home away from home.
Paul is a great host, the room is spacious and comfy. If you're staying in Zurich, Paul's place is the right choice.

I had a great stay at this place! The apartment was spotless and had everything I needed for a comfortable and relaxing visit. The location was perfect—quiet, yet close to the center. Paul was incredibly kind and responsive, making everything stress-free. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

Tania was a terrific host. She allowed me to correct a mistake with my reservation which was to her disadvantage and managed to get me an additional day that I needed. Place is nice, clean, well communicated, spacious, and with all you need for a comfortable stay. The only problem for noise sensitive people may be the traffic from the street and the neighbors playing beat music. Otherwise the place is a very good deal for Zürich. Thanks Tania!
Alina is a very nice host, and the communication with her was fast. The place is nice and very close to the station and walkable to main places to the city. I recommend it

Before I booked, I was hesitated due to the zero review. However, it was one of the best airbnb I ever been. Beautiful furnitures, clean flat, nice neighborhood, a supermarket nearby. Romain was very friendly and kind. Highly recommend!
Aurel's apartment was worth every penny. Good location, price and was very tidy. Although I didn't get the chance to meet Aurel in person, he was very helpful over the phone.

Aurel’s place is in a great location with a bus and tram terminal within walking distance. As well, there is also several grocery stores within a walkable distance. The kitchen is large and there is lots of fridge/ freezer space!

Transportation is not an issue anywhere, easy to get around. The host is really cool to talk to and very helpful in all areas. The only downfall was that there was not a place for me to do laundry, other than that, everything else was great. overall, I recommend the place.

This place is clean and very central. You can walk to the city Center in 10 minutes and there is a market nearby to buy food. The communication with Antonio was easy and he is a nice person. Our experience was unfortunately not very good. The place smells like marijuana, there are no dark shade curtains and we had to wake up at 2:30am at night because the host came back little drunk and he had forgotten his keys. Also, the Wi-Fi connection is very bad; the rooter is too far away and the connection kept breaking up. The host said it is a temporary problem. Lastly, the mattress is very soft, it is like a sponge. In summary, the place is fine if you are staying a short time and it really didn’t give us a safe and comfy feeling.
The place was very close to the city center, Antonio is very nice and friendly, had a great time in his place.

eder is very very friendly host, he guided me with lot of things about zurich which are quite helpful for future trips to zurich. the place is even better then it looks in the pictures. it is very convenient to super markets, train station just seconds of walking distance. I would defenetily recommend eder and it's listing's for bookings in zurich and around. thank you eder for everything once again.
Good location close to the station and good value. The only downside is the sofa bed, it’s ok but could be more comfortable.

Giuseppe was an amazing host and the place was absolutely wonderful! The location is perfect, the number 7 tram is right outside of the apartment which gives you access to everywhere you want to go! It was so nice to have public transportation so close to the apartment. The Airbnb was very clean and had everything you need. If I had to pick one thing to improve on would be the bed, however it was very minor. I recommend this place to anyone who is staying in Zürich and will be coming back in the future.

Nice one bedroom apartment in Zürich Wiedikon just around the corner from the S Bon station and located in central Zürich. Walking distance to everything including trains and tram. Would highly recommend for a single or couple. Great location and not a lot / no hotels in that area so the only way that you're going to find a place to stay is literally at an Airbnb.

Look no further, you won’t find a better place to stay while you’re in Zurich! Our visit was enhanced greatly by being able to stay in Taymour’s place. This is a nice apartment in a nice building and we enjoyed being up high where we could enjoy the view. There’s an Asian take-away restaurant one block in one direction, a pizza place one block in the other direction, plus a couple of small grocery stores just around the corner. The bed and couch are both a little too low for my liking, but they are exactly as shown in the photos… so I’m not complaining. It’s just something you might want to think about when deciding whether to stay here. Both the check-in and check-out processes were clear and simple. Taymour was very helpful and kind whenever we had a question!

A tastefully furnished apartment with 2 rooms. Communication with Alexandra was very easy and she always replied quickly. The location is very good, Stadelhofen train station and the lake are nearby. Public transport is less than 10 walking minutes away.

Beautiful and cozy place in a great location. Walking distance to touristic places and restaurants. It is next to a train road which makes the place super noisy in days and nights. Specially when you need to leave windows open in a hot day.
Great communication, instructions were well written. The place is very spacious and close by to public transportation.

Nathalie is an extremely pleasant and communicative host. Her place is wonderful. There is a nice view from her apartment onto the lake, and if you‘re lucky with the weather you can see the mountains. It‘s a quick (<5 min) walk to the rigibahn or a ~10 min walk to the bus/tram that takes you all over town. Location is super quiet. Super comfortable bed, and a nice desk for those that need to work. Thanks Nathalie for a great stay!

The balcony has the best view of the lake and the city. The neighborhood is peaceful. The unit was just as described. Nathalie is responsive and gives us recos when we ask her places we wanted to go. We will definitely book here again if ever we go back in zurich.

I moved to Zürich for work and stayed at Philipp’s for two weeks. I couldn’t be happier with my stay. The location is perfect, one can walk anywhere or use the tram/train nearby. There are good supermarkets, restaurants and bars, just around the corner. The flat is is gorgeous and well equipped. Quiet, private, modern, it has all the amenities. It’s a top place! I would recommend it to anyone who wants to discover Zurich and also enjoy their time at home :)
Stress-free visit, Michelli corresponds very clearly and quickly. The location is great as it is near the tram stop and the room is well-furnished :)

The place is very cozy and the location is great, lots of places to eat or have a coffee nearby as well as close to the main train station and with a tram staion in the front door. The apartment was clean and tidy with everything I needed for my stay there also with the posibility to cook there. I would definitely recommend it, also Shella was very helpful in the check in and check out and also in case anything was needed throughout!

Unfortunately I haven’t had the chance to meet Lea in person but the check in was very smooth, the room was spacious and nice especially the bed super comfy! The apartment is well-located in a quite neighborhood within short distance to the main HB train station and tram. It’s also near the main shopping area by foot.

Philipp's apartment has a lot of space, a large kitchen to cook in, a nice bathroom, and everything looks clean. The apartment is located on the 4th floor in a quiet area and within a 15-minute of walking you can be in the center of Zurich. Furthermore, the apartment unfortunately had no clean dishwasher because it was not cleaned. We thought this was a pity and the photos in the advertisement do not show that Philipp's belongings are in the apartment. This was not a big deal but nice to know for when you book an apartment. The wardrobe also contains clothing from Philipp and there is no space for your own clothes. Still, I would recommend the apartment as it has a lot to offer. (At least, it is good to know that Switzerland uses a different power socket then in the EU.)

The property was a fantastic place to stay if you are planning to spend a long weekend sight-seeing around Zurich. It is located very centrally, easy to get to and is within walking distance to all the sights. Paul-Emile was a great host, very responsive and helpful. The only fault I had was that the property was a little messy when I got there, but this was not a big issue overall. I would definitely recommend this property.

I stayed at Lea’s place for 1 night, it was walking distance from the main train station and easy to find. Check in was easy, and the apartment is shared with 2 other people as there are 3 rooms. The bed was comfortable and the apartment was clean, basic room but I felt right at home and had everything I needed. The only downside is the walls are quite thin so you can hear the other guests in the flat.

Roman’s place is clean, quiet and very comfortable. The location is great, with the tram stop right around the corner, making it easily accessible from the airport and getting downtown. Thank you for a pleasant stay!

We had a great stay here. The apartment was easy to find. There was an elevator (tiny one). The unit itself was spacious enough for three of us. It was clean, had all the basic equipments you need. Kitchen was great with dishwasher, fridge, oven and utensils. Bedroom and living room were spacious. The bed was comfy. The sofa bed did quite well. Nice bathroom with bathtub, a big cabinet to put all of your skincare regime. 😁 Big balcony to hang out in summer evenings. Our host, Dimi was very responsive with all clear instructions. In sum, this unit was spacious, clutter-free, easy, no fuss. Recommended. 👍

Impressive place, very clean and organized. The size of the flat was also impressive. The neighborhood is very private and peaceful. 2 mins to the tram station and close to the main train stations. If I were to go to Zurich again, I would rebook this place if available without a second thought.
Apartment is as described and detailed. It is very clean, with lovely home furnishings. Proximity to the station and local amenities is excellent. The property is quiet too.

The apartment was secure, spacious, well-equipped (eat-in kitchen with the possibility to cook simple meals, comfortable bed, good internet connection, washer/dryer, etc) and very clean. The location near the train station and Altstadt was great for traveling. The only downside was there was no coffee maker, but there are several coffee shops just a few steps from the apartment. Otherwise, I’d absolutely recommend this apartment. It was one of the nicest Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed in.

The studio itself is darling and there is so much to do around the area. We especially loved Hangs Vietnamese restaurant. That said, the apt complex is noisy and dingy, a shame given how cute the neighborhood is!

The room was very clean, and the bed had a nice scent of detergent. It was a relaxing space. They also provided drinks and snacks! and The beautiful scenery could be seen from the window. However, since I visited on a hot summer day, the room was very warm, which was tough. The room gets the afternoon sun. If possible, it would be great to have curtains that block out light and heat. Thank you for letting me stay.

This was a great place to stay if your willing to take public transport or walk into downtown Zurich. It was noisy throughout the night as mentioned in the description and the windows needed to be open for fresh and cool air among the July heat but it was kind of the hosts to leave ear plugs. When I realized there was no ice cube tray the hosts brought one over for us which was very kind. Overall this was a good stay just be ready to commute and wear earplugs if your a light sleeper like me.

Great place where I spent more than 2 months, in the heart of Kreis 3. Many bars and restaurants nearby, as well as supermarkets. Well connected to centre and station. Luca was available anytime to answer my questions and supporting especially in the first days. Highly recommend!

There's a lot I could say, but to keep it short, I don't know if I could ever find a better host. The room is huge, nicely-decorated, and impeccably clean. Everything was smooth sailing, thanks easygoing communication and amenities.

Excellent stay The location is near the station, with very frequent service. It is very quiet at night. The room is quite large. There is a private toilet, but the shower needs to be shared, which is not a big problem. The landlord is very good. On the first night, it was a bit hot, and the landlord immediately bought a fan to us

Madeleine’s place was a good affordable fit for our quick overnight in Zurich. You could walk into the center but the proximity to 3 different tram lines made it super easy to pop into the main train station and the center. Madeleine’s check-in instructions we very clear, her apartment is artsy and adorable. We did not cross paths on our short stay but based on our pleasant night I would recommend her place.

This airbnb is in a great location and just what we needed for our overnight stay in Zurich before heading home the following morning. However, we did not sleep well as someone came into the apartment at 1am and was making so much noise in the kitchen that it woke both my husband and me up, and we had to leave the apartment at 6am (which I mentioned to our host). This noise continued for about 20 minutes. Then around 2-3am, there was more noise from either inside the apartment or a neighbor. Needless to say, we did not get the rest we would have liked prior to waking up at 5am and traveling for 12+ hours the following day. I understand that people may have work and have lives, but we would have stayed somewhere else had we known about this.
This is the second time I stay here and I would definitely also come back again :)
The airbnb is 15 min walkable distance away from Zurich HB. The supermarkets are nearby and the area is private and quiet. Got everything u need in this place. Would recommend this place!
Tanya was very helpful. The house was convenient and clean. easy to reach home. I recommend this house.

Had a wonderful stay at Dimi’s place. The accommodation looked just like the airbnb listing. It’s quite centrally situated. Train & tram stations just 300-400 meters away and the central Zurich 15 mins away by tram. Thoroughly enjoyed my stay. Thanks, Aarooshi

Martin's place is beautiful if you love great design - all the furniture is from his shop downstairs. The neighborhood is great for walking and exploring, with a lot of interesting shops within 5 mins walk, and <10 mins walk from the central train station.

Perfect stay, clean, ideal location, and great host! The beds were very comfortable, and the bathroom was luxurious. We couldn’t have asked for a more convenient location and high quality accommodation. The only down side was the sound from the upstairs apartment, which is unavoidable of course. Luckily there were fans available which provided white noise.
Very nice, spacious and perfectly clean apartment at great location. Clear instructions and good communication from the host.
Elizabeth was a grea host and her flat is a very nicely upkept home in the center of Seefeld. Nice and bright, very clean and close to everything. I highly recommend it and would return!

Jens is a very nice host with a lovely flat, near the center of Zurich and a private parking slot - a big asset in this city. The area is peaceful but surrounded with restaurants and shops thanks to the nearby university. It is an ideal place for a week of work or holidays in the north part of Switzerland. Thank you Jens !
Beautiful and spacious flat within walking distance to the city centre. Communication with Zaynab was fast and uncomplicated, facilitating our stay.
Very nice place to stay and the conditions of the household is perfect. Zaynab is such a nice and friendly host, always replying clearly and on time. :)))

I really enjoyed my stay in this unique and stylish apartment. It's full of thoughtful and luxurious touches. It's close to some great restaurants and bars. It can be noisy with the train noise on one side and the bar on the other. However, the windows effectively quiet the sound. Perfect place if you're enjoying the city nightlife and love to stay in fun trendy places!

The place is nice, the kitchen, furniture and beddings, the area is walkable and near to the train station. The apartment is big. Would definitely recommend the place for those who’s coming to Zurich.

The place was spacious, very clean and in a safe neighborhood! Street Parking is easy to find. However, it does cost $15 per day but free overnight parking. The host was quick to respond when you called and willing to accommodate us with a private parking space! Additionally, last minute one of our friends could not make it and the host allowed us to add two additional guests to the reservation for super cheap!

We had a comfortable stay at this apartment in Zürich. It’s about a 20 -minute walk with luggage from the main train station (Zürich HB), but there’s also a direct bus that gets you there in around 10 minutes, which is convenient. A couple of grocery stores are nearby, making it easy to pick up essentials. The apartment itself is spacious and well-maintained. The only small downside is that the curtain doesn’t block out much sunlight, but it wasn’t a problem for us since we brought sleeping eye masks. Overall, we had a pleasant stay.

I'd highly recommend this place for anyone staying in Zurich. the location is convenient, a short tram ride from the centre of the city. the whole place was extremely comfortable especially the beds and there was everything we could have needed for our few nights stay there

Lovely and clean apartment in great location. The neighborhood is safe and right next door to the zoo. And walking to public transport was within 5 min. Perfect for getting around to explore Zürich. It is important to note the listed amenities because there is no TV in the apartment. The only thing that was really missing that should have been provided by the host are the required city trash bags. The apartment was very clean. And reasonably spacious. We had a very nice stay. I would recommend this property.

This is the cutest apartment I have ever stayed 🥰 it was a perfect distance of the city center by bike and we loved staying there. The place had a kitchen, fridge, and oven. The bed was comfortable and it had a little patio were we had breakfast. It has parking too for our car. The only fault is that shower cord wasn’t long enough, we were both tall and we had to squad while showering, but it had hot water and everything! Nerina was super nice and she even left chocolate for us ❤️
I was there with my father. He absolutely loved the place, is full of beautiful plants and the apparment was spotless. we really enjoy our time there

It’s a decent, clean, and convenient (also well connected) option if you simply need a place to stay overnight. However, if you are looking to experience Zurich, this is not the place to be. The building itself stood out in the area as a more rundown building and it is very dark and gets easily very very warm. The owners are professional serial Airbnb runners, that is not good nor bad, simply depending on how you would like your experience.
Great comfy little spot, super close to tram stop, big + pretty park, busy street but the place shut out the noise well and we had no trouble sleeping.

We had a pleasant stay, the place was nice and clean, it had a modern look so we really liked it, also the host was very responsive. The only thing I would say is that in pictures the place definitely looked a lot bigger than it was, I think it was a small space for 3 people and a dog to fit, but nonetheless we had no complains and were able to adjust because of how clean it was and the host was nice. Another thing we liked was that the train station was just a 5 min walk from the place and we had no problem traveling to other places.
walkable distance to Metro station and pleasant view from the room and balcony. very well maintained.

Helpful host who had an amazing apartment within 2 minutes of the train system in Zurich. Very helpful and appreciated the thorough binder of information as well as recommendations for local attractions.

We loved our stay in Zurich. The apartment was cosy, comfortable and an easy location for getting in and out of the old town. It was a well appointed apartment - the washing machine was handy and easy to use. The only comment would be the sofa bed is really only suitable for a smaller child - my 15 year old son who is quite tall slept on it and found it wasn’t very comfortable given his size. Overall a great apartment in a convenient location.

host was very kind and response was quick even my check in time was quite late night time apartment's condition was also nice and host allow me to borrow the bicycle so that i can look around the city well i recommend this apartment

We had a wonderful stay! The place was spotlessly clean, very quiet, and incredibly peaceful and relaxing—just what we needed after a long week of travelling. It's also conveniently located near public transit, making it easy to get around. Lucille was super responsive and friendly, which made the experience even better. Highly recommend!

Lovely apartment located above a restaurant (yet not noisy), so an easy landmark and walking distance to a tram. The host was friendly, communicative, helpful and very responsive. It was quite warm in Zurich, but the floor fan and open windows helped alleviate that. It felt homey, having all the kitchen and bathroom accessories one needed. We would definitely stay there again!

The flat is very well located , you can easily reach the city center in about 20 mins and the bus stop is literally in front of the house. Great the chance to use the private parking of the building with no extra cost. I had not the chance to meet Yannick by person but he organised perfectly the check-in and he was always ready to answer any question by message. The flat was clean and as described by the picture.
Yongli’s place is stunning. Communication was easy, the place was clean, and we had everything we needed. The only downside was that the WiFi was very unreliable.
Very comfortable and pleasant brief stay at Yannick's! Excellent host in making sure and going all the way for guests. Highly recommend..

Such a lovely apartment in the Seefeld area of Zurich! Belma was very responsive to any questions I had throughout my stay, and even purchased a moka pot for me to use to make my morning coffee in! The apartment was sparsely furnished as said in the listing, but really had everything I needed for my working vacation, from fast speed wifi for zoom calls to a nice tv for relaxing on the couch. Seefeld is nicely located, with many bars and restaurants and tram connections to the rest of Zurich. Highly suggest staying here.

Our stay at Yongli‘s didn’t match our expectations, mainly because the place was much smaller and furnitures were arranged differently than on the photos; on the small working space/desk was a big coffee machine and other kitchen utensils; cupboards were full of bed linen, towels and personal stuff and not usable for us; garden furniture was mostly broken and in the fridge there was a half-eaten cheese. Last but not least the wifi was mostly too weak to be used. We knew we had booked a basement flat but even a basement flat can be welcoming and cosy. And if you book a place with an outdoor area in summer you probably also want to be able to use it. The neighbourhood however is great and close to city and lake. All in all we cannot recommend Yongli‘s place.
The stay was great! Peter was able to answer my questions right away which was useful. The location is central and walkable to all locations around the city.

Peter's place was better than the pictures. Spotlessly clean, comfortable, warm and spacious for a couple of travellers. The location in Zurich's Old Town is perfect for a few days of exploring, and a perfect base to return to for a home cooked meal in the small but functional kitchen, a moment to relax on the couch, or a comfortable night's sleep. The self check-in process was well explained, smooth and convenient and Peter was easily contactable throughout the trip. For those not comfortable with stairs, remember this is in an old building in the middle of Old Town so there is a steep and ageing staircase to climb. Thanks for a great stay Peter!

We stayed here for a few days and have to say we loved the design of the apartment. It's pretty central and effortless to get to the centre (3mins walk to the tram). Sven replied to our questions quickly and check-in was smooth. The moka coffee machine really helped in the morning. We were allowed to leave our luggage at the flat because we had a late flight. All in all, it was great to stay there and we would definitely stay here again. Thank you Sven!

We had a great stay at Sven’s place, a stylish, spotlessly clean, quiet and well equipped apartment in an interesting part of the city. Transport was a breeze with a tram spot just around the corner. Sven made everything easy with great recommendations and guidance. We enjoyed the balmy summer evenings with windows open looking out over the neighbourhood. Definitely recommend.

This lovely charming neighborhood 1 BR apartment is located on a very quiet street which made a perfect "home base" for our stay in Zurich.  The 10 - 15 minute walk into town/train station was easy access to everything Zurich has to offer.
