The apartment itself is extremely light and airy with very spacious and comfortable rooms, large windows (blackout shades if you want), and a well equipped kitchen. Host, Jasmine, was very responsive to a few pre-check-in questions I had. The only downside was a quite soft and smallish bed, if that is not your preference. In summary: I would love to stay here again for a short or long stay!

Steg place It’s very nice decorated, and it’s located in a very good place . The check in was not very fluent so I even had to contact the support team to be able to talk to her . the apartment also has some issues regarding the lights

Great apartment with fully equipped kitchen, workspace, terrace and in a nice neighbourhood. You can easily reach the old town of Zurich by tram or by foot. The building has no elevator, but the terrace and the whole apartment are just wonderful!

Awesome place, short walking distance to the tram system. Also just across shopping mall and 15 min walk all the way to Zurich’s lake. We enjoyed Prisca’s place, the only caveat was climbing the stairs with luggage, since there’s no elevator, but we were glad to do some extra workout. The place looks west, so the afternoon sun warms the apartment. The kitchen was fully equipped, so there was plenty of room for a good cookout…! Hope to come back soon…!!!

A very friendly and adorable host she is! Enjoyed a lot while we did chit chat about various hints and she is so nice to us. She is a very classic and smart lady. Even she suggested us the best place to surface around and suggested the restaurant to have traditional food Wichita really worthy. We just stayed one night but if we go again then surely wanna go there and want to have some food made by her as she told us that she love to cook and she can cook for us. All these things gave us a family environment. A big thanks to her.

Amin's place was great, everything as described. Amin was very accommodating and helpful throughout the stay. However, the unit is in 1st floor (1 flight of staircase), so moving with huge luggages might be a bit difficult. Generally recommended.

So first, this lovely apartment had what’s most important to us — A super comfortable bed! The space is bright and very spacious, with comfortable furniture. The kitchen is really well equipped with everything you need to cook for yourself. Did I mention the amazingly comfortable bed!? :-). The location is 10 minutes walk to/from the train station to the airport. Everything else, other public transit, lots of little dine-in and takeout restaurants, as well as a couple of grocery stores, are all within a block or two. And then all the other things: easy self-checkin and checkout, spotlessly clean, great communication with Ann, and all sorts of other personal touches!

We stayed here during our brief visit in Zurich. For 2 people, the house was very spacious. There was ample space to relax and manage all of our luggage. I appreciated that this location was about a 10 minute walk away from the main train station, making it fairly easy to walk to/from the train with all of our luggage. Additionally, the neighborhood felt very safe with a lot of restaurants available to us. Because of the safety and proximity, we actually walked everywhere without taking a bus within Zurich. However, this unit does not have AC so I would be wary in the hot summer months if you are warm-natured. Overall, I would highly recommend this location to anyone looking for a place to stay!
We loved the apartment so much we wished it was ours! Sarah is an Amazing host. Very nice and always available to meet out needs. Definitely 10/10

Central flat, good price. Bed comfortable, and flat has the basics you need. Small things like a heavier shower curtain and clean curtains in the bathroom - as well as a more accessible place for the keybox - would quickly elevate this listing.

Harm’s place was perfect for our family of four. Plenty of space to spread out. The riverside location was quiet and so peaceful. The apartment had everything we needed and was a super quick walk to the Manegg station and a small grocery store. Would definitely stay here again.

Spacious home, bigger than expected. However some amenities, dishwasher, heaters and lights are spoilt. Lastly, parking was a hassle maze. Please locate the unit before unloading the luggage. You are required to go through 5 different doors from your car to the unit.

Valentino was an amazing host and his apartment is amazing! It has everything you need, more than enough space for 2 people and the location is central but quiet. It was one of the best stays I’ve experienced!

Niven and Luana were nice hosts, the apartment is exactly as the photos, the surroundings are very quite and peacefull, you can take an hour to walk to the downtown. you definetly can't use the kitchen, even to use microwave but niven offers it to make a coffee or take water!
Everything was good, a little bit far from the city center but the place has a lot of restaurants and things to do nearby, we enjoyed a lot the river next the train station, you can swim there! 👌🏼

My family and I enjoyed our stay at Daniella’s beautiful apartment, very artistic and the views were amazing on the roof top during sunset. The place was very comfortable for my large family of 6. We could have used an extra key since our family wanted to explore different sites. However, Daniella and team provided options for us. Thanks again. Best regards, Rose

Nice and modern place in a quiet residential neighborhood. A bit of a walk or bus ride to restaurants and shops, but a good option close to a cool area of town. Apartment looks as in the pictures and as a homey feeling. The rooftop is a nice addition with nice views - but there is no furniture up there, so not very usable. Thanks for a very comfortable stay in Zurich!

I loved staying here during my visit to Zurich. Cozy space, lovely balcony, great location right by the lake and the metro, and a safe and quiet neighborhood. Olga was a wonderful host. She offered me to extend my stay for free due to my arriving flight getting delayed, which resulted in me spending a night in London. Highly recommend this accommodation!

Olga was very kind to accomodate my situation, she was very prompt and helpful. Her place is quiet, comfortable and cosy, the balcony was a big plus, the location is great due to close proximity to Zurich's main attractions, and I enjoyed the stay to the max. If the occasion arises, I will definitely look to be Olga's guest.

Everything perfect. Nice flat, clean, good located, about 10 min by Tram to the City Center. Easy to Check in and we could also park just in font of the appartment. Thank you for having us Baptiste. we really liked it. (=

Enjoyed my stay at this Airbnb—clean, comfy, and well-located. The host was responsive and provided helpful local tips. Seamless check-in process and thoughtful amenities. Highly recommend for a hassle-free getaway. Will definitely book again!

Gloria’s place was cosy, warm, comfortable and spacious. I enjoyed my stay very much and would have loved to stay longer. The Vietnamese restaurant across the street Co Chin Chin was excellent and her mother was friendly, helpful and more than accommodating. The location and neighborhood is nice, but a good 20 + minutes long walk to HB for a more bustling and lively scene. Overall I would def recommend as the home is Super comfortable, and I felt right at home. Would not hesitate to return!
The room was so cozy and well decorated. The shower was incredible, and everything was tidy. Gloria was very kind and accommodating. Definitely would come back.

We found the home neat and tidy, with all the essentials available required for a family. It is walkable from Limmatplatz tram station, just 2 stops away from the central Zurich train station. The neighborhood was quiet.

The apartment reminds me of the early days of Airbnb, where you can stay were people actually lived. The place was very homey, with little interesting touches everywhere, and had a really relaxed atmosphere. Everything was as described and the roof deck was such a cool place to hang after being out exploring all day. The area around the apartment, particularly near the tram station, has some nice restaurants and a well stocked supermarket. Lous and Alex also were such gracious hosts, they were so welcoming and accommodating, always in constant communication. We hope to able to stay again at their place!

We had a lovely time spending Christmas in this beautiful home. The home was fully equipped with everything that we needed for our stay. The hosts were friendly, helpful and responsive. Would highly recommend. :)

Schervin is really nice. The maid forgot to put the bedsheet for 2 people and she put that only for 1 person instead but Schervin tried her best to reach the maid to get us a new bedsheet. And the comforter was a bit short/small , not enough for 2 people. Anyway, the apartment is ok, nice location and clean with necessary equipments.

Nice little studio apartment not too far from the centre of Zurich. Schervin was friendly and very responsive. Unfortunately I was ill for some of my stay so spent way too much time in bed! Luckily there's a well-stocked supermarket nearby in Kreuzplatz so I didn't have to walk far for food.

Absolutely beautiful and spacious apartment full of light! Communication with Dimi was very easy and quick. The only thing was the lack of soap bars/aprons in the kitchen etc. made it feel a little foreign and not like being at home. Other that that, everything was really nice! Thanks Dimi for hosting us :)

We stayed for 4 nights in Zurich to sightsee and enjoy the xmas markets. The place was easy to get too from central train station and from the airport. Plenty of trains and only one stop from the centre. Once there it was a short walking distance about 8 minutes to the flat. So very conveniently located and close to the city. Plenty of shops and restaurants around. The flat was very clean and spacious with all equipment as listed and internet available in working order. Kitchen fully equipped. We had a very comfortable stay and will return to the same place when we visit Zurich. The host was very friendly and responded promptly to our questions.

The apartment was clean and neat and described as in the post. Easy check in. Very comfortable bed and pillows! Kitchen had sufficient plates etc and the dishwasher was great! Location is near a train station, hence very convenient. 10 min train to Zurich station. However, the trains pass by the apartment till late and it can be quite noisy. Overall a wonderful stay!

1. communication could have been better, unclear if parking slot is included or not 2. on the last day, one of the building entrance doors did not work. The host (owning the whole building) should have put some signs on that door clarifying its defects. We found out it was broken by our selves, however the host replied very quickly and clarified the matter in a few minutes

The apartment was amazing and we felt like home in it. Isabela was very friendly and helpful with the check in. The apartment was equipped with everything we needed in the kitchen, bathroom and other miscellaneous like Apple TV and even a vertical iron. The bed was also comfortable and spacious. We had plenty of room in the wardrobe for 5 days worth of clothes. The area around the apartment is also very nice. There’s a river and a forrest, suitable for walks and riding a bike (we went jogging there a few times in the morning). Thanks for having us. Fully recommend!

nice apartment near supermarkets, public transports, bike sharing, restaurant, pubs, and still pretty quiet location! cool DJ apartment in modern building, essential bathroom ad kitchen (little dining table TBH) but overall nice. super responsive host. price OK considering position in Zurich and the city average.

Overall, fantastic, modern rental in a great location. The layout, design, and styling was top notch. The ease of digital pincodes was great to avoid keys. The only two negatives are an over-reliance on digital (check in process requires full passport info) and the only way to get help is through what’s app and working through a digital navigation system. The place was often too warm even with the heat off and windows open. Would stay here again for the price and location.

We stayed in a one bedroom apartment and it was a good size for a couple of nights. However the kitchen was tiny, we moved lots of clutter from the worktops which helped give extra space but I wouldn’t recommend this apartment if you want to cook full meals. Additionally they advise not to use the hob as it can set the alarms off, so you are limited to what you can cook. Good for breakfast and salads but little else! The location was great, near shops, cafes and transport links. The noise mentioned in other posts didn’t impact us, the church bells added character and it was quiet throughout the night.

The unit itself is pretty neat and comfy. Just a few minutes of walk from the nearest bus stop (Manesseplatz) makes it very accessible and convenient. However, the apartment does not have an elevator so if there are many luggages, it will feel a bit laborious to bring them all upstairs. Nevertheless, I certainly had a very pleasant stay here with my family, recommended if one is looking to stay over in Zurich.
The place is beautiful and the host is really Nice to communicate and help. The only con is that the house doenst have wifi and has a stair walkup
Great location for price and easy to get to through public transit. Spotty wifi while in parts of the apartment

The apartment is comfortable and very well situated, right next to a suburban railway line with frequent service to the city center. The host is very responsive and helpful. The only downside is that the bed is short and small for two people.
Nice place, second bed not the most comfortable and shower not the best, but a nice calm oasis to stay in. Pre plan your journey if you’re coming with a suitcase or two.

Vanessa’s place was as described. Fairly new and had everything we needed. We were met by the host and showed in which was very helpful. It’s a little way out of Zürich but the train is only a few hundred metres away and easy to catch with 10 minute services. Highly recommend.

Andrew is very nice host. My arrival was late but he allowed flexible check-in and check-out. The flat is at 4th floor and there is no lift. However, Andrew helped me with the bag. It was 5 min walk to tram station which can take you to train station in 10 min. I would recommend staying at his place.
we enjoyed the stay very much. and look forward to go back to Blueground next trip
Elizabeth is very helpful The tea and coffee provided at the kitchen are of high quality The house is warm during fall The neighborhood is quiet. Nice for a getaway
We only stayed overnight before a flight but the place was very well kept and clean. We only wish we could have stayed longer! Would come back for a longer stay in Zurich.
Great spot! Very clean and spacious Airbnb. The only thing that was an issue is that the entry and parking instructions were confusing so be sure to double check that the map matches where you are!

The place was convenient to the busstop and easy to find. however it is the last stop about 20 mins bus ride from Zurich HB so it may be a while to reach. but there are supermarkets abt 2 busstops away or 10 mins walk away. house was well equipped but since pets are allowed, there were furs on the sofa which may not be suitable for those sensitive to pets

Itamar is a great host. We felt very much at home at his place and Itamar did a great job explaining everything to us. The place is very close to the tram and bus station and quiet. Would come back anytime.
It was wonderful and the host was super helpful and nice!
Very nice apartment, like the description and the pictures in the advertisement. Great location!

Since I treated Thomas with sincerity and respect, I would have appreciated it if Thomas had made more effort to communicate with me clearly & face-to-face instead of badmouthing me. It was my right to change the reservation within the allowed period pre-defined by Thomas. From the review he left me, I could tell that he was inpatient when texting me on the platform. And When I found out that the check-out time was different than what I expected, Thomas assured me that it was okay to stay. However, he was just being ingenuous - I do not consider that as politeness - because by that time, I already cleaned up the room and could have left at any time. It is not okay to say ‘it’s okay’ but then badmouth someone afterward. I really tried to be respectful. Please do not be so hostile.

My partner and I stayed there for 2 nights and below are our thoughts. Pros - Friendly host, clean room, walkable distance (5mins) to the nearest bus stop at the main road. Cons - As the room was located at the 2nd level and facing the road, it tends to get quite noisy at night (vehicle sound, passer-by chatting etc). Kettle provided in the room was quite dirty but there was another one in the kitchen so that's okay. Overall a nice stay!

Unfortunately let down with amenities no longer accessible to guests because tge TV and patio were off limits in roommate's quarters. I specifically picked the place to watch some Olympics at night and relax on the patio with the nice breeze tgey have. The bedroom was very dusty, I turned on the roommate's and it also 10 degrees warmer then the rest of the house with no fan in the room or chair. The bed only had the mattress sheet and a thick blanket. He should adjust the amenities to show it's just the bed and access to shared kitchen and bath. It could be so much better with 30 minutes of cleaning and a fan and chair would be great to have.

Great place to stay for a quick trip to Zurich. As stated, the bedroom has its own lock and key. As a female traveling alone, I felt completely safe there. Great location too, easily walkable but public transport was nearby if needed.

I recently stayed at this Airbnb and found it to be a spacious and comfortable spot. The place itself is quite nice, with ample room to spread out and relax. However, the amenities provided were quite basic. One thing to keep in mind is that the host is unavailable after 9 PM, so plan accordingly if you anticipate needing anything in the evenings.
The location is great - but the church bells can be bothersome as others have commented. To us it was just part of the Swiss experience - but you need the windows open and the bells are loud

The property is in a great location with restaurants , coffee shops among other things around the area and is very walkable. The place is clean and organized. The properties communication is efficient. However, for check in to the property we had to wait an extra 1.30 hrs as the room was not ready for us at the check in time. But other than that the place is great and still would recommended it.

Nice experience staying in Zurich with Numa. Very easy check in and responsive host with great communication the whole time. Excellent location in the city from nearby supermarkets and city sights. Thank you for having me!

The apartment is well located. 3 stops from zurich HB. The apartment is as pre what was described and clean. However, we have an issue with the shower drainage. The drainage seem choked and water seem to flow down too slow. We have to off and on the shower head intermittently for the water to drain off. This is quite frustrating. Response from the team was quick, however they repairman wasn't able to come soon due to public holiday.

A great apartment, with black out blinds. Very clean and tidy. Really liked the location too, as I was there for work, and it was centrally located to a lot of stuff. Also, I had access to lockers in the building on day of checkin and day of checkout which was super convenient for storing my luggage. Highly recommend!
Awesome place! I was shocked with how spacious it was. Very clean and modern and loved the windows! Laundry service was so helpful in the middle of our trip!
Thank you Tomas! For the nice welcome, great communication, flexibility and everything! Tomas is a great host!

What a lovely place to stay! Tomas' home is clean, well-kept, and comfortable. Tomas as a host was insanely helpful with recommendations and making sure you have everything you need. The bed was comfortable, the bedroom windows had a nice view of the neighborhood, the room was spacious. TV + Netflix. Fast internet. Nice kitchen, very clean and inviting for your use. Bathroom was very clearn, shower was great. The only ONLY critique I had was that it got reaaaaally hot at night and there are mosquitoes so you can't open the window all the way when you sleep. Keep in mind in the summertime, I visited in mid June.
Wonderful apartment in a great neighborhood. Very close to the tram/buses. the apartment was clean and had a lovely balcony. I would highly recommend staying again in the future.

We had a wonderful stay at Daniela’s apartment! It had everything we needed and was a quick walk to the tram to get anywhere in the city. Daniela has a lovely home in a quiet neighborhood and was super kind and responsive to anything that came up. Would definitely stay again!
It is what you see on the images and in the description.

Good location, comfy bed, plenty of hot water, room temperature was fine, very quiet. Our only complaint was that there was only one small set of shelves to place our clothes. There was no place to hang clothes, all closets and most cupboards were taped shut. Except for the large kitchen table, there were lots of decorative items on most surfaces that also limited our ability to place our things. We felt like we were moving in on top of our host. This was not a major inconvenience, however, and is something that could easily be remedied.

We stayed in the apartment for a week. Tania was very helpful and active . The apartment is spacious, clean and with a great view . The only problem is the parking of the car ; better to go without car because the parking is very expensive.

Overall, it’s exactly what we expected! Tania was easy to work with, and responded quickly to all our questions. The apartment was in great condition, and had everything we needed. There is a cute little co-op down the street, so we were able to get some groceries, and it was easy to catch an Uber into the main part of Zurich (approx 10-15min drive). As mentioned by others (so we were already mentally prepared), there is no ac, but there are fans in each room, and there is no elevator.

The host is really friendly and helpful. The room is basic and comfortable. The other flatmates were also very nice. The only downside for me was the hilly location. I arrived via the main train station (lines 13 or 46), and while the bus/tram stop is only a 10 minute walk from the apartment, it's a steep climb and I carried heavy luggage.

A good and clean place to live. Place and traffic are good and convenient. Price is reasonable. But the sound isolation in the apartment is not perfect. If you are easily awakened by noise you need to prepare earplugs

Willimien & Roberto’s apartment is really home from home. The communication was brilliant and excellent instructions making it easy to find. We loved the local area and especially being able to get to the river for an early morning swim and collect delicious pastries on the way back. We walked to the centre of Zurich, which may not suit everyone but an easy route down. Sadly we didn’t get to meet them but we really appreciate everything they did to welcome us to their home. Kay & Monica

Lovely place and lovely people. Room is spacious and comfy. Location is ideal, it is only a short 25 minute walk from the centre. The hosts are very welcoming and accommodating, and they are also great people to have an interesting conversation with!

It was very conveniently located near public transportation. We did not meet our host Sofia, but the other host Fabienne, was kind enough to explain everything to us. The house also had a kitchen and a washing machine, which was very helpful for us as we were traveling for a long time. We had a very comfortable stay every day. I recommend it!

We had a very good experience! The flat is as described, and the hosts were very friendly! It’s very well located, super close to tram stations and supermarkets! The only suggestion I may have is that lighting is quite low in all the flat, and (even though we were informed as per description) it’s true that there are way too many things all over, and there is very limited space to place our bags and stuff. Other than that, I totally recommend the place and I would come back as well! Thanks ladies!!

Sonia and Pablo provided everything in the info pack (the only issues we had were because WE didn't read it properly first time round!) They were able to provide parking onsite (it's OK for a small car) The location is right next next to the tram which made getting in and out of the city VERY easy We were NOT at all bothered by the noise of the trams during our stay

Great place to stay! Easy tram ride to Zurich and they come often. Place was clean, had everything we needed even coffee pods for the nespresso, nice kitchen with fridge was super useful. Easy to access the condo with the key pad. We had slight trouble finding the place at first when we entered the adress on the gps but fairly easy to find. We are people that live in a city so the noise level was completely fine with us however they left earplugs at bedside if we needed them. The only thing I would add is a safe to place items like passports and stuff but I would totally recommend this place/come back!

Both the apartment and the host are extremely nice! We like the apartment a lot. Looks exactly as the photos. Has everything we need and very clean! Great neighbourhood, beautiful solurroudings, and very convenient for public transportation. Antoine is super friendly, responsive, and patient! Lucky for us to stay here for a month!

I had a great stay at this cozy studio! The host, Antoine, is very friendly and provided all the necessary information well in advance, making check-in and orientation super easy. Communication was always smooth — he was easy to reach whenever needed. The studio is exactly as shown in the pictures: clean, nicely decorated, and with a lovely little garden. The building also offers free access to a washing machine and dryer, which was a big plus. Located in a quiet residential area, it’s just a short walk to supermarkets, bus and tram stops, and about 15 minutes from the city center and central train station. I truly enjoyed my stay and would happily return!

Angela's place was a great find. The location was very close to the train station, and we were fine getting there with our luggage upon arrival. The apartment is in the middle of restaurants and shopping and is quite lively with some street noise. The street noise was not a problem at night as it did quiet down. We were able to sleep well without disruption. One of the best things was the hosts, who were extremely welcoming and personable. If in the area again, we would definitely book this spot.

I’m glad I booked Angela’s place off of the reviews. I was a little weary of the photos, but they don’t actually do the place any justice. The apartment is bigger than it looks with 2 separate living rooms with a sofa bed in each and also a bed room which was the perfect amount of space for 4 guests. Excellent location.
This trip to Zurich like returning home: This house is spacious, comfortable, and convenient for transportation: the hostess is warm and thoughtful and great!

We really enjoyed our two nights at Rocco’s place. Super easy to get the tram into Zurich, and very conveniently located for supplies from Aldi. The apartment itself was clean, comfy and perfect for our family of four. Rocco was super helpful, even popping round after work to supply us with an extra sheet. All in all, highly recommended.

We had a lovely time in calm, clean Rob's apartment in Zurich. Rob was a caring and responsive host. He recommended things for us in the neighborhood such as using the beautiful public pool across the street. We had plans with friends in other parts of Zurich, so we did not explore the neighborhood restaurants, but there seemed to be plenty.

The location was great! It was right next to Grossmünster church and nearby lots of restaurants. Could walk to Zürich HB in around 18mins or catch the tram from a few mins away. Self check in was easy, team was very responsive to any questions as well as providing information prior to and during our stay. Although there was construction on the streets surrounding, we didn’t find the noise to affect our stay. Everything was provided in order to cook and clean during our stay, the only thing missing was a TV. We would highly recommend to stay here and would stay her again!

Location was wonderful. The kitchen had everything needed to make a simple meal. The patio is a nice and quite space. We had some issue with the electrical in the living room. The team was responsive to our concern although we didn’t ask them to address as it did not impact our stay.

Thanks Rob for making us feel like at home. Great location, approx 10min to Center by tram which was rather close to the apartment. Rob was very flexible and let us check in and out in our preferred time. I will recommend.

When we arrived, the place smelled fresh and brand new which impressed us. However, most of the essentials we needed for cooking were barely available. In addition, there was a lack of communication as some of our important questions went unanswered by the host which was frustrating for us.

Wow! This apartment was stunning and in the perfect location. Milan was an incredible host. So responsive and incredibly kind and helpful. This was at the end of our family’s 3 week vacation and it was the perfect place to end our trip.

Milan is wonderful and the flat was amazing! Milan greeted us and gave us a quick tour of the flat, along with some recommendations on exploring the area. His restaurant downstairs was wonderful with friendly service and good food (and gelato). The location was perfect to explore the local area, and quickly access transportation. The place was spotless and the decor was fun. The cherry on top was the rooftop terrace - the pictures don't do it justice. We spent an evening up there enjoying the city lights, church bells ringing, and a local artist playing beautiful music on the streets below; and mornings sipping coffee and enjoying a croissant. Wish we could have stayed longer - loved this place!

Lukas place is a good 3 bedroom getaway right in the action in Zurich. Lots of restaurants and bars around and public transport within reach. The location is quite convenient for business in Zurich however if you're sensitive to noise it is a bit of an active bar area so there is always some noise during the night. Otherwise nice place and if you close the windows then its fine.
Commincation was awesome. Great rooftop and rooms very nice. The only bad thing was super noisy night life outside late into the night. But host and place were great.

Great place to stay and a perfect host. Charming place with plenty of character. A vibrant neighbourhood and walkable to the city but the flat itself remains peaceful for an undisturbed night. I would gladly return, Mari made me feel completely welcome in her home and her recommendations for the city and the quarter were tip top.
Up and close to the Central Station. The host was very helpful and i had a quiet night.

Jules was a great host. Quick to respond. Let us drop off our bags early before checking in. Location is close to trains and tram station. Very hot when we visited. Beds and pillows were not the most comfortable but the space was large and the bathroom was nice.
Awesome location and very convenient with many amenities within walking distance. The apartment was perfect for my stay.
The house was very close to the lake and clean & cozy!!

I enjoyed my time at this apartment, it was very close to the opera house and in a beautiful neighbourhood on the 3rd floor of a nice building, but there is no elevator. The room was beautiful and the apartment is very modern with good amenities. If the bathroom and the bedroom had been a bit cleaner it would have been a 5/5!
Great place for the weekend. Antranik and his wife Florence were very responsive and made us feel right at home.

We loved Nico’s place! Nice high ceilings large rooms, not to many stairs, parking right at the front door, king beds and one of the bathrooms is just huge and beautifully redone and the shower was perfect (A rare find in Europe where most bathrooms are small). Really appreciated the racks/shelving in the rooms for storing things. The kitchen is small but for traveling/vacationing it was perfect.

Nico's place was great for a family to explore Zurich and surrounds - a short tram ride to the city centre, gave easy access to Zurich's sites as well to the main train station. Nico was responsive when we first arrived
Nice place, next to the tram stop. Very nice and usefull for a family

This was our second stay at this property. It's exactly what we were looking for/needed. We loved the feel of the apartment. The instructions very clear, the apartment is clean, the beds super comfortable, the kitchen well-equipped. The parking spot right in front of the house a big bonus. The city center is a quick tram ride away. And the host very hospitable, friendly and responsive. The only downside is the location of the property on a very busy street with traffic, two tram lines and a church close by (regular ringing of the church bells). However, the windows are double pane and almost completely block out the noise. We hope to be back! Thanks :)

Anissa’s place was spotless and perfect for our one night. It was close to the train station, restaurants, and down town. We even got to drop our bags before exploring the city which contributed hugely to our amazing experience. The only negative about this place is the noise that comes from the street (granted it was a Saturday night). Otherwise, Anissa was very delightful and I would recommend her place to anyone I know visiting Zurich!

First lets start with the host, Valentino is superb, flexible, and friendly, he’ll go an extra mile to make your stay comfortable, like I requested for 3 portable fans and they were at the place, 3 new ones, he is more than a super host. Now the place, its very clean, nice, modern, and in a peaceful neighbourhood but still close to shops, grocery, restaurants, and public transport, all on foot. All basic amenities and necessities were at the place. Infact, we were also provided with some complimentary snacks, drinks, and fruits. The location of the place is also great as its not far away from the city centre, easily reachable by public transport. I would definitely recommend this place, five stars to the place and Valentino.

Valentino’s house is perfect. I stayed there with my family. He is very friendly and went above and beyond on our request to get few items arranged as we were checking in late with our toddler. Very respectful host and has amazing house. All the amenities listed are provided. Everything about his house is great. We rented a car so we did get the parking spot as mentioned. We would love to come back again and would highly recommend his house. Thanks

Mario’s place is located very close to the central part of Zurich, we walked everything by foot. Mario was fast to communicate although we found we had to message him frequently due to issues. We felt like we needed to do the legwork as guests. The keys were collected from a different location, you have to instal your own blinds otherwise you’re totally exposed, we had to ask where the guess towels were and I touched wet used towels under the bed and check out instructions included us having to empty the bin and find a specific one on the street which I couldn’t find. I ended up walking up and down the streets with a bag of rubbish before I was told I could just leave it for the cleaners.

Anissa’s place is very convenient, it right close to the train station. It is spacious with open living room and kitchen. However, it is not professionally furnished and decorated. A decent bed and furniture would be needed; the window curtain there does not cover the whole window. There was a lots of books piled up on the walkway of the living room. Hire a professional decorator, add a decent bedroom set would go a long way to improve the property, and make the guest staying more comfortable. If furnished right, house / room could rent at higher price. As it is now, the bed we sleep on making noises when we turned our body.
Mario’s apartment is perfect for a stay in Zurich, has all you need and the only downside is the uphill to get there from the station, would recommend!

The apartment had everything we needed, kitchen was greatly equipped and Dimi was nice to provide with the basics (salt, kitchen towels, cleaning product, dishwasher detergent). On top everything was clean, bed was comfortable and the place is very quiet. Unfortunately it was not nice weather but the terrace would have been amazing for breakfast and coffee. The location is amazing, trams go very often and within 10 minutes you can be in the city centre/lake side.

Dimi’s place was exactly the way it was described. The house is perfect for a 4-5 day stay. It’s close to the station and easily accessible by tram. We loved staying here and would definitely recommend this space to anyone looking for affordable and clean accommodation in Zurich. Worth every penny! Thanks Dimi for the wonderful experience.

Location was good. Just like anything else in Switzerland the apartment was easily connected to train. Lots of restaurants in the area and a short walk to the water front as well. Apartment had everything we needed. The cleaning was done three times a week which was very nice. Apartment was spacious with lots of room for my infant to run around when we were at home after a long day. The only one minor inconvenience was the main bedroom got really hot at night. There was one fan provided by it wasn't really enough on hot days we were there. There is one AC in the hall which works well for the hall when we were seated there.

It was great to stay at Dimi’s place! It was very clean and looked exactly as the picture. Only thing worth mentioning is to not walk to the place with luggage from Zurich HB. The map will say it’s only 10 minutes but the path to the Airbnb is a lot of uphill and stairs. Take the tram instead, and it is super close. Thanks Dimi, it was a pleasure
Great stay and great deal. Really enjoyed the apartment and the area was quiet at night. Would book again!

Sherley and Sofia were very nice and helpful. the place is perfect and central an well conncected with the public transport. it was as to be at home. thanks to the host for evrything. hope to come back soon.
there is a perfect place. really clean and quiet space. but the sink does not work well in the bathroom. it is the only thing that is uncomprtable.

The hosts were very responsive to my questions and they also provided recommendations for restaurants, cafes, and things to do in the area! The room and bathroom were very clean and felt very home-like. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Exact to the listing, the furnishings in this apartment were very high end with a great TV, a height adjustable study table. The sofa bed was thoughtfully set up for us. The location was also amazing and easily accessible by tram. To walk from the main station might be difficult because it is upslope but the tram made it easy. We knew from other reviews that the kitchen was not stocked with cooking supplies like oil and condiments, so we brought some. But it would still have been nice to have a few on hand for short stays especially for things like dishwasher tablets and laundry detergent. Overall a pleasant stay.

The bedrooms are quite nice and the location is quiet and beautiful. Near a public pool where we went and our kids swam. It’s quite close to the airport and multiple bus lines (easy to get to main train statio ). The whole place was quite clean, but the kitchen and bathroom are a bit shabby. 4pm check in is a drag (would be improved to have the key code to just drop the bags earlier).

Tania’s place is located in a quiet neighborhood, yet very close to "central" and the main station. The apartment was well-equipped, modern, very clean, and spacious for a family of 4. However, the weather was hot and humid during our stay, and the apartment felt like a greenhouse. We were aware of the lack of AC, but we could not keep the doors open either due to bugs. There was only one fan in the entire apartment, and as we were a family of 4 and slept in two different areas, one fan was not enough.

This is one of the newest and cleanest airbnbs I have stayed at. It’s also quite easily accessible (near tram stop and has a lift inside) but peaceful as it is in a residential area. I would happily stay here again.

Blanca was a great host! I was traveling alone and she made me feel very comfortable and at home. She gave me great recommendations, allowing me to see so many nice parts of the city. Hope I can come back to Zürich and stay with Blanca again!
Blanca was very friendly and welcoming, everything was as it said in the description, a short walk from the tram stop it’s very quick to get into/from the city centre. Would happily recommend!

luiz is a very good landlord, he is very warm and friendly, the location of the house is very easy to find, luiz helped us to park the car and pay the fines, thank you very much, if I have a friend who is coming to Zurich, I will recommend luiz's house!
Great stay—super close to the Oerlikon train station. Luiz was super friendly and kind!
Michal's place was lovely! Had lots of space and was close to transportation to get into the city. Easy check in and check out.

Michał’s apartment was a beautiful place to stay, and was very conveniently located for public transport (tram and bus) into the city centre. It was also very convenient to get to the Stadium, which was the primary reason for our visit to Zurich. We had a great stay, Michał’s communication was great and we would definitely recommend this apartment to others!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Melanie’s home. The apartment was very clean and comfortable with great facilities and it had a beautiful terrace to sit outside. We felt like home away from home and would have loved to stay longer. The location enabled us to visit Zurich centre with ease and also enjoy the local countryside. Melanie was easy to communicate with and always quick to respond to any queries. We would not hesitate to recommend staying here!
Zeke was very nice and friendly. He made the process smooth and it was a pleasure to be there. I would highly recommend!

Thank you, Zeke for being a fantastic host. Everything was as described. The apartment's location was absolutely perfect, and it was impeccably clean. Everything from groceries to restaurants to tram/bus/train transportation within a 3-5min walk. Zeke was always ready to help whenever I needed anything.Can't recommend Zeke enough!
The perfect place. Has everything you need for a stay in Zurich. Super close to the tram stop, very clean, organized, and nice place. Super responsive host, easy check in and check out. We loved it
Best place to stay in Zurich! Really nice neighbourhood, area and staff, the check-in was easily done by myself but the host was always ready to help. Just amazing! I cant wait to come back
Excellent stay. Stephanie was a great host, very responsive and friendly and even gave me recommendations on places to eat in the area. Very clean and comfortable. Thanks Stephanie!

Overall good house with great view! However there was a bad cigarette smell and it wasn’t clean enough. Also, all of their clothes and stuff were in the house so there wasn’t much space for ours! You can easily find super markets nearby and stores for food and drink. Nice view anyway!!

My staying at the apartment was perfect. Big and spacious apartment, you can find so far everything you need to feel as home. The location is great since it’s in a very calm area and easy to reach by public transport. Thank you so much for everything I will definitely come back soon.

We had a great two-night stay at this apartment in Zurich. The flat was clean, recently renovated, and conveniently close to public transport, though not in the center of the city. The only downside was the lack of ventilation and a fan. With temperatures reaching over 30°C during our stay, it got quite hot, which made it a little uncomfortable at times. Overall, though, a very pleasant stay, and we would recommend it for those who don’t mind a bit of heat during the summer!
The appartement is small, but in a very convenient location with good public transport. The kitchen has everything you need, and the balcony overlooks a quiet yard between the buildings.

Very minimal and lacking. The host expected us to bring/buy our own bathroom soap, laundry detergent, nespresso pods. I would've appreciated at least a heads up in the check-in instructions that I'd need to prepare these ahead of time. It was frustrating for us to scramble to buy shampoo/body soap ourselves late at night and not be able to use the washer/dryer (which we explicitly filtered for when selecting this Airbnb). There was also hair on the dish sponge (would've expected a new one between each guest). Overall felt very cheap. Check-in times are a bit constrained so check your travel plans first. No flexibility with leaving luggage at the doorway after checkout. Location is great and the apartment is very spacious. But unfortunately would not recommend.

The host was very clear with directions, and proactively communicated. The unit had a large bed, and was very clean. The only thing that was not expected was that the bathroom was in a separate unit across the hallway. It was a private bathroom unit just for us, with a lock and key. But that wasn’t clearly advertised and was a slight inconvenience. Otherwise the location was great, close to public transportation, great food, and beautiful views.

The apartment is very well located—close to the train station and surrounded by bars, restaurants, and grocery stores. Haoran provided clear instructions and was very responsive. Unfortunately, the room itself was quite disappointing. It is somewhat isolated from the rest of the rooms, requiring additional stairs and a terrace crossing to access. The bathroom is not en-suite nor private; it is across the corridor and shared with others. The room was cold, taking hours to warm up even with the heater at maximum. The duvet was too light for winter, and while a spare was available, I was unsure if the cover was clean.

Tania’s place is about 15 mins walk and 10 mins bus ride from Zurich HB train station which is very convenient. Amenities are new and stylish. Though during our stay in June there were lots of flies but we could not close the windows due to the heat.

Apartment was great and very new. There were some basic items missing like liquid for dishwasher and extra paper towels, but beyond that had the basic needs. We originally were booked into a separate Airbnb closer to the center of town but found it was not cleaned before arrival so dimi moved us to a separate Airbnb. It was further from walking distance to the restaurants but the quiet neighborhood was still very nice and apartment was great.
The place is a floor of a small and beautiful Zurich villa. The place is very quiet and central. The amenities worked great and communication was smooth and friendly. Highly recommend it!

The place is generally clean and tidy. Check in is easy but you have to plan your schedule well as the check out time is quite early, 10am. This is an airbnb and you cannot keep your luggage at their place before check in, you can use the locker in train station but it costs CHF 9 for 6 hours. The place is not close to the train station but you can still go there by tram or you may consider Uber if you are with many or heavy luggage. The host is nice.

We visited Switzerland in the month of August for 6 days. We had an amazing time at Dimi’s place, it’s one of the beautiful apartment located right in Zurich near the main train station. The place was equipped with everything we needed and we found the place to be cozy and convenient. The tram station is just nearby 2-3 mins walk and main station is 12-15 mins walk. You can easily carry your luggage from the main station to the apartment. There’s a very big coop store located nearby. Apartment is fully equipped with a lot of amenities like coffee maker, toaster, hair dryer, iron, iron board, television and WiFi. The wifi speed is also great. The balcony view is amazing. Overall we loved the place and had an amazing time in Switzerland.

Great location close to restaurant and shops as everyone has mentioned. However it was a different unit/layout than the pictures. A/C was not working well so the room was generally hot all the time. Some cracked floor tiles. Felt bare minimum. Fine for a night or two, but would not recommend prolonged stay. Other than a mediocre stay, Haoran was very nice and responsive.

The location is great, however the apartment is very small. It is clear the host wants to provide the bare minimum to make the place livable, having only 1 very small pillow per guest and no additional bedding/linens/anything really. Also, the wifi worked very poorly, and eventually stopped working all together, which was difficult for out of country travelers depending on wifi for use of phones.

The appartment was super clean, the host was very responsive and friendly, and the self-check-in process was straightforward. Everything was perfect. The only drawback is that the apartment is a 30-40 minute walk from the city center.

Overall good experience. Positives: - communication was very easy and clear - check in and check out was super easy - location was good - very clean - very walkable - a lot of restaurants around - good location close to the city - nice balcony Negatives: - A bit expensive for what you get - Checkout time was way too early at 10am and check in at 4pm - Hard to find parking spot - missing amenities in bathroom like shampoo etc - smoke from other apartments was annoying at times - every lamp in the apartment has a different button, was fun to find them tbh but took too long to understand how to turn on all of them

Arina's apartment was clean, practical, well-located and pleasant. We did get off to a rough start however since the key had slipped down from where Arina had left it and it took 2 hours before we could enter. Nonetheless, Arina was extremely responsive and through a number of phone calls, we managed to resolve the entry issue. Arina also provided recommendations for around Zurich. Outside the bustle of Old Town, the apartment is well-located on a number of tram lines, across from a lovely green park. We would definitely contact Arina should we return to Zurich (great city BTW)!

Very nice place, super spacious and very clear guidebook. The floor was a little bit dirty (we found hairs not belonging to us, little bit of debris, etc.). The neighborhood is also not ideal, there were many strip clubs in the area and not many people. We were right next to the tram station, however, so had easy access to all of Zürich. Overall, very nice spacious place and responsive hosts, just issue with the cleanliness and the surrounding area.

The place feels right at home and it had everything you need to ensure a comfortable stay. We think the kitchen was perfect and the apartment itself was massive which adequate furnishings. The only issue we had with the apartment was the construction work next door. We stayed on the A side of the apartment and the noise started every weekday at 7am and stopped around 5pm. There’s also no elevator so be mindful if you have heavy luggage.

The budget Airbnb stay was a bit bare bones with minimal amenities, and guests should pack light due to many steps. The host was responsive, and the location was great, close to the train station and restaurants. However, the apartment lacked sufficient towels for two people. While it was surprisingly quiet, an issue with the AC arose on the last night, though a fan helped. For those on a budget, it's suitable, but others might prefer upgrading to a hotel for more comfort.

The place is nice and clean, right near the old town, lake and almost everything. The only inconvenience is no elevator. Our room is on the 4th floor. We have to go up and down few time a day. It is recommended to indicate this in the description. Some people may not be suitable for these rooms.

Great location! Easy to find and access! We enjoyed our stay. They accommodated us at the last minute and were pretty responsive. The only thing I would have appreciated if they had some extra blankets as it can get cold at night. We were pleased with a property and our overall stay. Great experience in Switzerland! Thank you for hosting us!

Had a wonderful stay at Cher's flat! It was very clean, cozy, and thoughtfully maintained, making it a perfect space to relax. The location is fantastic: just a short distance from the city center with public transport only a few minutes away, which made exploring Zurich super convenient. Check-in was seamless and user-friendly, making the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. Highly recommend!

Cher’s place is convenient to the city centre of Zurich. Had a small issue of bathroom lightning and had someone over the next day to fix it, great response time. There’s also paid street parking if you’re driving, however most of Zurich street parking limits to 2 hours, unless overnight.
the apartment is awesome. close to tram, groceries, and some restaurant. just about 5 minutes by tram to the main train station.
Nice clean place. Not close to the main city center but plenty of busses and trams you can take.
Very nice garden and close to the nature. I like 😀

I booked Irene's place for my guest. He needed to get enough resting time and despite the constructionside, it is very peaceful there. On the weekend it was completely silent. The house is cozy and the kitchen is well equipped. The area is beautiful, a small supermarket and bus is at walking distance. My guest was very comfortable at Irene's place.
This was one of the best air bnb experiences I’ve had. Stefanie was a lovely host and I really felt at home. Her house is beautifully styled with fantastic amenities and location.
Like the place a lot and have been there now multiple times. Always to recommend - very friendly host, quiet & clean apartment. Very good location and close to restaurants & bars.

Thomas was a great host. We felt very comfortable in his place. He was pleasant and had good local recommendations for restaurants, etc. The only issue we had was with parking our rental car. It is VERY difficult to find parking in his neighborhood. We paid for the blue permit through the parking authority $30 chf (at Thomas recommendation), and then there were no blue spots. We ended up also paying for public Parking. So we paid for something we never even used. That was a bit frustrating.
Very accommodating host! Thank you Dragi for having us! The place was very clean and just like the pictures. Very comfortable to be in as well, almost felt at home. Would certainly recommend. 🙂

Dragi's place was exactly as advertised, we appreciated the good quality and amount of toiletries and laundry amenities. it's so clean and fresh. the ONLY drawback was the noise in the neighborhood, but that was indicated in other reviews part of being close to restaurants and bars is the behavior of patrons. very noisy, late (10 pm) until early (5 am) , by our standards, especially on weekends. if you close the windows you will be able to rest!

This listing is underrated by its photos, it's alot better in person. The check was extremely easy and clear. Strahinja is very kind and accommodating. She even allowed me and early check in with our baby. The unit has everything you'll need. The beds are so comfortable and the place is very clean. We appreciates the large pack and play and high chair. It's located in a quaint and walkable area with a COOP supermarket just down the street, so too are the trams. Wifi was good! There no issues at all. We even got a late check out and luggage storage, so we didn't loose our day! Hot water, appliances, convenience, hangers, extra towels and sheets. Pillows were fresh and clean! We really enjoyed our stay! Thanks for having us
Very helphful host. The place was very clean and well equipped. Instructions were super easy. I'll stay at this place again for sure
it was a great place to stay. very spacious and great location. a bit of a walk to the main hub but there’s great public transit that’s very affordable.

I spent a few relaxing nights at Tania’s place. It is very spacious, well equipped for cooking, comfortable living room, and conveniently located by the tram which comes regularly and is only a short ride into the central areas of Zurich. Definitely would like to stay again when I return.
The apartment is hot. We knew there was no a/c but there also wasn’t a fan. We ran the dishwasher and took out the trash but the host attempted to charge us an extra cleaning fee of over 100 dollars.

We stayed at this apartment for two nights with family and had a great experience. The place was easy to find with clear instructions provided by the host, who was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. The apartment was clean and well-equipped with everything we needed. The only thing that would have made it even better was having a dedicated parking space. Overall, a comfortable stay—I’d recommend it!
Fantastic location and had everything I needed! It's only a couple minutes walk away from the train station making it an ideal base.

The apartment is perfectly placed for exploring the centre of Zurich: peaceful yet within a few minutes of the lake, shops, restaurants and everything else that the city has to offer. Mika is a friendly, helpful and very responsive host.

The apartment is very nice and looks like the photos. However, during our 2 day stay, there was horrendously loud construction noise right outside our windows. Not to mention the smell of asphalt and other chemicals. If we hadn't been so jet lagged, we would have left and gone somewhere else. There was a notice on the door stating that the construction would occur from May 10, 2023 until July 30, 2023. Any decent owner/property management company would have disclosed this before booking.

Very nice, quiet and spacious place, there are two stations nearby, one within 2 minutes and the other a 5-minute walk. The street is 10 minutes from the center of Zurich by car. Highly recommended, I would definitely come back.

The hosts were very friendly and inviting, greeted us with fresh fruit and made a wonderful breakfast! It was a very hot day when we stayed so the attic was hot to sleep in, but the hosts provided fans. We were provided with great recommendations and a very nice stay before we left Zurich.
Kathrin is an amazing host and her place is great to explore the city on foot or with public transport. I'm looking forward to staying in her apartment again when I return to Zurich.

I was traveling alone and I felt very safe at Kathrin’s place. The neighbourhood is beautiful and very quiet. The place was sparkling clean and the kitchen was very well equiped. The only thing I missed was a proper sleeping pillow and an adapter but otherwise there is only positive that can be said about Kathrin’s home.

Diana was the best Airbnb host I have had! She is very responsive and super helpful in giving instructions or suggestions around the city (even drew me a map!) The space was very clean and comforting, no hassle. As a solo female traveler I felt so comfortable in her home and she made me feel so welcome. She offered me stuff such as water bottle, umbrella, that she did not need to provide. She even drove me to the airport! Will definitely be staying with her when I am back again in Zürich.
Great place in Seefeld. Near the shops and nice restaurants and only a short walk to the beautiful lakeside. Apartment is well furnished, clean and with a nice balcony. Well recommended.

The experience with the apartment went well, but when we left, the host accused us for stealing a remote control for the lighting. We explained many times that we will be traveling for a long time, and that a remote control is the last thing we need to have -- also it is a system that doesn't work in our country. Then, for future guests, ask for an inventory and take your time to check that all the remote controls (and items listed) are around. In our case, there was no inventory, but then we were accused for a remote control that we never used.
This flat is centrally located and very convenient. The neighbourhood is lively, but the noise dampening and blackout curtains were very effective.

What a lovely stop in Zurich! The place was even better than advertised and we loved the tiny little porch overlooking the goings on below. She was kind and helpful and honestly, it was everything we were hoping it’d be!

The apartment is wonderful, clean, cosy, has everything you need. The location is really great, next to the mall and public transport. My only complaint is that we asked for a baby cot before arrival but there was not one and it took them a day to get back to me and say we would get one only on Monday (it was Friday so we had 3 nights without a baby cot which was hard).

I had a wonderful experience staying in this apartment in Zurich. The location was fantastic, as it was close to the city center, making it convenient to explore all the attractions. What impressed me the most was the peaceful and quiet environment, allowing for a restful stay. The apartment was well-maintained and had all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay. I would highly recommend this rental to anyone looking for a great place to stay in Zurich!

The place was easy to access and clean. The company that manages it is very professional and responsive. There is not any parking and the property is located in the strip club / dive bar area of town (if that’s your thing). Short train ride into town. We had an issue with the bathroom smelling of raw sewage. The company sent someone over to address it, but they were unable fix the issue while we were there so we just dealt with it. If you are staying in room 602, make sure they fixed the issue before you book it.

Location is very accessible both trams and train and walkable to groceries store and fast food especially McDonald and Starbucks which my kids loves it,the apartment is very spacious ,tidy and very modern which I’m very pleased ,the host are both responsive and helpful and they make sure you feel at home at there place..given a chance to visit Zurich again I will definitely comeback to this place ,I’ll highly recommend the place to my friends and colleagues at work
Great location, next to the train station and transportation. Lots of bars and restaurants around as well

Very nice place, even better than the photos; it is in a residential area but downtown/lake is easily accessible w/ transport Very modern and clean and we really enjoyed our stay, however, it was on the pricier side of things Also Gloria is a very kind host but takes a bit to respond Overall, I would recommend this accommodation :)

We had an amazing stay at Noelle and Tobias’s Airbnb! They were super nice and easy to communicate with, which made everything so smooth. The location is perfect, with everything we needed close by. The interior is both creative and beautiful, yet totally functional. We especially loved the private outdoor lounge space – a great spot to chill out. Unfortunately, our dog had to stay home this time, but it’s awesome to know this place is pet-friendly, which is pretty rare. We loved every minute of our stay and will definitely be back. Highly recommend!

"The host was very friendly and cooperative, always responsive. He even gave us a special discount when we extended our stay. The place was very clean, conveniently located near everything, and easy to access. There's a parking spot just a few minutes away from the house. The only drawback was that the rooms were not separated; it was an open space. Overall, we are very thankful for the hospitality and the wonderful location."
Great host and the location is really close to the bus station. You can get to Zurich main station in around 30 minutes. Great deal!

The flat was really good, weel insulated, clean and everything needed to cook. The surrounding is not terrible and guess people whom knows a bit of Zurich would know. Although the room was good quality I have see good place in the center for same or even less fee. Communication was very good and proactive.
Very easy to navigate to from the train. Host was very helpful and responsive!

A very good stay at Strahinja's place. The flat was walking distance to the Letzigrund for a concert we were attending. Plenty of bars and cafés in the area for drinks and breakfast. The beds are comfy and the flat is larger than on the photos. It is functional -although it could do with a refresh with general wear and tear quite apparent. However, the hosts were really accommodating, left little snacks and coffee capsules, and generally very helpful. I do recommend to stay here. Thank you.

Had a lovely stay at this Airbnb! The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the kitchenette was well-equipped with everything we needed. Check-in was a breeze, and the place was spotless. Located in Zurich's vibrant red-light district, it felt both fun and exciting, with easy access to the city's attractions. The absence of air conditioning meant we had to keep the windows open, which made it a bit noisy at times, but the provided earplugs were a thoughtful touch we didn't end up needing. Overall, a great experience!

We loved staying in Angela’s very stylish, spacious and peaceful apartment, a short tram ride from the centre of Zurich and close to bars, shops, restaurants and the lake. Angela was a brilliant host and we would love to stay in this apartment again some day.

Angela was a very friendly host. She ended up not being home but was very communicative and proactive to make sure we had what we needed. The location is great and clear instructions on public transport to use from the station. Do wish there was a fan in the room or screens on the windows as it was hot and we wanted the window open to cool off but then mosquitos got in. But not a big issue.

Great place. Convenient location in the city, close to train and bus stations. But the apartment contained some of the owners personal belongings so there was not much shelf space. Especially in the bathroom. Overall, though a nice spot in Zurich.

We had a wonderful few days’ stay with the family! This accommodation is unique with its fairytale garden. The apartment is spacious, well-equipped (also for little kids), and maintained with love. Walking distance to the Irchel campus and a good 15 mins tram connection to the city center. Muriel and Michael were extremely responsive and helpful from the start, making us feel very welcome. A strong recommendation, 5/5!

Absolutely amazing. People say this a lot, but the pictures do not even come close to doing this place justice. Comfortable, luxury furniture, a wide open and airy space with huge windows and a nice terrace area, well-appointed kitchen and appliances, and super comfortable bed. Plus, Fabian was a fantastic communicator and made us feel at home immediately. Cannot recommend enough!

I cannot imagine a more delightful introduction to Zurich than arriving at Muriel’s spectacular home. Not only is she the most warm and gracious host but the apartment was one of the most beautiful, thoughtfully designed and comfortable that I have ever been in. It truly was such a pleasure to be in the space and of course in the garden which is very special and has endless corners to explore and play in. The location is fantastic, only a short direct tram from the airport and superbly connected to everything by Zurich’s incredible public transport system. We adored our stay here and would love to come back. Thank you so much to Muriel and her family for having us.

Turan helped me with all the details to reach the location, was very helpful during checkin. But host was not very friendly and didn't provide lot of details regarding the sight seeing. Also the room was not great, all the rooms in the house was well maintained and good looking but the provided room was like a dumping place, it has lot of unused items in the berth and cupboard. It can be a good place for bachelor, but was not a great choice for family.

Turan's place was conveniently located to zurich hb and the city centre. However, it could feel a bit dangerous at night to walk back to the apartment after sun down as the area was poorly lit. There were also often rave parties going on opposite the apartment so it could be a little noisy, but nothing that disturbed us too much. Turan's dog was a very cute added bonus and we had lots of fun playing with him. While the house and room was nice, the bathroom had a big hole at the bottom and the apartment complex door is often not locked, so safety was something we thought about often. Overall, a nice stay.
We had a lovely time. The apartment is well located and lovely. We recommend

Very nice apartment that is a quick 15 minute bus ride to downtown. Has comfy beds and fully equipped kitchen. The only downside was some noise from upstairs, but nothing out of the ordinary for a city apartment.

A great place to stay in Zürich. Our family of five enjoyed the surrounding area. I recommend reserving the parking with the owner, as street parking and parking garage are not very convenient. The place is in a great area with lots to do and easy access to public transportation. Fifth floor apartment, so be ready for stairs. No elevator, but chalk it up for a cultural experience. Would highly recommend, and would stay here again.
We had a wonderful visit. The location was close to public transportation and very clean/convenient. We would stay here again! Thank you!

Cher’s place is one of the best spots on Airbnb in Zurich! We only wished we could have stayed longer. It's conveniently located with easy access to everything. When we return to Zurich, we will definitely stay here again. We had a minor accident, and Cher and her team were incredibly accommodating, for which we are extremely grateful. The apartment had everything we needed, including an international charger. The only minor downside was that being on the ground floor, it was a bit noisy with tram sounds and the doors opening from outside.

Loved our stay here! The location was conveniently next to public transport and the apartment was very clean! We felt right at home. The apartment does get warm with the summer heat, but the host provides fans, which helped a lot.

Great apartment, very clean and well appointed! We needed a quiet place to stay after our busy days and were very comfortable at Thomas and Markus's apartment. The location was also great - just a few tram stops from Zurich HB, and the same from the apartment to the airport. It was clear that Thomas and Markus had put in a lot of thought and effort to make guests feel welcome and comfortable. Instructions and tips were also great. Would visit again!

Thomas and Markus are wonderful hosts who are prompt in their communication. They also provided me great recommendations around the city and the place. The apartment is exactly as described with everything required for a comfortable stay along with being squeaky clean. The patio is a perfect addition to enjoy a morning coffee :)

We had a great stay and would definitely recommend this place! The apartment was easy to find and check in was super smooth. Everything was very clean, modern, and thoughtfully furnished and decorated. We felt right at home from the moment we arrived. The neighborhood was also fantastic, with supermarkets, restaurants, a cinema, and everything else you might need within walking distance. We especially loved being so close to the river, which was perfect for cooling down on hot summer days. Our host was very responsive and incredibly accommodating throughout the stay. Overall, a really lovely experience!

The apartment is right in the middle of everything. Lots of restaurants. Very walkable area. IF it is hot, be advised the AC unit only runs ~1 hour before it needs to be drained. The exhaust from the AC goes out the window, which has cloth covering it. This lets in all the heat and humidity. We basically closed the windows and ran the fan only, so it was a little over 80 (28) in the room. That is the only less than ideal. Great place, great communication from the hosts. If you have to leave your bags, check the main train station (2 blocks away) for lockers. It worked out great!

Super cute little stay right in the center of the city. Other reviews complained about the noise but for anyone that’s stayed or lived in a city it’s normal city sounds. Saturday night had a lot of people out and about later, but I figured they were just enjoying their night. Super hot shower and really close to a coop for food and the train station. Definitely a great experience!

This is an incredibly beautiful apartment — clean, well-decorated, furnished, etc. the neighborhood is a little worrisome (noisy and seemingly dangerous), but we had no trouble (and it is only 2 minutes away from nicer seeming areas of Zurich).

one of the best airbnbs I have ever stayed at. bed was comfortable, having AC was amazing, the kitchen has everything I could possibly need to cook, it was amazing! convenient location between 2 bus stops, an easy wall to the main station, and a grocery store next door. Andreas was very helpful and responsive too!

Pull out couch was broken for our third guest and they were unable to repair, so we had to shove suitcases under for support. Shower curtain was dirty and some red unknown spatter on the wall. However location was amazing and quiet inside apartment!

Very cozy and clean apartment! Also very warm. Enjoyed everything! The only problem is that its a little noisy outside because there is a night club close to house so at night it was very noisy because of drunk teenagers

Ariana’s place was super clean, safe, and was just the right size for me and my friend. However, the bed was very uncomfortable, so be aware of that when you are booking:) Location isn’t in countryside like in the description but was only a 7ish minute walk to the bus stop that takes you into town. Overall was an okay stay!
We enjoyed staying at the Ariana's place and hope to be able to stay there again in our future trips to Zurich.

Alice’s studio was very peaceful and clean and within minutes walking distance to the tram that takes you to the center of town. The only negative was it could have been better equipped with a coffee machine and shampoo/body wash in the bathroom. But overall it was ok. There was no bed just a mattress on a wooden frame on the floor which also could have been improved.

Very nice clean and cosy appart apparemment. You just need to walk 15 minutes to join the center but there are also cute places nearby. The public transport being literally next door, if you are lazy it’s not a problem. Would recommend if you want a peaceful place in Zurich and don’t mind being in the full center.

We only stayed 12 hours (one night), but the sign of a good place is that we felt bad for leaving so soon. Sergio was very responsive and kind, he helped us check in and gave us our space despite an early morning departure. Great location. Cozy place. Comfortable bed. Can't ask for more.

Sergio and his wife’s place is really beautifully decorated and very clean. They are both super friendly and nice to chat with. The only downside is the neighborhood. The streets are filled with drunk and loud people in the evening. Not very inviting to step outside for a walk. Closing the windows helps, but not fully. So if you are a light sleeper you definitely need some earplugs

Stefano is a great host very helpful and very friendly! The place is nice, You got everything you need!! And Stefano responded very good to every question. However the Mattress was quite thin and it did give me some back pain, So probably won’t recommend this place if you are more sensitive. Is a safe place and area for woman traveling Solo !

The stay was okay for a family of five but there were quite a few problems that we are not satisfied about. First of all, the air dryer is basically broken as it is super loud and it smells like burnt when u are using it. Second, the WiFi connection was really poor in the flat, especially in the living room and kitchen as it was only one signal sign. Thirdly, there were no coffee capsules besides the coffee machine and tissues in the flat at all.

The positives were the customer services was excellent and always available. The rooms were bright and clean and the check in was super easy and flexible. However I had to move rooms twice as both of my rooms had blinds which were malfunctioning or completely broken. The second room didn't have working heating. It was very much appreciated that the customer service moved me to my 3rd and final room however there I also encountered some issue when the shower head exploded off the cable and soaked the whole room. Overall the place needs some serious maintenance but the design and customer service are excellent. I would not revisit or recommend to a friend based on all the issues.

Great place located not to far from Zurich city centre. easy to locate with the instructions provided. Daniela was very good with communication before arriving. She was also a wonderful, warm host, much like her two cats. The place is bright and airy, with a really comfortable bed, where I had a great sleep. Daniela showed me a beautiful relaxing walk past some vineyards and by the lake, which was nice to see away from the city. I wanted to stay later on in my trip, but unfortunately he place is booked during that time. If this place is available, I recommend 100%

She's warm and welcoming however, during my 3 day stay, I noticed she had entered the room twicw when I was not there, without even asking me. Once to take her adaptor and my charger off the power outlet and the day after, while I had put the adaptor outside the room, when I came to the room I noticed the window had been opened and the drawer was cloased. Also, it was not possible for me to enter the apartment's door with my key as she had put the key inside the lock from the other side. Also the cats, and their hair, were everywhere and were making noise at late nights and early mornings.

My stay at Dan’s place was a great experience. The flat is cozy, clean and nicely decorated. Dan had already prepared everything for my stay. Dan is also very kind and spending time with him was lovely.
