Great room in shared apartment less than a minutes walk from Billoweg tram stop. Lovely park next door and the lake is a few minutes walk. Yuan and her partner are super helpful and the place was very clean. Great value for Zurich.

Jörg is a wonderful host and his apartment is a fantastic place to stay in Zürich! The check-in process was very simple and straight forward, and it was easy to communicate with Jörg. The apartment itself is very clean, modern and actually larger than it appears in the photographs. You can really tell that a lot time and thought has been put into making this a wonderful place to stay. The Bahnhofstrasse, which is Zürich’s main downtown street and one of the most exclusive shopping streets in Europe, is one block away. Walk south along the Bahnhofstrasse and it will take you directly to Lake Zürich. Almost everything from restaurants, shopping, museums, etc. are all within walking distance. If you are looking for a place to stay in Zürich, I highly recommend staying at Jörg's!

This place is great in that it is centrally located and easy to walk everywhere. The apartment was quiet and was nicely stocked. We ate out most meals but the kitchen is well stocked. We would definitely return.

Very well designed apartment: stylish, functional and creative. In a quiet area, but still close to the center and the lake, easily accessible on foot or by tram (stop a few meters away). Very rich in services and facilities, for cooking, cleaning, etc.: nothing was missing. Great courtesy of Jordane: always quick to respond, precise, on time. She comes personally to provide keys and explain all the features of the apartment. Overall, great and perfect experience!

It is a clean, modern, interesting apartment in an incredible location. Jordane was very friendly, generous, and kind. The challenge is that it is on the ground floor. Being on the ground floor does not present a problem, generally speaking; however, on hot summer nights, you feel a level of vulnerability because you have to leave the windows open and sense there is a security risk as the windows open directly to the street or a patio that has no significant wall around it. If the property added a portable air conditioner and somehow found a way to provide more security around the patio, it would be ideal.

Hi, I believe I should be first fair to say that the location is very convenient and quiet, in a nice neighborhood at Witikon. I arrived very late and the keys were incorrect, but I appreciated the very fast response. I think I overall had an okay time, as I wrote. But it does look different than advertised. The garden is on the back of the Building, two stores down. The room felt somewhat dusty, and the wardrobe doesn't have much space to store clothes. Everything is very measured, one set of sheets, one trash bag and one toilet paper. A cleaning woman comes every two weeks to clean the kitchen and living room on an apartment with three rooms. Given that the place is still relatively good budget, it was okay. But the apartments could be more taken care of, so the stay feels homey.

It’s a very tidy and nice apartment, and fairly close to the tram stops to get into old town etc. Had a pleasant stay overall. The only thing that could’ve been better would be more bins - there was no bin in the bathroom and only one other bin in the kitchen.

Really enjoyed the location and walk ability of Sara’s spot. It was fantastic location and we loved how easy it was to move about as well as the apartment itself. Super cute and while furnished with all her things, she’s got great taste. Really the only downsides are it’s on the top floor so it can get very warm without AC and it was hot for us and it was not warm and raining most days (which also prevented us from keeping the windows open). The only other issue is when windows are open, you can hear the trains below creaking as well as revelers passing by. Other than that, the clock towers are quite loud and right next to the house so something to be mindful of but if you sleep deeply then no qualms here. Lovely spot in a hip part of town. Be sure to hit up collective bakery! Delish!

We loved our stay here, and we had such a great time!! The design and the vibe of the apartment are unique <3 ... really clean, and a big enough space for hosting a group. The location is really good as well. I totally recommend it!

Highly recommend this place!! We were staying at Brigitta’s place for almost a week, the travel to Zurich central is so easy, to/from airport is just one tram away. The place is super nice, just as described, we felt right at home and she’s very responsive. When we Switzerland again, will definitely book this place again :)
Great location near the main train station. Easy to find and the room was clean. Niko answered my questions very quickly. In general everything super. 5/5
I had a great stay! Niko was super nice and the neighborhood was great. Very central and easy to get to everything

Fantastic place. Great neighborhood and a MASSIVE place for the money. I was very happy here and can highly recommend it and Tania the host. The only small complaint was not being able to use the heating since it was central to the building, and it would only turn on if the weather outside was cold enough. But that isnt a fault of the host or the apartment

Absolutely within city with Zürich lake about 2 kms drive of 5-7 mins by tram. House is extremely well maintained and very functional. Would appreciate if host could provide the parking as well. However it’s not difficult to find parking in surrounding. Overall, I will surely rate this as 4 on 5. Superb stay and will recommend for families looking to stay in city center.
Responsive host, great location, comfortable apartment and worked well for 2 adults and 2 kids. Appreciate no clutter with the kids.

The house is beautiful, however you have to be aware that the parking lot could be a problem if you rented a car. Also, the host is very reactive but not flexible at all. I asked for an additional pillow because mine was too soft, and they didn’t allow me to have an extra one because “the number of pillows reflect the number of guests in the reservation”. Not very nice to say. We are talking about a pillow, not gold.

We loved this apartment. The first thing that made an impression on me was how fantastically clean it was. Really outstanding in this area. Lots of nice touches like new washing up implements, lots of coffee pods (although we didn’t use them, I know lots of travellers who would be very happy at this). It’s in an excellent location with shops and transport really near but it is so quiet indoors. The hosts are extremely quick to respond to any query even late at night. Very impressed by their customer service.

This was a great place to stay. We were in Zurich for a month, and I would not have changed this for any other place. The location is great, with easy access to everywhere in Zurich but still being in a peaceful and quiet neighborhood. Dimi was extremely responsive and helped us with all the needs that we had.

Jonathan was very hospitable and his condo had nice amenities. However, I would maybe have better instructions for some of the appliances and make it clear in the listing that the living room is not part of the rental. Overall, I would recommend his place. Great location.

The place was clean and spacious with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Kitchen was fully equipped and there are many utensils available. It’s a perfect location with tram stations and grocery stores around the corner. However, the key was placed in the letter box without any lock box. Also, it is just a single key without any tags or chain, need to be extra careful when you’re out of the house.

I booked the day before travel, so got a discounted rate which made this very good value. Excellent accommodation, and well presented. It’s cosy, but has everything you need, and it’s handy to have a small kitchen, especially if you’re staying for a few days. It’s conveniently across the road from a well connected station, with good small supermarkets that are open on Sundays.

Very clean and very new, in a nice neighborhood with easy access to public transportation. Perfect for a family of four with two kids. Walking distance to playgrounds and great places for coffee. In the middle of a heatwave, the modern apartment stayed cool thanks to floor-cooling. Roman was very helpful as well, providing info in advance of our trip. Check-in and check-out were a breeze. Overall, we feel really lucky to have had Roman's place for our stay in Zurich.

Dimis place was a good, clean, basic apartment. It was well lit with a lot of windows. Check in instructions were easy and exact. The washer wasn’t working during my stay but Dimi informed me beforehand so it wasn’t an issue for me. There are linens and towels but no soap or bathroom amenities. I would only ask that the bathroom include hand soap. The locality is within walking distance to public transport and feels safe (at least on well lit summer nights). There are a few restaurants and coffee shops in the neighborhood. However, it is quiet at night. All in all a good place and I would definitely recommend it.

The Airbnb was bright spacious and right in the middle of everything. the rooftop terrace was stunning and the couch and furniture were very comfortable. pillows were ofhigh quality. location is unbeatable less than 10 minutes to the train station and easily walkable to all of Zurich. right next to an aldi and a busy street but quiet up above it all Host was great at quickly answering questions once we were there. if your staying for a bit longer you will have to refill the toilet paper but the Aldi is literally next door so not too much hassle.

Dimi was incredibly responsive and easy to communicate with. The apartment is very comfortable and minimalist. The neighborhood is nice and quiet, but has easy access to a few local cafes/restaurants, and super easy access to city center via public transit. For future guests, the listing is very accurate and no other additional amenities exist so be prepared. There is no basic shampoo, laundry detergent, or extra towels/bedding, or any oil/additional spices beyond salt & pepper, which would have been nice to have. However it was clearly stated in the listing so it wasn’t a surprise. Overall, it’s a fair and decent place to stay in Zurich and Dimi is an excellent host.

Very nice and cozy home - not a rental place, but the actual home where the family lives. House is very clean, with fully equipped kitchen and comfortable beds. We used "perks" that most rental homes would probably not have, such as a printer, a piano, and full selection of spices in the kitchen! The location is not close to city center, but a short walk to the tram station - door-to-door all included, 18 minutes to Paradeplatz.

The apartment was absolutely fantastic. 65sqm felt much more thanks to the good design. Very well equipped, super clean, and warm. Note there is a shared washing machine in the building basement. Thanks for the great stay

Bright and warm apartment with great views. Quiet building. The outdoor space was lovely, but unfortunately, it was too wet and cold for us to use it. Would love to come back in the summer to sit outside for dinner.

Marc's apartment was very cozy and the beds were very nice. He was very clear with the directions and had all my questions answered already before me needing to ask. The only downside was the shower which is a little high up to get into and there looked to be some kind of mold in the top right of the shower wall. Overall great stay and enjoyed Switzerland alot!
Bed was cozy and the layout really nice :)

Very good location and beautiful place. Bus 31 is convenient to go to everywhere. The only thing is the kitchen stuff is not fully prepared, we bought oil by ourselves, but based on this price it’s still ver good! Highly recommend!

Slava was such an amazing host, very personable, genuine and great communication. He suggested places to eat and things to do before I even asked and the location was only 5 minutes from the bus station. His place was the perfect size for us and this was our favorite trip yet! Thank you for being a wonderful host ♥️ We will hopefully be back in the near future 🫶🏻

John, Has a great place in the quiet area of town but still centrally everywhere! Very near all Public transit. The place is very modern and had everything we needed! Thank you for hosting my family! Happy holidays! Cheers
I had a wonderful stay in this beautiful and immaculate apartment. It’s located in a peaceful neighbourhood and within walking distance of the centre of town.

The apartment is well connected both with the center of Zurich and Oerlikon. The apartment is clean and tidy, it has everything you need to stay. Thomas and Markus provided very detailed instructions about the stay, everything was clear and helpful. The only concern was about the child chair, which was in the ad but was absent in reality. But apart from that, everything was perfect. Thank you very much, Thomas and Markus!
Very cozy and great place to stay. All the accomodations are available. Its great location as well. We wnjoyed the stay alot.

How lucky I am to get this place when I got a cold lol. The warm room and super comfortable bed and hot water saved my life! And the lobby downstairs is just a pharmacy ( don’t even need to step out when it’s pouring outside) very clean and with all facilities needed for short stay. Michael is friendly helpful and responsive. There’s another flatmate but they give lots of privacy. No need to mention the Very Centre location 1min to tram. 7 out of 5 stars! Makes me love Zurich more ;D
Amelie was very kind from the moment we inquired about the apartment. Location was great, near Enge train station. Only 15 minute walk to main shopping street. We loved our stay and would stay again.

At first, the unit seemed a bit costly but the photos promised an amazing place. The reality turned out to be even better and exceeded my whole family’s expectations. It was worth every penny. We had an amazing time so much so that we felt more inclined to spend more time in the flat rather than go out and explore beautiful Zurich.

Stéphan’s apartment was lovely! The location is in a quiet neighborhood within walking distance of the main station, lake, and one of the only self-service laundromats in the city. Stéphan’s instructions were easy to follow and he was very communicative via text.

Stéphane’ place was great. Quiet neighborhood, quiet neighbors. We did not find the fish tank as loud as some other reviews say, I think simply by closing the door in the bedroom you can drown it out. The bed was super comfortable and loved the amenities. I will say it was a bit of a further walk than 15 mins to the main train station, but we were very clearly accessible to the tram by 5 min walk or train s-Bahn 8 minute walk. Access to all things downtown very easily. Stephane was very responsive and kind! The balcony was cute. Would come back again.

Very quiet place outside of the more hectic parts of Zurich, a quick stroll from the river and cute cafes and restaurants and a supermarket a literal stone's throw away. The host was very friendly, super easy to communicate with and kind enough to put together a list of things nearby to do and see. Ultimately, an easy and comfy stay.

Angelo was a very easy going host. He was flexible with the check in time and gave us thorough instructions on how to get to the apartment. He was very welcoming, we could make use of the kitchen and living room which made us feel like home. The apartment is in a great location, just 10 min walk from Zurich main train station and the main turistic part of the city. I highly recommend staying at his apartment.

The apartment is situated in a great location! Train station and main attraction are super close. Easy to find, in a safe neighborhood. The room is as described, cozy and all. Angelo is very friendly and always ready to help.

This was quite a basic stay. The location is very convenient, only taking about 10 to 15 minutes to get into the city. However, when we arrived there was a puddle of water from the radiator and when we used the washing machine the grey water was not plumbed in, resulting in all of going on the bathroom floor.

It was great to be in the City, Busstop in front of the hous, parking too (public and over night for free-swiss bluezone from 7pm until 8am). We areived pretty late and were given the keys personally and checkout was flexible, thaaank you Lilly! It was quiet, yet next to the street. Shops and Sihlcity (a great shopping mall with even movie theatres) in walking distance, a park and the River Sihl as well, and a wellness place too. The apartment is small, cute, clean, convenient, good price... Ki4chen got all you need to cook, but take evth along what you need for cooking. Wifi was perfect, so we had excellent connection to work on the computer with lots of data. We will be back!!!
Location is beautiful and there is easy access to the tram service but the tv doesn't work. Cooking essentials like coffee, sugar and salt are not provided.

Nice and cozy place. Clean and simple one-room apartment with a built-in kitchen. Walk to the busy Old Town in about 20 minutes, but the tram goes right to Franco's place, too. Highly recommended for those planning to have business at the ETH, which is within walking distance.

What an amazing stay! The place has incredible views overlooking the rooftops of Zürich. It's a small apartment, but has everything that you need for a getaway. But there is just one upgrade needed - a wine bottle opener haha! Jonathan was so kind to let us not only check in earlier but also checkout later than stated in the rules and he was kind enough to give us good tips on where to go and what to do in town. Additionally, he showed interest in our country as well which was super cute! The location of the place was convenient - near a big mall with grocery store and restaurants, 10mins from Uetliberg with the bus (in case you would like to hike) and just 15min walk to the center.

We had a very good time staying here, the apartment looks exactly like in the photos and it was spotless. We felt at home immediately. The neighbourhood is quiet and relaxed, but also well connected to public transport. There is a medium sized coop a few minutes away and there are multiple children playgrounds close-by. This is a good place for a short-term or a longer-term stay. The host was very responsive and helpful.

Beautiful apartment, and hadn't fully grasped how large it was from the description. A surprise given the location and proximity to all that downtown Zurich has to offer. The apartment was spotless, check-in and checkout were easy, and the host was helpful and responsive. Couldn't have asked for a better stay.

Dimi's place was very conveniently located - we could walk to pretty much everything we wanted to do. It was a very cool apartment, very clean and really helpful to have a washer and dryer since we were nearing the end of our trip. Would highly recommend staying here, with one caveat - like many places, there was no a/c, but there were also no fans, so it was uncomfortably hot at night. Other than that, everything was great.
Very cozy place, the building appears a bit aged especially when you’re used to modern finished buildings but the apartment is up to date and well furnished.

This property is highly recommended, with every detail thoughtfully arranged. The decor is fresh and cozy, offering ample space with modern furniture and appliances exclusively for guests. We found more than enough of what we needed. The neighborhood is pleasant, featuring several good supermarkets (we find a coop and a chinese shop) and a nearby tram station. The host is friendly and easygoing – when I communicated with him, he often provided more information than I needed, making me feel welcome. The balcony is nice, and nights are generally quiet. However, being on the first floor, there are occasional small insects, and the lack of AC or fans made recent hot days uncomfortable. Considering the overall advantages, I’d rate it 5/5.

Good value. The apartment was close enough to the center. With a tram stop around the corner. There’s a place with pastries and sandwiches that I recommend by the tram stop. Sometimes a small coffee spot is open across the street, solid coffee!

I really enjoyed staying at Sara's. She is a very friendly and helpful host, and answered all my questions patiently and with a smile. I had the whole flat to myself as she wasn't there. I had all that I needed in her place. It's clean and spacious, the road outside is quiet so I didn't feel disturbed by Street noise. A big bonus is that it's very easy to find and very close to a train station, only two stops away (or even one stop on faster trains) from Zurich HB, the main station. I will definitely recommend Sara and I hope to stay there again myself.

Giancarlo was super responsive and helpful it felt very professional. the only thing is it was a little confusing to find. Other than that it was an amazing stay. Great location super close to the train station.
We had a pleasant stay at this apartment. Communication was also great. The atmosphere close by is quiet and lovely. With this price, definitely worthy in Zurich.

The place was very well connected to the Public Transport. Well kept. However, it is to keep in mind on which floor you are getting the accommodation as it may be difficult carrying heavy luggage to third floor as there are no lifts. Lighting may be improved in living room and bedroom. Check-out timings are non flexible as requests for slight delays are not accepted.

Generally a very pleasant stay with no pests. However, have to admit that that bathroom is a little cramp for adults. the bathroom also has a hole in the door - the keyhole. Just something to take note off when travelling in the group for modesty reasons. Beds were clean and comfortable, I had awesome rest.

Loved our stay at Dragi’s Airbnb in Zurich! The place was clean, cozy, and well-located. Super comfortable and perfect for a relaxing stay. Dragi was incredibly kind and helpful, which made our experience even better. Would definitely come back!
The tram station is close, the host always response quickly, cozy and clean rooms, highly recommend!

The place was very well kept and clean when we arrived. It was a very modern and minimalistic space making it easy to get settled in. The instructions they provided us to get into the apartment were easy to follow and relatively clear, they were able to let us check in early. However it was a little pricey for what it was but not too bad.

Dimi's spot was the perfect stay for my family and I! Quiet area and not too far from the main city center. It was also pretty hot when we stayed but each room had a fan and he even gave us an extra one!! Appreciated the quick responses! Thanks Dimi!

Simo was an okay host, except that there are few things we didn’t like. Fireplace was added as form of heating, but there was no firewood, so place lost it’s glory and looked bland because of it. It was not previously cleaned, as Simo updated us, the cleaning lady ended up in the hospital and couldn’t clean it before we arrived. Therefore, place was extremely dirty with stains and hair all over the bathroom, it was dirty inside as well, full of dust. Simo brought us some clean sheets but that’s about it. One more thing we didn’t like is that he tried to rent us some e-scooters that were noticeably old and not functionable for very high prices and they were taking up the space in the apartment for no reason. Overall, we wouldn’t repeat this experience.

Nice stay at Michael and Theresa's place. It is very conveniently located to Access Zürich's city center and is as described. This is a real home, Michael and Theresa actually live in it, it had been a while since we stayed in an "inhabited" Airbnb which is, for us, the real initial spirit of this platform - thank you for that and for your trust in welcoming us to your home!

The location is really great, and you can park for free in front of the house before 9:00 am. Self check-in is available, and there are several doors, so it’s quite safe. However, there are two small downsides: there are very few pillows, and the room is in a semi-basement.

Stayed for one night to be close to the airport for a flight back home the following morning. 8 minute uber ride to the airport, it was great! The bnb itself looks exactly as the photos. Chidiebere met us out front and let us into the bnb, and showed us around before leaving the place for us. That was different, never had a host do that before. The bed was comfy and the TV was great. It was warm outside but the bnb felt cool with the fan that was provided

Chidiebere was really helpful in giving us directions to the place from the city centre and was always responsive when messaged. The place was a good base for a couple days in Zurich and really close to the Waldgarten tram stop which made travelling in and out very easy! Would definitely recommend as an affordable option for staying in Zurich. Thanks so much!

SO SPACIOUS! Perfect for 4 couples or a large family. Our “adult children” noticed “no tv” but isn’t that we vacation is for? Haha This apartment is stunning and in a very easy location to walk to the historic part of town and restaurants. And as always, the top of my list is a comfortable bed. These were lovely after a long day of sight seeing. We would stay here again!

Beautiful apartment, spacious, warm and comfortable. Easy access to the city by foot or plenty of transportation at your doorstep. Plenty of shops, supermarkets round the corner. Parking was made available at a cost, though we had some trouble getting timely instructions on where to park. The apartment needs blinds, as it’s easy to see in from the street. It’s also needs pots and pans for cooking as we had one pot at our disposal for a family of 5. Be prepared to come with all essentials, as the only thing provided was salt and pepper - absolutely nothing else. Recommended otherwise.
Great location and accommodations. The elevator did not work when we got their but they had so Done come out immediately to fix it. Also loved that they had an outside balcony seating area

The apartment was clean and conveniently located near the city center and public transportation. It had all the essential amenities we needed. However, being half a floor below ground level so be aware of insects/spiders if you open the windows. Additionally, three of the four rooms did not have cupboards, which wasn’t mentioned in the listing. Only one trash bag was provided for six people and two toddlers for a five-day stay, and additional bags were refused. Parking spots was not available, and public nearby parking slots was almost always full so take care if you bring a car. Lastly, the pillows were quite uncomfortable.

Martina-Michael were very pleasant, friendly and responsive host. They left very clear instructions and were helpful in suggesting local recommendations. As for the apartment, it’s very lovely and cozy, even looks better than how the pictures portray it. It is located in a very serene neighbourhood centrally located from important landmarks like Zurich Oerlikon train station and spar supermarket, about 12 and 3mins walk respectively. In all, it was a pleasant experience staying over at Martina-Michael’s, definitely worth what we paid and looking forward to staying over at their place anytime I’m back at Zurich.
Good location, easy for taxis and Uber eats to find! Note that if you are mobility impaired and don't like stairs, you still have to go up or down a few steps to get to the elevator.

The 2 hosts Sonia & Pablo were super responsive, we always got a response within minutes. The apartment is not that close to all the attractions, but very well connected by tram. The apartment was also very clean and the bed was comfortable.

Nice place in a good neighborhood. As expected, the trams were heard but they didn’t bother us much if at all. I would love it to be a teeny-tiny closer to the center but not critical. Worth every penny. Stylish and warm. Highly recommend.

We had a lovely stay at Martina and Michael's place. We are a multigenerational family of 8, including 2 elders and children. The place is close to 2 bus stops (about 3-4 minute walk from the house) and near 2 small grocery stores. The place is very clean. What I love about the place is that the kitchen has complete amenities so we did not have a hard time preparing meals. For first timers in Switzerland like us, what I appreciate about the place is that the hosts stay nearby so if there are any requests or emergencies, it can be addressed promptly. Martina and Michael are very responsive and helpful to our questions. Highly recommended if traveling with family or a small group.

Speechless. No words can describe how nice Martin’s place was especially for the value. Had everything we needed and the view was spectacular (we did not want to leave). The ONLY downside for us was the lack of a proper air conditioner because I get hot very fast in the summer months and start to sweat, or maybe we are just stupid Americans! Either way, I would definitely recommend this stay. Martin, you were a great host Thank you for your accommodations!

Many’s place was a great stay! Very walkable from restaurants and the train station. Staff members at many’s place were so welcoming and friendly. The only thing we found ourselves needing was a few more kitchen utensils/supplies.
Great place to stay with close by tram stop so getting in and out of the city was super easy.

Exceptional stay in a lovely city! It was refreshing to see that a Super Host actually upheld the standards that we’ve come to enjoy over the years. Massimo warmly welcomed us and gave us a tour of the place which was helpful. The place is pristine, fitted with everything we needed for our short stay and the storage space is abundant. The hair dryer is one of the best I’ve come across in our Europe stays and very much appreciated! The location is also terrific and within walking distance of everything. We opted to walk from the train station with large suitcases which we managed however I highly recommend asking the Super Host for a better route that doesn’t require stairs to get to Many’s.

I recommend staying at the loft for short and long visits. Good location, nice surrounding environment with convenient public transport. Clean and green area. Solid, new building and good community areas for guests
It was a great stay! Syrille was very welcoming and helpful with how to get to the location and offered me any more help if I needed. Place was clean, felt like home and Syrille was very pleasant!
Unfortunately the check-in was a big struggle : instruction in German, a lot of info to share I was not expecting to spend time to do that before to get in. The place is nice and very modern.

We enjoyed our stay, and the location is really good. The flat was big and very fancy, and have everything you need. Due to having to have internet to open doors, we sometimes struggled, as our internet wasn’t the best here with our foreign internet providers. The bed was comgortable, but the double duvet was not very big for sharing for two people.

I've decided to book Charles's room after reading the comments on Airbnb. And everything was same with the comments. Charles and Karina is so friendly, helpful. Home was really really always clean. Location is so closer to the train station. In the morning it's lovely to start the day by hearing birds singing..by the suggest of Charles i had a good programme. Thanks for their hospitality. If you want to book it, never have doubt just go ahead for your comfortable accomodation.

For a place in Zurich in a great neighborhood, this place was a gem. The company that hosts the apartment is extremely responsive and helpful. Its on the 6th floor and the elevator was on and off working. This is not the hosts fault but a heads up would have been nice, and a fair warning for anyone with issues with stairs.

The studio itself was as advertised and check-in was smooth. However, during my stay I was unfortunately locked out of the apartment late at night due to a door malfunction. While 24/7 support is advertised, it took hours to resolve the situation — I wasn’t given access to another room until around 2:00 AM, and my belongings were locked inside overnight. This caused a lot of stress, especially as I had an important interview the next day. I hope the host will take steps to improve their emergency response, as the situation could have been handled much better.

The location is excellent. We stayed for almost a month and we could find everything we need in the neighborhood…Christian is a very responsible and friendly host as well. We will definitely come back again when we visit Switzerland next time. Strongly recommend!!

Charles and Karina are extremely helpful and communicative. They give very clear instructions, and are responsive to communication via text. The apartment is shared with them, and they are attentive to the needs of the passenger. This is a small apartment with a room dedicated to the guest, With shared accommodations. The only downside is just one bathroom that is shared with three people, but it was never an issue. Highly recommended for a one person traveler close to easy transportation into Zurich.

If i could leave 7 stars i would! The place is really great, and my only worry is that it won't be the same price the next time i visit. The host was extremely helpful and responsive. Thank you so much!
Wondeful host, nice communication and comfortable house. Highly recommend if you are looking for the room :)
short but great stay. theres a coop nearby and a train station just in front of the building
Cleaning was not very good and the house was cold…

Thanks Marcin for your hospitality during our stay in Zurich recently!! We thoroughly enjoyed it's surroundings and city 👌. It's a 2 rooms neat & clean top floor apartment facility. The facility is well maintained. It's well connected to the public transport system - bus station 🚉 around 200 meters. Has grocery stores and restaurants around. Marcin - your timely help and timely communication is appreciated 🙏! Thanks 😊. We would like to visit you again!!
Very comfortable apartment for my family of 5. Check in was very easy, apartment was clean and conveniently located to the tram stop. Quiet at night. Highly recommend!
Alessandro was very cooperative and accommodating. The flat is very nice and comfortable. We had everything we needed. The surroundings a bit noisy but the windows double glazed

The apartment location was perfect, and we enjoyed it in general. Alessandro is an amazing and kind host. Very responsive . The only thing we didn’t love was the creaky floors and a creaky bed. Not a deal breaker but did take away from the experience a bit. The A/C could have been a bit stronger by U.S. standards, but it was okay.

Property was great. very new like, lots of light and good furniture. The location was also good. However, Less points for the host, who says he is not available to pick up the phone even at 9 PM and mentions that he is not available even at emergency after 9 PM. (our flight got little delayed) We needed to turn the stove on during the morning around 7AM. looks like it was child locked and there was no instruction how to unlock it. the host was not picking up the call, nor replying on the chat until around 9 AM. this wasted our 2 hrs precious time of travelling. host should have made some measures to help the guests if they are having any issue and 9 PM, 7 AM is not such odd timing if you are a host.
Marcin was very responsive host. The place is super clean and organized.

Dimi was extremely responsive and an excellent communicator. Two minor equipment malfunctions were investigated promptly the next morning by a repairman, even though it was a Friday. The bedrooms have plenty of cabinet space and the the lay out was exactly as pictured. Not a lot in extras but everything that was listed. By far the fastest residential internet I have ever seen. Much faster than available in the US easily. The neighborhood is out of the old town and very quiet. Any easy walk to restaurants or the main town. No surprises.

The apartment was incredibly spacious and spotless, making it feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. The location was perfect, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, and shops just steps away. Also 15 minutes walk to main train station. Everything in the apartment looked exactly like the photos, which we really appreciated. The check-in process was smooth and easy. We also loved how well the space was organized and thoughtfully prepared for guests. The only note is that the train noise can be noticeable for sensitive sleepers, but it didn’t take away from our overall experience. Despite that, we still found the stay very relaxing and enjoyable. We definitely recommend this place for a pleasant and comfortable stay in Zurich.

The penthouse was absolutely fantastic, and we had an amazing stay. It was very spacious, modern, and beautifully designed with an open-plan layout. The three bedrooms were perfect and comfortably accommodated six people. The view was incredible, and the balcony was a wonderful place to enjoy breakfast or a meal outside. The location was excellent, close to shops, restaurants, and many amenities, making it easy to explore the area. The owner was very welcoming, friendly, and supportive throughout our stay. Everything about this penthouse exceeded our expectations, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, spacious, and well-located place to stay.
Location is great！The apartment is bright and spacious. However, there are no cooking oil and salt in the kitchen as the web site stated.
Great location and access to train stops! Just needed a bit more AC for the hot days but the fan helped!
Excellent place, very clean, comfortable, spacious and central, the only detail that only has a bathroom for 10 people, but everything was good.!!
Good rental, it was just very hot due to the heat wave. The fans were a bit loud and ineffective unfortunately. The location was great close to many things.

It’s a nice house with large rooms. The place is in a quiet apartment to the level that kids find it scary. Frank’s team was responsive and helpful until I reported an issue with heating in one of the rooms post checkin. Unfortunately they didn’t care to resolve the issue nor communicated post that.

We enjoyed our time in Zurich and dealing with Dimi was very pleasant. Everything was very nice and clean, just as seen in the pictures. The nice spots in Zurich are all accessible by tram which makes it easy to come in and out as needed. We were there over the Christmas holidays and the only thing I wish I had known was to make reservations way in advance for restaurants as everything was closed on the 24th and 25th, also many places were closed on the 26th in observant of St Stephen’s Day which is highly acknowledge in this region. We were still able to find some spots and we did enjoy our stay very much. I would highly recommend staying at Dimi’s apartment and I would definitely go back if I’m ever in Zurich again.
Demi was a great host, quick to respond all the questions and very respectful and kind. Apartment was clean and spacious. Would come back again!

Clutter free base. Three stops on train to the centre of Zurich. Apartment is clearly only used for rental so not homely but that was ok for us. At first we were disconcerted by being dropped by taxi in a car park and all the concrete. Then realized it’s just the architecture here - the area is really nice and feels safe. Easy access to centre and host very responsive. Wonderfully fresh white bed linen and towels

Words can’t describe how lovely of people Carsten and Bruno are when it comes to hosting. They go above and beyond for their guests in all ways possible. I’d suggest this place to anyone. They’re a quick walk from a tram stop. They have a nice quaint neighborhood with a restaurant around the corner. They make the stay well above five stars. We appreciated them the entire stay.

This was a great spot to stay in. After having a different host cancel, we ended up staying here and it was so convenient and everything we needed! They were also super flexible with check in/out, which we appreciated so much. Thanks so much for the wonderful stay

The appartment is nice and very clean, the location is okay (10 minutes train ride to Zurich main station and view on the lake), however the room is very minimalistic. It says so in the description but I didn't expect that it would be that minimalistic, there is only a fouton which was not very comfortable to sleep on

All went smoothly during my stay at Vivienne’s beautiful home. She’s a considerate and friendly host. The room was pristinely clean and nicely decorated. The couch was comfortable to sleep on. I liked the neighborhood as well, the location’s really charming and right by a public transport station.
Dimi was really attentive throughout my entire stay and the flat is really cozy. For the ones working either at ETH our University of Zurich, the location is perfect. I recommend it!!!

Nice little studio. Well equipped and with little details that show that Sonia and Pablo want you to feel welcome. If you sleep with open windows you can hear the street nearby. The apartment is not in the city center but there a tram stops nearby with direct lines to the city center.

This was my first ever Air BnB experience and it was more than a perfect a hotel rather i would say felt like home with all ameneties inside. Just felt it a little away to reach there with heavy luggages but the apartment was pretty good. Its well connected with Tram and Bus and have a lift service so it was easy to carry luggages.
Very clean and spacious!!! Loved the location as it was peaceful and quiet neighbourhood!! Would highly recommend!

The apartment was clean airy and bright. The checking in was absolutely seamless as the instructions were clear. It is very close to the Central and Zurich HB however in a residential area so peaceful. The Sonneggstrasse tram stop was few metres away. There were many restaurants and eateries in a walking distance. Overall we had a comfortable stay.

We had a great stay at this apartment. It was very clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. The location is perfect — right in the center, yet surprisingly quiet, which made it very comfortable to relax after a long day. The apartment is fully equipped with everything a traveler might need, including a washing machine, dryer, kettle, and coffee machine. Overall, a very convenient and pleasant place to stay. I would definitely recommend it!

I had a great stay at "Sorpressa." The place was clean, well-maintained, and conveniently located. Sonia and Pablo were wonderful hosts. They were very responsive and I was able to check in less than 24h after a last-minute booking. As noted in the listing, the unit is near a tram parking station, which can get quite noisy. The walls are also thin, so you can occasionally hear neighbours. However, the hosts provided earplugs which helped.
We had a good stay at this apartment. The views were amazing and it was spacious with a nice balcony. It had a kitchen and two bathrooms, which was nice for a group of more than two.

It’s a great place to stay and it’s really near the tram and buses, so you can get around easily enough. However, unlike a lot of AirBnbs, you are expected to replace everything you use (including coffee pods etc), and there’s a fair bit of admin around the recycling and bins, so beware if that, but it is a lovely place to stay. And Julian was a good host and let us check in a bit earlier which really helped!

Olaf's place was very accommodating and well situated in a walkable distance to the city center, main sights and public transport. The communication with the host was very easy and friendly, he was also flexible about the times of check-in and check-out.

Martha was very responsive and a great host! The Bnb is in a very convenient area and is within walking distance of the city center. The only inconvenience we experienced was that the sofa bed was a little uncomfortable to fit two people since the size is a bit awkward.

I didn’t get to meet Olaf however we did have chats though the app. He was very responsive. The room was clean and well located - a small walk and a 15 min tram ride from the station. The room was much nicer than the photos! Felt very comfortable and happy.

Martha’s place was very local to the train station and easy to find with good instructions. We were able to get in early as our flight was an early morning flight and IRA her cleaner was most helpful. The apartment was spacious and had all amenities we needed. However we were expected it to be a full time Airbnb as opposed to someone home. The location is good for walking into town but was quite noisy especially on the Saturday night when music was really loud from somewhere. We understood quiet hours to be from 10 pm but this went on till close to midnight. If you like the idea of being close to everything and do t mind city noise this is a great location.

Lovely stay in a great location. Really easy to get about from the bus stop at end of road into centre in around 20 minutes. Silvia’s place is large and roomy with plenty of space for the 4 of us. We loved the sofa and projector - made for great watching of Euro games we weren’t at! The only thing I would clarify is Silvia lives on ground floor and shares an entrance with the airbnb which has the first and second floors. Silvia was a lovely host, took an interest in why we were there and was helpful with her tour of the airbnb when we checked in. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend as a base for exploring Zurich and surrounding areas!

very cozy home close to main attractions. Matteo was very proactive and responded to all my questions. instructions were very detailed and he also gave tips on restaurants, places to visit and even video instructions to certain things in the home. loved it

Dimi's place was very easy to find and move into. we felt at home and all the amenities worked well. one could easily explore Zurich from his place as it's very close to the bus and tram stops. The only inconvenience is the lack of hot water for shower once two or three people use it. That aside, I'd definitely recommend Dimi's place to anyone considering a stay in Zurich.
Absolutely recommended host. It was a pleasant experience and the place had everything I wished for.

Very good experience. The apartment located at a quiet district. There are some restaurants nearby, in which you don’t need to worry about nothing to eat when you are hungry. The apartment is at 3rd floor and there is a lift. The host provided food and clear instruction about how to go and everything I need. You will also be provided a map with guide about the city Zürich. However, there is no seasoning provided, so you need to buy some flavouring if you wanna cook. Also, no body wash, shampoo, washing powder etc. be provided, so you may need to bring your own one here. Overall, this is a satisfying experience. Thanks Dimi for hosting me.
Excellent accommodation and location, everything is very convenient, clean, and pleasant. Accessible, no stairs, and there is a large elevator. Many thanks for the wonderful hospitality.

Sonia’s studio was very nice and comfortable to stay in for 2 nights. The neighborhood it is located in was a bit removed from the main area with things to do and places to go. Not many stores or restaurants close by, but it was easy to take public transit to get to everything else. Sonia was responsive and helpful, and gave every clear directions and instructions for how to get there and how to check in. Overall great experience!

perfect location, easily reach by bus or tram, easy check-in, clear instructions, very good space ,well furnitured (TV, sofa,dinning table) kitchen well prepared, studio is in the second floor but there'sa lift so no worries, safe neighbour hood,the things I didn't like are( the window infront of the bed doesn't give you privacy and it should be shaded, there was broken plug beside the bed, there is no shower gel or soap in bathroom and I asked him but he didn't provide, any Airbnb I went supplies these things, little bit noise from Ambulance when passes otherwise you don't hear anything, bed is comfortable but makes sounds during turning right or left, generally I recommend this place and if I go i will choose again after fixation of these little things.

The apartment was clean and located close to bus stops. However the apartment is advertised for 3 persons. The sofa bed is definitely not suitable for anyone to sleep on. It was extremely uncomfortable and was not set up when we reached the apartment. We asked the host after the first night for another mattress or refund for third person. Our messages were ignored until the morning of checking out when the host told us that our appreciation of the furniture did not warrant a refund for the third person. Unfortunately my brother was unable to get any rest prior to our long journey home.

The place was roomy & the bed was huge. You could use EU outlets for the plugs. The shower was a bit small but that was to be expected. We liked the chairs and table that came with the kitchen. The chairs on the patio were not what were in the description, but it was still nice! The place was very convenient for grocery shopping & catching the bus.

Initially I had a problem, as after having easily found the flat, when I entered I found that it was occupied. It turned out that there has been a confusion in the booking. However Dimi and the staff were very efficient in finding an alternative solution, and helpful in the whole situation.

I recently stayed at an Airbnb hosted by Nuria and had an excellent experience. The location is incredibly central, putting me within walking distance of all the major tourist attractions. As a solo traveler, I found the space perfect for my needs—cozy, secure, and well-maintained. Nuria was an outstanding host, always accommodating and quick to respond to all my questions, which made my stay even more enjoyable. Her helpfulness truly stood out. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a convenient and comfortable place to stay.
Cozy little place in the heart of Zürich, Nuria was very responsive and helpful!

The host was very responsive. The unit was comfortable for two and at a great location. However for those who are sensitive to noise, it can be noisy because it is next to a busy street in the old town.

Gerard’s place is very central, close to the train, trams and the old town. It’s a reasonably sized studio apartment, not in the most glamorous part of town, but the central location is its biggest plus. Most essentials are provided, including fridge, coffee/tea, stovetop, but no microwave and no shampoo or shower gel. Gerard went to great lengths to provide contingencies for entering and leaving, and was prompt in his communication.
The place is perfect if you are looking for a spa experience and relaxing on weekend. The room is perfect for two but small. But the facilities are on point. I will come back soon
Perfect stay and the partnership with the crown plaza spa is wonderful it’s a great idea. Thanks to Linus

The deck was very nice and was supposed to be there 6 days, unfortunately i didn’t realize that the “bed” was not actually a bed and instead was a what i believe pull out couch. The cushion was stiff and had a very uncomfortable feel and the pillow had 0 support so I slept horribly and had to switch my flight to a day earlier. Everything but the bed was fine and as described.

I have visited this place recently, it was amazing to stay there for 3 nights. The host was very welcoming and friendly he was present to welcome us. The house was provided with ample amenities, utensils for a small family. The living cum dining room is a spacious space for family members to sit and relax. Bedroom is provided with bed and enough storage space. The bathroom is clean and perfect. The location is calm and serene with a picturesque neighbourhood. It is easily accessible from the railway station by tram and bus. The locality has enough restaurants for family hangout’s and also with departmental stores for daily necessities. If I happen to visit Zürich again I will definitely try to stay here based on the availability.

We couldn’t thank Dieter and flatmates enough for the great hospitality, the environment was cozy and extremely welcoming and we felt right at home. If you have a car but want to be close to city center, this accommodation is perfect. We would definitely recommend it for a nice stay.
Enjoyed my stay at Svitlana's place! She was a great hostess and very helpful. The location allows excellent access to the train station, and there's lots of food and grocery options super near.

Great apartment at a pleasant neighborhood. The access and Dimi instructions for check-in was great (as usual, since I stayed in some of his other rentals in Zurich). The apartment is spacious and has almost all the amenities needed for a short trip. The only downside was that the shades are too old and won’t completely close. I’m used to sleep in dark, and outside light was waking me up every day at 5am 😅

The appartment is very clean and the location is also great. Dimi responses to any enquiry quickly. The only issue is that the appartment is beside a busy street and if you open the windos for a fresh air then noise of passing cars are very loud and you nay not be able to sleep over night.

This AirBnB is perfect for 1 person or for a couple. It is located right in the city centre, with amazing sights to see around. A very quaint, cozy and neat and clean place that we used for 4 very comfortable nights. The bed / mattress is especially very very comfortable. Has a little kitchen that we used well, as it was well equipped with utensils as well as appliances. Special mention to crystal clear instructions given by the Host, as well as appreciate how responsive the host is. The only drawback is the size of the bathroom, as it is quite small.

It is exactly like described and well connected with tram, train and bus. The apartment is well equipped, there is basic condiments in the kitchen but missing cooking oil (not a problem as I could easily get one in the supermarkets nearby). I like the smart tv which I can cast YouTube on but for some reasons I couldn’t get the Netflix casted. For me, the only thing can be improved is the pillows as they are quite flat even I used both.

Lovely apartment, felt right at home. The balcony has a great view, and the location is super central. We walked everywhere we needed to go. Dimi was super responsive as a host, too. The only downside is that the windows don't insulate noise very well. Since one side of the apartment faces a busy street, it was quite loud, even with the windows shut. It didn't bother me much, but my mom had trouble falling asleep.

Great penthouse loft with small balcony overlooking the train tracks and the mountains across Zurich. Amazing screen to connect your lap top to and work from home and also smart TV that can be viewed from the mini living room and bed. Fridge stocked with some essentials. There is no kitchen but there are canteens, fast foods and restaurants all around (walkable). Also around are train, bus and tram stations for various connections. Finally, Jerry was always responsive and helpful. To be revisited! Thanks!

Bernd's home was a nice place to stay. It was clean, comfortable, spacious, and quiet. The access to the train station was a huge bonus. We were off exploring during the daytime and it was nice to have a quiet place to come home to each evening. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend renting from Bernd. After we left, he has falsely accused of us damage that we did not and could not have caused. Upon researching, we discovered that this a common scam for european hosts. This experience will impact if we choose Airbnb for future stays.

It was a very nice house, everything clean, and actually he offered us someone to clean the apartment during the stay. The apartment it’s nicer than it appears in the photos, very near from train station, and only 1 station from city center (5min on train). And Bernardo a really kind host, always in touch with us to see if we needed something. I 100% recommend this place to stay.

Super nice and clean Airbnb in a centrally located area, very quiet for the area. I will say the only downside would be you are in the addict, 3 flights of stairs, and short ceilings (probably 6.5 tall).

Great location. Lots of shops and restaurants closeby. Check in and check out instructions were easy to follow. The only thing I would advise is maybe have the fan open before guests arrive as it was a particularly hot day when we checked in, but besides that, the bed was nice and comfy, TV working well, bathroom was clean, thank you David for being responsive throughout.
Jerry was a great host, responsive and very helpful providing directions to his place. The apartment is nice and it is easy to get to the city center. Really enjoyed my stay.

I‘m really sorry to give only two Stars to my trip, because the host was really really friendly. I also could check-in one hour before the announced hour. And the location is really in a good spot of the city. But the heath in the room was barely endurable. A building with this kind of isolation needs to be fulfilled with at least a mobile air conditioner. Another strange thing is the fact if having a lavabo thats serves as lavabo for the toilet and the kitchen at the same time. I didn’t cook but otherwise you would clean your face in the same place where you wash your dishes.

This apartment was beautiful, clean, well-equipped, and in a great location. There were 3 of us and we fit comfortably. Nora is kind and very responsive. She gave us recommendations and helped us at all times when we needed it. It was an easy walk to Zurich HB train station, perhaps 15 minutes. It's close to good restaurants and shops on Badenerstrasse. The only issue was the clothes dryer in the basement didn't dry our clothes, so we had to hang them up, but that wasn't a problem. I definitely recommend this apartment!

Nóra is a great host. She is kind, flexible, helpful and quick to respond. The apartment is very nice. It is spacious, clean and well equipped. The area is nice. It is full of life but still calm and friendly. The communications are very good with a tram stop close by. Would easily stay at Nóras place again.

This was honestly the nicest and most comfortable Airbnb we’ve stayed in. We felt completely at home. Hemerson was super sweet and always quick to reply whenever we had a question. The place is a little outside the center, but with the tram stop just around the corner, getting around was super easy. Everything was just perfect , we can’t wait to come back soon!

Clean and spacious with a balcony to boot. Beautiful sunflower fields, peaceful forest trails and the delicious Ziegelhütte gastropub are just up the hill and tram 7 is right across the street for easy transportation in and out of the city center.

Overall the place was great and excellent value compared to alot of other listings. The location was ideal and we went to a local restaurant just 3 min walk away from the place and the food was amazing. However, there were left over party balloons left in the room and the couches were stained and some glasses were still dirty in the cabinet. Cleanliness could have been better.

Would book again :) Pros: - Very comfy bed - Amazing kitchen with all the appliances you need to cook a big meal - Beautiful balcony / wintergarden - Very communicative, responsive and friendly host Only con: - The apartment is a little bit cold in winter. But there is a mobile heater that you can use to heat up the room you are in. Would book again 👍🏻
Everything is so nice~ The room is cozy and Tobias is welcoming and friendly, makes us feel like staying at home. A special experience~
Tobias provided a very nice and good value accommodation and much appreciated communication and tips. Highly recommended for longer duration high quality stays in the center of Zurich. Thanks.

Mathilde’s space was perfect for my stay in Zürich! I could walk easily to nearly anywhere in the city center, but there was nearby access to trams if I wanted. Her place was clean, quiet, included everything, and was very comfortable. Mathilde was also very kind and communicative! Thank you for helping to make my trip so easy and relaxing!

Loved staying at Mathilde's place. Great location near a train station and tram stops, shops close by for groceries and other items, spacious and clean apartment. The only minor drawback was that the washer and dryer listed are not in the unit and instead in a common area only accessible at certain times. We made it work, but if you are counting on doing laundry at any time take that into account.

Beautiful apartment in my favorite part of the city. It is super modern and well furnished. You will find everything you need in the apartment. We were staying for a month with a small child and were very glad to have a washing unit in the apartment. The apartment comes at its price. However, most of the furnished apartments in Zürich are super pricey, especially in this area. The host was super responsive and attentive for our needs.
I had a great stay at Rossana’s place. If anything, the Airbnb is more spacious than the pictures show and it was well stocked with everything I needed for a few days!
The place was clean and had all the essentials. Responsive host, would stay again!

This stay was amazing! Andrea was truly a great host and communicated very well. She even let us store our luggage at the airbnb before our check in which was very kind of her to do. The location is very close to public transportation and everything about it was perfect. I highly recommend you stay here during your trip to Zurich!

Main complain is that apartment was not cleaned very well. There were hair on the floor that is not fine but may happen. But there were hair in the bed. For me its not acceptable especially for that price. Another item that is not covered in the description is elevator. Its small. Very small. Though it is said for 3 people it can contain only one normal-sized man and a small suite case. But if you have a stroller it does not work. All the rest is good. Apartment is in the very quite neighborhoud. Good supermarket (coop) is 3 minutes walk. City center is 30 minutes walk. Kitchen has all dishes to cook. Even fridge is a normal size. Host is very responsive

Thank you so much Andrea for your wonderful hospitality. From the moment we arrived, everything was smooth and easy. Your clear communication, fast responses, and warm attitude truly made our stay comfortable. The apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and felt exactly like home. We really appreciated the small details you prepared for us, and the location was perfect for exploring the area. We couldn’t have asked for a better host. Thank you again for making our trip even more enjoyable. Highly recommended, and we would definitely stay here again in the future! 🤍🇨🇭

Wonderful experience start to finish, the place is so nice and so convenient. We loved riding the tram around town that is just a short walk (this was the only town on our 3 week visit we never used a taxi or Uber) and the back yard and garden were just so lovely. Nunu is also the most friendly host, made us feel so welcome and gave us the best suggestions of places to go, she is a true local so definitely pick her brain when you arrive for some good suggestions to make the most of your stay. We’ll be back!

Of all Airbnb units that we have stayed around europe, Nunu is the only owner that greeted us upon arrival. She is friendly, helpful and her English is very good! Her unit is splendid, exactly the same as per the photos. And u got an extra with the garden at the back. Interior is beautiful and spacious! Truly a wonderful stay. Will repeat, definitely.

The apartment was a really lovely place to stay for a week in September. It feels even more airy, bright, and inviting than the pictures make out because there are windows on three sides, which also help with making a nice cooling crossbreeze. Ersin was friendly and responsive and made the experience feel homey. The apartment is towards the back of the building, so there’s little street noise and the main outside noise is just the regular church bells. I travel to Zürich at least yearly for work and I would absolutely stay again.

It was a great place to stay. Close to a tram stations which made it easy to get around. It’s up a lot of stairs with no elevator. The host was very responsive and nice. He was also very flexible with our check-in! The only issue with the place was the temperature. We went at the end of November, while it was snowing, and the apartment was very cold. There was an extra space heater provided, however it didn’t do much.

me and my family had fantastic stay at this AirBNB. The place was exactly as described-clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully stocked with everything we needed. The check-in process was seamless, and the host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout my stay...

The place is very close to old city centre. We go everywhere with walking. There are markets, restaurants, bakery near the apartment. The area is slint and peaceful. If I come to Zurich again I stay in the same place.

Dimiter’s apartment is in a great location, quiet but easy walking distance to old town, and other important locations. The apartment is nicely functional and very clean. Dimiter was very responsive . The only reason I did not give a 5 star is because the bathroom is small, and furniture/lighting/ wall decor is minimalistic. Very livable but not enticing. Great for a few day stay.

Conveniently located near the center of the city walking or a quick bus ride. The space was spacious and comfortable and great for a quick retreat in Zürich. If you don’t mind a little city noise (some buses, the occasional ambulance, some neighbors) then you are set for a great city stay! Dimi was an extremely responsible host and always responsive to our questions big or small. Thanks for everything! 😁

Perfect location steps from the Kunsthaus museum and charming old town with all the cafe's and shops to explore. The apt was very clean and the huge windows opened up to cool down the place without air condition. the apt is small but charming and the bathroom show works well. The only neg thing was the wifi didn't work when I was there she said she tried to fix it but it never worked. I would highly reccomend Dimi's place

The flat is very centrally located, check in was easy. Unfortunately the flat didn’t exactly look like in the photos, but it was close enough. It was rather clean and the bed was very soft. There was soap and salt and pepper available, some coffee or tea would have been a nice touch. Also some decorations might give the flat a little bit of a brighter feeling. Given the crazy prices in Zurich Dimi‘s apartment was good value for money in a very good location!

The apartment was in a excellent location. Very walkable and close to a supermarket, the Limmat and landmarks of Zürich. About 200-300m you are able to get a street tram that connects you with Zurich HB which is a must for tourists that intend to explore more of Zürich and the Switzerland. Bis bald! 🇨🇭
Small and comfy apartment! Slightly far if you wish to walk from Zurich HB, but the apartment is near a tram stop. Plenty of restaurants around and the river is beautiful!
Nice, bright and clean apt. Very close to all the central locations - lake, restaurants, bars, universities, etc.

Very quiet but central location, nice neighborhood, convenient for the tram, lake, and Altstadt. We were here during a very hot weekend but the flat maintained a comfortable temperature. Otherwise, the flat was very nice and had everything we needed. Dimi was also helpful, friendly, and responsive. Highly recommended!
It was a great spot near good restaurants and lots of kids playgrounds. More of a hotel feel with the cleaning and service with the benefits of of an Airbnb.
The apartment was cost and defect for our family of five. Location was good for our onward travel and access to the city by bus easy too. Stefani was a great host!

We truly enjoyed staying at Stefani and Alexander Airbnb! It was extremely cute and comfortable. Stefani accommodated us by allowing us to check in early. She also gave us tips on how to get around the city. The Airbnb location was walking distance to the train. She was very quick with responding to us. We did have a little issue with the toilet, and we do understand that it’s an older building; however, Stefani was able to correct the problem right away. I would definitely stay here again! Zurich was truly beautiful!! Thank you again Stefani!!

between the smart lock with app, keypad, and physical key, we found the place very easy to get in and out of. it's along Zurich T9 tram line that goes from downtown (Zurich HB (the main train station)) to the airport, which made our arrival and departure very convenient. all the furniture was rustic (in a good way) and cute, and the two salt lamps by the bed were very nice. kitchen is nicely stocked, but there isn't a ton of counter space. the place is close to a tram Depot, (the host Sonia is transparent about this before she confirms booking, and ear plugs were provided) but it wasn't loud enough to bother me. the window shutters (blinds?) close all the way, you just have to keep turning the Crank :)

Well located place - just 15 min away from the city centre by tram. Very clean apartment and great spot for a city trip in Zurich. Sonia is very quick in responding in case you have any questions. As a suggestion, I would like to add that it would have been nice if we had been allowed to enter the apartment a little earlier than 3 pm, as it was already ready but the code was set for 3pm sharp.

100% recommend this place! Great location! Right next to a tram station so it was super easy to get around. The apartment is very clean and comfortable. There are a lot of nice things to do nearby but the apartment is very quiet in the evening. Matteo and Margherita are wonderful hosts! They made me feel like home! The third host Legy is an absolute love bug. Be aware! He is also a con artist! Don't trust these cute eyes when he tries to convince you that he needs a second dinner. If you are visiting Zurich, this is definitely a great place to stay

Incredible sanctuary in the heart of it all, but just outside enough of the normal hustle and bustle of central Züri. Beautiful, pristine and spotless apartment is exactly as described. Lucas and Sara were truly kind and attentive hosts. A MUST STAY consideration if visiting this great city. Danke viel mal!

This is an immaculate, stylish apartment in a great location with excellent amenities. We had everything we needed for a few days in Zurich and the tram station is just outside the door, so we could be in the center town in under 10 minutes. The train station is just a 5 minute ride away! A few things to note: There are 70+ stairs to reach the apartment (no elevator) The washer and dryer are not in the apartment, they are just outside the apartment behind an unmarked door. Lucas was a good communicator.

Good location. Was not expecting the room to be in a business / office type building but the room itself was fine. The location was what I was most interested in— it was close to the city center and close to public transport. I didn’t use the kitchen but it has everything you would need to cook and refrigerate groceries.
It’s not so comfortable for 2 people. 1 is perfect, everything is a bit small. Overall great place, the gym and pool is great.

Such a gem especially in a place like Zurich! The room was clean, spacious and comfortable, the hosts communicated well, the location is just perfect for all possible activities in Zurich but the main highlight is the sweetest and most sociable cat ever! Will definitely book this place again when back in Zurich, thanks for everything!

Antonio and Angela were very gracious and friendly. I had plenty of privacy, but they were both available if I had any questions. I would absolutely recommend, especially if you are traveling solo. They live right near the lake with easy access to swimming in the summertime.

The location is excellent, with plenty of restaurants and coffee shops nearby. It’s easy to find. However, note that the apartment is on the third floor of a walk-up building, and there is no elevator. One significant issue is that the hallway leading to the apartment has no lighting, so you’ll need a flashlight at night. Inside, the doors between rooms are shorter than usual, so tall individuals should be cautious. Additionally, the Wi-Fi was not working during my stay.

Very clean place, super comfy, nothing bad to note. One of the cleanest places I have stayed. Only downside is that it was a bit outside the city center but easily accessible via public transportation or a ~30 minute walk. Host was very responsive and the guidebook of Zurich was very helpful. Would recommend and stay again.

The location is great, just 5-10 minutes walking from the train station. There is also a supermarket nearby. The view is beautiful, the kitchen is well equipped and maintained. The instructions are very clear. The only shortcoming is lacking of air conditioner.
Full set of kitchen with good water flow and drainage in the shower room. To note that the unit has unlevel flooring with a gradient from entrance to living room sofa.

We had a great stay here! The unit was spacious and very clean. It was very easy to get on the tram in a two minute walk, however it was difficult to get a taxi from here. The place was a little pricey for the area and the fact that the washer is in the basement, but we enjoyed our time very much!

My parents stayed at Monika’s place while visiting us in Zurich and loved it. Great apartment with everything you need, a beautiful balcony and ideally located near the lake, cafes, restaurants, shops. Can walk into centre by the lake or seefeldstrasse or get a tram 3 mins from the apartment. Monika was great to deal with and always contactable. Highly recommend

A beautiful and clean place, close to many nice restaurants, with a lovely view. However, we faced two issues: the weather was extremely hot and the place did not have air conditioning. Also, for elderly people or anyone with an injury, the stairs are very difficult.

Good location, comfortable beds, clean, and great layout for our group. The only negatives were the smell of mildew in the washer and the A/C wasn’t strong enough to cool the apartment as well as we would have liked. It did cool it but we like it cold. The host was responsive and helpful.

Fantastically clean flat, with a perfect amount of space for our family. Very convenient to public transport and a very safe feeling neighborhood. Host was very responsive to the few small issues we had. Having the washer & dryer was nice, but fair warning that it took nearly 5hrs for a load of clothes to dry. Our one challenge was that the only thing supplied for doing dishes was liquid soap, no sponge, rags, or drying towels. So we made do as best as we could with bare hands for the few dishes we had, but if you were doing real cooking there it would be more difficult. Would definitely recommend this flat and we're very grateful for our stay!

Solo traveler, 2 nights for a training during the week: Tomi welcomed me after checking-in and we had a very friendly chat. We were both pretty busy during my stay so hadn't managed to chat again, but Tomi was very helpful whenever I needed something and made me feel at home! If you're a light sleeper bring earplugs; the windows do an excellent job at insulating from the noise but the appartment is right next to Zürich's party area and even during the week there's something going on.

We had absolutely wonderful stay with Tomi! From start to end, Tomi was very quick to respond to every question, and he generously shared his favorite local spots and insider tips. The house itself is a dream, super clean, cozy and full of life thanks to so many vibrant plants. I could tell the hosts put real heart into maintaining the space, salute to their efforts! The location is very good, within easy walking distance of cafes, shops, train and tram stations. But there are a lot of bars nearby, so it was a bit noisy. We met Tomi in person on our last day and ended up talking for hours, he’s as warm and genuine face to face as he is over message. We’d love to stay here again and highly recommend it to others as well.

Franks flat is a quiet neighbourhood about 30 minutes from Zurich by public transport. It is 15 minutes from the airport by taxi. ( 50 euros ) It was as appears in the photos, comfortable and quite spacious. The kitchen is well supplied with plenty of crockery and cutlery etc As others have commented some shampoo coffee pods etc would be nice ( but as others had commented we came prepared even though we were only in Zurich for 48 hours !) The parking is not easy in the vicinity. But luckily we only needed parking overnight. And Switzerland is a very expensive country for visitors !! Thank you for a lovely stay.

A lovely place with lots of accessible public transport around. Very tidy, clean and comfortable. The check in was simple and all the information from the hosts was clear and helpful. We had a couple of small issues but the hosts were communicative and quick to respond. Small points for improvement would be to better equip the kitchen and provide some toiletries, such as shampoo, for guests. Other than that, this place is a highly recommended stay in Zurich!
Beautiful and ideally clean apartment. We enjoyed the stay and the host greeted, welcomed us in person and helped check in process. Beds are super comfortable, too!

Clean, large and simple home in a quiet location. It’s about a half hour walk from the center of town, which is perhaps the only negative. This is compensated for by the very close access to the tram line. The host was instantly responsive and I had no issues with check in or check out.
it s a very nice clean apartment with tram station near and many markets(coop,migros,denner,aldi)just 2 min away to walk!thank you for all the staff blueground apartments!

Simona is very communicative and helpful.The apartment is quaint and small, a decent size for a couple, and nicely decorated. The apartment is on the 5th floor and accessible by elevator. However, there is no air conditioning, which could be a concern during warmer months. Additionally, the neighborhood is very lively, with a club located below the building, making it quite noisy, especially at night.
mattress with no cot, no wifi, location close to public transport trams, small room and little difficult to find the key to get in.
