The flat is well-located, and although it was cold outside, inside the heating worked very well. It's small (like the pictures show), and the bed has no frame (also as shown by the pictures). There were no surprises, so you can trust what the ad says and shows (except that the hair drier does not work without an adaptor, which isn't available in the flat). Bayardo replied quickly to our messages, which helped, and offered us towels, bedsheets, toilet paper, etc.
Best place I’ve stayed while working in Zurich! The walk to work in the centre was great and easy to get to. Nice views also.

The location was perfect, apartment was clean and David was an amazing host and very responsive. The only issue was that we didn’t know it was his own living apartment and felt kind of uncomfortable noticing his personal stuff everywhere and not locked. Other than that it was perfect.
Great location and apartment, would happily stay there again! Close to bars, restaurants, transport and already in the city.

Not the best communication before arrival I wrote twice on the platform and sms without any answer and had to phone once we arrived. Very clean room but the real problem and what needs to be mentioned only for smoking people who like to smoke all the time, the smell of cold tobacco was really horrible. Even with opened windows it didn't go away, the neighborhood is very noisy even very late so it was definitely difficult to sleep. It's more like an hotel with many rooms and cleaning people staff in the morning than the home of someone. Only advantage as the price are crazy in Zurich it's relatively reasonable and very clean except the horrendous smell of cold cigarettes. So OK for smoking people on a short budget I guess
Great location and as shown in the description.

Christos was a wonderful host and when our plug adaptors didn’t fit he immediately found one for us. The apartment is a short bus ride from the centre of the city but the location was good for us to be near family and friends. The apartment was warm (it was January) and very comfortable. Our daughter joined us for two nights and stayed on the sofa bed which she found comfortable for the weekend. We would recommend this apartment and Christos as a host and hope to be able to return soon.
This apartment was great. A great size for two and in a great location - super close to transit options and very walkable. The only downside was how hot it was.

Amazing stay with a very kind and accommodating host! I loved the location and enjoyed relaxing on the balcony. The host went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable. I will definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place!

Host is helpful, but there’s no lift and it was very difficult to climb stairs to 3rd floor with luggage, there’s no air conditions inside the apartment, also some smell of paint, towels were new but leaving furs

This apartment is spacious and allowed for my family to stay comfortably. The location is very good - it is close to a train station and others public transportation options, it was short 3 min walk up the train station Oerlikon and about 5 min away to old town Zurich HB by train, but the consequence of the convenience is the noise. The apartment does not have lift which gave us a bit of work, especially on the last day, to get all the big bags down, but anyway in general the experience fot us was good!

Exactly as pictured, very good and friendly communication. The place has plenty of amenities and lots of closet space. It was extremely clean. There's a nice balcony, and the doors to the bathroom and living room also have a lock for extra safety/privacy. There's two elevators in the building. You're allowed to leave any leftover unopened food for the cleaners. The only two downsides: - the self check-in is very handy, but the key box is a few minutes walk from the apartment, which means a slight climb with your luggage up a hill. Only a minor inconvenience, but it would have been good to know beforehand - the apartment had no oil, salt or pepper, coffee or tea. Thank you for the pleasant stay!

This newly renovated flat is beautiful, with a fantastic and spacious balcony with a view of the hills above Zurich. Is is in the peaceful Seefeld neighborhood, a 5 min walk from the station Zurich Stadelhofen (which is a 3 min S-Bahn ride from Zurich Main Station, and 15 min S-Bahn ride from Zurich Airport). If one walks to the center of the Old Town, it is only 10-15 min. And, about 2 min walk from the lakeside. Very hard to beat!

Jose-Luis’s apartment was perfect for my wife and I. It was small but enough space for the two of us to feel comfortable and cozy. There are 5 other apartments on the same floor next to each other, but it felt very private the whole time. The balcony was a nice feature as well. Unfortunately, there was construction going on during our stay so the noise in the early morning was very disruptive. However, the hosts communicated it to us and apologized for the inconvenience. Overall it was a great time.
We had a great time in Zurich! We loved the location and the balcony to sit on. Dimi was easy and quick to communicate!

apartment was as described, with a lovely balcony. it was convenient to take the tram from just outside, and the main train station and was not far to walk to. above all, we appreciated the clear instructions, elevator access and hassle-free check in & check out process!

Great stay! Very comfortable beds and the apartment had everything we needed. Although the place isn’t very large it’s a comfortable stay, in a great location. Only thoughts - there is no air conditioning but there are fans and the windows do open. Additionally the street is very loud outside and with the windows open it would definitely be challenging for some to sleep, but was just fine for us. Definitely recommend this place!

The flat was perfectly located very close to city center — just a few minutes away from HB/center by car or public transport. There are plenty of supermarkets nearby, and even a cozy coffee bar right at the corner of the street. The apartment itself is very spacious and comfortable, everything was absolutely perfect. If I visit again, I will definitely look for this flat first! The host, Dimi, was extremely kind and helpful. During our stay, my son suddenly became sick and we had to go to the emergency hospital. Dimi was so understanding and agreed to extend our stay with just a simple adjustment in the price. That support meant a lot to us in such a stressful moment. Highly recommended — thank you, Dimi!

Dimi was a great host is quick to respond. The location is in the center of everything. The only problem I had was the map on Airbnb brings you to an area below the building. If you go realize it is across from the church. The apartment is close to the laundry room and very quiet.

Giancarlo and Dimi’s apartment was a real treat. Located right in front of the Grossmünster made for the ideal location. Quiet, clean and comfortable we would highly recommend this wonderful apartment. Giancarlo and Dimi were super hosts, very responsive and gave clear and concise directions and information! The location of the apartment is within walking distance to most if not all the sights to see in the Altstadt.

Clautilde was a great host, always very responsive with quick and clear communication. The apartment was very cozy, clean and tidy and just what we needed. The only downside is that it was very noisy. Between the bars on this street and road construction that started around 6am, there were not many quiet hours at night. This extra noise may just not be avoidable for being in such a central location, but something to know depending on how lightly you sleep. Overall, still a great stay, great host, and great location!

Beautiful, clean and pristine apartment in a very central location. The only big downfall, is that the building seems to be going through renovations, so we were woken up at 7am to intense construction drilling every morning, directly above or beside the apartment. We genuinely couldn’t hear ourselves think. I don’t think that’s the fault of the hosts, so 5 stars for them & the space, but still wanted to leave a fair warning for anyone considering this apartment as it was very very disruptive to our vacation.
Comfortable room and bed on a peaceful street. The check-in was smooth and easy.

The place looked exactly like in the photos. It was suitable for a couple or a small family with a double bed, a TV, a sofa, a private bathroom and a separate toilet (no bathroom door though) and a small kitchen with enough cooking utensils. The host was friendly and allowed us to check in earlier. However, the drawback would be the lights were really dim and the room was dark overall. The host helped us and gave us 2 additional desk lamps though. Thank you for the stay.

Room was perfect for our one night stopover in Zurich, close to the station, clean functional shared bathroom and flexible for checkin time. Interior decoration is functional rather than hotel standard and fortunately for us the Jazz club opposite wasn’t loud on a Monday evening but the complimentary ear plugs suggest this isn’t always the case.

Typical European hotel. Nothing special, you’ve remodeled all the charm out of it. Please start copying US hotels and add USB ports so we don’t have to purchase an expensive converter and haul it around with us. The chance to do laundry was a plus, but other than free coffee, no breakfast was available

Raphael is such a perfect host, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! We went to amazing restaurants and loved the surrounding neighborhood. The bed was very comfortable and the window in the bedroom luckily has a screen which is not common in Switzerland I found! I would love to stay with Raphael again if I’m ever in Zurich, he is incredibly kind and respectful. Also - the tv and Netflix were easy to use!

It is a quiet and peaceful area and short train journey from centre of Zurich. Raphael was really responsive and provided clear information. The accommodation is spacious and tidy. Couldn’t find a microwave or kettle in the kitchen but the stove was plenty for our short stay. The kitchen was otherwise well-equipped eg tea/coffee/cooking spices are provided. In the bathroom the only ventilation appeared to be a window (maybe there is an exhaust, couldn’t see it though!) but it opens to the street so it’s not too comfortable opening it. It was good that all amenities eg soap/shampoo are provided. Overall a really comfortable stay with a great host, would definitely recommend!

A very big apartment located in a small street close to the lake, not far from Stadelhofen. It has everything you may need, including a washing machine and a dryer which is a huge plus in Zurich and a big balcony. The place is very pleasant, quiet and comfortable. It is clean and well maintained on a high standard, like one can expect in Switzerland

The apartment is quite spacious and very clean. The location was very convenient as well. However, I was surprised how bare bone the apartment was. Nothing was provided in the kitchen, not even a salt shaker! There was one bath towel per guest provided, even though we stayed for four days. And no toiletries with exception of a tiny disposable bar of soap. We were disappointed by this lack of hospitality.
Appartement was wonderful and the host was always reachable, absolutely perfect!

Stefani’s place was in a great location just a short walk to the train station and the grocery store. The apartment is on the 3rd floor. Stefani reached out to inform us about construction being done across the street and we appreciated the heads up. They started around 7Ish in the morning, which was not inconvenient for us because we had early mornings. They finished around four 4:30ish in the afternoon. At night with the windows open, you could hear the Shisha bars downstairs but nothing we couldn’t sleep through. We also stayed on Monday/ Tuesday, I know some of the reviews say it can get pretty loud on the weekends. Stefani’s place was spacious and clean and perfect for our group. Thanks for the accommodations.

Stefani’s apartment is a good place to stay for convenience and if you don’t need to be in the main area of Zurich. The main area is easy to get to by train but there’s not much around the area. The apartment was mostly clean except for a blood stained sheet which they promptly sent the cleaning service and replaced the sheets and unclogged the shower. The fans were also dusty. The biggest drawback was that it is on the top floor with no elevator and a lot of stairs. I inquired about the luggage carrying service but it was not available on the weekend. If you have heavy luggage and aren’t physically capable of hauling luggage up 5 flights of stairs I would consider staying elsewhere. Overall, decent for what it is was and an accurate description and host was very nice and accommodating.

I had a wonderful experience at Daniel's property. He provided clear instructions for the check-in process, making it very easy to settle in. The location is excellent—just a 5-minute walk to the train station, 3 minutes to the nearest bus stop, and about 7 minutes to the closest tram stop. The bar on-site was a delightful addition to my stay. I highly recommend this property to friends and travelers in the area. Just a note: there is no TV, which I initially overlooked 😂. However, this turned out to be a positive aspect of my trip, as it encouraged me to disconnect and enjoy my surroundings.
We had a wonderful stay at Daniel's Airbnb, the apartment was spotless and the view was absolutely stunning! Everything was just perfect, I highly recommend it!

The flat was perfectly located in the heart of everything. We did not realize the flat had no air conditioning but the breeze through the many open windows was lovely. It may not be ideal if you are a light sleeper- the church bells ring throughout the day and night and all the activity outside in the courtyard but it did not bother us at all. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!
very convenient and near Zurich bahnhof and have many tourist attractions, shops and restaurants around. however it might get a little noisy at night due to the nearby restaurants/bars.

Great location, it has a microwave which is very helpful, but the heater didn't heat very well even at the highest setting, and the showerhead wasn't securely fixed to the base. Even so, I recommend the place and will return more times.
Great apartment with everything we needed. Perfect location right on the lake and close to the tram, which took us into the city within 10 minutes. Stephanie was very friendly and responsive.

I really enjoyed my stay in Stephanie's apartment. You will walk in and know that you're stepping into someone's home and I found that quite charming. The location is excellent, steps away from train and tram stations, but I most enjoyed walking along the lake front to get into Old Town. You're also near some good cafes and a co-op for groceries along Seefeld. The apartment itself was spacious with a big bathroom and kitchen and the building is really quiet. The only slight downside for us was the largest bed was a bit uncomfortable and we probably would have appreciated two extra towels. Minor issues - I would stay here again!

Check-in was smooth and the location was convenient, with easy access to the tram. However, the overall stay was disappointing. We also noticed spider webs in several corners, and basic amenities like shampoo were not provided. For the price paid, we expected at least the essentials to be in place.
Spacious and bright apartment in a green residential area not too far from the main station. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Stayed for a short period and I loved how close it was to everything. I walked everywhere and the neighborhood was fabulous. Giancarlo answered all my questions and was very helpful.

The space was perfect and exactly what I needed. I think it was a great price for the location. Walking distance from just about everything but several stops/stations nearby if you need to take the public transportation.

Giancarlo was fantastic and efficient to communicate with. His apartment was exactly as described; immaculate and comfortable. The location was awesome for our trip; a very short walk from the train station, the Trams, and Buses. Coffee and yummy restaurants were right around the corner. I would absolutely love to stay there again and would recommend others to as well.

Giancarlo is among the most extraordinary AirBnB owners and managers I have ever met! He is a great communicator and constantly kept in touch with me to make sure that I was having a comfortable stay in Zurich. I felt immediately like at home at this beautiful, spotlessly clean and quiet apartment. I have no words kind enough to describe how happy I was to be Giancarlo’s guest! Thank you so much for your outstanding hospitality, dear Giancarlo !! Best wishes always to you !! Kiril

Great deal for the neighborhood and the space! I was a bit hesitant about only one review, but the apartment overdelivers for what is promised. The in-unit washer and dryer were super helpful for a two-week work stay. The instructions were very clear, and the apartment is well-supplied with all the essentials. Easily walkable to many restaurants, bars, and transportation but very quiet at night.

Great spot from a local apartment management team. It’s a quaint space with everything you need. It was difficult to get air flowing through the apartment, but the free laundry and stocked kitchen made up for it!

My stay was good overall. Tania communicated well and was always kind. The only issue was that I asked a lot of questions and there was a bit of confusion because I first booked the apartment and then extended my stay, so not everything was completely clear between us. But honestly, it wasn’t Tania’s fault. The apartment itself is very nice, clean, and well located in a quiet area close to the city center. I also liked the service they provide. Overall, I would recommend it and I appreciate everything Tania did for me during my stay.

Excellent, clean and spacious accommodation. Relatively price friendly parking, public transport stop right in front of the house. Very good communal accommodation. Thank you, I will be happy to come again in the future.

We had a great stay! The check-in process was easy and the place was very clean. The location was near the mall and supermarket, so it was very convenient! The only bad thing was that the second bathroom's lights were not working, but we managed and I believe it is now fixed. Overall, I would recommend this place!

Dimi's olace was really clean and location is perfect. Calm neighborhood and wakable to most of Zurich's spots. Bed Pillows are very thin so were not so comfortable however bed itself is very comfy. Would have been useful to have soap or shampoo in the toilet. Overall it was a lovely and comfortable stay.

The place is great. Close to Tram stop. It’s a studio apartment, so the space is small. One issue was that there is no Air conditioning and in summer, it can be a little distressing. However a fan was available and this softened the blow of the heat. Dimi communicates, at her own pace. Overall a good place that’s cheap and close to trams.

Melanie was incredible! 10/10 host. She was incredibly flexible and understanding when our travel plans changed, gave us breakfast & coffee in the morning and helped us plan out our day, and even helped with my laundry when one of my clothing items had a stain 😂 would definitely return for a stay with Melanie!

Dimi's place was great as our final stop before headed to Zurich airport. While it was very bare bones in terms of decoration, it was relatively clean and there was a lot of space & storage. Loved that the host was very communicative and gave clear instructions. The only thing I will note is that it was loud at night and seemed to be near a fire station as there were sirens all night long each night of our stay.
Super host, attentive and polite, amazing location and super clean apartment. I loved staying with the host.

The apartment is nice and well situated, but there were a problem with Joanna's organization and it resulted in a bad experience unfortunately. Her roommate (who were nice to me though) was in charge of the check-in and the apartment and room were messy and not very clean.

Alex was an excellent host! He gave us clear directions for a flexible check in and even met us at the team station to personally walk us to the property. He provided us great recommendations and made our stay special. I would love to stay here again. Highly recommend!

Alexander is a top communicator, professional & friendly! The place is clean and tastefully decorated. The area is residential, quiet and conveniently situated close to amenities and public transport! The only thing for travellers to bear in mind is that the flat is on the top floor of a 3/4 storey building without a lift, so not well suited to people with mobility issues. I had a fab time & hope to be back in future! Thanks again Alex!

Michael's Airbnb is a great place to stay in Zurich. The tram station is very easily accessible just 1 min walk from the Airbnb. Parking is a big advantage. The place was clean and had all amenities needed for a comfortable stay. Michael is a great host and was very responsive. We had confusion regarding parking and could sort out with him as he was very responsive. Definitely recommended.
Room was ok and location is convenient. However, found that the TV was not working after trying out several times
Great location near public transit and the lake! The apartment was exactly as shown and described, perfect for our family of 4

The apartment is very nice, in a quiet neighborhood, close to the Sbahn station (10 min for the HB). Rooms are wide, clean, well furnished. Kitchen is well equipped. It was easy to interact with the manager, who was always polite and proactive. One mishap: they left the wrong key in the mailbox, so we had to wait for the right key for a while. One small problem: the dishwasher broke down, but the manager immediately sent the technician to identify the problem. Suggestion: provide written instructions for garbage disposal. Each country has its own rules, so it should not be assumed that guests are familiar with Zurich garbage rules. I think it is a very good choice for a short stay (we spent 8 days) in Zurich.

Very cozy apartment in a good location in Zurich. I especially appreciated the comfy bed and the amount of natural light in the room. Communication with Giancarlo was easy and efficient, instructions clear and precise. I reccommend! Thank you.

Great location, so close to anything you'd want as a tourist, and easy to access even by car (2 minute walk from where cars are allowed, but extremely close for the neighbourhood). The flat is perfect for two people exploring Zurich, and I appreciated how quickly the hosts would respond when we had questions. FYI to North Americans visiting, there is no a/c (which is VERY normal for Europe), but there was a fan, which made the 35+ degrees (celsius) weather (not so normal for Europe, although more and more so every year) bearable, and the window made for a decent cross-breeze. Highly recommend this place for anyone visiting, and we'd happily stay here again!

We would love to thank Carlo for the hospitality on his place. It was an amazing experience, not only the flat was great but the location and all the support we received from Carlo and even his friend Petros was priceless. We will definitely come back again. Carlo was such a great host and responded to all the questions we had. Also, he allowed us to use the laundry providing credit on a card. Thank you so much for everything! This place is fully recommended

I had a fantastic workation here! Carlo communicated so well, helped me with little bits as the week went by and generally was an amazing host. I loved the flat, I felt right at home and super safe on my own there. The area is also fantastic as it's so close to the tram for moving about but there are also great restaurants nearby - as well as the best gelato place. Can't wait to stay again!

Very nice stay! I assume that we were first guests of the apartment because a lot of things (hair dryer, iron) were still inside the store boxes. Clean apartment, nice kitchen, responsive host. Good and convenient location: 10 minutes to city center, 30 to the airport, 3 minutes to the big supermarket. Under the building nice pizzeria. Highly recommended

Very nice apartment! It was better than advertised, with some major upgrades including a large TV, and a new sofa, coffee maker, and balcony table. There’s not much going on nearby but public transportation is close and it’s 15 minutes to the Bahnhof and everything. Great hosts too.
Everything was excellent! The apartment took good care of me and my travel companions. All my communication with Lina was nice and easy.

The place was very clean and generally comfortable.The kitchen was well-equipped with everything we needed, including a coffee maker and toaster. The beds were comfortable, but the pillows could use improvement. The property was warm and had nice towels. Access was easy, and it was quiet overall. The instructions provided were clear and Lina was a great host.

The van is very nice and cozy. It is of course a small space but ideal if you're looking to spend one night transiting through the city. The only downside (probably because we have stayed on a friday) was the noise coming from the square nearby; there was a group of young people partying.

Great accommodation and conveniently located within a short walking distance to the nearest tram. The space was neat and tidy with all amenities included as advertised in the listing. The self check-in process was seamless and the host always responsive. Thank you Delta.

Great location - close to public transit, a delicious bakery and convenience stores. Apartment was very clean and as pictured, very spacious (even with 6 adults), but the walls are thin. Communication was fast and easy. Would definitely stay again!

We enjoyed our stay in this 3 bedroom apartment. We visited Zurich on the hottest day of the summer (92 F), so the first night was a bit warm without air conditioning. But the apartment was everything we could hope for and large enough for 6 people (4 adults and 2 teenagers). Nico was very responsive to our questions and helpful.
My flight got cancelled the day before, I informed them that I won’t be there but they never responded. Unreliable and unhelpful host.
the place is a perfect location but the rooms are under my expectation for 100 CHF, the bathroom and room was not clean
Stefani was very welcoming and the apartment was great! I recommend:)

Our host was very responsive. We were in Zurich for the Eras tour. He sent us articles regarding the concert/rules/traffic. He also took the time to share local recommendations for food and activities as my family was visiting from the USA. He made sure we had clear instructions to get into the building and upstairs to the apartment. We had so much to do in Zurich that we didn’t even mind there not being a television. Would definitely recommend a stay here!

We really enjoyed our stay in Zurich, Tobias gave us clear instructions on how to find the apartment and was very accommodating. The apartment is in the middle of the city and is in a great location to reach most things on foot, everything is available, the apartment has a very minimalistic but nice interior.

Jens place is so wonderful, this is my second time staying there. It's perfect for people looking to explore Switzerland on a budget. It's very close to public transportation, which I found to be the best thing thing about the apartment. When he was there, he was very polite and helpful, made me feel at home. 10/10 I would definitely stay again.
The apartment was very close to the train station which was very helpful and easy!

As the listing states, this location is right by the train station. During the day, there is a lot of traffic in the area and trains that you can see from the windows. At night, there is significantly less noise. There are a few lounges at the street level open until 2 or 5 am (depending on the day), however, we did not hear them on the Monday or Tuesday night we were there. The unit is quite spacious and looks the same as the pictures. Floor heating can be turned on and works quite well. There is a grocery store with a few minutes, walking. The listing does state there is no elevator. The unit is on the 2nd floor, so you do need to go up from ground level to 1, then to 2 on a wide, winding staircase.

Stefani's place is very clean and comfortable to stay. He is very easy to communicate with and always response quickly. Location is very convenient and close to the transportation stops. The only thing is the area is noisy since the train rail is near by, you also can hear the traffic all the time from the main road. There is a restaurant on the main floor, you may hear people talking in the middle of the night. We have to open the windows for cool air circulation but the noise is much louder while you sleep, Stefani is very thoughtful to have a fan on each bedroom. That's really helpful. If there is AC for this unit, it's possible to close the windows, the noise may not be a issue at all. Other than the noise issue, this is a good place to stay.

The apartment is conveniently located near the train station and restaurants. It is well maintained and has basic amenities. However, because of the restaurant’s nearby it can get noisy in the night at times. Also, given the heat in the summer months, I would recommend bigger fans in every room. While they had 2 portable fans they were small and did not cover enough surface area.

Everything is very good, especially for the price in Zurich. The flat is clean, easy to access and near a train station. The only little thing is that sadly during our stay there wasn’t not hot water, I don’t know if it was just during our stay or it’s always like that. Everything else is great !

Pascale was so friendly and responsive to any requests from my side so I felt really comfortable and safe. The place has good connection to city centre. In the kitchen you gonna find everything you need. Huge bedroom, plenty of space. Washing machine was a life saver. Happy to choose Pascale as my host and next time will do it again. Thank you

Pascale's place is only 5 mins walk from the nearest train station and many tram stops nearby which was very convenient. She also provided many good food recommendations and was very responsive. Home was very cutely decorated and cozy. She was also very kind to allow us to store our luggage after check out time due to our late flight, which we appreciate it a lot.

Listing is exactly as posted. Very nice accommodation & there were shutters that kept the bedrooms cool during the hot summer compared to other places I’ve stayed. Location is very close to bus and train stations. Airport only 10m walk & 5m train away OR 5m walk and 15m bus ride. Grocery store was close. Place was clean and kitchen was nice. TVs and fans in both bedrooms was great! Host is very helpful and responsive & I would stay here again if I was in the area 🙂 The only thing to note for me was that there is no “living room” area - however this made no impact on our stay.

The host was incredible and communicated very well. The place was clean, easy to find, and very centrally located in a fantastic location. However, please note that there is no shared living space, which makes it nearly impossible to hang out with your party. It is just two bedrooms, a kitchen, and two bathrooms. Additionally, the showers and tubs are difficult to get in and out of, even for young and healthy individuals. I am 5’10” and the side came up to my mid-thigh. There is a built-in seat that makes it very difficult, as you have to stand in one spot directly under the water. Otherwise, it’s a great place to lay your head and the host is fantastic.

Checkin was marvelously clear and easy thanks to Dragesa. However the flat was much smaller than the pictures showed, therefore than expected. It was a little claustrophobic. One of the 2 bathrooms didn’t have a sink to wash your hands. Everything needs maintenance and a good refurbishment. The owner should charge half the amount of money it asks. All in all, the experience was great thanks to Dragesa!

near to the station... a very big house. very comfortable stay for 4 people. Gabi got everything at home. she had a proper rice cooker. being indians we loved it. the place comes with detailed instructions and lot of love. feel like home. the 48 steps up might look like downside. but it's the best house we stayed throughout the Europe trip. it has everything u can think about. we were slightly unprepared for my titlis trip, Gabi arranged gloves and mufflers too for a small price. however we werent aware of that arrangement and we got a full set at decathlon. Gabi is a sweet person. if she arranges a lift or a caretaker for the luggages, this is a first class house. best stay at Zurich . I would definitely visit again.

We spent two months in the apartment and we loved it. It’s not a typical Airbnb place because it’s a real personal space and it feels like that with all its ups and downs (mostly ups). The location is amazing for longer stays and even for shorter ones- it’s the best part of Zurich by a long shot and the trams to the center take 5-7 minutes and pass every 2-3 minutes. We would definitely recommend it for any single person or a couple who wants to experience true Zurich and it’s charm and calm

Positives: Very nice place with quite a bit of room. Easy to get to with the metro stop only minutes away. Mini market conveniently located also minutes away. Drawbacks: Price (however, Switzerland in general is expensive), Location, yes we chose it however, probably would opt for something even closer to Zurich central The floors in the apartment are very noisy and we received complaints from the neighbors. Overall, a great spot and host if willing to be a little outside of the center.

Flat was clean, spacious and exactly as described. Couple stops away from Zurich city centre but was convenient to get from A to B with both a train and tram accessible. Just fyi you're based on the third floor with no lift.

I recently stayed at Kathrin‘s amazing apartment, which is stylish, well-equipped and impeccably clean. The location is perfect and the host went above and beyond to make my stay enjoyable, providing valuable tips and always being available to help. I highly recommend this AirBnB for anyone looking for a superb experience. I can’t wait to visit again!

Kathrin’s place is at the heart of Zurich, really easy to reach and allows you to access the city smoothly. The flat is very cozy with all necessary amenities. Kathrin was super helpful with all inquiries and gave really good recommendations!
Olaf is a great host, kind, responsive and the home is close to public transport into Zürich city centre.

I liked the room. Spacious and cosy. Comfortable large bed. I was not aware, that 3-4 rooms are rented out in the apartment. I thought I would only be sharing the apartment with Olaf. It matters as there are more people coming and going. My room was next to the kitchen and bathroom and I hear everything in the hallway. There was activity until 12.30-1 am starting again 5.30-6 am. As I was there for a conference- with many hours of lectures - I needed a good sleep. This was unfortunately not possible. Had I know I would be sharing with several people I would not have booked the place. Otherwise the place was fine - good location. Easy to walk everywhere.
Walkable to shops and restaurant，worth the price of it!

We found the apartment to be well located though finding it the first time was a little challenging. Guests should not give up. It is located near a large mall and two grocery stores for easy access.The bus and train stops were very close. It is very spacious.

This layout for sleeping was perfect for us and we thought the location was fantastic. It was even more walkable than I expected, and lots of green space around. Peaceful even though it’s a big apartment building. We had everything we needed but nothing more—furnishings are not luxury but the beds and bedding are comfortable. I would have appreciated if more linens, a few coffee pods, and some other basics for the kitchen were provided and if the grass on the little yard had been trimmed. High char was a plus but a baby bed would have been even better! But all in all a good price point for Zurich and lots of space to hang out.

Valentina has a lovely apartment in a calm but vibrant area. A lot of beautiful streets, restaurants, cafes, all you need really right outside :) The apartment looks exactly like the photos, very cosy and homey and equipped with everything one would need! Super easy communication all around and lovely stay! Highly recommend! :)

I had a truly wonderful stay at Luca’s place! The apartment is beautifully maintained, clean, and full of thoughtful touches that made me feel immediately at home. Everything was exactly as described —if not better— and the peaceful atmosphere made my time in Zurich extra special. Communication with Luca was smooth, kind, and always helpful. He provided clear check-in and check-out instructions, and his mother, who welcomed me, was absolutely lovely and made me feel incredibly comfortable. I wholeheartedly recommend staying here— this place is a gem. Thank you again, Luca, for your hospitality. I would definitely love to come back!

We had an extremely good experience staying at Luca’s Airbnb in Zurich. The place was very clean, well-maintained, and nicely decorated, making it feel cozy and comfortable from the moment we arrived. It’s in a great location, with easy access to public transport, shops, and restaurants, yet still peaceful and quiet. Luca was an excellent host—responsive, helpful, and thoughtful throughout our stay. Everything was exactly as described, and felt very welcomed. I would highly recommend staying here if you’re visiting Zurich .
Great apartment and super friendly and helpful host! Totally recommend the place!

The apartment had insufficient bathrooms (only one toilet upstairs for four bedrooms), insufficient furniture in living room for sitting, very hard beds and even harder pillows, and a floor in living room that was coming loose. There were no brochures or maps for tourists and no Zürich pass for guests. . It was very plain and uninviting. It was however convenient to trains and trams and was clean, and the hosts were very responsive.

The house was nice, and the rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, making for a pleasant stay and good night's sleep. However, light sleepers should be aware that there is some train noise nearby. The host was responsive and communicated promptly throughout our stay. When we encountered an issue with the dryer, the host quickly arranged for someone to come and inspect it. One inconvenience was that the lift to the house was not working. As we were a group of seven traveling with luggage, carrying everything up the stairs was quite challenging. Guests should also note that soap, shampoo, and laundry detergent are not provided.

Ornella is a wonderful and generous host. The apartment was very enjoyable and quickly felt like home. I really enjoyed the opulent sofa and the ‘50s/‘60s furnishings. The view is gorgeous and the location combines the best of both worlds…a minute to the tram, a quick walk into the city even without public trans. and great walks through mountainous woods, jogs along the river, all at the doorstep. I will definitely return.

John’s flat is even better than the pictures and previous reviews describe. Really great easy location, relaxing apartment, fantastic host. Would happily stay here again if I’m back in Zurich. Appreciate John’s responsive communication, care and attention.

The place was less than 100 meters to the tram. Tram took 10 min to reach Zurich HB. Location is super amazing! from airport, direct tram to home. Place was clean and nice with beautiful plants. Highly recommended! The only thing is that the wooden floor made noise while walking. Stay was perfect! Thank you Theresa.

Rafael's place was beautiful, compact and close to grocery store, Coop. Also walkable to bus stop which directly to train station. However the common area was a bit small but the kitchen are fully equipped. Other than that, everything are excellent.
The house is so quiet and clean. The host is so kind and cooperative.

We were a bit worried at first because the flat had only several reviews and the price was lower than flats nearby. But I should say it is the perfect place to stay. The host is not a private person, but a city agency of accommodation. Communication with the host is super quick and easy. The flat, cutlery, and amenities are extremely clean (we were with a child), and there is cleaning available once a week. Downstairs there are 2 washing machines and 2 dryers - they are quite nice not dirty. Also there is a gym downstairs. We super recommend this host and this block of flats for short and long staying in Zurich.

María was a great host and very responsive, apartment looks like the photos. I was unable to connect to the wifi while I was there but Maria was responsive and tried to help nonetheless. The apartment is nice but the walls are a bit thin and I could hear noise from the street and entryway. Not a big deal but if you are a light sleeper bring earplugs!

Agnes’ apartment was perfect for our stay. The apartment was very clean, tidy and exactly what our family needed. She made sure we were very comfortable during our stay and well informed about the neighbourhood. Agnes was helpful in any way needed and very easy to communicate with.

Beautiful home with good location :) Very near to the station and easy way to get to and from the airport The house is equipped with everything needed for cooking and enjoying (netflix🎈) Hoping to come back again!

The apartment is even better than the pictures- it is charming and stylishly decorated in minimal style. It is spacious, very clean and the kitchen is well equipped. Delia was very responsive and helpful, and her colleague met us for check in and even carried our bags up. As described, the location is in a very colourful neighbourhood so there is plenty of noise from the street activity and bars and clubs, but there are earplugs provided. It is a very convenient location for seeing Zurich with a close walk and easy public transport options. Definitely recommend this place!

Delia and Harold communicate really well and we found the place easily and parked in a private spot next to the apartment. Harold helped us in and even carried some of our bags. So helpful ands super kind. The place is perfect and just like the photos. It’s a buzzy, lively area which may not be to everyone’s choosing but we enjoyed it. The hidden gem is the river (15 mins walk) where you can swim and sunbathe. Really amazing! Highly recommend.

Delia and her husband were super helpful and responsive. They gave recommendations, responded right away and let us store our bags and receive a last minute parking spot if we wanted it. I’d say the place isn’t exactly how it appears in photos, just an old property. It was very noisy even on week days outside and upstairs so I wouldn’t necessarily come here to relax but if you want to stay out, it’s lively and fun. The only other thing is the area is a bit dicey, I wouldn’t stay here alone as a woman but felt comfortable with my boyfriend.

This was the perfect spot to explore Zurich and the areas nearby. The central location was great for catching local transit, and close to the trains station for getting in and out of town. The space was very comfortable and had everything we needed. Delia was super helpful before, during and after our trip. Highly recommend!

A nice, very well-kept and clean apartment. The location is near to the train station, and also not too far from the downtown area. The space is definitely on the small side. There was a nespresso coffee machine there, but unfortunately no pods to use.

Great location! The apartment is really small and the bathroom is not great. If you plan to stay for just a weekend, the location is absolutely perfect and I would highly recommend it! However, I wouldn't recommend a longer stay due to the bathroom and size.

We had a nice stay at Mateusz’s place. It was clean and had a relatively good kitchen set-up. Although, we felt the neighborhood was in a more noisy, night life adjacent part of town than we were hoping for. It was fortunately very easy to take the bus or tram into the other parts of Zurich; however, I would not stay again in this neighborhood.

We had a great stay at Oscar’s apartment. Everything was very clean, and Oscar was friendly and welcoming. We felt right at home. The room was quiet, so we slept well, and the location is convenient — there’s a fast connection to the city center by bus and tram. We’d definitely stay again!

For my first solo trip and my very first Airbnb, I am absolutely thrilled! Oscar was incredibly helpful, and the apartment itself was wonderfully comfortable. Being in such a good neighborhood, so close to all the city's major tourist hubs, made exploring a breeze. This was an excellent experience from start to finish, and I 100% recommend it!
Julius apartment is very big and nice. the area is super calm, close to tram and bus stop and close to nature

Lovely apartment (accurate listing) spotlessly clean. Very clear communication and precise check in/out instructions. Great location - few minutes walk from tram stop or a pleasant (25-30 minutes) walk into central Zurich either along the waterside promenade or the street. Highly recommend.

this was an amazing apartment. very well kept and modern. my fiancee and I loved that it was super close to the Zurich Main Station since we used the SBB trains during our entire week stay. the only downfall of this space is the walls are thin. we stayed during the weekend and the bar next door was extremely loud until nearly 1am each night.

We spent 4 days and we had a great stay at this apartment! It’s clean, well-maintained, and located within walking distance to Zurich's Central Train Station. The apartment itself is very nice, although it would have been even better with a microwave. The area can be quite noisy from Friday to Sunday, as there’s a bar downstairs, and the sound is very loud – almost like it's inside the apartment, even considering the typical Swiss quietness. It’s also worth noting that there are some instances of illegal product sales right across from the building during certain hours, so a bit of caution is advised. However, Lara was amazing and made our check-in process very easy. Despite the surrounding environment, with a little care, I would definitely recommend this place.

The appartment is very modern and cozy. You can reach the city center by foot or tram within 10 minutes. Unfortunately, there were several long dark hair in the provided towels as well as beds and bathroom.

A modern and great apartment in an excellent location. Great connections with public transportation. Wonderful view. Easy communication with clear instructions. Few minor improvements could be made, such as sharper kitchen knives and better vacuumed carpets and leaves should be cleaned from the balcony. However, we would gladly return and warmly recommend the apartment!

We had a great stay at Frank’s place in Zurich. His co host,Liv was very helpful and responsive to our questions . Checking in time was flexible and easy . The apartment was very clean and comfortable and spacious for 4 people. I definitely would stay here again if I am in Zurich.

Had a great stay! The host was very responsive and friendly. The place was exactly as advertised. tidy and well equipped. It’s conveniently located near bus stops for easy travel. Will definitely book again! 5 stars for me!

The place was clean and had a door code that made for easy check-in and check-out. The only issue we had was that on the listing it lists having a washer and dryer. While technically true the washer and dryer is not in-unit and is shared by the whole building. Because we had only a short stay we were not able to get the laundry card from host to be able to do our laundry.

The place was superb! Location was great with easy access to trams and trains. Only near from the airport and central area of Zurich. There were also variety of restaurants around the area. Will definitely stay here again when I visit Zurich in the future!

The flat is nice and comfortable overall. However, I wanted to mention an issue with the bathroom setup. The shower area is open and only separated by curtains, so when someone takes a bath, water spreads across the floor and doesn’t drain properly. There’s also no outlet for the excess water, and the area stays damp.

The room was nice and comfortable, and the kitchen was fully equipped. It’s in a great location, not far from the train station and close to a Coop supermarket. However, during my stay, the bathroom door had an issue and couldn’t be closed, and the lighting in the living room was too dim, which made cooking quite difficult
Great stay! The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and well-located. The host was responsive and helpful. Highly recommend!

Overall good stay, with the caveat that no shampoo or soap was provided and we had to buy our own. Also, we weren’t able to get additional towels (we were given 4, but we used two for the body, 1 for the hands, 1 to clean up a water spill), but the bnb had good location and pricing. I’d recommend staying and bringing your own body cleaning products.

Great neighborhood, spotless place with a cool balcony and backyard!! A real Zürich experience. Felt like a quick 15 min walk everywhere. We were required to be quiet between 10pm and 7am, but the neighbors upstairs and downstairs didn’t follow the same rules which wouldn’t have bothered me if the rules weren’t so explicitly stated in the listing. Stayed during a heat wave had a specific request that led to some back forth. That being said all of the hosts were very gracious and accommodating. Overall a wonderful little place, well equipped with amenities and a cool spot to call home for any duration!

The apartment was exactly as described. The only thing I would note is that it’s listed for four people, but I’m not sure how four could fit comfortably at once. It’s quite spacious for three guests, though. It’s close to the train station and just one stop (Oerlikon) away from both the airport and Zurich HB. Because of the weather, we didn’t get a chance to enjoy the balcony, but it would be great in nice weather. The host, Stefani, answered all our questions and was very kind. Thanks for their hospitality.

Stefani and team is remarkably responsive. I was stunned with the prompt reply and measures. After my checkin, I have realised that workplace I.e. work table and chair was missing and I requested Stefani that it world be very helpful for me if I get a table and a chair to work as it was my official visit. After 1 hour she rang the bell with new table and chair. It was overwhelming . I wish every Airbnb admins are like this :) Bravo for Stefani and team for this. My stay was very pleasing and hassle free, great location, easily reachable, neat and clean and soothing.

Stefani’s property was in an incredible location, as it was less than a 10-minute train ride from the airport, and it had several tram and S-Bahn options to commute into the heart of Zürich. Additionally, the flat was extremely clean and all of the amenities worked really well. My friend and I also really enjoyed using the balcony to have our supper and to enjoy the summer breeze. Stefani was also very responsive to all of our queries throughout our stay. We really recommend this property if you plan on visiting Zürich!

Excellent stay. Studio apartment was clean, tidy and as shown in photos. Easy check in and excellent communication with the host. The studio is within easy walking distance (2 blocks) to the Oerlikon train station. From there it is only a short journey to the airport or the Zurich main train station. The studio is very quiet and no street or train noise with windows closed. I would absolutely recommend this apartment and would return again.

The location is a little outside of the main area of Zürich however, it’s very conveniently located near bus and train stations. There is also convenient access to the grocery store. I really appreciated that they had a coffee machine with a milk frothing element. It was a little extra that helped a little with our coffee budget. The apartment was small, but it was very clean. The communication with hosts was excellent. We were a bit of a last-minute booking and they were quick to get back to us and confirm the booking as well as answer questions. Also, transportation to the airport was very easy from this location.

Nice, spacious apartment with all the necessities. It is conveniently located close to the centre, but the place is a bit noisy - it is right next to a busy road and the windows do not appear soundproof at all. Also, the small side windows have no blinds, which is not perfect for privacy.
Nice, comfy and close to the lake - almost perfect! Would rent again if available next time :)
The place is very clean, and located close to the lake and the train to the airport. The host is very friendly and helpful and super responsive. Would definitely recommend!
Really fast answering always when we had questions about something. Also very easy to reach from the airport by tram. Clean rooms and was just what we were expecting!

Great place to stay with family and it's only a 5 min train ride to the main station "HB". Stefani was super responsive and provided great instructions. The place was neat and quite spacious. Highly recommend!

The apartment is in a fantastic location, close to everything you need. The accommodations are generally comfortable, though it can get quite warm at night during the summer. Unfortunately, there's no AC, and the current fan provided isn't quite sufficient to cool the space. For the price, I would have expected a better fan, and I hope the host considers upgrading it soon. That being said, the apartment itself is nice and would be perfect with improved ventilation.

I found Enada apartment since I changed my booked accommodation. Enada took good help to support me and gave me good description of what she offers although I was very a lots of questions before confirm since my experienced before. It is very good strategic location apartment since near the Zurich HB station and huge area for me and my wife, although short noticed however she could prepare the accommodation for us. Bit crumbs on the floor that I have to swapped but it was not big deal. Also her stuffs still remained since she live there also if not offered. She is very helpful if I have some questions surrounding and also with others. Many thanks.

I had a nice stay at Vilma’s place! The home had all the necessities and was exactly as described. Vilma was a very friendly host, making check-in and the stay easy. The neighborhood was quiet and safe, with a nearby bus stop. I would definitely stay again, highly recommended!
Our trip was great! the place is very well communicated and very close to restaurants, cafes etc

A really nice air bnb and very clean. Would definitely come back and it was a great bonus there is parking right behind the building which was great because we had a car and it’s very hard to find parking on streets.

We really enjoyed our stay, the apartment was exactly as we expected and even better. Everything was comfortable, clean, and beautifully prepared. Thank you, Stefani and team, for your kindness and for always responding so quickly to any questions or requests. We truly appreciated it 🤍

Thank you for a clean and tidy convenient location for us to stay in on our international travels it was noisy due to construction and a small Appartments but the place its self was need tidy and accommodating.

Stefani and the team is super responsive. I got quick replies to my questions. In general the place was clean and nice. It was easy to check-in and clean towels were provided. The only issue we had was the area was noisy if you left your window open. There was a cafe or some sort of shisha bar near the place and there were loud people staying pretty late like up until it’s 12 am. Whenever we opened our windows they were all looking inside 🤦‍♂️. The host is amazing btw, this is not related to them. In general it was good value. Thanks!

Great stay! The host is very responsive and helpful. The location is great, a few minutes walk from the tramstation and supermarket. Walking to the city centre is also possible (15-20 min walk). There is a elevator. The studio is clean and complete. It doesn't show on the pictures, but there is a little kitchen with the necessities you need. Bed is comfy, pillow are for me personally too soft, but still good. There is a desk. The bathroom is clean and has a bathtub.

We had a great stay at Délia’s apartment in Zurich! The place feels even bigger in person than it looks in the photos, with two comfortable bedrooms and a separate kitchen. Although the street outside is busy, the bedroom was well soundproofed, so the noise didn’t bother us at all. The only small issue — which didn’t affect our stay — was that one of the curtains in the main bedroom wasn’t working properly, so we got some morning light. Other than that, everything was great. I definitely recommend this apartment!

The location is close to many restaurants and supermarkets. The kitchen is very well equipped with a new and efficient oven and a full size fridge. The only drawback was the noise from the neighboring bars on Saturday night. The music was on until 2 am. It gets stuffy during hot summer nights since the windows had to be closed to keep the noise and 2nd hand smoking away. The rest of the nights were quiet and fine. I’d book it again given how reasonable the rent is but just avoid the weekend stay. It might be a good choice for young folks who enjoy night life and don’t mind the noise.

Stylish, yes; sterile in a non surgical way, yes! There is a kitchen and a mocha coffee pot, but no complimentary coffee, not even for one day. There is no extra light bulbs in case one is burnt. Bring your own shampoo, conditioner and body wash. There is only a tiny bar of soap. One table light has no plug to be used The modem is right on top of one of the night table. There are no blackout curtains and the only one that is thick enough does not even cover the glass door. The place is spacious yes, and a great bathtub, but the fact that you have to bring your own bubble bath bottle does not worth the value. If these amenities would have been included in this place, then it would have deserved 5 stars.
The room is very clean and quiet. Easy to reach every place. The host is very responsible, communicative.

Our accommodation fell through last minute and we were able to book Dimi’s Airbnb and check in an hour later due to their great response time. Location is great, only 5 minute walk to Stadelhofen station, and 10 minutes to the lake. It would be a 25-30 min walk down hill to the main station but the tram line is also around the corner. Airbnb is very clean and was perfect for what we were needing during our 5 days in Zürich.

Location was great, apartment magnific and probable something that I missed from the description (or doesn't exist, or it was opened by mistake), the access to the building roof was open and me with my wife enjoyed the morning coffee there with the view towards Zürichberg, which was amazing.

Annabelle was an amazing host, quick to reply, gave recommendations for things to see and do around Zurich and was flexible with check out times. The apartment itself is in a good location for public transport to the city centre and feels nice and homely inside. The balcony is also a bonus, we’d love to visit Zurich again so this apartment will be at the top our of list of places to stay!
Lovely place truly home away from home. The location is quiet and with easy public transport (trams and buses) to city center. Highly recommend!

We loved our stay in Kenny's Wilson Apartment - it was perfect for our 1 night stay in Zurich. The apartment is so well set up, and easy walking distance from the main train station and other sights in the city. However, it is the friendliness and kindness of the hosts that made our experience memorable, including providing us with a great meal at their pizza restaurant under the apartment. Could not recommend more highly, and would love to come back one day!

Had a really great stay at Kenny’s place. Apartment was clean, had everything we needed. Comfy bed, nice shower. Plenty of fans. The metal blackout curtains were a very nice, unexpected treat. I think I mostly liked the location. I felt like it was plenty close enough to the train station and public transit, maybe 10-15 minutes from the old town by foot or transit. But the neighborhood itself was very quiet, charming, and a real joy to walk around. Plus, we got a free meal! Which was very good and definitely welcome after a long day of traveling. I would definitely stay here again. In fact, we wanted to stay an extra day once we were there! Highly recommend this stay. :)
We had a good stay for two nights here. The only major issue was that we were unable to use the dryer and due to the weekend, it could not be attended to during our stay.
I’ve stayed at Giancarlo’s places previously and they’ve all lived up to expectations. I would not hesitate to recommend any of the locations that he manages.

Giorgio was very friendly and helpful, and then introduced me to his Mum, Franka, who took over looking after us. She has been very helpful to us, and has provided everything we have needed. The flat has a beautiful outdoor space, and it is very easy to get into town, either by walking or by a short bus or tram ride. It is in the hills, so walking back takes getting used to, but that keeps you fit! You can also go up to Sonneberg Park and get an amazing view of the lake and the city. I would highly recommend this place, and also Giorgio and Franka. They are a pleasure to deal with.

The apartment is in a very convenient location, close to tram and train stops, super markets (even for late hours) and restaurants and has great views. It was clean and organised, with all amenities as described. Bed and sofa were a bit uncomfortable for our preference, but the rest of the apartment was fine. The host was friendly and responsive and gave us clear instructions on anything we asked. Overall, a great stay!
Perfect for Hallenstadion, 8 min walking from the flat. The place is clean, tidy and good quality overall. I'd be pleased to come back here when I'm in Zürich again

Clean, modern apartment with easy transit access. However, the listing was unclear: there's no A/C, and the 3 bedrooms are split across two separate apartments with no internal connection — important to know for families. Communication was polite and responsive, though I was disappointed to be mistakenly charged for missing pillows that were left behind. That was resolved, and overall we had a good stay.
We were disappointed at first because this rental was actually 2 apartments, not one. The ad was a bit misleading. We made the best of it, however and enjoyed our holiday in Zurich!

We had two adjacent units and Stefani was very helpful in allowing us to check into one an hour early due to a tour we had scheduled. Unfortunately in the scramble to get our unit ready the adjacent one was not cleaned by normal check in. However, Stefani responded immediately and cleaners were there within 5 minute which was great. Very convenient to both trams and trains but busy traffic neighborhood. Enjoyed our stay!!

The place is nice, comfortable, and convenient for a couple(2)…relatively close to public transport and Rose was a very responsive and friendly host! However, it is right next to a busy elevated highway intersection as thus very noisy if you need to open any window!!!…which we needed since it was a very hot summer week and it has NO air-conditioning, so you needed the air to cool it down. In cooler days it would probably be ok since the windows are modern and offer good insulation so you do not hear much of the noisy road. If the noise foes not bother you…it is great. All in all, a good place to stay though!

I can’t say enough good things about Monika’s place. It’s a lovely location, easy to get anywhere you want to go on foot or by transit. There are grocery stores and good restaurants nearby. Yet it’s a quiet street, very peaceful. The apartment is serene, well equipped and so comfortable. Monika is an excellent host and has thought of everything you might need. She was very welcoming and friendly, checking in with us but not intrusive. I would absolutely stay with Monika again and highly recommend her apartment to anyone visiting Zurich.

Fantastic Apartment to stay at. Our host Monika was very helpful and accommodated us very well. Super clean , with all the amenities we needed. Great location too where you are far enough away from the noise, but also walking distance to everything

Amazing place! Felt at home right from the start and wouldn’t mind staying longer or coming back another time! Beautiful location although it does take a bit to walk to the centre (about 1h) but beautiful walk all the way along the lake. With the tram it’s much faster and takes about 15min. I was a bit disappointed that it was first said that I can get clean towels and sheets as I please but then charged extra, initially 75€ then reduced to 35€ for fresh sheets.

Claudia’s place was perfect as a home base and jumping off point, for 1-2 people, to get all around Switzerland. Claudia was very responsive and helpful. Great location! Very peaceful and private, right across the street from the tram, 8 minute walk to the train station, and 4 minute walk to Aldi. The balcony was lovely for morning and evening reflection, tea, and writing. Looks exactly like photos, small but lots of storage space. Bed and bedding was very comfortable! It was a good spot for our first time being in Zurich! Thank you, Claudia!

We loved our stay at this Airbnb! The apartment is a good size and in a quiet area, and the views are fantastic! It is worth noting that the bus and train stops are both ~10 minute walk, as well as a grocery store. When the description mentions “10 minutes from Zurich HB”, that is 10 minutes in a car, closer to 30-45 for public transit. The only real issue we had is the blinds in the bedroom do not block out the light in the morning! There are large gaps between the blinds and the window/building and it got bright very early. Consider an eye-mask if you are a light sleeper or can’t sleep with daylight!

Stefani's place was great and perfect for our family. It was actually two apartments, but the whole floor. We were all very comfortable. Stefani was fantastic, very communicative, and shared a lot of information about things to do in Zurich. While the apartments are not in the center of Zurich, they are right next to all of the transportation options; all travel was inexpensive and quick to get anywhere, and they were perfect. It was actually fun to travel around the city this way; it helped us to understand the city better. I would recommend Stefani's place to anyone.
A very nice place, great location, clean and a very responsive host. The only improvement might be a bigger blanket/two blankets when two persons stay there.
Great place and the host is very responsive, however the stay is a little far from main attractions and the bed is small for 2 people.
A great place to stay when visiting Zurich. You get everywhere easily by public transport or car and the builduing was very calm and lovely to stay at. Very nicely kept apartment.

This was so conveniently located just a quick walk from the train station. It was very clean and we were very comfortable with the accommodations. The host was very responsive and kind. We loved Switzerland!

This was a fantastic Airbnb. It was great with kids and easy to access. No elevator but nothing like a good workout carrying a bunch of bags! Just be mindful if you are elderly or have a disability. Kitchen, beds, etc. were all great. The only con I have is that people were making lots of noise until 2 am. I should’ve have complained but I know people are also just trying to enjoy their vacation and this may be a one off instance. You also can’t open the windows because downstairs there’s a hookah bar and lots of people smoking weed. Again, totally fine with me but just don’t want it in the home and around kids. Other than that, host was great and we really enjoyed the convenience of the location. So easy to get to airport and to other places.
This place is very new, very clean, and very convenient as it is close to the train station (5 min walk or less!). My family and I enjoyed our stay here and will recommend it to others!

The apartment was very nice, tidy, and clean. The only challenges we faced were that there was no elevator, and during hot weather there is no air conditioning, while the fans didn’t cool the place enough. But overall, it was a very comfortable and very clean place, and we truly enjoyed our stay.
Perfect place and stay! The hosts are super warm!

It was in a very good location, the toilet is very old, he needs a full refurbishment, lift very old towels, I wish they have a bigger and better quality. Overall experience is OK but the toilets need to improve.

Good choice for young travellers! Super location. Close to Zurich HB station, ETH main campus, and many bus stations. Warm and quiet room, sufficient room for 2 people. And the toilet and the shower room is very clean. The host gives us very clear instructions on how to use the room and the house with sticky notes. Quite cute.

Thanks to Maxime, we had a really enjoyable stay at Zürich. Maxime himself was so friendly and responsible and the house itself was clean, warm and located in a good location. In general, I am sure that if I ever travel to Zürich again, I will try to book Maxime's AirBnB again.
Easy check in and easy stay. Water in the morning wasn't hot, but the place was very nice.

Nice and spacious apartment, had everything we could need. The location is also good but a bit noisy. Our host was great with communication, answered any questions we had and tried to solve any issues in a reasonable time. The only down side was the air conditioning, we went there in Summer and honestly it was a bit too hot for us, the portable air conditioning in the apartment is more like a fan and doesn’t do much cooling.

Sara’s place is perfectly situated very close to old town. Lots of restaurants and places of interest within walkable Distance . The apt was very clean and well maintained. The kitchen had basic utensils( if you plan on cooking mostly then it can be a challenge) but lot of great restaurants close by. Sara was able to provide high chair and baby crib for my baby which was greatly appreciated. She is also a very responsive host! Made our stay very comfortable. The only recommendation to the host is to replace the sofa bed. It was pretty squeaky and uncomfortable to sleep in.

Overall, we had a good stay, and the host was kind and helpful. However, there were a few minor issues during our visit. There was no gas available for cooking, and the electricity supply was very limited, making it difficult to charge even two phones. The host kindly allowed us to cook dinner at her place, which we appreciated, but it would have been nice to have gas available at the accommodation itself, as we were unable to prepare breakfast or lunch. Despite these inconveniences, we enjoyed our stay overall, especially because of the convenient location close to the train station, the city center, and swimming areas.

Wonderful apartment in the heart of Zurich. It was easily walkable to (just about) anywhere you would want to go to experience what the city has to offer., including the boat tour dock and train station. Gil is an outstanding host, quick to respond and extremely helpful with advice. We highly recommend this AirBnb Thank you, Gil, for a great experience

There were four of us and we absolutely loved our stay! The space was spotless, spacious, and felt so comfortable. Perfect central location, we could walk everywhere. Would definitely stay here again!

The flat was very clean, very well located, and it has a great view from the roof. Chris was friendly, helpful and easy to talk to. The only thing I'd improve would be the check-in process, the flat has many switches, buttons and remotes to control the lift, main door and windows/blinds which are not intuitive, and the host was not fully sure how they work either, so it took me a bit of time to figure it all out, but other than that I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Zurich.

Great location and decent-sized apartment with lots of natural light. Note there is no AC, but the fan provided makes it very bearable during the summer months. Dimi was a great and communicative host. Would recommend!
Thanks for the stay Dimi. The space was as described and more with everything you could need for a short or long stay also located in a very walkable location.
Location was good and the stay was worth it

Nice staff, OK value for money. Nice temperature in the room. A little outside of the city center and therefore not that much of interest in the immediate surroundings, apart for some good options for food. Only a few parking spaces available, and quite expensive (though «expensive» goes for everything in Zurich).
My wife and I had a wonderful couple of days in Zurich while staying at Hotel Stoller. It is a convenient location with great public transport and matches the description.

Good location, close to tram and train station, bars right outside. Didn’t have any noise problems even though there is a bar right outside. Unfortunately, the place wasn’t very clean. Found a chewed gum on top of the shower soap dispenser, hairs on the bed, soap and shampoo dispensers were empty. The wifi didn’t work although we messaged host and he supplied another wifi connection. They advertised to have a freezer, but no freezer at all. Washing machine is at the basement level which is all ok but have to supply own detergent. Host was responsive only on some things.

Overall great stay. The host is very proactive and responsive. The apartment was clean, comfortable bed, and in a good location. Zurich Hb train station was about 15-20 min walk. It was nice to have a kitchen with all of the supplies to cook!

Giancarlo’s place was in a great part of Zürich, near lots of shops, restaurants, and accessible to transportation. The place itself did not look as new as photos. Also, the dishwasher smelled awful and several dishes that were in the cupboard had dried and crusty food on them. A little disappointed that there were no coffee pods for our stay like the other Airbnb‘s we had stayed had. Nor were there any salt and pepper and other basic amenities.

Great stay! The apartment is close to two tram stations and the apartment complex is very easy to find. Everything was clean and everything inside looks just like the photos. Nana responded to all our messages within 20 mins, no complaints :)

It's a decent stay, one can consider the place for a few nights stay. The presence of laundry is a great plus, however very complex to operate (we wasted a few CHF only to learn how to operate the washer and dryer. Accessing the laundry was not easy either. The room is conveniently located near tran stations and MIGROS for any groceries. The host Nana was very responsive and helpful, which makes the experience overall positive. We did find some dust, stains here and there (which was a big concern and we had to clean things ourselves). We found chicken bones (and other food leftovers) on the floor, below the bed. Not expected from high rated AirBnBs like this one. The cleaning agency needs to do a better job for what they are charging the guests. Overall, it's an Okay place.

This apartment was in a lovely building with the most amazing architecture and decor in the public areas. It is close to the tram station and good if you have kids or lots of luggage even though it’s on the top floor as there is a lift. The roof terrace is lovely too although there were lots of wasps around! The only issue we had was that the sky lights in the apartment don’t have any blinds over them so when the sun comes up although all the windows have great blinds you’re woken up due to the light coming through the sky lights. The host was very responsive and allowed to us to check out slightly later which really helped us as we had 10 hours until our flight.

Geoffray's place was modern with nice overlooking view of the city. Getting there was a bit challenging for us due to the very steep road going up the street where the building was located. It was good that Geoffray was there to help us carry our luggages and brought them inside his flat. Groceries like Denner, Coop and Migros were just near the flat as well as some restuarants. Beds were comfortable and room was clean. Just need more cleaning in the kitchen drawers and other utensils and pots. We were four adults but there were only 3 towels in the flat. The host must be aware or check on this next time.

The location and flat itself were okay, but the host asked us to come early to pick up the key, saying he would be leaving at 2 pm (check in was supposed to be at 5), then when we got there, he said he wasn’t leaving until 5, so we left again to kill a few hours, which was inconvenient, since the flat is far from the centre, and my mom was ill. Then once we came back at 5, the host was hosting friends, and they left only 15-20 mins later. And finally, there were only 3 towels, even though there were 4 of us.
Great location, in the heart of old town Zürich: 5-10 minutes walk to train station, restaurants and supermarkets.

Location was incredible - it’s not far from the train station and nearby a lot of wonderful spots. The apartment is small, but had all the amenities we needed and is as-described. Overall, very happy with the place especially for the price. Our one complaint is that the mattress was sagging significantly, and we weren’t able to sleep very comfortably. For our short stay this wasn’t too problematic but could be an issue for others.

The host was polite and did try to address the issues we raised and communication was cooperative. However, during our stay we experienced a blocked shower and an ongoing ant problem in multiple areas of the studio, including the kitchen and bed area. Airbnb ultimately provided a partial refund, which we appreciated. Overall, the stay did not fully meet expectations, but the host was responsive in dealing with the situation. We would recommend ensuring that the ant infestation is fully investigated and eradicated before anyone else stays.
