The stay was fantastic and Dragesa was really good. The location is in a beautiful neighbourhood and quick morning walks to the nearby park was all we needed for my kid. The apartment was a quaint little place to stay and explore the city. I would definitely recommend this place.!!

We had a great 2 night stay. Excellent communication from the host with very clear instructions for remote entry. The unit was spacious with a great kitchen and very clean. In fact I think it was better than the photos. It's on the 3rd floor but there is a lift. A very quiet and pleasant neighborhood with a tram into town about 100m away. Highly recommend

Daniella’s place was wonderful. I would book it again. The only nay was that it was a work trip and had requested a few times that the bed gets split which hasn’t happened so we had to do it ourselves when we got there, but not an inconvenience that would require me to tax the review ❤️

Overall we had a nice stay, but the apartment we ended up staying in is not the one pictured. Our room was still a good place to stay for our quick trip in Zurich, just not what we expected. Host was communicative and check-in was smooth.
The studio was greatly located, can reach the city center in 15 min. Everything was really clean and it was easy to get there. The only thing is that there was not hairdryer.

The apartment is not in the center of the city, but a few tram stations. It is old, but well maintained. It was very nice to have selection of tea and some coffee capsules. There is a small supermarket quit near. It is a very peaceful and quite neighborhood. Not much to do. The only drawback is getting the key - it was a struggle opening the key lock both when we arrive at dark and even when we left in the morning.
seemless from beginning to end thank you we enjoyed our stay and the amazing property

This place is centrally located and restaurants and shopping are in walking distance! Kitchen is well equipped with everything you need and the place was very clean. Our only complaints were both bathrooms were on the first floor, which wasn’t convenient for the bedroom on the second floor. Also, in the second bedroom, mattress is on the floor and very uncomfortable. Unfortunately, my mother who was assigned that room had to sleep on the couch instead because she got a backache.

We only stayed for 2 nights, but the apartment was perfect for a short stay. About a 20 min walk from the main train station. Clean, comfortable and stylish. A little far from the main attractions but nothing was too far out of reach. Overall the perfect spot for our trip.

This place is amazing! Beautifully designed with modern furniture and comfortable beds. We didn’t get to use the terrace on the roof but will do so if we return in the summer. The apartment has everything you need with amenities in the kitchen, bedrooms, and bathrooms. Very quiet building and neighborhood and rooms have blackout shades so we slept well. The only downside is it being a bit far to walk to the city center but there is public transportation close by. All in all we absolutely loved our stay!

We have a wonderful stay. A bit of a walk from the city center but the area is lovely and has a track field right next door for running. Convenient for uber and plenty of street parking. Has an elevator so that is nice. The rooftop deck was a wonderful surprise and lovely view.

We had an amazing stay with Julien! I highly recommend the flat. Julien was very reactive and understanding. He also provided us with good addresses/ tips in the area and was happy to chat with us while at the same time respecting our space. The kitchen is very well-equipped and the bathroom spacious. The neighbourhood is also great and very central (we did everything by foot). My friend and I were delighted with our stay and would recommend the accommodation many times over! Thanks again to Julien for his kindness and warm welcome!

Excellent spacious bright apartment with a soul. Lots of plants! There is everything you need for comfortable living and cooking. Huge and comfortable bed. But the most important thing is the silence inside and around the house! I have never seen anything like this. 15-20 minutes walk to the center, tram and bus stop opposite the house. Two large supermarkets around the corner. I highly recommend this original airbnb. It's like visiting an old friend. Thank you, Julien!

The place was in a great location. Very comfortable and had everything we needed! My only complaint would be that it showed an iron/board but the board was not there so I had to leave my clothes wrinkled. The host was also delayed in sending us details regarding our check in code, besides that all was good and I would definitely recommend!!

Had a wonderful 4 night stay in Nicole's place. As others have stated, it is bigger than it looks from the photos. There is also a large balcony, perfect for dinner in the evening if you want to stay in. The bathroom is a shower over bath and is beautifully clean and spacious. There is no microwave, air conditioning or lift/elevator which may be relevant to some guests. The apartment is a 2nd floor apartment but the first flight of stairs is short (only 8 steps or so). We had a great time and would certainly consider staying again.

Had a great time at our stay, a very nice walk to the water and all the restaurants, and super close to the station. The apartment itself was bigger than expected and the patio is huge. The lack of A/C could be challenging in the summer, but the host was kind enough to leave a fan for us without us even asking. Great stay!
All good, easy communication, nice we could leave our luggages at the office before checking in. Location is perfect and the flat is very functional and super clean

Great stay! The apartment was very nice with lots of space--the living room is more of a large bedroom with the couch/pull-out sofa and a table, as well as extra chairs and a balcony, which was such a plus. The location was amazing too, and transportation around town was convenient and simple. We felt very safe. Would definitely stay again!

From the beginning the contact and communication was easy and fast. Unfortunately we haven’t met and Rafael arranged an easy and flexible check in. The room and all of the apartment was clean and spotless prepared. We felt right at home. An early check in and late check out gave us most flexibility with our friends and our flights. We will definitely come back to Rafael’s place and we do recommend his room to his future guests. Thanks a lot.

Overall, great stay! Host was responsive and instructions were easy to follow. Everything was as described and clean! Only issue was the noise, I know it was noted before and noise usually doesn’t impact me much. However, it is much louder than anticipated. Otherwise no issues!

We had a great stay here- only 15min walk from the big train station, lots of places to go and perfect for a weekend stay. Lovely apartment and if you like to go out there is lots of food and bars nearby!

The only complaint is not having a second bathroom. But we know this going in. Great place probably best suited for one family. Luckily half of the party did not make this trip. Gary and Leslie will try to make it back.

This is a beautiful, very clean apartment filled with history in the centre of the old town. It is very comfortable and clean. Anna is a wonderful host and was so attentive, helpful and friendly. I would highly recommend this apartment.

Easy to get to from the airport and located within walking distance to everything I was interested in seeing. Haymo's place was the biggest of the three I stayed at during my trip to Switzerland... and the shower was the largest! :-) Thanks for all your help/advice during my stay Haymo!

If I could give Haymo more than 5 stars - I would. This place is next-level, from the amazing location downtown, the panoramic views of the city, the incredible peace and quiet despite being in central Zurich. Not only that - but the entire apartment is tastefully appointed and Haymo provides outstanding information on how to get there, easily check in and provides a guide of all the best sights, restaurants and much more, and is generally super responsive and helpful. All I can say is I can’t wait for my next visit.

Would definitely recommend! Great location!Clean! Easy to check in. Plus the host is extremely responsive. It’s a simple place that has all the necessary amenities to lay your head down after spending the day touring Switzerland. The only thing I would recommend is a couple of additional pillows. The ones provided were very thin and unsupportive.

LOCATION. LOCATION. LOCATION. We are a couple with the baby, and we truly enjoyed our stay at this place. For us, location was everything. In the most beautiful part of town. Just couple steps away from all the best places. In the apartment everything was fine and clean, just as in photos. Check-in was easy. If we visit Zurich again, we will choose the same place for sure.

We had a very nice stay in Serena’s flat! It is a no-frills apartment, clean and elegant, which had everything we needed including 2 supermarkets visible from the balcony and was around the corner from the Uetliberg and a short tram /bus ride from the center of town. Serena was well-organized, accommodating and helpful. The kitchen had everything we needed and Serena was so kind to supply some essentials for cooking.

The place is in a good location—just a 2-minute walk from the tram station. Dimi, the host, was very responsive, and I really appreciated how flexible he was with the check-in time. The studio looked exactly like the pictures: clean, tidy, and well-kept. The neighborhood was quiet and felt very residential, which made the stay even more pleasant.

It was easy to find his house and everythink was clear. My towel was damaged but they left me a new towel, He was always responsible the answer us! There is only one missing that there was no shower gel but It is OK!

Unfortunately, the apartment wasn’t reddy at check in time, as it was still being cleaned. I was told it would take another 1-2 hours. They found us another unit in the building on the ground floor, so I appreciate that, but we lost time as a result and made the afternoon stressful as we had plans in the evening and things were pushed back. I can’t speak to how this unit was as we had a different one. But the unit looked ok. The ground floor one was very noisy, even with the windows closed. Location was good.

This is my second stay, and it is as enjoyable as last time. Very convenient y located, Giancarlo is very responsive and friendly. Cherry on the pie, flexible with my schedule. Perfect for a business trip or tourism. Thank you Giancarlo
I had a lovely stay with Giancarlo, who was responsive and accommodating throughout the trip. The location is great, with a nice creek that runs right outside the apartment.

Place is as described, restful and enjoyable. Host communicates clearly, easy to check-in and overall a quiet and peaceful place. Restaurants and main places at least 15 minutes walk but reachable. If you want to use a rented bicycle or scooter they’re mostly everywhere and to come in really handy. In another note I kept looking for the washer area but could not find it so a little trouble there, however had a great experience overall.
A cozy studio apartment with all the basic things you need for a short trip. A quiet neighborhood and only a 15-20 walk to the main railway station. Hosts were easy to communicate with.

The apartment was in a great location, very clean, and well-equipped. Initial communication and the booking process was a bit confusing, as this was a last-minute booking and the calendar of several of the host’s units showed availability when there wasn’t any. However, once I booked, everything went smoothly and the host’s instructions were clear. I would recommend staying here, especially if you are able to plan your trip in advance.
Love the location, small and functional and definitely good value. Very responsive and helpful host. Jumping in the lake within 4 minutes was a total luxury 😊
Perfect stay! Clean and good location near the tram station and the center.

Mr. Dimi was incredibly responsive. The apartment was spotless and exactly as described in the photo. Mr. Dimi went above and beyond to communicate well with us to ensure we were comfortable. Perfectly located at the old town center & great for exploring Zurich and the check-in process was seamless.
Very nice and spacious apartment in a quiet neighbourhood. The kitchen is fully equipped. We had a very nice stay at Jose’s apartment.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb near Zurich’s center. The location is truly unbeatable! Nearby everything the city has to offer, yet tucked away in a peaceful, neighbourhood. The apartment itself is fantastic. The fully equipped kitchen was a huge plus; there were absolutely no limitations when it came to cooking, which made it feel just like home. The workspace was comfortable and well-lit, making it easy to get things done during my stay. The natural light throughout the apartment creates a warm, inviting atmosphere that I loved coming back to each day. Combined with Jose’s thoughtful hosting, this Airbnb is the perfect option for anyone visiting Zurich whether for work, leisure, or both. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend!

The location is great. Modern, spacious penthouse with impressive views of the city and beautiful neighboring buildings. Cozy and comfortable place with stylish, quality furniture. Snow-white bed linen, comfortable pillows, and blankets. The blinds provided a great sleep. Sufficient lighting. Comfortable bathrooms. Exquisite decor. Dimi is a responsive and friendly host. It was a pleasant, amazing experience to stay here.
I had a really positive experience here. It was warm, cosy, clean and wellbeing. The host was friendly, responsive and helpful.

appreciate the fact he allowed me an earlier check in . he was rude to me when I asked about unclear / wrong instructions and he sent me back to read the instructions. when he found there was a mistake , he apologized but the magic was broken already. apartment is very hot in summer time , everything else is great !

Accommodation was as described. Communication was excellent and every query was responded to very quickly. The property is immediately at a tram stop. But, it is still very walkable to the train station area. It is a good alternative to traditional hotels. While it did cool down at night, the unit can get warm during a hot June day. I would consider staying here again.

The place is clean, well located, the kitchen had all that it needed. However, an extra blanket would be needed during the winter times as the heating stops between 11pm and 6 am, and the room gets very cold during the night time.

Well located apartment for exploring Zurich. Close to public transport and the city centre. Ersin was very responsive and helpful. However I would not recommend taking a baby in a stroller as the entrance to the apartment is via an external staircase.

The appartment was well situated, pretty much centered in a very quiet area. I really enjoyed my stay. The bed was very comfortable, which is important if you walk around all day visiting Zürich. The appartment was very clean. A little plus is the bathtub and the covered balcony. Thank you very much. I totally recommend this place.
Really liked the apartment. Great, spacious and tons of restaurants around.
We were in z-town for a few days for business and it was a perfect place to sleep and spend a few hours in the evening. Good location very central.
A very nice, clean, bright and lovely furnished, well located appartement in the heart of Zurich. Highly recommended!

The apartment was nice and quiet, although it didn’t have an air conditioner which is something to keep in mind if you are coming in the summer, it does however have a fan. Theres an elevator but you have to climb a few steps to get into it. I liked the location a lot, it’s close to a bus/tram stop which you can take to go anywhere. Overall i enjoyed my stay and maybe I’ll come back here again but only in colder weather.
great place! had a cute balcony and kitchen with utensils and such provided. the bed was very comfy and it was super close to public transit!
The apartment is in a great location and very clean. Easy check in and check out. The host is very friendly. I recommend.

The apartment was as shown in the photos; it was clean and the location was good. However, we experienced an issue with the heating during our stay. The host mentioned that they were unable to address the problem due to the Christmas period.

The apartment was in a great location, we felt very safe walking everywhere even at night. The apartment was comfortable, the bathroom was a little older than the pictures showed (the lighting was very good in the pictures) and there was no hand soap in the bathroom. But the apartment was great for a short stay and we felt very comfortable! Giancarlo was also very responsive!

Great time In Zurich. This apartment was very comfortable and so close to everything. Me and my friend were able to do a lot on the 3 days we were there and it was nice to come back to a place that was comfortable and relaxed. Would recommend!
Loved this place and location! Very spacious apartment as well. Near Wiedikon station and felt safe walking around the area!

Thr host was very responsive to all my worries in a promptly manner. on arrival i called the host my phone immediately went off, however tge host was very proactive by continuously calling till contact with me was established and helped with my query immediately and in a very friendly manner. I will definitely recommend this place. tram stop was directly outside which made my travel to both the airport and main train station very easy.
The apartment is exactly what it looks like in the pictures. Semion is very communicative and responded quickly. Close subway stations to get to the city. Great deal, perfect for a weekend in Zurich!

Close to major attractions. Everything you need. We overlooked that the listing did not offer air conditioning, but the host made sure to bring us a fan when we asked! Very responsive and helpful. The elevator was down so we did have to take our luggage up 6 flights of stairs. However the host did offer to have someone when assist if needed. Would stay again if in Zurich.

Arye was very communicative but the place is older than I expected. Also with suitcases it is quite difficult to get to on public transport and then its on the 6th floor. Although there is a lift it is very small. I also had trouble with the internet and could not get my phone connected, only my laptop. So overall the stay was fine, but given these factors, I felt it was a bit overpriced.
The room was very clean and simple, just right to rest. It can get warm in summer, but the host kindly provided a fan. Great location with easy access to public transport.

Loved the room! Attention to detail, modern and super cozy. Host was very friendly and helpful and made us feel very comfortable. Totally recommend, and when back to Zürich will be choosing it again! :)

The place was very good and we really enjoyed it. Regarding instructions, everything was clear and straightforward. The room was also clean and like the pictures. The only minor drawback is, although in the description it is mentioned there is no elevator in the building, but it wasn't mentioned that the rooms are only placed at the 4th and 5th floor. So, you should prepare yourself for a little bit exercise (specially if you have luggage with you). Overall, I suggest this place.

Considering the price of everything else in Zurich it’s an ok place to stay. Unfortunately the bed was paper thin, the bathroom cubicle had many unwanted stains throughout it, and the shower curtain is much too small leading to a mess while showering. Although multiple large towels was a nice addition to have.

This home was perfect for the six of us - me, my husband and our adult children. The home has been beautifully curated with unique modern furnishings and decor. The kitchen had everything you needed to make meals easily. The only choice was to enjoy it on the deck or lovely dining room. The location is fantastic-right in the center of old town. Minutes from the train station and grocery shopping at Coop or Aldi is just across the street. A great spot for adults! So glad we selected this home for our stay in Zurich 🥰

The apartment was located at an impeccable location near the Zurich train station, close to all the big supermarkets and shops. The host Nora was very understanding as we had young kids and she was willing to accommodate some of our requests. The only minor point was that the master bathroom had a bit of a funny smell but Nora provided us a solution and offered to help in no time.

Great host, he was always kindly responsive. The house has a great location and is located next to the supermarket. The host was generous in providing coffee, dishwasher tabs, and everything... The only downside is that the house has not lift and The parquets making noise. I highly recommend this place.

Very well connected by all means of transportation. Supermarkets are at the walking distance. However the apartment soundings are little off. Apartment is equipped with all the necessary amenities and it is quite spacious. The cleanliness is maintained throughout. We enjoyed our stay here.
Lovely stay, David was a wonderful host, very respectful and kind. I felt right at home. I travelled alone and felt safe in the neighborhood. Would recommend totally this place.

Erik was very welcoming, easy to communicate with and I felt home immediately. It is very well organised and the room is spacious. The shared areas also very pleasant. Great location to move around in the city. Thank you Erik for a pleasant stay.

Erik is a warm, kind, helpful, friendly and welcoming host. I stayed at his place for 3 nights and most definitely recommend it. The apartment is conveniently located close to the train station and tram lines, both within 5 mins walking distance. The room (Jura) was spacious, cosy and the bed super comfortable. The common areas (living room, kitchen and bathroom), were always kept very clean and tidy. I felt at home and would stay here again when in Zürich!

Loved Erik’s Airbnb! One of the best I’ve had the pleasure of staying in. Erik is very thoughtful and made sure I had everything I needed. The apartment was clean and the location is conveniently located next to the station. I would 100% stay here again.
Really great location and responsive host but The bathroom was not clean, the bedding was not super confortable.

The place was near the city center. The room was clean, and the check-in process was easy. However, it would be better if the room had at least one small cupboard. Also, note that there were no employees inside the hotel
Great location. Comes as advertised! Perfect base to explore the city old town area and the lake.
Wanted to leave my review, as the only lace was really good. Dmitrii’s place was really good and he was really helpful, and friendly. Highly recommended.

The stay was very pleasant. I had a great time at Simon’s 🏬 Flat everything was super tidy and clean 🧹 felt like home 🏠, the shower 🚿 area is pretty small and you need to bring your own toiletries 🧴 🪥🧼 the bed 🛏️ can fit one person comfortably, you can’t access the 🛋️ living room because it’s Simon’s Workplace 🖥️ but then the flat is in the 3rd Floor I had to lift my luggage upstairs apart from these things I had a good time at Zürich 🇨🇭😬

Simona was a fantastic host who gave me super clear check in instructions which was very helpful with my late arrival. The room was fantastic and the apartment was lovely, I felt right at home for a few days
I loved the apartment! Fabiola's space felt very cozy and the location was perfect. Close to everything. Fabiola was very responsive and flexible too. Would highly recommend staying here.

Fabiola was helpful and friendly. Her apartment is in a great location, walking distance to tourist spots and just a few minutes from a train station. It is clean, spacious and has all the amenities you would expect/need. I would recommend it!

apartment was good.. easily walkable from oerlicon station... neat and clean only problem was in amenities washing machine and dryer was not there..and fan was in one room...I messaged to host..they arranged me a standing fan next day so one night we were sleeping in hot room.... and they didn't talk anything about washing machine... I messaged them about the balcony gate also which was not working..so we could not sit in balcony.. if amenities are written in the description as washing machine ,dryer, fan , balcony...then they should provide them .. so after paying a big amount in peak season amenities were lacking otherwise ok.....

Nico's place is spacious with plenty of natural light and a calm interior. The host was very communicative and easy to reach, and check-in and check-out were very smooth. I will recommend this place and host to all my friends.

When we arrived at the apartment, it hadn’t been cleaned after the previous guest checked out. Prior to our arrival, Nico had declined our request for early check-in, stating that the apartment needed to be cleaned. However, it was clear upon arrival that this had not been done. I messaged Nico, and he responded immediately by sending cleaning staff. While I genuinely appreciate his quick response and action, it would have been more professional if the apartment had been prepared as communicated.

had a fantastic stay! The room was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great, and the host was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting and would love to stay here again in the future!

Check was completely automated which went very smoothly. Room was very small. Noise was average for being in a small building in the middle of a city centre. The only issue we had was the smell of marijuana and cigarette smoke that was potent in the room. Unsure where it came from but it was overpowering until we opened the windows.

This is nicely close to the train station. But the area is sketchy, bathroom not clean and unmaintained, and the mattress hurt to sleep on. This place is probably just fine if the location and price is all that matters to you. Otherwise, just say no.

We arrived 2 hours earlier than planned due to a bus change and asked the host if we could check in early since we were very tired. The cleaning lady confirmed the room was ready, and the host kindly allowed us to check in. 1. The room was incredibly clean and comfortable. 2. There was a market just downstairs and unlimited tea and coffee. 3. The bus station was only a 10-minute walk away. 4. As Turkish tourists, we loved that there was a Turkish restaurant right next door, but for other travelers there were also McDonald’s and a burger place nearby. The only minor downside was that if we left the window open at night, we could hear some noise from outside — but once the window was closed, it was completely silent. Overall, it was an excellent stay!

This is a really central location, the apartment looks just like in the photos. Communication was easy and so was checking in. However it’s a going out area (the windows isolate a lot of the noise but it’s worth saying it), the kitchen is not well equipped and I was told there was a spot to keep my luggage but when I got there was given an area that was accessible for the store. In general I think it’s great for a short visit!

This was one of my favorite Airbnb experiences. Anu truly embodies what it means to be a gracious host. She invited me for tea and made me feel welcome in their lovely home. Anu was very responsive and understanding, and I definitely felt at home during my stay. The house is peaceful, and the beautiful surroundings enhance the experience. The location also offers privacy, which was the perfect combination for relaxation. Thank you, Anu, for being such a wonderful host. I will definitely return to visit.
I had a wonderful stay with Anu. She was very communicative and helpful. The room is very quiet and peaceful yet easy to get it central Zurich with the tram.

The place was absolutely perfect—comfortable for our stay with two young kids and located in a great part of town. The apartment is easily walkable to old town and the lake and surrounded by bakeries and restaurants. The beds were SO comfortable and a real highlight. The hosts were very responsive and kind. Would gladly stay again!

We stayed in Nora’s apartment with 3 young kids. The kids loved the different designs in each room and they loved the games! Nora was an incredibly communicative and friendly host! We would love to stay again.
This place is nice — organised and has everything you need. The host team was helpful.

Fantastic place. Right in the middle of neighborhood. Felt safe and sound with families. Accessible to public transport in just about 5 mins. Some of the bathrooms do not have a lock which can be looked into, however it is not a big hassle 😁. The hosts are simply amazing and responded in about 5 to 15 mins. I highly recommend this place

Super clean, well located, really easy to access, big house with tonnes of room for a big group of friends visiting Zürich. The property was fairly basic and didn't have loads of decor/personality but did the job absolutely perfectly, and we would stay again!!

Super location with the tram and train very close by and easy parking outside (in the blue zone once you have the daily parking permit or across the road using Park+Rail). A lovely lake view is enjoyable from the balcony. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable and exactly as described. The wifi was a little weak but the hosts promised to get that solved which was much appreciated. Overall I can easily recommend it as a place to stay.

Dimiter's place is a gem in Zurich. The location is awesome. Easy to walk to the lake and the old city. One block from the train station and tram. The apartment was easy to access and exceeded my expectations - it is spacious and modern. Perfect for an individual or a couple. The patio is also spacious. Highly recommend!
The stay was great! The neighboorhod is really chill and good to walk. There's a plenty of restaurants and cafés nearby. The apartment is great

Really nice place, in a great area, matched the photos. The one thing, we had no clue how to turn on oven, it needed a child code for us, which we didn’t have, but that was the only thing that could’ve been improved. Responsive host, and emphasizing how great of an area it’s in!

This is not going to be your completely aseptic soulless usual Airbnb. This is a place where people live and it shows so do not expect an hotel room. It is cozy, receives a lot of light, is ideally located, close to everything. All that is necessary is there and works. The host is super nice and responsive. I had a great time.

For Zürich good place near University Irchel. I visited family and enjoyed the privacy in the flat. The flat has a decent size and has a balcony. But it was too cold to enjoy such in winter. The balcony was a great plus, but in December, it was too cold. The only negative point was, that there is no elevator, so be good to walk up 7 half floors to the third floor. Just be aware. I only suffered on thee first and last day carrying my suitcase, with all the presents to bring to the family and then to to take back. :-)

We stayed at this hotel for 4 nights and overall, it was a great experience. The room is large and feels luxurious. It was very clean and the bed was comfortable. There are a few ants around the room, so be careful not to leave crumbs on the floor. We went during a European heatwave, and the apartment did not have an AC unit. However, the host was very helpful and brought in a portable AC unit the next day which made a huge difference. Location is near a red light district, which at first shocked me. However, it is very quiet at night and we didn't have any issues sleeping. The hotel is within a close walking distance to central Zurich and bus stop.

We had a great stay at the Deluxe Appart & Hotel! We had an overnight stay in Zurich before our flight, and this was the perfect location -- within walking distance from the main city center as well as train station. We had a small issue with the self check-in (it was a machine/technological error, so no issue on the listing's part), but the team responded immediately and we were able to check-in quickly after a long travel day. The room was clean, comfortable, and looked just like the pictures. We would definitely stay at Deluxe Appart & Hotel the next time we are in Zurich!

Overall great stay. The included snacks and drinks were a pleasant surprise. The apt was clean and well maintained. The only complaint was that room itself was a little hot, despite the portable AC. Would recommend for other travelers

We stayed one night in Zurich at this lovely hotel, 10 mins from the train station. The room was clean and came with free snacks and drinks. It’s a self check-in, but the steps were very easy to follow. The host also provided an AC which we were so grateful for during the 35°C heat! Be aware there’s no elevator and it’s above a cabaret club, so it can be noisy at night. Overall, a good spot for couples or solo travellers.

Giancarlo’s place was ideal for its location. We felt safe staying in the building. His apartment is more of a clean bedroom with a bathroom. I would not call it an apartment because the only sink available was a small bathroom sink. There was a small cube size refrigerator and microwave available. The room was clean and had a fan.

The place was spotless, clean and plenty of electricity plugs to charge things. Check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow so that was a wonderful thing after a journey to be able to check in seamlessly without a hitch! All because the instructions are very clear and detailed. WiFi works great & the bathroom was very clean. Centrally located in old town Zurich where you can move to anywhere on foot or by tram. Apartment was nice and cosy. I loved my stay there!! And would book it again for my next Zurich visit.
These are the reasons why I would rerurn again. 1. Great location 2. Very clean 3. Walkable and easy access to public transportation 4. Reasonable price However, I wish there were a washer.

Way bigger than it seems in the pictures and in a very convenient location! The wood floors are pretty but if you have light sleepers and people that get up in the middle of the night to use the bathroom, the squeak of the wood floors could be a concern. The kitchen and bathroom could use an update, but the good price more than makes up for it! The host was very responsive to an issue and resolved it quickly! Overall, we were pleased with our stay.
We really enjoyed our stay! The location was great, and the room was clean!

Positives: great location, clean, bright and well insulated unit, very responsive owners, clearly eager to help their guests appreciate their stay. The kitchen is well appointed for breakfast with coffee/tea options. Why I probably won't come back: Not that quiet at night due to the location (proximity to a restaurant, some neighbors can be heard walking one floor above late at night). The kitchen is functional mostly for breakfast, but cooking a larger meal is out of question. We are avid cooks and even boiling 4 potatoes took more than 1 hour, that's the only thing we attempted besides making tea/coffee. The kettle in the kitchen leaks from the base of the spout, making it hard to pour water in a coffee mug. Some provided supplies could be more plentiful but that's an easy fix.

The location is fantastic, and the property itself is OK. However, I was disappointed by the unclear instructions for retrieving the keys, which left me wandering around with luggage late at night or on weekends. Additionally, the absence of WiFi was a drawback, especially since it wasn’t mentioned upfront—ideally, the description should clearly state if it’s not a provided amenity. Overall, it was OK.

Fernando's appartement is in a great location and not expensive, he is friendly and helped especially when I arrived. However the apartment is not in a good condition, especially common areas like the kitchen and the bathroom, the bedroom's window does not close well either. Overall, pretty good deal if you are ok with loose cleaning, otherwise it could throw some people off.
The place is well located , but the men where together with the women , not good and people Were loud in the evening , I had to wake up early to catch a flight , and people Were talking

its a super nice little capsule hotel! very central and easy to find. I was a bit worried about the check in as the instructions said you need a code and I never got a reply from the hotel, however this was not necessary if arriving before 10pm.

The apartment is 9 minutes walk from the closest tram stop, or 30+ minutes from downtown. For us it was worth it to save some money, as staying downtown is expensive. (I’ll add though that, with three people, it ended up being the same cost to uber as it was to take public transit.) The kitchen is quite small, so much so that I imagine cooking meals would be difficult. However, the rest of the space was very spacious and comfortable. There were plenty of towels, blankets, etc. There was a small amount of mold in the bathroom due to humidity from the shower.

The apartment is nice place to stay in Zürich for a few days. Nice and quiet area, short walk to bakery and groceries. Unfortunately the apartment wasn’t clean and some important amenities auch as towels and kitchen equipment weren’t present. The host sent us money so that we could buy the necessary items. However se still had to spend our time to fix these issues ourselves. The bathroom is small and could use some refurbishment.

This modern one-bedroom place is wonderful ....lots of space in one of the best neighborhoods in Zurich, close to the lake and the #2 and #4 trams that take you to the old town and Opera Plaza and Bellevue in minutes. Communicating with Laurent is easy and quick. Having an elevator is also a plus. Be aware that Laurent may expect you to strip the bed and deposit the laundry in the basement machine before you leave. But overall all, a great find and a great deal.
This location is really well located. Close to the train and close to multiple restaurants
The airbnb is a short walk from the Zurich HB and the bus line. The unit is on a busy street but the insulation blocked out a lot of noise. Host was communicative. Very easy check in and out.

Great location and apartment! Walkable to the city, in a quiet area with parking included! The home was very clean and exactly as advertised. Comfortable and clean! Host was extremely responsive and easy to communicate with. Would definitely stay here again!!

Great place to stay, nice neighborhood, and even during a holiday weekend Jaybee was able to accommodate our early check-in for a 30 pound fee for housekeeping. The place was well equipped and cozy. TV was nice. The only comment is that there were some ants coming in through the window. The bed was smaller, but as a couple where both of us are closer to 5 feet tall, it was manageable. Jaybee was helpful, communicative, and chill.

We made an early check in for 10 chf, the machine errored while doing that but the stuff helped us immediately. The room was clean and everything. Only downsides are, there are no extra space to hang our clothes to. No hangers in the bathroom for towels. And it was kind of far from the old town but not too bad. The neighborhood was really nice and calm.

William was very responsive and helpful. We were thankful for the umbrellas that we needed for a day when it rained. The location is optimal and central which is very convenient. It is right across from a restaurant so if you're a light sleeper, it may be an issue. However, we were tired after busy days and it didn't bother us much.
Perfect location! Enough space for a family of three without feeling cramped. Value was excellent and the arcade was a huge hit!

We had a very comfortable stay. We had trouble with the TV not working, but the next day the staff rushed over and dealt with the problem. They were always attentive and polite so that we could have a comfortable stay. The area around the apartment was quiet, so we were able to sleep peacefully. Thank you.

Jack was very nice and helpful! We felt a warm welcome ✨ He received us on the entrance and gave us a little tour to show us where everything was, the place is very good located right in the heart of the city and just a few blocks from HB plaza and a few min walk from some museums, hope to come back!(:

The host was very responsive. I asked quite a few questions before and during check-in, and Jaybee was always available to help and responded quickly. The location is convenient, with the nearest tram stop just a few minutes’ walk away and less than a 10-minute tram ride to Zurich Central Station. The accommodation was also very clean. The only minor issue was that water could easily spill out of the shower area, even when the curtain was fully closed, but it was not a major problem. A nice touch was that they provided a portable fan, which was especially appreciated during the hot weather. If you’re into Korean food, I also highly recommend the Korean restaurant IMONE. It was really good and worth a visit.

Great listing. We found no problem in checking in. The entire apartment was clean and spotless. The apartment however is in the second floor without any lift. So it might be a challenge for some, but the apartment itself was very good, airy and had lots of natural lights. The nearest Coop is right around the corner, so it's easy to find all the essentials there.

The apartment was on the first floor, and the building has no elevator so can be hard for luggages. The room smelled of cigarettes, the light of one bedroom is broken and the hairdryer cannot be plugged to the socket. But the staff is responsive, however they only deliver the adapter the next morning. They did send vouchers as a apology for this tho so i can buy my own adapter.

It’s a very nice apartment and it was extremely toddler friendly (they had a crib ready for us). It is up 3 flights of stairs which was tougher for a more senior group and there’s no air conditioning so a lot of street noise with open windows and noise from the other apartments but the place was beautiful and in a good location and a fair price.

We absolutely loved this apartment! Bright, airy and squeaky clean, it’s also right around the corner from the polybahn which was a simple and novel way to get right down to old town in 3 minutes! Loads of trams also took us everywhere we needed to go. Frederick was so helpful and responsive - a perfect host. The only thing we missed was a dryer as the machine was washer only. But that may not be relevant for all - otherwise the perfect stay!

Nora and Christian’s apartment was extremely well located, we didn’t rent a car and even with luggage the main train station was <10mins walk. Several grocery stores were also very walkable and kitchen was well stocked (coffee maker, oven, microwave, fridge and freezer). Clean and quick communicators, would stay again.

Nora's home was perfect for a short stay in Zurich. It was well equipped, clean, and very comfortable for our family of 4. The extra crib and baby changing table she provided were very nice touches and made it much easier for handling our infant. It's quite close to the train station (4 min walk) but there are either stairs or a steep hill to navigate in case you have a lot of luggage. Trams to the main train station are close by. I would highly recommend staying here for your next visit to Zurich!

Nora was a wonderful host! The apartment was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The check-in was smooth, and communication with Nora was always friendly and helpful. I’d definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

The apartment is just 5 minutes walk-distance from the train station and easy to get in.The apartment is as the same as the photos and well equipped.The location is quiet.The apartment is really nice for a small family.

My children (9 and 11 years old) spent 2 nights at Manuela’s apartment. The location was perfect, only 10 minutes by car away from the city center with lots of trees and beautiful surroundings. The apartment was exactly as in the pictures and very clean and well equipped. We would definately come back here for our next Zurich trip. We highly recommend it.

The apartment was great for us. We were just two people, but there was plenty of room for two couples, if required. The bathrooms are modern and clean. When I say clean, I mean spotless. We walked extensively throughout the city. We went on a long boat ride and there are many fine restaurants in the area. Manuela the host was super cool and so very accomodating. She thoroughly explained all the functions of the apartment as well as the amenities. I consider this place as a stay anyone would love and it met all our needs. It even has a mountain view from one of the windows in the dining room. We also loved the balcony. I could only recommend she include more pictures, as the listing does not fully show what a wonderful apartment this is. We were pleasantly surprised.
Place was very nice and I really like how easy the host made the experience.

Great location- hear the main train station and in historic area. Nice looking apartment, as seen in photos. Unfortunately, when we arrived, the housekeeper was still there. She was nowhere near done when we arrived, and rushed finishing. The apartment certainly felt like someone else had just been there. As mentioned by other reviews, the Airbnb notifications sent to us all say a 2pm check in, but the owner emails and says 3 pm check in. This needs to be addressed. Could be a lovely stay, if the cleaning is better dealt with. Perhaps we were just unlucky.
Leonardo’s place is great- spacious, clean, and in a convenient location. Just be aware the bar next to the apartment is pretty noisy on the weekends!

We stayed one night and it was a nice apartment. It was easy to find and the host provided clear and easy instructions. The apartment was very clean and spacious. It was able to accommodate six of us very well. The only downside was the stairs! Pretty difficult to climb so many stairs with lots of luggage so keep that in mind. Other than that, it was a great apartment. Also, perhaps having bottled water for guests would be helpful as we could not find any at any stores nearby as it was Sunday and everything was closed.

Great for an overnight stay. As advertised, this place is a budget friendly option in a great central location near the station. The place looks new and fresh and blocks the noise from the street very well. Don't expect any services or much from the room (i.e. fridge, good pillows).

This place is exactly as billed, no frills or services. And its reasonably priced, especially considering some of the other hotels in the area. Everything is done online or at a self serve kiosk. We had no trouble at all checking in or out. But the location is what was best, 5 or 10 minute walk from Zurich HB.

We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was very clean, beautifully designed, and equipped with everything we needed. We especially appreciated having a washer and dryer, as well as an iron and hair dryer — these details made our stay very comfortable. The only small downside was that on very warm nights, when we needed to keep the windows open, it could get a bit noisy due to the nearby tram and occasional helicopter traffic from the hospital in the area. Other than that, everything was perfect. We truly enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend this place to other guests. Thank you for being a great host! 😊

If you plan to stay here, the apartment is beautiful, modern and has all the amenities you need. If you’re staying here longer, there are shops close by 5min to pick up necessities. The station is very close and is one stop away from the city center however it is also an easy 20-30min walk for those wanting to explore the city.

Dimiter was a good host - being very responsive and explaining all very well. The place was at a great location, very central and easy to reach. The apartment was spacious, modern and as shown at the pictures. Unfortunately, cleanliness of the place could have been better (e.g. dust, hair,..) which we shared with Dimiter who said that he will take it up with his cleaning crew.

Great place to stay while in Zurich. The BnB is very well furnished with all the amenities and is very close to train and tram stations. In rare case you find something amiss, the hosts are super responsive and will resolve the issue fast. Awesome place, will definately recommend to Airbnb community.

We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was clean and there were nice towels for us to use. The house was equipped with what was needed. The apartment was a little bit outside of the city center, but there is public transportation super close by.

A lovely place with all the amenities you could need, including underground parking for a car which was a blast to use! The kitchen is fully equipped and there is a washer and dryer as well! The space is tastefully furnished and decorated and should provide a convenient, enjoyable, and comfortable place to call your temporary home when you visit Zurich.
Thanks for a lovely stay! It was a HOT week in Zurich, but the flat was lovely and we had a great time seeing the city!

The place was spacious and very clean. We enjoyed our stay here. The apartment was easy to find. The only thing there isn’t a lift which makes a bit difficult for the luggages. Also, the parking is on another location where you need to walk to go

We loved the apartment, it was very clean and comfortable. We really enjoyed our stay. It's close to the city so that you can walk to the centre but also in a quiet street with beautiful trees. Close to the river, too, for nice walks.

We spent about a week in Giancarlo's Stork 21 apartment. It was at the perfect location, we found the unit clean, comfortable, and quiet. However, there were some unresolved plumbing problems, and it took days to get wifi.

This was one of the best stays I have ever had! The pictures are beautiful but they don’t do this place a justice. Just book it and see for yourselves. Look nowhere else! Location is perfection, and the apartment itself is perfection.

We had a fantastic stay at this central apartment in Zurich. The location is unbeatable — everything is within walking distance, from lake to shops, restaurants, and public transport. It made exploring the city effortless. The apartment itself was spotless, modern, and thoughtfully designed. It had all the amenities we needed, and the bed was extremely comfortable. Despite being in such a central area, it was surprisingly quiet at night, which we really appreciated. The host was friendly, responsive, and provided clear instructions for check-in and local tips that made our trip even better. It truly felt like a home away from home. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Zurich.

Nice but small appartment outside the city, but in walking distance to Zurich HB from where you can easy come around in whole Schweizerland and see the mountains like we did. jaybee is fast to respond if you have questions, but the flexible checkin plan and easy to understand instructions and pictures did that not many questions was needed. we had a great stay!

We had a great stay and would recommend to other travelers, friends and family. Location; great location, a few minutes walk from the main train station. 15 minutes walk to old town and all shops and restaurants. if you are traveling with large luggage or strollers or it is hard to walk uphill- the entrance is up the street at an incline. Not super steep but worth noting. The home; exactly as described and like the pictures. Very clean and comfortable. The AC units worked very well - it was very hot during our stay in Zurich and it was nice and cool in the apartment. Overall I would stay again

Superb, spacious place in Zurich’s Old Town, tastefully furnished and very comfortable. The host was great, helpful, responsive, and easy to communicate with. The apartment was spotless, and we were pleasantly surprised by the thoughtful amenities, from fresh flowers and nice bath products to useful kitchen essentials. Fantastic location. Would absolutely stay again.

Anna`s place match description and was perfect for our stay. Very close to stores and restaurants and very comfortable. I would only add that it is located at the top floor of the building and does not have elevator. So, people with heavy luggage and/or special needs might struggle a little. Also, the shower head in bathroom is strangely positioned at 1m of height or so, which makes it weird and a little tricky to use. Positive highlights to the living room (lots of space and very well decorated) and kitchen (modern, clean and fully equipped). I really recommend the stay!

The apartment is very close to the train station and is easy to find. It was kept very clean and was good for our family of four. The apartment can get quite warm even with the thermostat turned all the way down, so we needed to keep windows open while in the flat. There was also a small alarm going off in the lobby of the building 24/7 which unfortunately we could hear while trying to fall asleep. This is not an issue with the apartment itself. Overall we had a good stay and we’d likely stay here again.

the place is amazing. very cozy apartment and kitchen with everything you need if you want to cook. the only thing is there is no screen on the windows. so if you want to open the window in the evening be prepared for mosquitoes in the summer🥲
The location and the luxury qualities of the unit makes this one of my favorite Airbnb properties we have rented. I would recommend and stay here again.

What a great spot in Zurich! Our family enjoyed being away from downtown and exploring this neighborhood. The view of the Lake was stunning, the access to nearby playgrounds and public transit also great. The place was old-style-AirBnB in that we could tell the hosts usually lived there, which made it speciall and homey. It was lovely to open the windows and get a breeze.

Perfect location and a beautiful walk along the lake. Direct train to and from the airport and Zurich city. Spacious apartment and it’s worth noting that there are a lot of stairs to the top floor (no lift) and it is their home so you must be respectful.

This 5th storey apartment is beautifully decorated and spotlessly clean. The only issue we had was it was very noisy; we could hear every footstep from the apartment above making it difficult to sleep.

- Unit was not ready past check-in time. - Moved to another unit because the unit was not ready, but the other unit was not clean either. Oily and dusty floors, smelly unit. - Miscommunication between the host and the cleaner. Messed up. - No responses after sending a few questions prior to stay. No communication about check-out process.

Just loved the apartment, right outside of the hustle and bustle of Zurich. We had no problems getting around via public transportation. Switzerland really got it right. The bed was quite comfortable. The air conditioning worked very well and appreciated the Dyson fan to keep the cool air circulating. Reto did a great job staying in communication with us to ensure we had no issues. We had everything we needed and would definitely return when we visit Zurich again.

We had a great time in Zurich at this cute and cosy Airbnb. The place was located perfectly for and was so wonderful with the vineyard near by, it was quite picturesque. Public transport was extremely close with a tram just up the hill less than 200m I think. Retro was a great host and made our stay very pleasant.

Loved this place! Was VERY clean and comfortable bed. Had a little hiccup at check-in due to the fact that my key had not been in the lock but the hosts were very unresponsive and were able to have someone give me the key in 45 minutes. The best location and everything worked! Just remember to bring your own cleaning supplies + coffee + tea + shampoo, etc... as the place only had 1 small bar of soap! Overall loved this place and would come back. Clean and tidy.

Raphael is a fantastic host - everything from the start was smooth, quick, and professional. The apartment is cozy, well-equipped, and perfectly located, just steps away from Lake Zurich and within walking distance to everything you need. We felt right at home and will definitely book with Raphael again!

great apartment and great location. amazing guests very helpful and responsive. would recommend the apartment to anyone who wants to live centrally in Zurich with great connectivity and nice neighbourhood with greenary and parks around.

We had a lovely stay. Location is really close to the train station. The apartment was very clean. Alexandra was really helpful with recommendations of places to eat and things to do in the area and gave clear instructions to find and access the apartment. Thank you very much
Extraordinary! Fantastic location surrounded by supermarkets and restaurants. Just 1 minute walk to the train station. You will never miss a train staying at this place.

The apartment is exactly what you see on the pictures. Not a big one, but the space is well arranged. The bed is super comfy. The view from the window is really stunning. Walkable distance to the old city and other attractions of Zurich. Luigi replied super fast, in my case it was just in minutes. I needed to have a late check- out, and Luigi was extremely nice to let me leave my suitcase in the apartment though it was not super comfortable for him, I guess, as he was returning home from his trip the same day. Overall I enjoyed my stay and will be happy to stay at Luigi’s place next time in Zurich

We had a great stay! The place was in the most central & convenient location, remarkably clean and well-put. It felt as taken care by truly professional hosts. They have also been so friendly and always responsive. I can’t recommend it enough - we’re definitely staying again there in our next visit. Thank you so much!

A very spacious apartment not too far from Hbf. It was clean and accessible with lots of balconies and open spaces for natural light and fresh air. Only had small trouble in finding the apartment in the maze of buildings and the huge commercial center which makes the entrance a bit obscure. Also there were no basic amenities like tea/coffee/soap. Would be nice to have it for short stays especially.

We were very satisfied with Frank and his team. Their communication was excellent and they were always helpful. The apartment was big and had everything necessary. The location was good as everything was a walking distance away: shops, restaurants, etc. The heating is unfortunately central and you can adjust the heating only to a certain point. The apartment was too hot for us, especially at night and sleeping with an open window was a bit noisy. As well often the elevator smelled strongly of weed and that was a bit unpleasant, especially with a small baby.

The apartment is in a good location, but there are a few areas that could be improved. Upon arrival, it did not appear to have been thoroughly cleaned: the floors needed attention, some coffee capsules had been left behind, and there were visible marks on the windows and mirrors. One of the bedrooms faces the street and can be quite noisy when the window is open, while the other bedroom is much quieter. The apartment is functional, but it would benefit from some renovation and a more welcoming interior to make it feel more comfortable and homely.

Fantastic Zurich Stay at Cher's Apartment We thoroughly enjoyed our time here! Cher is a very helpful host, and the apartment delivers on quality and convenience. The Upsides: Unbeatable Connectivity: Bus, tram, and metro stations are all just 5-7 minutes away on foot. Spacious, High-Quality Kitchen: The kitchen is large, and all the appliances (fridge, induction, dishwasher) look brand new and work perfectly. Thoughtful Amenities: The apartment includes a great Marshall speaker and a much-needed travel adapter. Added Convenience: Cher offers luggage storage in the basement cellar. It's a nice, spacious 2-bedroom apartment. The Only Note: As noted in the listing, the apartment is located on the third floor of the building. We had a great time and would definitely stay again!

A clean and beautiful apartment that we have the pleasure of staying 2 nights in. Do note that there is no lift in the building and the apartment is located on the 3rd floor which may not be that convenient. However, everything else was perfect! Thank you for hosting us.

The apartment was very clean and spacious. The location couldn’t be better to get around Zurich. All the best bars and restaurants are very close. It does mean the street noise is rather loud, so over the weekend you can hear the partying. We loved having the washing machine and dryer. They are brand new and great for longer stays like ours. The TV has Netflix and the internet was very good too. Communication was really good. However, the mattress for the bed is firm and not that comfortable, so we didn’t sleep too good. But there were far more pros than cons.

The apartment was also quite nice and close to Zurich HB main station, as well as the tram stop and Coop supermarket. However, the Wi-Fi always disconnecting, and the equipment was limited. For example, the shower screen should be repaired for improvement.

Perfectly clean and quiet, a well-organized and tidy space with room for two to relax. A very comfortable bed, plenty of air and light. I especially appreciated the fans in the bathroom and laundry closet. Good restaurants, museums, markets and bars are all within easy walking distance. Street life is lively but not noisy. A delightful experience!

We had a great stay! It was nice to have a washer and dryer to use. Area was quiet after 10p even though there were several restaurants and bars in the area. Great location to old towne, the river and lots of restaurants a d cafes. No air conditioning but they provided a fan which worked adequately as it was unseasonably warm while we were there. Something to note is: cabs are not able to drive down the street between 11p and 5a.

The apartment was in very clean, as advertised, and in a great location close to lots of transportation options that made it easy to get around Zürich. The hosts were accessible and made check in and check out really easy. We would definitely stay here again!

We really enjoyed our stay in this spacious, modern apartment. The layout was open and bright, with large windows that brought in lots of natural light. The beds were very comfortable, and everything was clean and well maintained. The only thing we missed was having a washing machine for our clothes. The location was perfect—peaceful yet with easy access to trams that made getting into the city quick and convenient. A great base for exploring Zurich!

Sage suite was the perfect place for us. Spacious, clean, and close to everything. We walked to old town, the FIFA museum and amazing food. Train station is very close. The public transportation is easy and right outside of the apartment. When it was time to leave we walked maybe 20 yards down to a tram stop and jumped on one straight to the airport. Location is amazing and so is the apartment. Thank you! Hope to be back someday❤️

Friedrich was a good host, very responsive. The flat is nicely appointed, and the beds were comfortable. The flat is right next to a major street with public transport running by, but it’s not an issue unless you have the windows open. We stayed in the summer when it was warmer at night, so it would have been nice to have a cool breeze from the open windows, but the noise would have been too loud. We utilized the fans, however it was still somewhat warm. But the location was very ideal for our family of three kids, with a public transport stop very close by. We were also able to leave our luggage in the flat when we arrived in the morning, which was a big help. Nice flat overall.

Nice location, walking distance to train station and supermarkets. The host answer ed what I questioned, but it took long time for response. The place is neat, however, the handheld shower is a bit weird that another shower will be turned on and released cold water after shutting the small one off by pressing it harder. Because of this, I had bad showering experience.
Me and my family had a nice experience in this stay, it was very centric, useful. The bed was comfortable but the sofa bed not so much ^^ either way, we had a good rest. I recommend it.

The apartment was as listed and matched the photographs shared. Very spacious, lots of light, ventilation across the apartment. Location is very central, bang opposite the Silhcity mall and only a few tram stops away from the main high street / shopping destination in Zurich. The tram stop is right outside the apartment. An excellent supermarket attached to the same campus with a few eateries was a bonus. The host was responsive. Overall highly recommend.

Dogan was very responsive and nice. He was kind enough to accommodate an earlier checkin which was appreciated after our long trip. The apartment was very clean and spacious. Definitely big enough for 4 guest. However, it would benefit from additional pillows and blankets. There weren’t enough for all. The location is next to public transportation but not too close to old town if that’s a preference.

Absolutely beautiful apartment in a great location! There's a well-stocked Coop grocery store right outside the apartment, which worked really well for us as the kitchen was quite nice. The apartment is also right outside a tram stop that takes you right to Zurich HB, the main train station in Zurich. Dogan left very clear and easy-to-understand instructions for check-in and we got into the apartment with no problems. The apartment also has a great sound system and television! Important to note that there wasn't soap in the apartment, but this wasn't a problem as we had brought our own.
Lots of room in this flat for our travelling family of 4. Great park out back and shopping centre across the road. Nice neighbourhood with easy short tram ride to the old town. Nice stay.

Giancarlo’s place is located in central part of Zurich, in a beautiful, clean and quiet residential neighbourhood. The tram station is only a 2 minute walk from the apartment, and within a 10-minute walk, you’ll have the lake with a few surrounding bars, restaurants and shops. The apartment is very clean and it has a gorgeous balcony. The only downside was the fact that the elevator was not working during my entire stay, which made going up and down the stairs difficult for me with my knee injury. Other than that, I was very happy with the place.
unfortunately we didn't get to meet dila whilst in zurich, but andres was the perfect host - he was welcoming and incredibly helpful during our stay, and was always quick to respond to any questions

Dila and Andres are the best hosts! On a hot day in Zurich they brought me along to swim in the river and attend a concert :) I truly felt welcomed as their guest and had the most amazing time in such a short visit to a new place. I highly recommend staying with them, they are wonderful people! (plus they have an amazing cat Sophie🐈‍⬛)

The apartment itself was fine — as shown in the pictures, and the location is good. No major issues with the space. However, I had a negative experience with the host. From the beginning, he did not provide clear instructions to enter the building. At the end of my stay, he pressured me to leave a positive review and even threatened to leave me a bad review when I said I would be honest. He also claimed I didn’t leave the apartment clean, even though he admitted he never checked it himself. The place is okay, but I cannot recommend the host’s behavior.

We booked very lastminute, and this was a good option in terms of location and convenience. The apartment was a bit dated but clean. You could also hear the street traffic, tram and sounds within the building quite well. We had asked for separate beds but the sofabed isn’t really suitable - Its on the floor and came without any topper so little comfort. The double bed was comfortable, so I’d recommend this for a couple that is out and about a lot.
Great location Cozy apartment and easy access to the central

The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures. There is everything you need for cooking but there are also restaurants within walking distance. It is a short walk to the city center but there is also a tram stop right next to the apartment and the public transport here is easy to navigate. Over all we enjoyed our stay and would love to come again!
It was a good location, nice place very clean but there was construction going on outside and on the floor beneath the apartment while I was there.

We had a lovely stay in one of the City Stay apartments - keep in mind there are clearly several that differ from the photos. The location is wonderful - super short walk from the HB and main city sights. The apartment is old however with a very crammed bathroom, but for the price, worth it for a short stay.

No elevator. This should be very clear to other guest because if you have large luggage’s as we had it’s painful depending on the floor. Smells from other people’s apartments and it came into our room. Room also had a smell when we first came in. Toilet seat looked dirty. It wasn’t cleaned correctly. Had spots all over it. The price I paid for a 1 bed with 1 bathroom it would be better at a hotel for same price. Basically it was a hotel and The only difference it had the tiniest kitchen which was a tiny sink and tiny stove top. We didn’t cook so we regretted not opting for a hotel and avoid the smell and no elevator. Internet was horrible and it eventually stopped working and they never fixed it.

The Airbnb property is located at a very good and convenient location, which made travelling around very easy. The amenities provided were also well-equipped and suitable for families staying together. However, the only noticeable issue during the stay was the unpleasant smell inside the property, which could be improved for a better guest experience overall.

Had a lovely stay at Merlin’s place. Merlin and the other tenants were super friendly and forthcoming and Merlin had lots of good recommendations about Zurich. Merlin was always quick to respond in case of questions and the check in and check out went super smoothly. The house is a beautiful old building with lots of charm and the bathroom is renovated really nicely. However, while the floors were super lovely to look at some of the planks are also quite squeaky, which is quite common for old buildings but something someone who is super sensitive to noise may struggle with. If you’re sensitive to light like myself you’re all set though - the blinds world quite nicely. I had a great time at Merlin’s and would stay there again.

This stay was amazing! The room is in a shared house, so can be noisier at times but the housemates are incredibly kind and respectful. One even took the time to show me where the washer was and teach me how to use it.

The space is beautiful and looks exactly like the photos! Carla was very responsive and helpful with any issues/questions. The only unfortunate thing was that there were no towels available for guest use in the space. This was inconvenient but we knew about it beforehand as we had asked her. Overall very well kept and pretty apartment with great access to central Zurich via public transportation while remaining peaceful
Convenient location but the room is a little bit dirty and the shampoo was empty when we checked in.

This is a no frills apartment and you’re constantly reminded of this when there. AI slop art stapled to the wall No hand/small towels provided. Posting advertised a wireless charger but there wasn’t one so we had to go buy a converter. Included travel wifi was nice. Loud sounds all times of day/night. Sad looking room but in a convenient location. I’d say you get what you pay for but it’s not cheap either so 🤷‍♀️

This studio is in a wonderful location, very central in Zurich and easily walkable to restaurants, shops, bars, Lake Zurich. It is also very clean, simple, but has what you need. However, as it is so central and with 2 churches nearby, there is quite a bit of noise, and church bells ring twice an hour. While I was there, there was also construction going on outside, so there were metal slabs covering the pavement, and when cars and vans drive by, it makes a lot of noise. Unfortunately the windows are not double glazed so you hear all the noise. The noise started already at 5am with delivery trucks.

The apartment is small, but very central with everything walkable. It had everything I needed, good bed, good internet and access to a washing machine. The agents were very professional. Always communicative, well-organised and responsive. Check in was done by code/key box and very smooth. Unfortunately, my stay was affected by noisy roadworks outside which was clearly announced inside the building, but not communicated to me. The agents were understanding about this and were quick to come to a suitable compensation agreement. All in all decent value for the accommodation and position.

Good location surrounded by lots of shops, restaurants, and things to do. The main train station is even a 5 minute walk, which is great. However, the room I was given did not match the photos. It felt held together, and a vent cover was even held up by tape in the bathroom. Quite costly for a place of that quality. Safe and an ok place at best. 3 stars for me.

An old and a bit shabby, but clean and spacious apartment. The only negative surprise was the 4th floor and no lift. Parking was easy to find on the street, but the city of Zurich hasn't made it easy to get the permit so it is recommended to check the process in advance. There is also a bus stop cross the street.
Great location, really close to train station and the airport however the sink was block through out my whole stay. Struggled with the heating other than that it was okay. Very clean
Nice stay overall. The place is a bit small, but the location is excellent — very central and convenient. Comfortable and had everything needed for a short stay.

Jaybee was a great host and very responsive. He was able to accommodate a late checkout for us and since our flight was at 5:45pm we found it really helpful to have somewhere to keep our luggage till we were ready to leave Zurich. Place was extremely clean and had all the listed amenities. The location is best for a couple. We are a small family of 3 and found the space not quite enough but the listing says that it’s suitable for 2 so trust that. Overall we had a wonderful time and felt secure in our location. Thank you Jaybee!

I LOVED staying here! I was only in Zurich for 12 hours and had 3 hours to explore the city before getting ready for bed and an early train ride the next day to Germany. Maxi was so friendly, helped orient me to the city, get an affordable train ticket and feel comfortable in Zurich. I would highly recommend staying here. Plus, the bathroom was so nice and the bed comfy! 5/5 stars!

I had a wonderful experience staying here! The view was absolutely stunning, and the location was perfect—just a short walk to the tram stop, which made it easy to get anywhere I needed to go. The host was incredibly nice, responsive, and helpful throughout the entire stay, which made everything smooth and stress-free. I’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!
Nice place! To get into the city you need to drive but the location of the Airbnb is quiet and a good place to stay!

The location is great and the neighbourhood felt peaceful and safe. The host responds fast if you have any troubles. The walls are very thin so you can hear conversations and foot steps from the neighbours in the evening and early morning but the neighbours seem to be quiet and calm so that doesn't bother too much. The apartment looked exactly like in the pictures. All the beds are though queen size (I think one was mentioned to be a king size). Some improvement in the cleanliness of the apartment would be very much welcomed but otherwise we were happy with our stay.

This was an excellent stay. I looked at the reviews beforehand and didn’t have a as much of a problem with heat, the temps while I was here were in the 60-70s Fahrenheit during the day, but the door being able to open and the fan on made the room comfortable. The location is so walkable and close to tram stations, and extremely convenient to Zürich HB. The room was clean. No complaints and I would stay here again! (Solo, able-bodied, female traveler for context)
Dimi is a great host and the flat was perfect for a few days stay. Thank you!

We stayed at Giancarlo’s place for 4 nights, and absolutely loved it. The apartment was spotlessly clean. The neighborhood is walkable and very convenient to the center of Zurich. We didn't need to work while staying, but the separation between the bedroom and living room would make it an ideal apartment to work from. Giancarlo was immediately responsive and provided all the information we needed. We hope to be back!

The tram stop is right in front of the apartment building. The apartment is cosy and clean with beautiful skyline view. Maxi is responsive and he checked in with us regularly. The only information that was inaccurate was the tram number. It was not the fault of Maxi as there is a change of tram number from 4 to 51 due to construction until Dec 2026 It will be helpful if this piece of information is updated so that the next guest will get to the apartment safely.
Very nice and friendly person! It is walkable location from the main station :)

Stayed here overnight and was super pleased with how accessible this was to the AltStadt/Downtown area. This is a basement unit so you have to navigate down a small walkway and downstairs but the instructions and accompanying pictures made it super easy. There was also a small dehumidifier/cooling unit in the room which I appreciated. Room was as described. Thank you!
Kathrin‘s place is small but very nice and cosy. It‘s nice situated, near the lake, in the green but still within the city.

Everything was perfect. We had a last minute change to our plans, and communication went seamlessly with the host. The apartment itself was super cute, and stayed noticeably cool during the day, even with a heat wave washing over Zürich. I would highly recommend this listing.

We really enjoyed our stay in Zürich at Dominik’s place. He was very responsive, flexible with the check-in and had very clear instructions about the place.
