This tram stop was literally a minute walking distance which made it very convenient for us. The place itself is clean, very beautifully furnished and very comfortable. The only thing I will add is Switzerland gets hotter than what I thought and there is no AC in the apartment. We just made sure we closed all the windows in the morning and put the blinds down before leaving the house. And then we opened the windows in the evening, which helped with the breeze coming in. There are also floor fans in every room which greatly helped. overall we had a wonderful day.
Great location, plus 1 min away from the bus stop to get a bus ride straight to the airport. Supplies and amenities more than complete! Amazing! I would highly recommend this place to my friends!

I enjoyed my stay here. It’s a beautiful 2 bedroom apartment that was very spacious, clean, and had everything you might need while you stay there. The only room for improvement was that it wasn’t ready by check-in time.

The apartment was gorgeous and in a great location - public transit to the main area of the city wasn’t too far and there were plenty of cute shops and restaurants nearby. We also had our flight to Zurich get cancelled from the US and Johannes was very patient and communicative with us as we tried to find another flight (ended up going to Frankfurt and training over). Lovely place and host!
Beautiful apartment and perfect location! Unfortunately there was some problem with the hot water during our stay but Johannes was very helpful about it
Great place to stay if you want access to both the central train station and the beautiful old town in Zürich.
Absolute pleasure staying with Heiko, he's super responsive and super friendly person I would definitely stay in the future with. Thank you so much for your hospitality, hope to see you soon

Simon resolved an issue we had promptly, and always quick to respond. The inside of the property was clean and tidy. Heads up that the outside of the property is currently a building site, literally. This is covered by the owner’s description, but for this reason alone we couldn’t recommend it at the moment.

The apartment itself is clean and comfortable. It is located close to the train station so has the expected noise level. Check in instructions from host are very clear and information about the state of building was accurate. Not really equipped to cook meals - lacks basic cooking equipment other than pans - e.g a wooden spoon or something similar for cooking. Not even salt or oil are provided as was described - just a half used sachet of sugar. Coffee and milk were provided however which was helpful.

The apartment was very nice, and the location was quite good, close to the train station. Unfortunately, it was on a specific, party street. If you don't like that kind of atmosphere, we don't recommend it. Some of the information in the listing description was inaccurate. There was a lack of salt, pepper, oil, and, most importantly, toilet paper. Half a roll of toilet paper for four people for three days was an absurd amount.

The price for 1 night was to high and the rest is good we left early morning at 5:40 to train station we had the train early morning. But the people in nearby restaurants and bar has too much noise all night long we could not sleep.

We only needed a place for one night before flying out and it was a great location near the train station for easy access to the airport. Any sort of food, drinks, and groceries were extremely close-by. Although the building was under construction we had not issues with conflicting noise or cleanliness. The flat is vey spacious with huge rooms and clean kitchen but there is very limited utensils or serve ware if you are looking to make any of your own food. The location is noisy and would not have been a problem except that there was no air conditioning and all the rooms were very hot at night. Keep that in mind for longer stays.

A few days before our stay, the host informed us that the original apartment was unavailable due to water damage and offered an alternative on the fifth floor, which included a third bedroom. The replacement apartment was very clean, comfortable, and well-suited for our group of five. Its location was ideal—just a 10 to 15-minute walk to the train station. The only thing to note is that it’s near a bar, so light sleepers may want to use earplugs at night. Although there is ongoing construction in the hallways, it did not impact our stay. The hosts were responsive and attentive throughout the entire process, from booking to checkout. The apartment looked exactly as shown in the photos.

Quiet and clean apartment that I'd happily recommend, however please pay close attention to the "no frills" element in the description. The kitchen equipment and accessories are very basic and cooking for a hungry family is a bit of a challenge. That said it is in a quiet location and well located for trips in and out of Zurich.

Beautiful place, clean and perfect for a group of four. The location is excellent very close to Zürich HB and the city centre, making it easy to get around. The apartment is right in front of bars and the train station, so there can be some noise, as mentioned in the listing. However, once the windows are closed, the noise is minimal and we were able to sleep peacefully every night. The host was amazing very responsive, quick to reply, and extremely helpful throughout our stay. They even allowed us a late check-out, which we really appreciated. Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend staying here

The apartment is comfortable for a family of four, bright and clean. The kitchen is well equipped (including a dishwasher) and there is also a washer/dryer. The location isn’t bad though there isn’t much to do in the area however, it has good connections, making it easy to get around the city by car or public transport. On the downside, there aren’t enough parking spaces available in front of the building and they’re usually occupied. The nearest covered (paid) car park is about a 10–15 minute walk away (45 CHF per night) If you’re staying here during the autumn or winter months, ask for the heating to be turned on before your check-in to avoid getting cold. Apart from that this is a good place for a short stay. I’ll recommended.

We enjoyed our stay at Friedrich’s place in Zurich, it was a nicely located flat a short walk from a vibrant little centre of bars and restaurants, with really easy S-Bahn connection to Zurich Main Station. The flat is really nicely furnished, but the flat itself is a little tired and could do with some TLC. The floorboards in the main bedroom were comically creaky, and the kitchen could do with a few additions to make things easier (frying pan, chopping boards of a decent size, tea towel). It did the basics well enough, but for the price of the flat you’d expect a bit better. That said, the hosts were really friendly and responsive and the flat served us well whilst we were in Zurich.

We really liked the apartment. It's an old house, but a very nice apartment with a lot of space and almost everything you need in the kitchen. Unfortunately, there's no designated parking spot, but we could always find something nearby - it's generally complicated in Zürich anyway. The host was very friendly and responsive.

The apartment is very well located in central Zurich, with easy access to restaurants, grocery stores, and public transport. However, parking can be a challenge if you're traveling with a car—it's limited and quite expensive in the city center. The apartment itself is comfortable but could use a few small improvements. A coffee pot would be a great addition, and the bathroom could be better equipped—there’s only a short towel rack, no hooks, and no shelf for toiletries. The wifi could be spotty at times. That said, the host was responsive and quick to answer our questions, which we really appreciated.

The 24 hours we spent in Zürich in the Appartement were quite comfortable and we were able to relax on the terrasse. The kitchen needs extra utilities if more time is to be spent and if cooking is planned.
Well decorated, clean, comfortable, and cozy! Loved this place for a few nights in Zurich. Easy to get to the train station with one stop to main station.

overall a good stay, the apartment was on the top floor and exceptionally hot. However, instructions were clear, communication was good, and the location was what we were looking for. just be warned if you will be there in warmer months, our room was an attic space and understandably very warm.
very lovely place! the loft was very clean and had everything you needed and also the host was very super nice. would come back anytime :)

It was an absolute beautiful apartment and we really enjoyed the quiet and spacious stay. Yvonne was very response at all times and I will come back to the apartment again if I visit with family next time

The place itself was fine but the quality of your stay also depends on your roommates. This time I got unlucky so the place was pretty dirty (kitchen/bathroom etc.). If you want anything cleaned or fixed please be proactive - the host is very responsive once you initiate the request. Other than that - location is great and decent price considering it is central and well connected.

The apartment is very nice. Lots of space to enjoy and relax in. Location is a short distance out of the central hub of Zurich - but there are plenty of busses/trains/trams ect to get to from town easily and quickly.

Fantastic stay, we highly recommend! The apartment was excellent, very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host’s communication was outstanding throughout, making everything really easy from check-in to check-out. We’d happily stay here again!
A very nice place overall, the place was very new. A bit far away from central, but tram connections are good and fast.

This property was professionally managed and well-suited to our family for our 5-night visit. The kitchen was suitable for the minimal cooking we did (however, we could not figure out how to use the oven). The layout with three bedrooms and a large living room was very comfortable. The location was good with two grocery stores within a 3 min walk, however it is not located where we spent our time while in Zurich, but it was close enough for us to access all of those places.

We had a wonderful stay in the apartment. It was quiet, and public transportation to the city center was convenient and nearby. The apartment matches the photos. It was quite clean, and all the listed amenities were present. The assigned parking spot was hard to find at first, but the host responded immediately to our message. In summary: highly recommended!

Great apartment! It was very spacious, the sofa bed was comfortable, and check-in was easy. The location also has good public transport connectivity. Steven was also very quick to respond. The only minor issue was that there was no shower gel in the bathroom, but overall, it was a wonderful stay!

The place was perfect!! It was well located, and it was just as in the pictures Frederick was helpful and reachable The only comment I have is that the place smelled like cigarettes (perhaps from the previous guests so not Frederick’s fault) but after a little bit of air everything was better Highly recommended

Friedrich's Airbnb property was amazing. I really enjoyed the stay. The beds were very comfortable. There was a big kitchen and big living room with dining space and a balcony. The bathroom was very nice. It had all the amenities one needs. The area was nice with lots of shops and restaurants in the vicinity. All in all I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to stay comfortably in Zurich.
The house was tastefully furnished and extremely functional. I had a couple of simple suggestions regarding minor issues, and I believe the host will take care of them.
Good view of the place and responsive host.

I had a wonderful stay at this property! The room was spotlessly clean and came with a room heater, which made it extra cozy. The location is unbeatable—just a short walk to Sihlcity, one of Zurich’s largest shopping centers, and the tram stop is less than 100 meters away, making city travel incredibly convenient. The check-in process was smooth and hassle-free, and Navad was always available on WApp for any questions or support, which made the experience even more comfortable. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a clean, well-connected, and welcoming stay in Zurich!

It’s a small place for two, but there was lots of storage to keep luggage out of the way. The balcony was a treat for morning coffee and arriving home at the end of a long day of walking around. 5 minute walk to grocery and tram to get to more central attractions. It was quite warm when we were in Europe, the fan helped. I had a travel fan as well.
Janet hosts a space that is very convenient to the city yet located in a quiet peaceful neighborhood. She is generous with recommendations. Her hospitality and kindness made for a most pleasant stay.

Had a really pleasant stay overall. The place was clean, cozy, and looked just like the photos. The location was convenient and quiet at night, which made it easy to relax after long days exploring the city. Check-in was simple and the host was friendly and responsive whenever I had questions. The bed was comfortable, Wi-Fi worked well, and the apartment had everything needed for a short stay. I’d definitely consider staying here again in the future

Leonardo was very helpful and responsive whenever needed. We had to check-out late, he helped us to put luggage in the room for extra time. Over-all we liked the stay, but the location is little bit outside city center.

A reasonable choice for the price, the room and house are very clean, the owner always responds quickly. The only problem is that the sound due to being near the train tracks is quite loud, and there is nothing to do around in the dark. Still a good option for choose.

We only stayed for one night, but the apartment had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Although it's small, it felt cozy and well-equipped. We were three people, and there was enough space for all of us. One pleasant surprise: the host provided towels, even though we had understood from the description that we would need to bring our own. The large balcony was definitely a highlight – a lovely spot to relax. Public transport connections were excellent, which made getting around really easy. Finding parking nearby was a bit of a challenge, but that’s to be expected in the area. Communication with the host was smooth and easy. Although we didn’t get to meet in person, I have the feeling we would have gotten along really well. All in all, a great stay – thank you!

Jaybee was a great host, the check-in instructions were clear, and the communication was excellent. The apartment is quiet, in a good location, in a peaceful neighborhood, and it's possible to do activities on foot.

I had a really great stay and would definitely recommend this place. Everything was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well organized. The location was very convenient, with easy access to transport, restaurants, and shops, which made getting around really simple. The space itself felt welcoming and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. Ivan was an excellent host—very friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout. Communication was smooth from start to finish, and I felt well taken care of during my visit. Overall, it was a very positive experience, and I would happily stay here again in the future!
It is a very comfortable apartment. It has all the necessitates and is fully furnished. I would definetly book it again.

We had an amazing stay! The place is absolutely beautiful and honestly the photos don’t do it justice at all. Everything was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a perfect stay. The host was wonderful, super responsive, friendly, and made everything really easy from start to finish. You can tell they really care about their guests. We would 100% stay here again. Highly recommended! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I’ve stayed in several apartments in this area, and this one is by far the best I’ve found. It’s very quiet, stylish, and cozy — real Pinterest vibes. The apartment was clean and smelled great, everything felt well thought out. The only small downside is that if you’re over 2 meters tall, it might be a bit uncomfortable. Other than that, 10/10. Highly recommended.

My mother and I had a wonderful stay. The washer and drier were very convenient and the shower/bathroom was clean. It is conveniently located by a bus stop so you won’t have to travel too far with luggage. However, finding the airbnb was a little tricky since we came after sun down. The host did send directions an hour beforehand but It would have been better to send it a day early. Also the mattress wasn’t very comfortable and little small for two people. Otherwise, once you’re inside, it’s a great place to reset and travel to the city. The host is very responsive. Thank you for having us, we really enjoyed our stay! :)

We had a great stay at Michael’s place. It was clean and very spacious for two people. It is conveniently located near a food shop as well as a tram stop which allows easy access to the centre. Michael was very communicative throughout and a great host. We would definitely stay here again!
great location, Michael was a great host, house was clean besides a stain on the carpet and bed, but other than that, everything was great.

A fantastic stay from start to finish. Really communicative host with very clear instructions which made finding the place and checking in super easy. Lovely clean and big space. Well equipped kitchen and comfy beds which is a real plus if you have back trouble! Thank you so much.

We enjoyed our stay here for the most part! The location was great and place is spacious and clean. The only drawback was that the pullout couch was broken, but we were still able to accommodate our group of 8. Also, the showerhead was broken so water pressure is relatively low. But those were minor issues we were able to deal with, and the place itself was pleasant to stay in. Would recommend overall!

felt at home with staying here. the only feedback would be making the bed larger as it's not sufficient for two adults. the location is amazing. the kitchen and amenities wonderful. would recommend providing laundry detergent and diswasher liquid to better accomodate facilities.

The stay was great, very clean, close to transportation that takes you right into downtown. ( or you can walk 15 min ) coffee shop next door was great to start the day. Check in process was fast and easy!
Convenient location and amazing natural lighting in the kitchen.

We had a truly wonderful stay and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Everything was well prepared and thoughtfully arranged, which made us feel welcome from the first moment. The atmosphere was calm and cozy, perfect for relaxing after a busy day. Kairbekova was a great host – kind, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. Communication was easy and clear, and any questions we had were answered quickly. The location was also very convenient, with everything we needed nearby. We genuinely enjoyed our time and would gladly stay here again. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a pleasant and stress-free stay

The property is very conveniently located, close to the centre, and near a tram stop. The property was as described, and was very clean and very practical. This was all at a good price for Zurich and compared to similar properties.

Good accommodation. The building did smell of cannabis but I guess that's just society now and nothing to do with the accommodation itself. Would recommend it to anyone who wants a city centre accommodation. There is parking underground which I won't recommend as there is also parking across the road which is completely free after 20:00 till 9:00 a.m. overall a very good accommodation and the host is very proactive in their communication which is also appreciated.

very inviting apartment, rooms looked just as shown, kitchen was very spacious and accommodating, and host even was so kind to provide milk in the fridge! shower was very enjoyable with ample hot water and fresh body towels for each of us (4). the beds were very comfortable and the duvets were plenty even in the cooler weather we left the windows open at night (around 9°C). The main room's furnishings were comfortable to just sit, relax and enjoy morning coffee. We would certainly consider returning to this place when we return to Zurich.

Brilliant host and a beautiful apartment. We struggled a little with the heat and lack of fan or outdoor space, but there was a very hot heatwave at the time of our visit. The apartment is historic and very beautiful, as is the area it’s in. It was very easy to walk to the lake or into the city centre. A great place for a mini-break in Zurich. Thank you!
Good place to stay. Description and photos matched the place. Location is good. The balcony is nice. Dimi is responsive and helpful.

Happy to find this place, which was pretty good value for Zurich! It's a 15 min bus or tram from the centre which are really easy to use, so decent location. It was also really clean and roomy, with a comfy bed, decent kitchen, and nice shower. The host was also really communicative and flexible with check-in after my flight got changed. I think I was the first guest so it might change but there were no towels, condiments, or WiFi so keep that in mind. There was also an unexpected cleaning fee which wasn't on the listing, but I was told would be added to the advert so shouldn't be unexpected for whoever uses it next. Definitely recommend for its relative value.

Good sized bedroom with all the basic amenities, however we personally found the bed to be too firm for comfort. Tina was approachable and responsive. Apartment was very clean and the shared amenities were no issue. Location is within close walking distance to a bus that goes towards the city. Large grocery stores and train station are within a 15 minute walk.

We had a pleasant 3-night stay, and the location was great. The room was simple (as per listing) but had a comfortable bed and pillows. Vanessa was an excellent host who went the extra mile to assist, especially with receiving me upon arrival and helping with our luggage. We truly appreciate her hospitality and highly recommend her place for anyone visiting Zurich.

The room was exactly same with photos, and it was very cozy and comfortable. Cheyenne was kind and always quick to respond to any questions and provide help whenever needed. We had just a one-night stay during a layover, and since it was raining heavily we were very tired, but the mattress and pillows were incredibly comfortable, so we were able to sleep deeply. The location is also perfect for airport access. It takes only 2–3 minutes on foot after getting off the tram. Highly recommended to everyone! If we travel to Zurich again, we would definitely stay here again:)

We had absolutely fabulous time at this beautiful apartment. Everything was perfect, even better than expected from the pictures. The location is super central but at the same time the gorgeous rooftop garden is like a private oasis. Our hosts were really responsive to all our questions and the place was spotless. 5 stars and highly recommended if you’re looking for a great place in Zurich.

The apartment is spacious enough for 7 people, with great amenities, and easily accessible in the center of Zurich. It was a bit challenging to use the stairs to the top floor, but once inside the apartment is great with a good view on top. We were not able to use the gas stove but the host was kind enough to offer us a refund. Due to heavy rains, we also had minor flooding through the windows and the water heater broke but the host is readily responsive. Overall, we enjoyed our short stay in Switzerland in this place.

We had a very comfortable stay at this apartment in Zurich. The location was excellent — centrally located, well connected, and convenient for exploring the city with family. The apartment was spacious, clean, and comfortable overall. The host was very responsive to all our queries and tried his best to help whenever needed. Since it was unusually hot during our stay and the apartment did not have AC, we requested fans and the host arranged them for us, which we really appreciated. The only point to note is that the apartment has only one toilet for three bedrooms, which was a bit of a struggle for our family. Apart from that, we had a great experience and would recommend this place for a family stay in Zurich.

We stayed for a few days and were very pleased with everything. The apartment was in a great location, yet it was wonderfully quiet after a long day. It was clean, comfortable, and equipped with everything we needed. Overall, it was a wonderful place to stay, and we thoroughly enjoyed our visit.

Not a bad place to stay, it’s clean and comfortable and in a good location. But the listing is a bit misleading as listed amenities include washer & dryer, which we assumed were in the unit but when in fact it’s a shared washer/dryer with the entire apartment complex in the basement and you have to pay. Wouldn’t have been a big deal if that was a little more apparent but it’s a bit misleading as currently depicted. We cooked one night and it also would have been nice to have a cutting board and one or two good knives, again we assumed those would be there because it was described as such.

Other than the fact that it is a long uphill walk (which I really didn't mind) from the old town and train station to the apartment, everything was great. Anastasia was super nice and communicated well. The place was clean and spacious. The kitchen was more than adequate. Anastasia provided some welcome beverages. The bed was comfy and the shower had plenty of hot water.
Amazing stay, great host, the location is perfect. Next to the train station and many shops and restaurants.

Apartment is on 3rd floor, so if you have a lot of luggages it might be a problem. Theres a storage in the basement, and everyone in the building has access to it. Hot water was not available I think after 11pm, although we waited a an hour but there was still no hot water.

The location of this Airbnb is convenient and walkable to local restaurants, supermarkets and bakeries. Free parking is also another positive aspect of this Airbnb. However, it is best not to stay here if you are traveling with senior citizens. There are numerous stairs to climb (maybe around 50 steps). The tub is hard to climb in and out of. Furthermore, there is a wooden step between every room and the hallway. It is very easy to trip on those wooden steps.

Our stay at Blueground was overall great, from the cleanliness of the place, to the responsiveness of the support team. The only aspect of our stay which we would raise as a complaint is the very poor Wifi connection. From the beginning of our stay, we brought this up and though they sent people to investigate, no real solution was provided. I hope they can resolve this issue for future guests. Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this immaculate flat. The welcome pack and attention paid to detail made this stay even more special.

Tom’s apartment is located in one the best districts of Zurich, very close to Limmat and the station. The apartment felt spacious and well equipped and it was a pleasure to stay there. Highly recommended.
beautiful and spacious apartment in a great neighborhood, close to supermarkets and the tram station, with lots of amenities, Tom is an amazing host, would recommend

From check in to check out, the stay was wonderful. Florian treated us like family and helped us with everything we needed. He brought our luggage up for us, guided us to restaurants, downtown and literally was just amazing in every imaginable way. The place was close to public transportation. The kitchen was filled with all the things needed to cook. I think our interactions with Florian were even more wonderful than the place we were staying. Haha He made the visit absolutely lovely by taking time to make sure we had everything we needed to enjoy our time in Zurich. What a gift to our tired souls to have such a kind person to help us on our last day of our trip. Truly was marvelous. Nice to have an elevator for our 86 year old mother too.

Glad to say we had a very pleasant stay! Our host Florian was extremely accommodating, and went out of his way to allow us to check in earlier due to our flight, and even rushed over to check us in when we arrived earlier than expected. He replied very quickly and provided relevant suggestions regarding things to do around the area. The accommodation itself is spacious and clean, and well equipped with amenities. The only consideration would be the lack of a washing machine. It is also conveniently located right next to a tram station, which provides easy access to the airport as well as the Zurich main station. There are also cafes and grocery stores located within walking distance of about 2 tram stations. Overall very pleasant stay, would recommend and stay again in the future!
The apartment was exactly as described and clean. Also, it is close to Zurich HB. Check-in was smooth and the host was welcoming and responsive. I really enjoyed my stay.

Lauren was friendly, considerate and responsive host. The location is about a 7-10min walk from the main station, so it is very well connected. there are bunch of nice restaurants all around the place. The only caveat of being close to train/bus/tram station and a main street is the loud motorway and train noise. That was expected by me so no stars off for that. The home itself was very comfortable. I would be happy to stay again when in town.

We really liked the location of the apartment. It was close and in walking distance to everything- the train station, ETH Zürich, the river. It was also very quiet neighborhood, felt really nice and peaceful. It’s perfect for 1-2 people. During a hot day the apartment did feel warm, but after opening the windows and turning the provided fan on high, it was bearable. I live in the USA and by our standards this was considered hot. But in Europe not many apartments have an AC, so there is nothing to complain about. I would stay there again just because of location.
This space is centrally located to multiple tram and bus stops making it very easy to get around the city. Joy was incredibly communicative and helpful in meeting our needs.

The cleanest Airbnb I have ever stayed in. Really lovely space, bright and wonderful host. We were very happy with the area and Mi-te a Vietnamese restaurant near the flat is absolutely incredible. Highly recommend.

The condo is spacious, bright and quiet. It is half a block from the main tram line and very close to grocery stores and a good base to explore Zurich. We were very impressed to be in the area where Einstein was a student and teacher.
host was very responsive and had clear check in and check out instructions .The house was very clean and there is a fast and reliable wifi.Tho I do wish there was a TV in the apartment.

They provided beddings for 4 people, although we reserved for 5. They told the fifth person to use the dirty couch with chocolate and other marks everywhere, and the pillows on the couch. They did not provide bed linens, and clean sheets for the 5th although we asked them to do so in the moment we checked in. We checked in at the earliest moment they let us. They said sleep on the dirty couch tonight, and the clean sheets will be provided the following day. As it is a company, they stop working after 4-5 pm, which cuts any type of support if you need something. Yes, you can chat with them online, but they will just tell you to wait until the next day.

The apartment was well connected to the tram network and offered an excellent city view. The owner was nice and helpful. As we were a group of four, the apartment felt a bit cramped. Communication was sometimes delayed. During the summer heat, the apartment became quite warm due to limited ventilation and no fans. Although the owner kindly provided a small table fan on request, it was not sufficient for all of us. Keeping the windows open helped with ventilation but resulted in road noise. Overall, it was okay for our one-night stay, but better ventilation would improve comfort during warmer months.

The apartment was cosy and spacious, and we felt right at home. It was easy to reach by tram and, since it was a little way from the centre, it felt very peaceful. The view was nice, too. The host was very nice and polite, and responded promptly.

I thoroughly enjoyed my time at Natalie’s apartment. It’s modern, well appointed, and thoughtfully decorated. The space was quiet even without the shutters down. The host was very responsive and accommodating. Highly recommended.

Tania was very responsive in communication even prior to the booking and she accommodated my requests on dates and room. The room was very clean with cleaning service once a week where towels and bed linens are also changed, and it has every thing you would need during your stay including the washing machine. The neighbourhood was absolutely lovely with many restaurants, bakeries & cafes and also a famous gelato shop and tram station, bus stations and coop were all located within 5 mins walk so very convenient. I would definitely stay here again when I come back.

We felt at home and welcome at Livio's place right away and really found the location practical in terms of nearby public transport, shopping and restaurants, while also quiet for a good night's sleep. We'd be more than happy to come back! Thank you, Livio!!

Really a beautiful apartment. You can tell that everything in it was carefully selected. Location was great - only a short walk from the train station. Livio was a very responsive host as well. The only issues were that the floor boards are very loud (not ideal if you have a baby), and that sometimes you can smell the food from the restaurant downstairs strongly.
The flat was spacious, light and airy. It was located close to a supermarket, restaurants and trams. Although there was noise from the railway line, this was minimal with the windows closed.
Excellent flat within walking distance of the town Centre and close to a well stocked supermarket and neighborhood restaurants.

I was hesitant to write this review because I don’t like being negative, but I also can’t be dishonest. The booking process was smooth and the original apartment location was very convenient. However, upon arrival, the access code provided did not work. I had to contact support and went through a long, frustrating process before being relocated to another apartment. The alternative place was acceptable, though the location was less convenient. The next morning, the checkout experience was unnecessarily stressful. Overall, while the apartments themselves were fine, the check-in process, communication, and handling of the situation were very poor, especially for travelers arriving late or tired.

The place was very spacious and clean, staff was easy to communicate with, and the location was conveniently near a bus stop. The only complaint is it could get a bit noisy at night. If you are unlucky to have loud upstairs neighbors, you can hear them.

We are family of 4 ( our kids are 5 years old and 3 months old) in search bar we put our number of family and after we got the conformation we received email at the arrival, that normally is for 3 person and that they made us a favour. We slept only to nights and the neighbor from down she came up to complain about noise imaging we arrived at 1:30 at night and she came 10 in the morning to complain ( we didn’t even had energy to be wake fully) after 8 hours driving The key box was in the number 21 but the apartment was in 23 and we needed to search and figure it out without telling us specifically instructions because in some countries the email ( key ) box is inside at the entrance So very very poor instructions Locations was ok but NOT recommended from us at all

The space was great. Note it is near a loud bar that people seem to hang out outside of until about 3 or 4 in the morning. I do not mind noise so it didn’t bother me. Also, there is no AC so you’ll want to open the window which will just make the bar seem louder. Also a lot of bugs flew in when the window was open but having the window open was the only way to cool the apartment down. Overall, this place is great if you’re looking for inexpensive and near good nightlife. I would not recommend this place if you’re looking for a peaceful stay.
Beautiful apartment and wonderful place to stay during my solo trip to zurich. Walking distance from the centre, station, and all amenities. Nicole was a wonderful host
Had an amazing stay! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was super helpful and responsive. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

I was staying at this accommodation for one night because I have to travel the following day by train. The accommodation located nearby the main Train station in Zürich and so you can easy walk from there to the station. You have many eating options nearby and can go directly to the City Centre of Zürich. The accommodation have all you need to live, also for longer stays. The Check-in and Check-out is really easy. I can recommend this accommodation.

The stay was very good and the overall experience was pleasant. However, the check-in procedure details were shared quite late, which caused a half-hour to one hour wait at the site before we could check in.
Great, spacious airbnb! My friends and I had no problem getting into the city center and check in/out was easy!

the apartment was lovely and matched the pictures. it was also clean when we came in. elevator is also available so it was great if you have heavy luggage with you. we were allowed to do eaely check in, thanks! the neighborhood is peaceful. the only problem is that the wall is pretty thin I can hear quite a lot from the neighbour, so trying to sleep was quite a challenge. overall it was still good apartment to stay.

Everything was great overall, but there was an issue with the Wi-Fi credit. They asked me to purchase a new SIM card at around 9 PM, even though most stores close early, and I had no Wi-Fi access. It would be helpful if the Wi-Fi credit could be checked and topped up before guests arrive, as it shouldn’t be the guest’s responsibility to sort out.

The place was really nice and clean. It’s located right around the corner from a bus stop and grocery store as well. We had an issue getting inside due to lock issues, but the whats app team member Maryem helped me through it and got us another room. Other than that initial incident, we had a great stay.

This is a wonderful apartment in a perfect location. Everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The beds were very cozy and we felt right at home. I will definitely stay here again on my next visit to Zurich. Highly recommended!

This was the perfect place for our stay in Zürich as a family of five. The location was great with everything we wanted to see and do within walking distance and the train station was close by too. This made our arrival by train and our day trip to Lucerne very easy with our three kids. The hosts were quick to respond with any questions we had. We would definitely stay here again.

The flat itself was very good - the room was as described, the contact person was always reachable and helpful. The cleanliness and state of the place really depends on your roommates. Certain things - if you want done you'll have to ask but the hosts will help.

Really comfortable apartment in a great location. Perfect for our short stay in Zurich arriving and leaving by train. Lots to do in a short walk from the flat. Best of all was the really clear and friendly communication that made everything so stress free (is it possible to give 6 stars out of 5 for this?)

I had a very pleasant stay at the apartment. It is quiet, comfortable and well maintained. I stayed over the Christmas holidays, and everything was calm and peaceful, including the street below. The view from the living area is beautiful and adds a lot to the overall atmosphere. Communication with the host was smooth, and everything worked as expected. I can absolutely recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again.

We very much enjoyed our time in Zurich and our stay at Stephanie’s sweet apartment. The space is mostly as described, a very cozy one bedroom apartment. The bedroom is large with plenty of space to spread out and store your luggage and things. The living space is a small table and two chairs within the bedroom, not a separate space you can retreat too. As described, the location is a short walk to the train station with frequent trains into the heart of the city and central old town. The additional cost and time to transport to and from the apartment is noteworthy and something to plan for. The price reflects the location and space, so good value. Thanks Stephanie for a great stay!
David was very kind and helped a lot during our stay. The flat was very clean and exactly as he had described. I suggest this flat to anyone looking for problem-free accommodation in Zurich.

I really enjoyed my stay at Jaybee’s place. The location was great – I could walk around and explore Zurich easily, and the view from the apartment was a nice bonus. It felt like a perfect base to get to know the city.

The stay was super pleasant and the host Jaybee was very helpful when we wrote him. The washer and drying facilities were really nice as well as the balcony where we were able to sit out and eat dinner in the evenings. The kitchen was fully equipped and the only issue was that the dishwasher didn't seem to work and smelled pretty bad when we opened it. However, we were provided with everything to just do the dishes by hand so this was not really a big problem. Besides that the apartment also smelled of smoking but other than that it seemed very clean - especially the bathroom.

We absolutely loved staying here! The room was perfect for two people and the views were absolutely amazing, plus the restaurant above our room was yummy! We definitely would go back and stay here again.

I went there for a new job i found in zurich. the night before, another client and several other people upstairs made noise entire night. The walls of the apartment are paper thin. i couldnt sleep anymore after 6 am and bang their door, no answer. contacted customer service but no solution as well. horrible sound isolation.
Tinka was a great host and was very helpful with questions I had. It is a beautiful place with good access to public transit and the city center.

The apartment is great for two people. Small but modern and confortable. Clan and well located, close to the tram and the train station. The surrounding area is very nice as well. The only (minor) issue is that there is only one chair, so for two people is difficult to have breakfast for example after having cooked the meal in the well equiped kitchen. Also a light close to the bed (for reading for example) would be ideal.

Liliane’s place was in the perfect location for a few days in Zurich. The space is small but did have most things we needed to make our stay easy. Few things to note, there was no kettle which meant we boiled water in a pan - this was fine for us but might not be for others. Overall the place was generally clean but there were some marks on one of the towels and the bathroom was a bit grubby. However it’s one of the more affordable places in Zurich so it was suited to the price and was fine for 2 people.
Tamara's place was clean and in an excellent location, very easy to access all parts of Zurich and great food around. The only downside was the main TV not working, but overall we enjoyed our stay!
Nice place and location however worth knowing that the stairs to the main bedroom are steep and not ideal for older folks. Pretty loud location but also great to be close to restaurants.

Easy to find the house - instructions were a little unclear on how check-in would work. They said they would meet me to give the keys to the house, but then sent instructions on how to get in and we never met the host. House is less than 10 minute walk from the tram that brings you to Zurich HB. Lots of food options within walking distance and a coop a block away so very conveniently located. We originally booked another apartment in the building, but host said there was maintenance being done, so they gave us another apartment in the same building. Was great that they were able to provide us another option without much hassle. Toiletries were provided and they have washer/dryer within the apartment.
Anna is very friendly! The appartment is very pleasent and the location is great.

We had a great time during our stay! The apartment was lovely, clean, and comfortable. The location was very central, close to restaurants and the train station, which made it easy to get around. Lukas was very responsive and friendly. Overall, it was a great experience, and we’d definitely recommend staying here!

Nono was wonderful, and the place was great. it was very easy to get to from the train, and close to everything I wanted to do. Nono was super accommodating and helpful and I would definitely stay here again!

I would stay again at Lukas’ house, it was cosy and beautiful. Close to the centre and the station. Everything was close walking Some kitchen utensils were needed but the rest was totally perfect. Thank you

Julia & her roommates went out of their way to make us feel welcome in their home - even allowing us to drop off our luggage early. We could use their kitchen, however no towels were provided so we could not shower. It worked out okay as we only stayed one night and were flying home the next morning. She told us which public transport to take to get to the airport and 43 minutes later we were there. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend staying at her place.
Great stay! The apartment is nice and cozy. There were ample supplies. Nice location.

Our stay was very pleasant, the apartment is right in the center of Zürich and the public transport is just a 3 minute walk. There are many restaurants and supermarkets nearby. The apartment was clean and warm. Please note that the host has some of their belongings in the apartment, but they didn't cause any inconveniences (for me). Overall a great experience, highly recommended!

We were initially provided a small apartment instead of what was booked. But the Swiss stay team was responsive and changed us to another apartment in same locality. otherwise we had a pleasant stay at swiss stay apartment.
Clean, close to bus and tram station. Supermarket nearby. Spacious, the kitchen also clean and we use it alot since eating out in switzerland is very expensive

Really spacious Apt and looked like the Photos and described. Very walkable area with a Supermarket just in front of the Building. Most importantly, Frank and his Team are very responsive to any questions, concerns you might have

The place was clean and nice, everything was as he described. The only struggle was parking because you have to pay to park in the streets but besides that everything was good. I’d stay there again. Very quiet area and private. Absolutely beautiful city. 5 stars, the hosts were very responsive.

The stay completely matched my expectations and had everything an Airbnb should. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in was smooth, communication was easy, and all the essentials were provided. A great experience overall — I’d happily stay again!

Good: Flat is very spacious and having 2 bathrooms was great. It was 20 swiss francs in an Uber from the airport and you could walk to the train station in about 20 minutes. Block and surrounding area felt safe with lots of local amenities. Bad: we couldn't use the wifi as the network which we had the password to wasn't showing up. The flat is very minimalist to the point of bland. None of the small lamps were charged so couldn't be used.

Had a wonderful stay at Lukas’ apartment. Lukas is friendly and responsive to our queries. The apartment is spacious and functional. Only issue that I encountered was the power sockets are by the door and none by the bedside, I had to improvise with my travel extension cord in order to use my CPAP. Otherwise all went well with the stay. Walking time is around 15min to/from Zürich HB station but the path is relatively flat and we were able to find the apartment easily via google maps navigation.

Because of the walkable distances from the Zurich HB train station, this place is perfect to tourist visiting Zurich. However, the apartment is located on the 3rd floor (4th floor for the U.S. folks) and does not have an elevator.

The apartment was extremely nice! We enjoyed our stay and we were very comfortable. The terraces were pleasant. It was quiet. Close walking distance to the old city and train station. However, we should note we stayed through New Year’s Day and it was very noisy throughout the night on New Years Eve. But otherwise, very quiet.
Good location. Convenient check in. Limited fixtures and utilities but sufficient for the stay.

Great location but beware if you are staying during the summer the room gets very HOT and there is only a fan. Safe location. Central to a lot of things to do. I was also asked multiple times by the host what time we were leaving so they could coordinate cleaning. I have never been asked this before. Considering that you’re staying in one of the most EXPENSIVE cities in the world, maybe let your guests get what they paid for and don’t try to push them out early. Weird.

Unfortunately, my stay was not very comfortable. The cleanliness did not meet my expectations – the bathroom had an unpleasant smell, and the room itself could have been cleaner (there were hairs on the bed and the floor wasn’t spotless). Since I arrived quite late in the evening, I stayed, but otherwise I might have considered leaving. With some improvements in cleaning standards, the experience could be much better.
Excellent stay. A lot of transport around to go to the center. The place itself is very clean and calm. The photos are accurate the place is easy to find. 10/10, I would definitely like to come back.

Hands down the best place, best hosts and best location. I loved how quickly we could walk anywhere plus have what we needed right in the same neighborhood. The hosts are also incredible. I hope this place is available next time I’m in Zurich

This place was fantastic for our two families with children ages four to ten. The spacious flat overlooks a beautiful church and square in one of the best locations in the city. It’s well decorated and has everything you need, and the hosts could not be more gracious. They got back to all of our questions promptly, and left a few goodies upon arrival. It was such a treat to stay here! Thank you, Nora!

We had a wonderful stay at Nora and Christian's apartment. Nora was extremely responsive and accommodating when we asked for an early check in as we were coming in early with a lot of luggage and skis. She was quick to respond and always cheerful and friendly. So lovely to deal with!! The apartment was perfect for our stay with our group of 6 as we were traveling back through Zurich on our way home from Zermatt. The apartment is large, comfortable and extremely clean. The location was fantastic in Old Town and we walked to everything...restaurants, sights, shops, bars, coffee, etc. Everything was so easy to get to. Such a great city and area to stay. Wish we were staying longer! I highly recommend their apartment!

The place was perfectct for us as we had a car and there was free parking outside. The only downside is there is a church very close so you hear the bells all the time. But this is all over Zurich. The host is super nice.

The room itself was modern and spacious but the area was incredibly noisy. There is a bar/club opposite the road that blasted music until 6am, cars honking non stop and patrons loitering around outside yelling and carrying on. Also no soundproofing on the walls/windows so we were able to hear everything making it impossible to sleep.

The apartment was a good fit for our family of 6 for a few days. Close to the Zurich train station, central tram station, the river, and old town it provides access to a lot of the city and countryside. The property was easy to access, comfortable, clean, and quiet. We would absolutely recommend staying.

The place was good and clean. When we first arrived, the windows were open and the heater was not working properly. But the host was easy to reach even in the late night and he solved the problem the day after. The downside is only it has no elevator.
Great location and surprisingly quiet for being right next to the station. A very neutral decor, but the home cinema projector was a nice touch.
Great place in the heart of the city. Clean, comfortable, and a convenient location. Great option for the price :)

I couldn’t get the key to the flat even on the next day. There was a problem with the lockbox, and I was messaging back and forth with support, but they said they couldn’t do anything, even the next morning (I spent the night elsewhere). I had to look for another place. The host refunded my reservation
The apartment is very nice and clean. It's only 5 minutes away walking from public transportation that can take you to the center of Zurich in 15 minutes. We had a great time :)

We had a very pleasant stay at this Airbnb. The place was extremely comfortable, clean, and well-maintained. The location was also very convenient, with easy access to public transportation nearby, which made travelling around much easier for us. The only downside was that the apartment was located on the 3rd floor without a lift. We had to carry 6 pieces of luggage up the stairs, which was quite challenging. Other than that, everything was great and we enjoyed our stay very much.

It’s a great place for a large family, very clean, everything is new and in perfect condition, and it’s conveniently close to the station. The only downside is that there’s no hair dryer in the room, but everything else was perfect.
Beautiful, spacious apartment. However, all three air conditioners weren’t working, had to open the windows and with all the noise had zero sleep.

Amazing place to stay for a night or two in Zurich. The Aelpli-Bar downstairs is a wonderful bonus and the staff was very kind! We loved getting to listen to traditional Swiss music. The only downside is that the blankets provided are very thin and small so it can get quite chilly.

The place was great and clean. It was in a lively neighborhood with plenty of places to eat and supermarkets nearby. Had some problems with the parking key but the host was very helpful in making sure the problem is solved. The house had everything we needed. Will definitely recommend.

Well placed, quiet, clean mainly however missing basic essentials. Soap and washing up liquid are the bare minimums to be able to wash your hands and wash the dishes and for the high price we paid for our nights there it’s the very least that can be provided. Thank you for sharing this feedback with the owners

Overall great stay. Nicole was great and made check in easy. She also responded well the first day. Plenty of towels and place was nice and modern. However, some of the materials are hard to locate. Asked where the laundry detergent pods may be and was left on read. Besides that, parking and everything else was great.

Nicole was an amazing host. Our flight got cancelled and we missed our first night in Zurich. Nicole was understanding and refunded us the first night stay. The place was clean and had all the amenities you need. Location was great. Walking distance to train/tram/bus station. 15 min train ride from the airport and 10 min train ride to Zurich HB. Quiet area not too much noise. I would recommend staying here. The only downside I would say is that there is no elevator/lift and you have to walk up 2 flights of stairs so be aware if you have big/heavy luggage.

This was one of my best Airbnb stays. Pia was incredibly friendly and truly the most communicative I’ve ever had…she gave great tips and made everything easy. The place was super clean, beautifully decorated, and right in the heart of Zurich. I’ll definitely stay here again when I’m back.

The room itself was very comfortable. It was clean and everything was in good condition. Regarding the reservation messages, I received what seemed to be standard automatic instructions. There were two messages, each with a different address. Unfortunately, I didn’t notice that and went to the first address I received. I assume this was due to some management oversight and that the messages were sent automatically. The bedding was clean, and there was laundry detergent available. There was also a dishwasher, but no dishwasher detergent. (I understand that detergent is optional, but I’m mentioning it for the reference of future guests.) The location was excellent — close to a supermarket, a tram station, and the lake is just nearby.

Chris and Tsering were very responsive and friendly. The apartment is a short walk to the Zurich train station and close to lots of grocery stores and restaurants. Just a short walk to the heart of Zurich.

Tsering is a wonderful and passionate host! He gave us a very warm welcome and shared great recommendations about the local area. The apartment itself is quite spacious. The kitchen is basic and doesn't have oil or seasonings, so you’ll need to bring your own if you plan to cook. We also suggest some maintenance for the facilities, as the front door lock is a bit tricky to use. However, Tsering’s service was excellent. When we felt the room was a bit stuffy, he immediately delivered an electric fan for us, which we appreciated a lot. Overall a very attentive host!

Location location location! Great location can’t stress it enough. Coop was like a 3 minute walk and restaurants were a 5 minute walk. Host was Great. Recommended some great restaurants in the area. Views were great as well. Would recommend to anyone.
Everything worked out splendidly! Communication, check-in and check out were super easy! The flat is very spacious and easy to reach the old town! Thanks a lot!!

The location of this apartment is great! Several minutes’ walk away from the central station. The bus stop is also very close so it’s quite easy to hang out around the city, or go to the airport. The apartment is easy to be found and check-in intro is quite clear. It’s hard to find such an apartment with this reasonable price in Zurich. However, the heater is not warm enough and we couldn’t find the remote control to turn on the AC. The landlord didn’t reply to my text the whole night. Luckily we found extra duvet in the cabinet so we didn’t suffer from the coldness a lot. More unfortunately, somehow we were not able to get hot water when we tried to take shower the next morning… Maybe it was a coincidence but it did make us not pleasant.

The apartment is well located and easy to reach from the airport and from the city center The communication with the host was great and the check-in very flexible and easy. Unfortunately there was no wifi in the apartment even though it was mentioned on the listing. Another downside is that the bathroom has no door.

The place is functional. Pretty small and generally modest, but everything works. Roof windows don’t have blinds, including the bedroom (I just used a sleep mask, and had good sleep). Heating is adequate. There’s no wifi, but the cellphone reception is very good

Overall a decent stay! Apartment is quaint and fits the description. The host is very responsive and all basic amenities are there. The elevator in the building is also a plus. The only two downsides were the bed (not that comfy) and a smell, I assume from the heating.

Had a great stay at Delta City Hotels. The place is spotless, comfortable, and in a super convenient location. Everything ran smoothly — and the self check-in system was excellent, very clear and efficient. Overall, fantastic experience — would definitely stay again!

My teen daughter and I had a truly fabulous one-day stay. Jaybee was a spectacular host. The apartment was easy to find, safe, quiet, well-located, impeccably clean, and spacious/well-organized/full of amenities for the size... It was a perfect stay. We slept very well. Highly recommended.

A great home base for exploring Zurich! The apartment is an easy 20 minute walk from the train station and Old Town in a quaint residential area. Jaybee was super responsive and quickly responded to any questions we had. An amazing spot I'd recommend to anyone!

This cozy studio apartment looked newly renovated, was very clean and had everything I needed for my short visit to Zurich. Description and pictures are accurate. Nice size modern bathroom. Kitchen is well equipped. Elevator was helpful as I had luggage. Having laundry in the basement is very convenient. Neighborhood is residential with a few restaurants near by but they seemed to close early. 10 to 15 minutes drive to the city center where more options are available. Or a 8 minute walk to the nearest train station and from there the central station is a only 5 minute ride. Communication was prompt. Overall a very good place to stay.
Nice location, a little further away from the centre than I realised but with good transportation nearby. Flat was as expected, clean and comfortable.

We really enjoyed our stay here 10-15 minute walk from the front of the station really would recommend staying here if you are looking for an apartment to stay near to the station and easily walkable to the city center which is about 20 minute flat walk
Our stay was really nice and we had a good time. Arieli is also a very nice person with a cozy apartment. The only negativ aspect was that the house itself is noisy.
Lovely place, lovely neighborhood, 15 minute walk from the historic center and the lake. Marvellous place would definitely stay there !

We had a great time in Zürich! The apartment was very clean & cosy. It is located in a very nice district, with the train station & Bellevue station close by. The apartment was spacious, nicely styled and it felt like a home, even though it was just for the weekend ;)

I rented this place for a few days during a work-related visit, and it was perfect for my needs. The apartment was furnished in a modern style and felt like just renovated. Despite the small space, it had all the necessary amenities, making it very comfortable. It was also spotless – cleanliness was top-notch. The location was great – very close to the main train station and within walking distance to the city center, which made it easy to get around. The only downside was a bit of noise from the upstairs neighbors and some street activity due to its proximity to a lively area, during Fridey night but it didn’t detract much from the overall experience. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for a cozy and convenient stay!

Great place, small but ideal for a quick trip in the city, 5 min walk from the train station but still quiet. the only thing that would be nice to have in the room is a clothes hanger for the jacket but otherwise everything was there, bathroom and kitchen well equiped, everything was very clean. I highly recommend it and I would stay there again.

The home was very clean, and convenient to the tram stop. The beds were also very comfortable. Only downside for us was that the furniture wasn’t the most kid friendly and there was wasn’t cleaning supplies provided. With 3 small kids it’s helpful to have a vacuum cleaner or broom to clean up after meal time. Overall we had a great stay!
Lovely apartment. Very clean, very good communication and description. Well located, 2 blocks from the tram. The only thing is that there is no elevator and it feels like 6 floors instead of 4.

Apartment was good. But there was wrong information passed. - Information was given like 2bed rooms and 2bath rooms. But in actual if we need to access the second bed room we have to go through first bedroom. Bed rooms not accessible separately. - Even though two bathrooms are there we can bath in only one since hot water facility is provided to one bathroom only. - There is changeover switch for boiler and hob. Only one can be switched. -There are no lights outside the apartment at night . - Host was responsive for all the messages. - Location is good and nearby to tram stop.

The apartment is located very close to orelikon station which makes it convenient but it’s very very loud, you can hear trains passing by. So if you need a quiet place, I highly do not recommend. The apartment is relatively small but it’s modern and clean . The bed is extremely uncomfortable unfortunately.
This is a very nice place. It was very clean and had everything we needed. The train and bus were within easy walking distance. Having an elevator was a huge plus.

Barnabas was a great host and always quick to reply. The flat was very clean and comfortable, and even though the train tracks was right outside, it really wasn’t a bother at all. In fact, I was very happy to only have to walk 5 minutes to the train entrance, it is so close and convenient for getting around. The only thing we wished the flat had was a television, but otherwise we had a great stay. There was also a wonderful Persian restaurant down the street with delicious food and incredibly friendly staff. Overall, we really enjoyed our time here and would highly recommend it.

A bit outside of the main city, about 15 minutes drive into the heart of Zurich. there was several public transport steps close by that could be very helpful. We did not utilize these as we had a vehicle available. The only notable issue was the listing had a TV as an amenity and there was not one there. As they operate many rentals, I'm sure it was an oversight that they corrected with a price reduction as a way to make things right. Good communication and response times. Thank you for assisting us with our travel needs!
The place is right on the city center so easy walkable and lots of restaurants around.

The host is very prompt to my messages and even replaced the electric kettle when I told him it was not in good condition. He even bought another fan as there was only one in the bedroom but not the living room. However, it will be good if I was to be told earlier that I need to climb the stairs to reach the room as I have 3 luggages.

Place was in a quiet residential neighborhood with various eateries scattered around. We like that the place was well furnished, has good lighting, clean and had access to laundry (detergent not provided). Dimi was also friendly and helpful over chat. However, basic items like shampoo/soap, cooking oil and facial tissue were not provided so we had to rush to buy. Dimi said he will rectify this, so do check. I would also suggest a non-slip mat for the bathtub as my toddler slipped and fell once. Other than that, a peaceful stay.
Felt right at home in this place. Dimiter provided multiple amenities and was real responsive to our questions. It’s so worthwhile the stay especially the location and balcony view.
Very good place to stay and easily accessible. The host is friendly and responds quickly. Nice place to choose in a bustling city like Zurich

The apartment was very clean, spacious, and comfortable. The price was also very reasonable. The only thing to keep in mind is to be respectful of the quiet hours, as the neighbors are sensitive to noise. Overall, we were very satisfied with our stay.

My husband and I and our 2 small dogs absolutely loved this spot in Wiedikon. Super close to transit made it very easy to get downtown, and the neighborhood itself has several great restaurants and breweries. Would absolutely stay again and recommend to others!

Caroline's house is exactly like described. The location is very quiet and peaceful but still super close to centre and easily accessible. The kitchen has everything you might possibly need. The bathroom has heated floors which is a great feature. I'll definitely book again if I ever go to Zürich again.
Amaya is a very helpful and responsive host. The place is great, with everything you need and located close to public transport. The pretty garden is a real plus!

Good location in peaceful neighbourhood. Walk down a slope for 5 min to a train station. Shampoo and shower gel are not available although they are listed in the amenities list. The hair dryer's power cable is damaged, with exposed wiring near the plug, and the plug itself is held together with tape. There was burnt smell when I turned it on. It doesn't appear safe to use. Contacted host, host asked to get our own shampoo and shower gel. Would have been better if this is accurately explained in the listing. Host said hair dryer may be damaged by previous guest and she won’t check the hair dryer condition after every guest checks out. But the tape on the cable looks very old. Spacious and cooling unit during summer.
Haoran was a great host. We truly enjoyed exploring the beautiful historic center from this central accommodation. Very comfortable and a great place to relax!

Was okay for 1 night but wouldn’t want to stay any more nights. Location was easy to access the main station which was ideal for us but the place was very small and our biggest issues came from the bathroom in which we could hear water gurgling and the plumbing all night and the shower completely floods the entire bathroom even from a short shower. Since we were only there one night we didn’t bother the host with the issue because there was not much that could’ve been done. If we were to go back we would probably try to find a different place in a similar location. Can’t fault the host on his communication in the lead up to staying though.

This was the PERFECT place to recover from some jet jag. Once we figured out the city transit, it was very easy to get to & in a quiet private neighborhood. Once inside, Amaya’s space was absolutely beautiful and very clean. And the bed!!! It may have been the sleep deprivation, but the down bedding & linen sheets/duvet, plus the black out curtains, provided some of the best sleep my husband and I have ever had! We woke up with zero aches from our long flight and long day of walking carrying our heavy packs. I would recommend this to any couple wanting a quiet place to stay before backpacking the stunning Alps.

The accommodation was easy to find, located right next to a grocery store and bus stop, and was very clean. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely consider staying there again because of how affordable it was. The value for the money was great for an Airbnb in Zurich. The only downside was that there were no extra pillows or blankets we could find for the person who slept on the couch so they got a bit cold. Something to keep in mind if traveling would be to bring an extra blanket.
A lovely apartment with great transport links to the city, everything you could want and a responsive welcoming host
We just stayed a night, but the place was awesome! Super clean and easy to access. It was close the airport and well stocked. Loved staying here!
Modern and clean apartment in a pleasant neighborhood in the outskirts of Zurich. Easy access to public transport.

Overall, this place was great. The only thing I would mention to consider is that there is no elevator or lift and, since this place on the top floor of the building, you need to carry your luggage up several flights of stairs with the last set of stairs being very narrow. Also, the slanted ceilings inside make it difficult to sit on the couch or stand in certain places. There is also only one medium sized mirror on the wall in the bathroom but it is not located above the sink. Those were all minor inconveniences. This place was quiet, spotless, easy to check in, easy to find, and a good amount of room. The host was responsive and helpful. I used an ebike through lime/uber to ride in to the main parts of town and it was only a 10 minute bike ride.
We had a lovely stay in this property. The location was great and the hosts were very accommodating. Would recommend!

Location is great, easy access to public transport, walkable to lots of restaurants and shops. Cool little space in an old building, lots of character but still very private. The rooftop terrace was lovely to enjoy in the warm evenings. Hosts accommodated my last minute request to separate the king bed into two separate beds for my kids. I very much appreciated that! We had a lovely stay!
Really perfect location. Clean and spacious. They provided a crib for us, and some fruit, chocolate and even a few diapers for the baby. Very sweet!

Thomas and Cristian were excellent hosts! The apartment was as described and clean. We had an issue when we checked in that a window was broken but they were able to quickly find us a different apartment to stay in. It’s a great location and close to the main train station and tram stops.

The apartment was spacious and had everything we needed for our stay—including the laundry facilities. The location is incredibly convenient, sitting about a 5-minute walk from the Oerlikon train station, which is just a 5-minute train ride from Zurich HB (the main station) and 5 minutes from the Zurich airport. ​However, the only thing missing was fans. It was 93+ degrees with record-breaking heat and humidity during our visit, which made it quite uncomfortable inside the apartment. While fans are not listed in the property description, adding a few would be incredibly helpful for future guests to beat the heat, especially since houses in Switzerland typically do not have central AC.

A lovely apartment in a very nice locality. Plenty of restaurants, supermarkets and paid street parking in the vicinity. The apartment is very well maintained. The kitchen is equipped with daily essentials. There’s a tiny little balcony which overlooks the main street below. Just be aware that the elevator is a half-level above this apartment meaning you will have to take a few stairs down when you come up the elevator. It wasn’t a problem for us at all, but good to know for certain category of people.

The apartment itself inside is great and match the description. Unfortunately my first night stay not so great because of dirty beddings but the host sort it out right away the next day. Fair price but i didnt aware that outside a bit scary looking and we also met a few scary people too, which not great while travelling with kids. The location is somewhat convinient for bus, but not other public transport, the walk a bit far. Overall, the price is completely reasonable, host is friendly and responsive through message (but i couldnt call anyone), recommend for when you travel alone or as couple if you need a place to sleep and shower but not for family 😅

They call it a Royale with cheese. Amazing apartment in a super private environment. The host, Friedrich, was extremely charming and replied within minutes when I had questions. The apartment is very bright and quiet and left no desires unfulfilled. The only downside was, that Uma Thurman was not there personally for a quick dance ;-) 5 out of 5 stars I'll make sure to check out Friedrich's other listings next time I'm in Zurich...

The host was very accommodating in letting us stay last minute when our original air bnb canceled on us. They were responsive and the place was exactly what we needed. The host’s helpfulness, the location of the place, and the price helped save our vacation after a couple of very stressful days. This was exactly the relief that we needed. Would definitely stay here again thank you!!!

One of the showers wasn’t working. Some of the lights didn’t work. Several windows were open when we arrived and windows did not have screens. Several outlets didn’t work. Empty beer bottles left on the roof top. No elevator- this was stated on the description- however- with two bags per person- that was too much to carry up four flights of steps. I honestly felt sorry for the other residents- if they were home at the time of our arrival and departure due to the noise.
it was very nice and easy to find, we checked in late and spontaneously and didnt have to wait for a response. just the late check out fee is kind of high. thanks for havin me

Very clean, lovely home, suitable for a short stay. Communication with Patrick was also very easy and prompt. We travelled with a 13 month old toddler and Patrick provided a comfortable travel cot and lots of toys that kept the baby busy ! Would love to stay here again.

We had problems with the kitchen sink draining on the first night. Since the person who was supposed to fix it couldn’t come the next day, we spent the entire stay without being able to wash the dishes comfortably. In the shower, the water took a very long time to drain, so we had to turn the water off, wait, and then continue showering. The apartment is lovely and the location is excellent, but the drainage issue prevented the stay from being a 10/10.

Jaybee was a great host, and the apartment was excellent. The location was very convenient, with the tram station just a short walk away and easy access to Zürich HB. The place was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. I would definitely recommend staying here.

This apartment suited our needs perfectly. It is a quick tram ride into Central Zurich and Zurich HB. The neighborhood is nice and peaceful. Inside, everything was very clean, comfortable beds and nice linens. It was also easy check in and check out with codes that you are provided with. I would definitely recommend staying here. The host communicated very well.
Alexandru was very frinedly and always reachable when help was needed or a question was open. He explained everything well and showed us the whole appartment. Thank you for having us.

It was a pleasant stay. The studio is small but very clean and well-equipped. The host informed me that he would install air conditioning for the heat, and he did. The host is very kind and answered our questions immediately, responding politely. The space is in a great location near supermarkets and the train station. The only downside was that the bed is small, and since we were two tall people, it wasn't comfortable to sleep. And I think the 10 am check-in time was very early, haha, but you have the option to discuss it.

This was a nice stay! There is great public transport access and it is a walkable area. The kitchen setup is quite basic and the blinds are very transparent, so you wake up with the sun, but the bathroom was lovely and the apartment was easy to find!

The place is well-equipped, and the host replies to messages very quickly. The only downsides are related to the room’s lighting and temperature. The room gets extremely hot in summer no matter the windows are open or closed.
