In addition, there are no blinds on the window next to the bed, resulting in bright morning sunlight and limited privacy.

The property was in an excellent location and walking distance to the tram and close to the city (10 min by tram) the apartment was comfortable and in a quiet area. Some local recommendations for coffee shops, cafes, restaurants and supermarkets would have been helpful. The bed needs to be Queen size and not a Double. otherwise a great city apartment.

It was absolutely beautiful, clean, cozy, and next to a lot of things! The only thing I warn, especially if you brought heavy suitcases like me…. There are so many stairs and even more stairs to the apartment for when you go inside. Made it hard bringing the stuff up.

Pros: Unit very clean nice amenities. Great location easy to find. Quiet. Close to tram routes had luggage storage. Cons: About 90 steps to get to Nest Suite, serious workout with 2 large suitcase. Got very warm inside due to sunny days and being on the top of building. We asked for fans to be there when we checked in and they said they would provide them but they didn’t. No closet. Overall nice place. Make sure in good physical shape if you book on the top floors

It completely met my expectations. It was a peaceful, clean, and comfortable stay, just a ten-minute walk from the city center. I had no problems at all thanks to the detailed information provided during check-in and check-out. I would recommend it to anyone staying in the city.

Lovely place, in good location. Short walk to train station. We had a quick overnight stay, but having a washer and dryer was such an added plus, as was the elevator! Very nicely decorated flat. Wish the weather had been better so we could’ve used the rooftop patio, maybe next time.

This was the best Air Bnb we had ever stayed at! 5 star in terms of decor, location and amenities. Lovely place with gorgeous rooftop (we really enjoyed it for meals) and Nora was so responsive and kind. Fantastic just. Wish we could have stayed there longer. I will absolutely be sharing this listing with anyone headed to Zurich! We will be back :)

Negativ: Unfortunately, we had an issue as we had no warm/hot water in the apartment. We approached the host and he did not react for 12 hours. Also, the of 14 amenities listed four were missing ( essentials such as soap, shower gel, shampoo, toaster in kitchen). Also the pictures of the apartment did not match with reality. Especially the sofa was completely run down. Positiv: cleanliness of the apartment

Great location in the historic district near the main train station. Flat was spacious enough and fully equipped with the essentials and very clean. The hosts were very communicative. Little warm on the first day but the fans helped. Expect a bit of noise from the street, the place is above a bar, but nothing too disturbing.

Phil’s place was great. Excellent location and an easy walk from the main train station. Lots of public transport nearby. The apartment was super clean and comfortable. It was HOT in Zurich but the fans helped a lot. Overall we loved our stay.

I had a great stay and I’m really thankful for such a smooth and comfortable experience. The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described, which made everything stress free. The host was kind, responsive, and made sure everything was taken care of. I really appreciated the hospitality and would definitely recommend this place to others.

The flat of Eduardo is not placed in the city centre or in the middle of a hotspot, but it only takes 5 minutes by tram to get to "Lochergut" (nice area with bars/restaurants/cafés). The tram/bus stations are really close to the apartment and are just 5 minutes walk away. There’s also an Aldi under 10 minutes away. The apartment was clean and had almost everything you’d need for a stay!

Just what we needed in Zurich- close to transit and easy to find. Be aware that air conditioning is rare in Switzerland. It was very hot while we were there, but the fan was super helpful. The space is tiny, but all we needed. Would definitely recommend for a solo traveler or a couple.

This apartment was gorgeous, but the room at the back was incredibly stuffy, very small and had no ventilation for my kids. It needs an air vent or fan. We had to leave the windows open for airflow but didn’t sleep all night as it’s right above bars and restaurants. Great location though, good host and very clean apartment.
The apartment was very well located, very clean and well equipped. The double bed was very comfortable. It is rather on small side, which is the only negative remark on my side.

Overall good place location-wise. Room is spacious but there’s only one socket at far end. The WiFi is very unstable and I fail to connect 50% of the time (and I have checked with the host but no reply). However always great to have laundry machine available.

The location was excellent, and Hamza was easy to communicate with and very helpful throughout our stay. However, the bathroom and common areas were quite dirty from the time we checked in, which was very dissappointing for us.

Hamza goes above and beyond! He is genuinely so nice. I requested a few favors, and he took care of everything without hesitation. He responds to messages right away and is always available. The location is great. clean and conveniently walkable to the train station :) thanks Hamza

Overall, this place is what you’d expect for your money’s worth. Hamza is really responsive but I found that my experience fell short due to the environment. Kitchen and bedroom was clean when I arrived. However, I knew I’d be going into a place near the station and without AC but I didn’t expect to hear so much noise from people up to 4 am, which made it hard to sleep. In addition, there is a drainage problem in the bathroom and sometimes did make the shower process longer. Therefore it was an okay experience, but the restaurants around this Airbnb were fantastic!

Host super responsive, apartment was well fitted out and in a great location. There were plenty of sockets, adaptors and a hairdryer. We had the sofa made up throughout the stay but there was a table and chairs to sit at. Just right for three girls travelling together. If you’re not a fan of bar/street noise throw in some ear buds. It’s the compromise of being so central but also means there’s plenty of places to eat. Check-in and checkout instructions were clear and easy to follow.

The place is nice and very well located. Nora communicated very well with me. I think the place is overpriced but still went for it because I value my comfort. The only issue is the absence of air conditioning which made the place incredibly hot I didn’t stay 10 minutes in the place. I just booked a hotel and wasted the money spent on booking. The place is great and Nora is amazing but I wouldn’t recommend in summer time.

Your rental apartment was absolutely amazing. We really loved the layout of the house with its many rooms. The beds were very comfortable and soft, and the kitchen was spacious, with two refrigerators. We especially appreciated that all the spices, dishes, utensils, and absolutely everything needed for living in the house were provided. Everything was simply excellent. If we have the chance to return to Switzerland, we will definitely look for this accommodation again. Thank you very much.

Apartment close to the tram station. Good localization. However the system for warming the shower water is annoying (you have to use a switch) and the apartment is badly insulated so you can hear everything happening in the corridor (and it is close to the entrance door). Beside these issues, it was fine.

This was a great deal in Zurich! Super close to the tram which made getting around the city a breeze. The only downside would be the noise from the neighbors, but other than that the apartment and host were great!

Great place to be if you like quiet and peaceful settings. Close several biking and hiking trails. Close migros and coop. The only thing it needs is a TV and maybe a little more furniture for the living area. But overall it was a nice stay.

this was an amazing spot, very beautiful view of the surroundings from the apartment, very clean, and was in a very calm and peaceful neighborhood. Although checking in has too many steps, but they do a good job of providing the instructions. They are really responsive and a great host. Very much recommend this place.

i’m very lucky to find Michal listings at the last minute before my europe trip. And somehow i got this amazingly comfortable studio to live in while staying in Switzerland. first of all, i texted Michal saying that my arrival time to Switzerland is going to be earlier than expected, and he let us to check in earlier, so thankful for that. when we got inside the house, everything is squeky clean and the neighborhood is so peaceful even when it’s located near the big road you cant hear any car from inside the house. Michal is so responsive and guide you through anything you need. Thank you so much and definitely recommend everyone to book at his place while in Switzerland !!!

We enjoyed our stay at Michal’s place. The apartment was very nice - clean, spacious and comfortable. The location was within walking distance of the train and markets. Michal was a very communicative host. I would highly recommend staying here!
Great place to stay that is 15 mins away from the Zurich HB. Apartment was exactly as listed. Michael was very helpful and responsive with messages.

We stayed there during Easter holidays of 2026. Got our room on the 4th level which is basically on the 5th floor. There is no elevator in the building. So, we had to take our luggage all the way using stairs. We got help from the cleaner during our checkout though. There were not sufficient amount of utensils, coffee, tea etc. However, when we asked, Haoran brought some cups and we bought whatever we needed from the nearby grocery store. To keep the wifi running we needed to keep the TV turned on all the time. Otherwise the wifi dies down. Overall, Haoran was a very responsive host but the place needs some upgrades.

I went on a business trip so I found the apartment as close as possible to my work location for the best price. The place is really clean, cute and neat and the instructions are really clear and communication was very good. The only downside things were the fact that The street is extremely noisy so if you want a really peaceful place, this is not it. The coffee machine was not working which was a minor issue for me and Carl responded pretty fast to bring a new one. All in all I would go back but I would bring my earplugs again

Carl was great and responsive throughout our stay. He took care of everything we asked for, and when the internet went down, he quickly offered temporary solutions that worked well for us. The apartment was clean, and the kitchen was fully equipped with everything we needed. We stayed for several days and felt somewhat comfortable overall. The location is excellent and very convenient. However, the noise level was difficult for us. The apartment does not have air conditioning, and during our stay the temperatures were quite high, so we needed to keep the windows open. Unfortunately, this made the street noise much more noticeable, and it affected our comfort.

Absolutely perfect location on the tram line, bakery across the street. The apartment itself is beautiful, but the kitchen was lacking some essential items for cooking which was a bit of a pain. Beds were comfortable, and we had everything else we could need.
Clean and spacious apartment. Responsive and friendly host. Only downside was carrying our luggage to the apartment floor. But highly recommended for people travelling light.

The location was really perfect to be a let to get around Zurich. The parking on the street is very hard to find overnight. But the parking garage down the street worked well. The construction noise is not a problem with the good windows. The place is clean and exactly as described. Very good communication. We had a great stay

The location was perfect. However I was very surprised that there were no elevators as this apartment is on the 4th floor. The apartment was clean, however it did come with very creaky outdated floors. Beds were very comfortable, bathroom is large and clean.
Everything was good overall. The only issue was the front door — it was difficult to open and should be fixed. Other than that, the stay was pleasant.

Nice place, close to all necessary amenities. The apartment is simple yet nicely furnished. The kitchen is really well-equipped and easy to use; it was perfect for a long, 15-day stay. The building is really modern and you won’t hear any neighbors. You can notice the trains during busy hours, but it quiets down in the evening, so you will sleep well. The only easily fixable downside: the blanket for the bed is a bit too small, and the sheets are a bit lackluster. Apart from that, perfect!

This is a gem of a location, about a 15 min tram ride from the main train station, 30 min downtown. The neighborhood is lovely and there is a great park with a wonderful play structure near by. Other services are also close by. The apartment is small (as posted) but the space is well laid out. There is tons of storage in closets and drawers. The kitchenette is just enough with a good dishwasher and refrigerator/freezer. Again, good use of the space. The bathroom doubles as a hangout spot if you have a sleeping kid. The blinds make it very dark. Jaybe was an excellent host, proactive and responsive. Check-in directions were clear and operating the 6. He proactively added an AC unit to the apartment which was needed during a heatwave in an attic unit.
the place is easy to find, near main station and the neighbourhood was ok

Nice clean apartment, we stayed for one night but the place is neat and organized. Recommended. They provided us with a baby cot too when we asked, but missing the pillow for the cot. Extra pillows for guests would be nice.
Apartment was really spacious and clean, and the host was responsive to my questions. I had a pleasant stay here!

I had a wonderful stay at Zengbao's place. Clean, quiet, comfortable, coffee- and tea-equipped, and close to restaurants and supermarkets. Zengbao is a very nice, friendly, and kind person. Also, check-in instructions were easy and clearly communicated by the host. I would definitely book this place again.

We were very happy with our stay here. Throughout the whole process, our host was always very attentive and helpful. He regularly checked in with us about our arrival times and plans so he could arrange everything accordingly, and whenever we needed something — like hot water or any kind of assistance — he was always quick to help. The location may require around a 30-minute walk from the train or bus station, but if you do not mind walking a bit, it is absolutely manageable and worth considering for the warm hospitality you receive.

i had a lovely stay at Teresa's place! the whole apartment has such a cozy atmosphere, the bed is super comfortable - really perfect after a long day of walking around. it's conveniently located next to a bus/tram stop that takes you to the city center and the main train station. the only minor problem i had was that my data roaming didn't work the first day, and since there's no wifi at Teresa's place i could only fix the issue the next morning at a cafe that had free internet. thanks for having me, i had a great time overall!
Nice and quiet location. public transport right near the apartment.

The place was very clean and enough for the few days that we stayed, however, the bed was very uncomfortable. It sank in heavily in the middle, making it difficult to sleep. The location is nice, close to the public transportation and very close to the grocery store. However, there are no fans or AC so if you want to open the window at night, be prepared to hear noise until 2-3 in the morning.
The accommodation was better than I expected, everything was clean and nice. The tram was right outside the door, the only disadvantage was that the tram could be heard even at night.

If you just need a place to sleep and keep your things, this is it. It is very basic. As pictured, the bed is very low to the floor and quite uncomfortable. There is only a little fan that didn't do anything in this heatwave. It is also is very noisy and constantly moves directions on its own. Also, while it states there is a washer/ dryer, what it doesn't say is that it is shared and you have to pay to use it. However, it is conveniently located near Zürich HB (12 minute walk or 10 minute tram ride) and there are teams nearby (3 minute walks). They were flexible in check in time, which i appreciated.
We were the first family to stay here! It was quiet, calm and sunny. The hosts were great, helpful and welcoming. If you’d like to stay near the city of Zurich, you should stay here!

We had a wonderful stay at Ahmad’s house. The home was spacious, clean, and exactly as described. The check-in process was easy, and Ahmad was responsive and helpful whenever we had questions. The location was great, with easy access to Zurich and nearby attractions. We especially appreciated having enough space for our family and the convenience of the free parking spot. Thank you for hosting us and helping make our trip to Switzerland enjoyable. We would gladly stay here again and recommend this home to other families visiting the area.
Ahmad was a great responsive and proactive host especially when we encountered issues over some appliances and made the effort to rectify them to the best of his ability.

A small and compact studio apartment with modern amenities and well cared for. The host made sure that directions for use for each appliance was clear and available. The apartment is well sited in a quiet residential neighbourhood with excellent transportation links. The host was very prompt and polite in his communication.

Rebecca was transparent, responsive, and always willing to help. The place was clean, easy to access, and well connected to both Zurich city center and the airport by tram. The small kitchen is fully functional; I would have appreciated having a frying pan or something similar for cooking, but there are supermarkets close by, so it was easy to manage.

Awesome stay, very close to Zurich HB. There are plenty of food options, bars, and a kiosk just one minute away. The apartment is amazing, and the room is beautiful. Hatam is an excellent host—very friendly, helpful, and highly cooperative throughout the stay. The apartment has a lift and plenty of natural light during the day. The only small improvement I would suggest is adding a little more lighting in the bedroom and bathroom for nighttime use. Other than that, everything was perfect. I would definitely stay here again, and next time I will contact Hatam directly.

Very very beautiful stay the host is very helpful Just some kitchen utensil’s are missing but he given me the voucher ihave bought it and i left there after my use but the climate was also good not too hot but after night its cold no need fans and ac the water beds rooms everything super clean especially the host is very very very help full its very near to city center and compare to his own website in air bnb the price is high thank q I enjoyed a very lot

This apartment was very spacious which was super nice and had 2 separate bedrooms in addition to a living rooms. Also close to train station! Unfortunately, it had a very strong smell of cigarettes that made it uncomfortable walking into the apartment and even into each room no matter how long we were inside for, it was impossible to become nose blind to. Also, the curtains were see through so we were woken up by the sunlight each day which was unfortunate. The host was very kind and the place was clean but just could have done without the smell and liked some thicker curtains.
the place was great! the only downside was that there was no AC and it was very hot this weekend, but there is a heater so in colder seasons it would be fine!
